description: In US-East production, the Session Controller is displaying incorrect tenant data for approximately 130 users. Additionally, we are seeing intermittent HTTP 403 and HTTP 401 errors when trying to access valid sessions. This is a high-impact issue.

title: Rate limit exceeded on Analytics Dashboard in production (LATAM)
description: We are seeing a lot of errors on the production Analytics Dashboard for our LATAM region. The system is throwing 'rate limit exceeded' messages, which prevents users from viewing their reports. This is affecting roughly 415 active users right now and is blocking critical business monitoring. We need to know why the dashboard is hitting these limits and how to increase the threshold or stop the throttling so our team can continue working.

title: Critical Compliance and Data Residency Issues in Payment Gateway v2
description:
We have identified several critical issues with Payment Gateway v2 in the production LATAM environment that are impacting compliance. Specifically:
1. Data residency flags are mismatching expected values for certain transaction types.
2. The recent compliance report generation failed to include all required fields, resulting in an incomplete document.
3. The configured data retention policies do not appear to be being applied to stored payment records.

These issues affect approximately 4,327 users and pose a significant compliance risk. We need urgent assistance to investigate the data flow and policy enforcement mechanisms.

title: Analytics Dashboard performance degradation and intermittent failures
description:
Users are reporting that the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West production environment is becoming very slow to load. We are also seeing intermittent failures where the dashboard simply fails to render data or times out completely. 

We are confident this is purely a capacity limitation issue. Our traffic has increased slightly, and it seems the dashboard servers are just maxed out and cannot handle the current load. Please provision more resources or scale up the backend to resolve this bottleneck. Note that no specific business impact metrics are available, and user count errors are currently showing 0, but the performance lag is noticeable.

title: SSO Error Page appearing in Payment Gateway Staging Environment
description:
When attempting to log into the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment in US-East, we are encountering an SSO error page. This is currently affecting only 2 users and has low business impact.

We suspect this is definitely an operator error on our end. One of our team members might have entered the wrong credentials or clicked the wrong link during a test session. We think the system is working correctly and the issue is just a user mistake.

title: MFA prompt missing in SSO Sandbox
description: Hi, the MFA prompt is not appearing for some users in the SSO Integration Module sandbox environment. This is happening in US-West. It affects about 5 users. We are trying to test the new login flow but can't get past the first screen. Please advise.

title: Event Tracker causing mobile app timeouts and slow performance
description:
We are observing significant performance degradation in our mobile application in the production US-West environment. Users are experiencing slow response times, frequent timeouts, and general sluggishness when interacting with features that rely on the Event Tracker.

This impacts approximately 40 users and is having a moderate negative effect on customer satisfaction. The issue seems correlated with data syncing events triggered by the tracker. We need assistance debugging why the tracker is causing these client-side timeouts.

title: High Latency in Analytics Dashboard Sandbox - Critical Impact
description:
The Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM sandbox environment is experiencing extremely high latency. Response times are unacceptable for our testing workflows. This is currently impacting a large user base of roughly 11,442 testers, making it a critical blocker for our release schedule.

We believe this is due to an idempotency or duplicate-processing failure in the dashboard's data aggregation layer. It seems like requests are being processed multiple times or stuck in a loop, causing the lag. We are confident this is a code logic error related to request handling and not a network issue.

title: Full Outage of Analytics Dashboard - Service Unresponsive / 503 Errors
description:
We are reporting a full outage of the Analytics Dashboard in the production US-West environment. The service is completely unresponsive for users. Direct API calls and web interface attempts are returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors.

This affects approximately 77 users and has a moderate business impact as analytics data cannot be accessed. The outage appears to have started recently. We need confirmation of the status and an estimated time to resolution.

title: Duplicate Subscription Charges in Payment Gateway v2 Development Environment
description:
During testing in the development environment for Payment Gateway v2 in US-East, we discovered that subscription payments are being charged twice. 

When a user initiates a subscription renewal or initial signup, the transaction is processed, but a duplicate charge is also created shortly after. This is a functional bug in the payment processing logic. Although the reported business impact is currently 'none' and affected users are '0' (since it is a dev environment), this must be fixed before promotion to higher environments.

title: High Latency and Intermittent Failures in Mobile App (LATAM)
description:
We are experiencing high latency and intermittent failures within our Mobile App in the production LATAM environment. Users report that actions take a long time to complete, and occasionally the app crashes or fails to sync data entirely.

This affects approximately 35 users and has a moderate business impact. The issue seems regional to LATAM. We need help identifying the root cause of the network or service-level latency.

title: Config Manager Unresponsive with 502 Errors and Certificate Warnings
description:
In the EU-Central sandbox environment, the Config Manager service is behaving erratically. We are receiving HTTP 502 Bad Gateway errors, and the service often becomes unresponsive. Additionally, users are seeing certificate warning prompts when trying to access the interface.

This affects 9 users with low business impact. We are convinced this is a rate limit misconfiguration issue. We believe our test scripts are hitting the API too frequently, triggering throttling that results in the 502s and the unstable connection causing the cert warnings. We need the rate limits adjusted.

title: Duplicate Accounts Created via Onboarding Wizard
description:
We have identified an issue in the production Onboarding Wizard in the EU-Central region where duplicate user accounts are being created. When a new user completes the signup flow, the system generates two distinct account entries with the same email address.

This is affecting 27 users and has a moderate business impact due to data integrity concerns. We need to understand why the validation step is failing to prevent duplicates and how to clean up the existing affected accounts.

title: Rate Limit Exceeded Errors in SSO Integration Module
description:
Users in the ANZ production environment are encountering 'rate limit exceeded' errors when using the SSO Integration Module. This prevents successful login attempts for a portion of our user base.

The issue affects approximately 28 users and has a moderate business impact. We need to determine if the current rate limits are too aggressive for our traffic volume or if there is an abnormal spike in requests causing this throttling.

title: MFA Manager Issues: Timeouts and Errors (ME Region)
description:
In the Middle East production environment, the MFA Manager is showing signs of instability. Users are reporting timeouts and errors during the authentication process. We also see status indicators suggesting issues with upstream dependencies.

This affects 78 users with moderate business impact. At this stage, we have insufficient information to determine the root cause ourselves. It could be network-related, configuration, or provider-side, but we are unsure. We need engineering assistance to diagnose the source of these failures.

title: SSO Provisioning Stuck and Sync Delays in LATAM Production
description:
We are experiencing synchronization delays in the SSO Integration Module in the production LATAM environment. Specifically, user provisioning jobs are getting stuck and not completing. New users are not appearing in the system promptly, and existing user attributes are not syncing correctly.

This impacts 8 users and has a low business impact currently, but could escalate if provisioning remains blocked. We need investigation into the sync queue and job processing logic.

title: High latency and poor performance on mobile app in APAC region
description: We are experiencing significant slowdowns on our mobile application for users in the APAC region. The analytics dashboard shows high latency metrics correlating with this behavior. This is affecting about 32 users and has a moderate impact on our business operations. We need this investigated to improve the user experience.

title: Webhooks not triggering for events in ME region
description: In our production environment within the ME region, webhooks configured via the Analytics Dashboard are failing to fire. Approximately 34 users are affected, resulting in a moderate business impact. We need support to determine why these events are not triggering as expected.

title: Audit log gaps and data residency mismatches in EU-West dev env
description: While working in the development environment (EU-West) using the Analytics Dashboard, we detected discrepancies in the audit logs and a mismatch in the data residency flags. This affects around 33 users and is considered a moderate issue. We need assistance in resolving these data integrity and compliance flag errors.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Invoices, double charges, and undercharges
description: We are seeing a range of billing issues with Payment Gateway v2 in LATAM production, including incorrect invoices, subscriptions being charged twice, and instances of undercharging. This has a high business impact affecting 727 users. We think this is definitely a data migration defect causing these financial discrepancies.

title: Identity Vault: Wrong data display and HTTP 403 errors for 2 users
description: Two users in the ME production environment are encountering HTTP 403 errors and seeing incorrect data within Identity Vault. This appears to be an access grant issue. The business impact is currently low given the limited number of affected users, but we need it resolved.

title: Permission Engine SSO redirect loop affecting 733 users
description: The Permission Engine is causing an SSO redirect loop in the EU-Central development environment. This is a high-impact issue affecting 733 users. Please investigate the authentication flow for these users.

title: Issues with Data Export Service in APAC sandbox
description: We're having problems with the Data Export Service in the APAC sandbox. There are duplicate accounts being created and password reset emails are missing. This affects 47 users and has a moderate impact.

title: Analytics Dashboard slow response and high CPU in ME sandbox
description: Users in the ME sandbox environment are experiencing slow responses from the Analytics Dashboard, accompanied by spikes in CPU usage. This is affecting 191 users and is considered a high impact issue. We need performance tuning or a fix for this.

title: Missing audit log entries in Help Center EU-Central prod
description: Audit log entries are missing in the Help Center production environment for the EU-Central region. This affects 21 users and has a moderate business impact. We think this is definitely caused by stale internal documentation followed during implementation.

title: Payment Gateway v2 invoice issues
description: Invoices are incorrect for Payment Gateway v2 in EU-West production. This is a critical issue affecting 2070 users.

title: Analytics Dashboard API empty responses
description: The Analytics Dashboard API is returning empty responses in the US-East sandbox. This affects 512 users and has a high business impact.

title: Bulk import failure in SSO Integration Module
description: Our bulk import process in the SSO Integration Module for the ANZ production environment has failed completely. This affects 5 users and currently has a low business impact. We need assistance to retry or diagnose the import failure.

title: UI element rendering failure in Self-Service Hub staging
description: A UI element is not rendering correctly in the Self-Service Hub staging environment for the LATAM region. This is a critical issue affecting 4542 users. Please investigate the front-end display problem.

title: Payment Gateway v2 webhook failures and malformed JSON
description: We are encountering issues with webhooks not firing and receiving malformed JSON responses from Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West production environment. This affects 2 users with a low business impact. We think this is definitely caused by credential rotation not propagating properly.

title: High CPU usage on Webhook Engine in EU-West staging
description: The Webhook Engine in the EU-West staging environment is experiencing significant CPU usage spikes. This is affecting 91 users and has a moderate business impact. We need to understand the root cause of this performance degradation.

title: Dashboard slow
description: The analytics dashboard is taking forever to load. It's really laggy for everyone. Please fix.

title: SSO Sync hanging in Staging Environment
description: We are observing that the SSO integration module in our staging environment is stuck during the sync process. The status indicator has been spinning for over 2 hours and no users are being updated in the target system. Logs show the job initiated but never completed. No production impact as this is staging only.

title: Missing data in analytics
description: Data looks wrong. Files seem cut off and records are missing. Lots of people are complaining. Help.

title: Critical Payment Gateway Issues in LATAM Staging
description: We are seeing multiple issues with Payment Gateway v2 in the LATAM staging environment. Specifically, users are receiving chargeback notices incorrectly, legitimate payments are being declined, and some transactions are showing overcharges. This is blocking our release testing for over 1000 test users. Please investigate immediately.

title: KPI Tracker broken
description: Search isn't working, nothing shows up. Also some buttons are missing and forms won't submit. A lot of users are affected.

title: Payment issues
description: One user got charged twice and received a chargeback notice. The payment was also declined initially. Not sure why.

title: Analytics error
description: Getting a 429 error on the dashboard. Only happening to me.

title: Analytics Dashboard Timeouts and Webhook Failures
description: In the LATAM production region, we are experiencing frequent timeouts when loading large reports on the Analytics Dashboard. Additionally, we have noticed that webhooks configured for report generation are not firing for these timed-out requests. This is affecting our automated reporting pipeline, though no end-users are directly impacted at this moment.

title: Critical Data Mismatch and Loss in EU-Central Production
description: We are seeing a significant data mismatch in the Analytics Dashboard for the EU-Central region. Users are reporting missing records, and our internal validation shows a discrepancy between source data and dashboard figures. This impacts approximately 3400 users and is considered a critical incident due to the potential for incorrect business decisions being made based on incomplete data.

title: SSO Dev Environment Showing Wrong Tenant Data
description: In our development environment (EU-West), the SSO Integration Module is displaying data from the wrong tenant. I also encountered a 'Permission Denied' error unexpectedly when trying to access admin settings, despite having the correct role. This is isolated to my dev account but blocks testing.

title: Consent record missing
description: Can't find a consent record in the analytics dashboard. Unsure if it's there.

title: SSO Provisioning Stuck and Duplicates
description: Provisioning is stuck and we're seeing duplicate accounts being created for about 800+ users in APAC production. We think this is because of a third-party service failure on their end causing the sync to break.

title: Audit log gaps
description: Audit logs seem to be missing some entries. Not sure which ones. A few people noticed.

title: Empty responses from SSO API
description: API is returning empty responses. Affects about 30 users in APAC prod. Not sure what's causing it.

title: Analytics Dashboard API Returning Empty Responses
description: We are observing that the Analytics Dashboard API endpoints are returning empty responses for a subset of requests in the ANZ production region. This is impacting approximately 900 users who are seeing blank widgets or failed data loads. The issue appears intermittent but frequent enough to disrupt daily reporting for our teams.

title: Payment Gateway v2 errors: Rate limits and bad JSON responses
description: We are seeing multiple issues with our Payment Gateway v2 integration in production (US-East). First, we are getting 'rate limit exceeded' errors when sending transaction requests. Second, the webhook callbacks are not firing at all. Third, when we do get a response from the API, it often returns malformed JSON which breaks our parser. This has been happening for the last 2 hours and is affecting about 45 users who cannot complete checkout. Please check if the gateway itself is throttling us or if there is a bug in the response formatting.

title: High Impact: Analytics Dashboard API errors and Webhook failures (APAC)
description: Our production Analytics Dashboard in the APAC region is experiencing critical failures starting from 14:00 UTC. We are observing three distinct symptoms: 1) HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors on the main data ingestion API, 2) Webhook retries are being exhausted with no successful delivery, and 3) An API schema validation error indicating the response format does not match our expected model. This is impacting approximately 548 users and has halted our real-time reporting. Please investigate the API gateway limits and schema definitions immediately.

title: Session controller issues in dev
description: Hey, the session controller in our dev environment (US-East) is acting weird. Some users are getting 403s when they shouldn't, and others seem to have access they don't have. It's happening to about 60 of our test accounts. We can't figure out why permissions are flipping. Can you take a look?

title: SSO Notifications failing - likely third-party outage
description: We are noticing that notifications are not being delivered through our SSO Integration Module in production (EU-Central). We believe this is definitely a third-party service failure on their end, as we haven't changed anything on our side. The upstream timeout seems to be caused by their service being down. Please escalate to the vendor as we think their API is unresponsive.

title: Critical: Analytics Dashboard Data Loss and Connection Errors (EU-Central)
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in EU-Central production is failing to load historical data for approximately 995 users. We have identified that our nightly backup job failed, and subsequent queries are hitting 'database connection pool exhausted' errors. The dashboard shows empty states for all reports generated after the backup failure time. This is a high-severity issue as we cannot access last week's metrics. Please assist in restoring the backup and resolving the connection pooling issues.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Federation Metadata Mismatch (LATAM)
description: We are encountering a federation metadata mismatch error in our Payment Gateway v2 configuration in the LATAM production region. The error appears when we attempt to validate the SAML metadata against the gateway endpoint. Although no users are currently affected (0 impact), this blocks us from rolling out a new merchant integration. Please verify if the metadata URL is correct or if there is a certificate rotation issue on the gateway side.

title: Subscription Double Charging via Payment Gateway v2 (EU-West)
description: We are receiving reports from 32 users in the EU-West production region that their subscriptions were charged twice within a 5-minute window. The transaction logs from Payment Gateway v2 show two successful capture events for the same order ID. We have paused further billing but need to identify why the gateway processed the duplicate request. Please investigate the idempotency key handling in the EU-West cluster.

title: Massive Login Failures: Invalid Tokens and Expired Resets (US-East)
description: Production Payment Gateway v2 in US-East is failing for approximately 749 users. Two primary symptoms are observed: 1) Users receive 'invalid token' errors when trying to authenticate via API, and 2) Password reset links sent to users are being flagged as expired immediately upon clicking. This is preventing account recovery and API access. We suspect a clock skew or token validation rule change. Please check the authentication service logs for the last hour.

title: Admin Console Data Discrepancies and Truncated Downloads (ANZ)
description: In our production Admin Console (ANZ region), we are seeing data mismatches between the UI display and the underlying database records for 24 admin users. Additionally, when exporting large reports, the files are arriving truncated (cut off at ~5MB). This makes it impossible to audit financial records accurately. Please investigate the export buffering and data synchronization logic.

title: Analytics Dashboard API Schema Error (LATAM)
description: We are observing an API schema error in the Analytics Dashboard for the LATAM production region. The endpoint `/v2/reports/export` is returning a response body that does not conform to the expected JSON schema, causing our client-side parsers to fail. This is impacting 94 users who cannot generate custom reports. The error started appearing after our recent update to the visualization library, but the server-side response seems non-compliant with the documented API spec.

title: Funnel Analyzer Dev Environment Disk Space Full
description: Our development environment for the Funnel Analyzer (EU-West) is out of disk space. We are unable to ingest new event data, and the UI shows a 'storage limit reached' banner for 46 developers. We have deleted temporary files but the usage remains high. Please provide guidance on cleaning up old datasets or increasing the storage quota for this dev instance.

title: Fee Analyzer Showing Overcharges and Missing Refunds (ANZ)
description: High priority issue in production Fee Analyzer (ANZ region). Approximately 370 users are seeing incorrect balance figures. Specifically, refunds processed last week are not being reflected in the dashboard, leading to perceived overcharges. The data seems to be stale for the last 48 hours. We need immediate investigation into the data sync between the payment processor and the analyzer dashboard to prevent customer disputes.

title: Token Service Lockouts and Session Expiry (Staging)
description: We are testing the new Token Service in our staging environment (EU-West). We are seeing intermittent account lockouts and sessions expiring unexpectedly after only 5 minutes, despite the configuration being set to 24 hours. This is blocking our QA team from completing regression tests. Please check if the session timeout configuration is being applied correctly in the staging cluster.

title: CRITICAL: SSO Integration Module Returning Empty Responses (LATAM)
description: Our SSO Integration Module in production (LATAM) is returning empty API responses for all authentication requests. This is a critical outage affecting 18,440 users who are unable to log in or access any services via SSO. The HTTP status code is 200 OK, but the body is empty, causing our client to throw 'JSON parse error'. We have failed over to a secondary provider but need immediate assistance to restore the primary module. Please escalate this to L3 support.

title: Onboarding Wizard Failure: Disk Space and DB Pool Exhaustion (US-East)
description: The Onboarding Wizard in production (US-East) is completely down for new sign-ups. We are seeing 'out of disk space' errors in the application logs, which is causing the 'database connection pool exhausted' errors as transactions hang and time out. This is a critical blocker for 1,110 new users attempting to join today. We need immediate disk cleanup and a pool size adjustment to restore service.

title: Data Export Service failing in staging with connection errors
description: We are trying to run our scheduled backups via the Data Export Service in the LATAM staging environment, but the jobs keep failing. The logs show that the database connection pool is exhausted right before the failure. This is blocking our testing for about 60 users.

title: Report Builder issues in prod
description: Report Builder is acting up. Search results are wrong, sorting doesn't work, and sometimes it just shows a blank screen. Happening for many people.

title: SSO not working
description: Some users can't log in. They get an error page and their MFA codes are being rejected. Only a few people affected.

title: SSO Integration Module timing out for EU-West users
description: We are seeing widespread timeouts when attempting to authenticate via the SSO Integration Module in the EU-West production region. Approximately 800 users are currently unable to access the platform. The issue started suddenly and persists across different browsers and devices. Please investigate the latency in the authentication flow.

title: SSO login failures
description: Lots of users are getting SSO errors and their MFA codes aren't working. Critical impact in ANZ.

title: High latency in Data Pipeline for APAC dev environment
description: We are observing significant latency when executing data jobs through the Data Pipeline in our APAC development environment. Tasks that usually complete in minutes are taking over an hour. This is slowing down our development cycle for the team of 28. Can you check the pipeline performance?

title: Analytics Dashboard showing stale and missing data
description: Users in the APAC region are reporting that the Analytics Dashboard is displaying stale data from yesterday, while other metrics appear to be completely missing or showing zero. It's unclear if the dashboard isn't refreshing properly or if the underlying data isn't being captured. High impact on 550 users.

title: Deploy Manager failing due to network/cert issues
description: The Deploy Manager in LATAM production is throwing errors during deployment. We are seeing DNS lookup failures, warnings about expired certificates, and TLS handshake errors. It seems like the tool itself is broken because it can't connect to the target environments.

title: Can't log in
description: My login keeps looping. I think it's the Role Manager messing up my SSO redirect.

title: Certificate warning during Active Directory Sync in ANZ
description: We are receiving a certificate warning when running Active Directory Sync in the ANZ production environment. While the sync seems to proceed, the warning is causing confusion and potential security concerns for the 19 affected users. We need to know why the certificate is flagged.

title: Payment Gateway charging wrong amounts
description: Payment Gateway v2 in EU-West staging is overcharging users and the currency conversion is wrong. Huge issue for thousands of test transactions.

title: SSO redirect loop when accessing Payment Gateway v2
description: Users in the APAC region are experiencing a login loop when trying to access the Payment Gateway v2. The SSO integration redirects them back to the login page repeatedly without authenticating. This affects about 33 users and is moderate impact.

title: OAuth sessions expiring too quickly
description: Sessions are dropping unexpectedly across ANZ, affecting thousands of users. We think this is definitely a monitoring and alerting failure on your side because nobody warned us until users started complaining. Please fix the alerts.

title: Identity Vault export corrupted
description: Exports from Identity Vault in staging have garbled text and duplicate records. Seems broken.

title: Webhooks failing with 429 errors in Payment Gateway sandbox
description: We are trying to test webhook integrations with the Payment Gateway v2 sandbox in LATAM, but the webhooks are not firing. When we retry, we get HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors, indicating we are hitting a rate limit. This is blocking our integration testing for the small team involved.

title: Refunds not showing and customers being overcharged in Invoice Service
description: We are seeing a major issue with the Invoice Service in our dev environment (US-East). Customers are reporting that they are being overcharged, and when we try to process a refund, it never reflects on their statements. This is affecting about 265 users and is causing a lot of support tickets. Please check why the refunds aren't triggering or updating the balance correctly.

title: Analytics Dashboard: Data residency flag mismatch and missing audit logs in APAC Sandbox
description:
We have identified two significant issues in our APAC sandbox environment that are blocking our compliance validation.

1. **Data Residency Flags:** The Analytics Dashboard is incorrectly flagging datasets as non-resident for users in the APAC region. This seems to be a configuration sync issue.
2. **Audit Logs:** We are unable to retrieve recent entries from the audit log for these flagged datasets. The logs appear to be missing entirely for the last 48 hours.

This is impacting approximately 18,317 test users and is considered critical for our upcoming launch validation.

title: Customer Portal broken in ME
description: The customer portal is acting up. Search isn't returning the right things and sorting doesn't work. Also some buttons aren't showing up. It's in production and a lot of people are complaining. Please fix.

title: Discrepancies in Analytics Dashboard data residency and consent records (ANZ Prod)
description:
We are noticing inconsistencies in the production Analytics Dashboard for the ANZ region. Specifically, the data residency flags do not seem to match the user's location settings, and we are finding instances where consent records are missing from the dataset views.

We aren't sure if this is an issue with how the dashboard is rendering the data or if the underlying data itself is incomplete or mislabeled. It's affecting a small subset of users (3) with low business impact, but we need to understand the root cause before it scales.

title: Missing entries and gaps detected in Analytics Dashboard Audit Logs (ME Production)
description:
Our compliance team has flagged an issue with the Audit Logs in the Analytics Dashboard for the Middle East (ME) production environment. We are observing specific gaps in the timeline where expected log entries are completely missing. 

This appears to be affecting a broad range of user actions, not just a single type of event. Approximately 540 users' activities are currently untracked during these gap periods. This is a high-impact issue for our audit readiness. Please investigate why logs are not being written or retained for these time windows.

title: SSO Integration Module: Users seeing wrong data and receiving HTTP 403 errors
description:
We are experiencing issues with the SSO Integration Module in our ANZ production environment. A subset of users (approx. 64) are reporting two distinct symptoms:

1. After logging in via SSO, they are redirected to a page showing data that does not belong to their profile/account.
2. Subsequent navigation attempts often result in HTTP 403 Forbidden errors.

The issue seems to have started recently. We suspect it might be related to session handling or permission mapping after authentication, but we are seeing this as a data visibility and access control failure. Please advise.

title: Token Service: High replication lag and failed backup jobs
description:
In our ME production environment, the Token Service is showing signs of instability. We are observing consistently high replication lag, which is causing delays in token synchronization across nodes. 

Additionally, our scheduled backup jobs for this service have failed to complete successfully in recent cycles. While the immediate business impact is low (affecting primarily administrative monitoring), we are concerned about data integrity and availability if the lag continues to degrade. Please investigate the replication status and backup failure logs.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Double charges and missing refunds due to credential rotation
description:
We are seeing a high volume of issues with Payment Gateway v2 in EU-West production. Customers are being charged twice for subscriptions, and refunds are not reflecting on their statements.

We think this is definitely a problem with credential rotation not being propagated to all nodes. The recent security updates we applied seem to have broken the connection between the payment processor and our ledger. Please prioritize investigating the credential sync status.

title: KPI Tracker: Data mismatch in US-West Sandbox
description:
We have identified a significant data mismatch issue in the KPI Tracker within our US-West sandbox environment. The figures displayed in the dashboard are not aligning with the raw data source, leading to incorrect performance metrics for approximately 353 users.

This discrepancy is causing confusion in our internal testing and reporting validation. The business impact is high for our project timeline. Please help us identify where the calculation or data fetch is diverging from the source.

title: Critical Issue: Overcharges and failed refunds in Payment Gateway v2 (ANZ Sandbox)
description:
We are encountering critical billing errors in the Payment Gateway v2 integration within our ANZ sandbox environment. 

1. **Overcharges:** Transactions are being processed for amounts higher than the configured plan or checkout total.
2. **Refunds Not Reflected:** When we issue a refund via the API, the status returns as successful, but the balance does not update in the customer's view or the ledger.

This issue is blocking our launch testing for over 4,800 simulated users and represents a critical risk to revenue accuracy. Immediate assistance is required to debug the payment processing and refund reconciliation logic.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Database query timeouts affecting 706 users
description:
In our ME sandbox environment, we are experiencing frequent database query timeouts when interacting with the Payment Gateway v2. 

These timeouts are causing transaction failures and status checks to hang, impacting approximately 706 users. The issue seems to arise during peak load simulations. We need to investigate the database performance or query optimization within the gateway's data access layer to resolve these latency spikes.

title: SSO Integration Module: Failover failure and application crashes
description:
We are facing moderate issues with the SSO Integration Module in our US-West production environment. During a recent simulated outage, the failover mechanism did not trigger as expected, leading to application crashes for a subset of users (approx. 18).

The system appears to hang rather than redirect to the secondary provider or display a graceful error. This impacts our reliability targets. Please investigate the failover logic and health check configuration for the SSO module.

title: Payment Gateway v2 errors and webhooks not working
description: Payment Gateway v2 is throwing schema errors and webhooks aren't firing right. It's happening in production US-West. About 400 users are affected. Please help.

title: Identity Vault: Bulk import completely failed
description:
We attempted a bulk user import into the Identity Vault in our EU-Central production environment, and the process failed entirely. No records were ingested, and we received no granular error details, just a general failure status.

This has halted our onboarding workflow for approximately 207 new users. We need to identify why the import failed and ensure we can successfully process the batch. Please provide guidance on retrying the import or debugging the ingestion pipeline.

title: SSO Integration Module: MFA prompts missing and SSO error pages
description:
Users in our US-West production environment are reporting two issues with the SSO Integration Module:

1. **MFA Bypass:** The Multi-Factor Authentication prompt is not appearing for users who should be challenged, allowing direct access after SSO login.
2. **Error Pages:** Others are encountering generic SSO error pages when attempting to log in.

This affects about 41 users and poses a security risk. We need to understand why the MFA enforcement is inconsistent and why some sessions are failing with errors.

title: Sandbox SSO: Users receiving 403 errors and incorrect privilege grants
description: We are experiencing issues with the SSO integration in our sandbox environment (APAC region). Approximately 27 users are being granted access incorrectly. Specifically, we are seeing elevated privileges for some accounts while others are hitting HTTP 403 Forbidden errors when trying to access resources they should have permissions for. This is causing moderate business impact as we cannot accurately test role-based access controls.

title: Critical: SSO timeouts in Dev due to DNS configuration issues
description: Our SSO module is failing with upstream dependency timeouts, impacting 514 users in the APAC development environment. The vendor status page is showing an incident. We are confident this is definitely a DNS configuration problem on our end causing the resolution failures. Please advise on how to fix the DNS records to stop these timeouts.

title: Production SSO Failure: MFA prompts missing leading to account lockouts
description: We are reporting a critical issue with the SSO Integration Module in our ANZ production environment. Users are reporting that MFA prompts are not appearing during login attempts. title: SSO permissions and 403 errors in EU-Central

description: We are seeing permission denied errors in production. About 45 users are affected but it doesn't happen to everyone. Can you help?

This is impacting over 16,000 test users and blocking our release validation. Region is LATAM. Please advise.

It appears that failover did not occur automatically. This is a high-impact business issue and we need immediate assistance to restore service.

title: Slow performance observed on mobile app via Payment Gateway v2 (APAC)
description: A small group of users (about 9) in the APAC region are reporting slow response times when using the mobile app. The latency seems to be originating from interactions with Payment Gateway v2 in production. The impact is currently low, but we want to track this down to ensure it doesn't affect more customers.

title: Data Pipeline experiencing partial to full outage in ANZ Production
description: We are reporting an issue with the Data Pipeline in the Australia/New Zealand production environment. This is having a moderate impact on our business operations.

title: Incorrect overcharges detected in Billing Disputes Handler (APAC)
description: We have noticed that the Billing Disputes Handler in the APAC production environment is generating overcharges for some customers. About 10 users are affected so far. This is causing a moderate business impact as we have to manually correct these errors. Please investigate why the system is applying incorrect charges.

title: Billing Disputes Handler: Overcharges and failed renewals in EU-West
description: In the EU-West production region, we are seeing two related issues with the Billing Disputes Handler. First, customers are being overcharged. Second, we are seeing instances where subscriptions are not renewing automatically as expected. This is affecting approximately 42 users and has a moderate impact on our business.

title: Subscription renewals failing and refunds not appearing in Payment Gateway v2 (EU-Central)
description: We are having trouble with Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-Central production region. Two specific issues: 1) Some subscriptions are not renewing, and 2) Refunds processed are not being reflected in customer accounts. This is affecting 2 users currently. title: Database query timeouts when testing Webhook Engine in Development (ME)
description: While working in the development environment for the Webhook Engine in the ME region, we are encountering database query timeouts. This is currently blocking our internal testing but has no impact on users or production. We just wanted to log this so the dev team is aware of the environment instability.

title: SSO Integration Module failover did not occur in US-West Production
description: We experienced an issue with the SSO Integration Module in the US-West production environment. When the primary service encountered a problem, failover did not occur, leading to a disruption in authentication for approximately 27 users. This had a moderate business impact. Please investigate why the failover mechanism failed to trigger.

title: Attribution Engine index corruption requiring rebuild in ANZ Production
description: We have detected index corruption in the Attribution Engine within the ANZ production region. An index rebuild is required to restore full functionality. This issue is currently affecting 761 users and has a high business impact due to missing or incorrect attribution data. We need assistance triggering the rebuild and investigating the root cause of the corruption.

title: Currency Converter showing incorrect rates and billing errors (LATAM)
description: We are seeing discrepancies in the Currency Converter for the LATAM production region. The conversion rates appear incorrect, which has led to overcharges on some transactions. Additionally, refunds issued due to these errors are not being reflected correctly. While we have not yet confirmed a specific user count, these issues are present in the logs and need review.

title: Payment Gateway v2 generating incorrect tax amounts and invoices (ME)
description: Users in the Middle East region are reporting issues with Payment Gateway v2 in production. Specifically, the tax amounts calculated are incorrect, and the resulting invoices are also malformed. This is affecting about 49 customers and has a moderate business impact due to the need for manual invoice corrections.

title: OAuth Service granting incorrect access leading to data exposure in Development (APAC)
description: We are seeing a security issue with the OAuth Service in the APAC development environment. Users are being granted access incorrectly, resulting in them seeing wrong data sets. We believe this is a configuration issue with the OAuth Service causing the permission mismatch. This has a high impact on our dev testing data integrity.

title: Incorrect tax calculation and undercharges on recent invoices
description: We are seeing errors in the final invoice totals for transactions processed in the US-East region. Specifically, the tax amounts are being calculated incorrectly, resulting in customers being undercharged. This has affected approximately 67 users so far. The base prices seem correct, but the tax line item is definitely off. Please investigate the tax engine configuration as soon as possible.

title: Billing issues with subscriptions
description: Hey, we are having some problems with the payment gateway. It seems like the currency conversion is wrong and people are getting overcharged. Also, some subscriptions appear to be charging twice. Please look into this urgently.

title: SSO Integration failing in Sandbox
description: Our SSO module is not working right now. We are getting errors when trying to authenticate. It seems like the responses are malformed and the webhooks aren't retrying correctly. This is blocking a lot of our testing. Please help.

title: MFA and Federation issues
description: We are experiencing issues with MFA codes being rejected and federation metadata mismatches. We think this is definitely a capacity planning problem on your end. It seems like the server resources are insufficient to handle the authentication requests, causing these errors. Please increase capacity.

title: Missing entries in audit logs
description: The audit logs are missing some entries. We are not seeing certain actions recorded. This is critical for our compliance needs. Please check why data is not being logged.

title: Consent records missing in Analytics
description: We noticed that some consent records are not appearing in the Analytics Dashboard. This is causing issues with our data reporting. Please investigate why these records are missing.

title: Refunds and currency conversion errors in Staging
description: In our staging environment, refunds are not being reflected correctly, and currency conversions are showing the wrong amounts. We think this is because you are following stale internal documentation. The behavior doesn't match what we expected based on the latest guides, so it must be a documentation issue on your side. Please fix this.

title: Data issues in Metrics Engine
description: We are seeing missing data and mismatches in the Metrics Engine. The numbers don't look right. This is impacting our reporting significantly. Please look into the data integrity issues.

title: Account lockouts and unexpected privilege elevation in Sandbox
description: In the EU-West sandbox environment, we are encountering two distinct issues. First, several user accounts are getting locked out unexpectedly after multiple failed login attempts, even though the credentials are correct. Second, we observed that some users were granted elevated privileges without going through the proper approval workflow. This affects about 26 users and poses a moderate security risk. Please investigate the authentication logic and role assignment mechanisms.

title: MFA prompt missing during SSO login
description: Users in the US-East production environment are not receiving the Multi-Factor Authentication prompt when logging in via SSO. This is a security concern as MFA is required for these accounts. Approximately 28 users are affected. Please check the SSO configuration to ensure MFA challenges are being triggered correctly.

title: Tax and subscription billing anomalies in Dev
description: We are seeing issues in our development environment where tax amounts are calculated incorrectly and some subscriptions are being charged twice. It's unclear if this is related to the payment processing itself or how usage is being metered. Please investigate the billing logic and any potential overlaps with usage tracking.

title: Analytics Dashboard data retention and consent issues
description: The Analytics Dashboard is not applying retention policies correctly, consent records are missing, and there is a mismatch in data residency flags. This is a high-impact issue for our data governance team. We believe the problem lies within the dashboard's data processing logic. Please investigate why these specific controls are failing.

title: Invoice and tax calculation errors
description: We are noticing that invoices are incorrect and tax amounts are not being calculated properly in the LATAM region. This seems to be an issue with the Payment Gateway's invoicing module. Please review the tax calculation rules for this region.

title: Subscriptions not renewing
description: Some subscriptions are not renewing as expected. We think this is definitely an improper access review issue. It seems like user permissions are interfering with the automatic renewal process. Please check the access control lists.

title: Login loop during SSO authentication
description: A single user is experiencing a login loop when trying to access the application via SSO. They are redirected back to the login page repeatedly without being authenticated. This is happening in the US-East production environment. Please investigate the session handling and SSO token validation.

title: Analytics Dashboard performance degradation in ANZ sandbox
description: We are experiencing significant slowdowns in the Analytics Dashboard within our ANZ sandbox environment. The initial page load time has increased to over 30 seconds, and users report frequent timeouts when running complex queries. Monitoring indicates high CPU usage on the dashboard instances and database query timeouts occurring simultaneously. This is impacting about 14 users who rely on this environment for data validation.

title: Missing records in Production Analytics Dashboard (ANZ)
description: Critical issue: We have identified missing transaction records in the Production Analytics Dashboard for the ANZ region. Approximately 128 users are currently unable to access complete historical data, with gaps observed in the last 24 hours of reporting. The data appears to be present in the source system but is not populating in the dashboard views. Immediate investigation is required as this affects our monthly financial reporting.

title: Active Directory Sync causing account lockouts in EU-West sandbox
description: A large number of users (452) in our EU-West sandbox environment are being locked out of their accounts shortly after login attempts. We suspect this is related to the Active Directory Sync process. The sync appears to be triggering repeated failed authentication attempts, causing the directory to lock the accounts. This is blocking all development and testing activities for the affected teams.

title: Billing issue
description: Hey, we're seeing some problems with billing in dev. A few users got charged twice for their subscriptions. Not sure exactly when it started or which plans are affected, but it's happening. Can you check?

title: SSO Module issues: Unexpected session expirations and MFA failures in EU-West Production
description: We are encountering two distinct issues with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-West production environment. First, user sessions are expiring unexpectedly frequently, requiring users to re-authenticate every 10-15 minutes. Second, a subset of these users (approx. 16) are reporting that valid MFA codes are being rejected, resulting in failed logins. We have verified that the system time is synced and the MFA device codes are current.

title: Payment Gateway v2 anomalies in APAC Staging
description: During recent testing in the APAC staging environment, we observed three unrelated payment behaviors. 1) Legitimate transactions are occasionally returning a 'declined' status. 2) Some successful charges are being applied at an incorrect amount (overcharge). 3) Duplicate charges are appearing for single subscription renewals. These issues are isolated to the staging environment and have not affected live users, but they are blocking our release certification process.

title: Data quality issues in US-East Production Analytics Dashboard
description: We have noticed duplicate records appearing in the Analytics Dashboard for the US-East production region. Additionally, some users are reporting that the data displayed is stale, lagging behind real-time updates by several hours. While this does not impact immediate business operations, it is affecting the accuracy of our data analysis for 7 key users. Please investigate the data pipeline integrity.

title: Configuration and data inconsistencies in ME Development Environment
description: We are seeing a 'config drift detected' alert in our ME development environment. Alongside this, there are data mismatches between expected and actual values in the transaction logs. It is unclear whether the issue originates from the Payment Gateway configuration or if it is related to missing entries in the audit trail, as an environment variable also appears to be missing. This is affecting one developer's ability to test.

title: API Gateway instability in EU-West Production
description: The API Gateway in the EU-West production environment is currently unresponsive. We are seeing application crashes on the client side and the gateway is consistently returning HTTP 503 errors. This is a critical outage affecting all API traffic through this gateway. Immediate assistance is required to restore service.

title: SSO Integration Module sync delays and bulk import failures in EU-West Sandbox
description: Users in the EU-West sandbox environment (approx. 20) are experiencing significant delays in user synchronization via the SSO Integration Module. Furthermore, any attempts to perform a bulk import of users are failing completely. This is preventing the onboarding of new test accounts and delaying our QA cycle.

title: Audit and retention issues in EU-West Staging
description: There seem to be problems with the audit logs and retention policies in the Payment Gateway staging environment. Some entries are missing and the retention rules don't appear to be working right. This is a big deal for compliance. Can you look into it?

title: Active Directory Sync logs and certificate warnings in EU-Central Production
description: We are receiving a warning regarding an expired certificate related to the Active Directory Sync service in the EU-Central production environment. Additionally, we have noticed that audit log entries for sync events are missing. Currently, only 3 administrators are affected by the visibility issue, but the certificate warning needs attention to prevent future sync failures.

title: Mobile App Outage in ANZ Staging
description: The Mobile App in the ANZ staging environment is experiencing a full outage. Users cannot log in or access any features. Monitoring shows that the application pods are restarting repeatedly. This is blocking 555 users and preventing us from completing our pre-production validation.

title: SSO Sync and Provisioning Stuck in APAC Production
description: We have noticed that synchronization and provisioning are stuck for about 63 users in the APAC production environment. New hires are not receiving access, and updated profiles are not reflecting in the target systems. We think this is because of a third-party service failure on their end, as their status page showed an incident recently. Can you verify if the connector is waiting on their API?

title: Analytics Dashboard intermittent outages in EU-West Sandbox
description: The Analytics Dashboard in the EU-West sandbox environment is experiencing intermittent failures. At times, the service is completely unresponsive (full outage), while at other times it works correctly. This inconsistency is affecting 58 users and makes it difficult to perform reliable testing. We need help identifying the cause of these intermittent connectivity issues.

title: Cache Service Webhooks failing in EU-West due to rate limits
description: We are seeing webhook retries exhaust their limit for our Cache Service instances in the EU-West region. The errors indicate that we are exceeding the rate limit. This started happening around the start of our peak traffic window. Can you check if there is an issue on the platform side or if our quota needs adjustment?

title: Feedback Collector causing high latency on mobile app
description: Our mobile application performance has degraded significantly, specifically showing high latency when interacting with the Feedback Collector module. Users are reporting that the app feels slow and unresponsive during these interactions. We need to investigate why the Feedback Collector is impacting our user experience.

title: Analytics Dashboard returning empty/malformed data - Network Config Issue
description: We are experiencing moderate impact with 61 users affected in the EU-West region. The Analytics Dashboard is returning empty responses, malformed JSON, and timeouts when calling upstream dependencies. We are confident this is definitely a network configuration error on your end blocking our requests. Please review our network settings immediately as this is disrupting our data visibility.

title: SSO Integration Module returning HTTP 429 in LATAM
description: A small number of users (3) in the LATAM region are reporting HTTP 429 errors when attempting to log in via the SSO Integration Module. The business impact is currently low, but we want to ensure this isn't a precursor to a wider outage. Please advise if there are known issues with rate limiting in this region.

title: Load Balancer unresponsive and connection refused in US-East
description: Our Load Balancer in US-East is throwing HTTP 504 errors, and we are also seeing 'connection refused' errors indicating the service is unresponsive. This is affecting approximately 25 users with moderate business impact. We need urgent assistance stabilizing the load balancing layer.

title: Incorrect access privileges granted in Invoice Service
description: We have observed elevated privileges being granted incorrectly within the Invoice Service in the ANZ production environment. Six users are currently affected by this access issue. The business impact is low at the moment, but we need to correct the permission settings to ensure security compliance.

title: Duplicate accounts created via SSO Integration Module in APAC
description: We are seeing duplicate account creation issues with the SSO Integration Module in the APAC region. This has affected 56 users so far and is causing moderate business impact due to data fragmentation. We need help identifying the root cause of these duplicates and preventing further occurrences.

title: Chargeback Handler causing subscription and currency errors
description: There is a high-impact issue with the Chargeback Handler in our US-West development environment. 580 users are affected by subscriptions not renewing, incorrect currency conversions, and overcharges. This appears to be a critical failure in the chargeback processing logic that needs immediate attention.

title: Missing feature in Mobile App
description: Hi, the mobile app is missing a feature after the latest release. It was there before. Please check. Thanks.

title: Overcharges occurring via Payment Gateway v2 in ME
description: We are observing overcharge incidents using Payment Gateway v2 in the ME production environment. 49 users have been affected, resulting in moderate business impact. We need to stop these incorrect charges and refund the affected customers. Please investigate the billing logic in the gateway.

title: Analytics Dashboard webhooks timing out and hitting rate limits
description: In our ANZ sandbox environment, the Analytics Dashboard webhooks are not firing. We are seeing rate limit exceeded errors and timeouts. Three users are affected, with low business impact. Could you help us understand why the webhooks are stalling and if we need to adjust our retry configuration?

title: Analytics Dashboard timeouts
description: Dashboard is timing out. Lots of users affected. Please fix.

title: Fee Analyzer performance issues - Incomplete Rollback?
description: We are experiencing slow mobile app performance, high latency, and intermittent failures related to the Fee Analyzer in the ME production region. Two users are affected. We think this is because of an incomplete rollback of a previous update. Please check if all changes were properly reverted as this is causing stability issues.

title: SSO Integration Module notifications not delivered in ME
description: We are facing a high-impact issue in the ME production region where notifications from the SSO Integration Module are not being delivered. 410 users are currently affected. This is disrupting our user onboarding and alerting processes. We need immediate support to restore notification delivery.

title: MFA code rejected in SSO
description: Users are saying their MFA codes are rejected in the SSO module. 12 users affected. Low impact. Please advise.

title: App feels slow
description: Our mobile app is running really slow lately. Just wanted to let you know.

title: Double charge on subscription
description: We noticed two of our users were charged twice for the same subscription period. This could be an issue with how the billing system handles renewals or potentially related to administrative settings we recently adjusted in the console. Please investigate which side is causing the duplicate transaction.

title: Report Builder Export Issues: Duplicates and Truncation
description:
We are experiencing two distinct issues with our scheduled reports in the ANZ production environment. 

1. Duplicate Records: Approximately 15% of the rows in the 'Monthly Sales' report contain exact duplicate entries. 
2. Truncated Files: Several large CSV exports are cutting off mid-file, resulting in incomplete data for about 50 users. 

This is blocking our financial reconciliation for roughly 700 people. Please advise on a fix ASAP.

title: Performance degradation and autoscaling failure in APAC
description:
We are seeing significant performance issues with Payment Gateway v2 in the APAC region. Specifically:

- Memory usage has spiked sharply, reaching near-capacity levels.
- CPU usage is also consistently high during peak hours.
- Most critically, the autoscaling policy does not appear to be triggering despite these spikes. We expect more instances to launch but they are not coming up.

This is affecting approximately 380 users with high latency and some timeouts. Please check the scaling configuration and resource limits.

title: Analytics Dashboard unresponsive - Likely Auth Issue
description:
Our team in the ANZ region cannot access the Analytics Dashboard. We are getting health check failures and the service seems totally unresponsive. 

This is definitely an identity provider outage on your end. We can't log in at all, so it has to be the auth system breaking the connection. Please fix the IdP integration immediately as we are blocked from viewing any reports.

title: Refund not appearing in statements
description: We processed refunds for 7 customers in the US-West region last week, but the funds have not been reflected in their account balances or recent statements. It is unclear if this is a delay in the Refund Manager processing logic or if the data simply isn't being exported correctly to the billing records via the export service. Can you please check both the refund status and the data export logs?

title: Token Service: Missing Audit Logs and Privilege Escalation
description:
During a recent security review, we identified two concerning anomalies with the Token Service in the LATAM production environment:

1. Several successful token generation events are missing from the audit logs. We have timestamps for when these occurred but the logs are empty for those intervals.
2. We observed some tokens being issued with elevated privileges that should not have been accessible to those specific user groups.

This impacts the security posture for about 50 users. Please investigate the logging pipeline and permission validation logic.

title: Webhooks failing in Dev - Expired Cert?
description:
None of our webhooks from the SSO Integration Module are firing in the development environment. This is critical because it's breaking our integration tests for over 11,000 internal dev workflows. 

We are pretty sure this is because of an expired certificate. We checked the cert dates and it looks like it might be expiring or expired, which is definitely why the secure connections are dropping. Please renew the cert on your side.

title: Certificate Warning and Log Gaps in EU-West
description:
We received a warning regarding an expired certificate for the Payment Gateway v2 endpoint in the EU-West region. While the service still appears to be functioning for the one user testing it, we also noticed that audit log entries for transactions around the time of the warning are missing. 

We need clarification on whether the certificate issue is causing the logging failure, or if these are two separate problems. Please verify the certificate status and check why logs are not being written.

title: Staging OAuth: Duplicate Accounts and 404 Errors
description:
In our LATAM staging environment, the OAuth Service is behaving erratically. We are seeing scenarios where a single user creates a duplicate account entry, and subsequently, other requests for that same user result in 'Account Not Found' errors. 

This is affecting data integrity for about 220 test accounts. It looks like a bug in how the OAuth service handles user creation and lookup logic. Please fix the account mapping in the service.

title: Billing Discrepancies: Tax and Double Charges
description:
We are seeing incorrect tax amounts being calculated on several invoices, and in some cases, subscriptions are being charged twice. 

This seems to be an issue within the Payment Gateway v2 logic itself, specifically around how it applies tax rates and handles renewal triggers. Please review the calculation engine in the gateway to ensure tax and charge amounts are correct.

title: SSO Module: Wrong Data and Permission Errors
description:
Users in our development environment (US-East) are seeing data that belongs to other users, and some are getting 'permission denied' errors unexpectedly when they should have access. 

We think this is just insufficient information on our part or a config mismatch, but honestly, this looks like a fundamental SSO bug. It's definitely an SSO integration problem causing the wrong user context to be passed through. Please check the SSO module.

title: Event Tracker slow in dev
description: The Event Tracker in the ANZ dev env is timing out and making the mobile app lag. Not sure why. Please help.

title: Critical TLS Handshake Failures and 504 Errors in EU-West
description:
We are experiencing a critical outage in the EU-West production environment for the Config Manager. 

1. Clients are receiving TLS handshake errors when attempting to connect. 
2. Subsequently, we are seeing a high volume of HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout responses. 

This is impacting approximately 2,687 users and preventing configuration updates. Please prioritize investigation into the TLS termination layer and load balancer health.

title: Certificate Expiry Warning in LATAM Staging
description:
We are receiving repeated 'certificate expired' warnings from the API Gateway in the LATAM staging environment. 

This is causing intermittent connectivity issues for about 487 users during our integration testing. We need the certificates for the staging environment renewed or the expiration alert logic reviewed to determine if the service is actually rejecting valid connections due to the warning state.

title: Compliance report in Staging Analytics Dashboard is incomplete
description: We are seeing an issue with the compliance reporting feature in our staging environment for the Analytics Dashboard. When generating the monthly compliance report, the output is missing several sections that should be populated based on the data in the system. This is affecting our ability to validate regulatory compliance before pushing changes to production. Approximately 700 internal users rely on these reports for their workflows. Can you investigate why the report generation is truncating or omitting these fields?

title: Billing Engine Sandbox: Disk space critical and index corruption errors
description: Our sandbox environment for the Billing Engine is currently unusable due to disk space issues. We started receiving 'out of disk space' alerts recently. Upon checking the server logs, we also see messages indicating 'index corruption detected' and 'disk usage critical'. This appears to be isolated to the US-East sandbox instance. While this doesn't impact our live production users, it is blocking our development and testing activities. Please advise on clearing the space or repairing the indices.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Dev: Data residency flag mismatch and missing consent records
description: We are experiencing high-impact issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in our development environment in the ANZ region. During transaction processing, we are seeing a mismatch in the data residency flags. Additionally, several test cases are failing because the corresponding consent records are missing from the transaction payload. This is blocking our compliance team from signing off on the new features. We need this resolved urgently as it affects 112 users in our dev group.

title: CRITICAL: SSO Integration Module Access Denied for Production Users
description: We have a critical incident occurring in production (EU-West). A large number of users (approx. 13,000) are receiving 'Access Denied' errors when attempting to log in via the SSO Integration Module. The issue seems to affect all users trying to access services protected by SSO. We are unsure if the fault lies within the SSO configuration itself or if the identity provider is rejecting the requests. This is a total outage for user access and requires immediate attention.

title: Notification Hub Production US-West: Missing records and potential data loss
description: Users in the US-West production environment are reporting that notifications they expected to receive are not appearing in the Notification Hub. Furthermore, some users claim that historical notification records have vanished or are incomplete, suggesting potential data loss. This is a critical issue affecting over 11,000 users. We need to determine if these messages were never sent or if they have been purged from the database.

title: Bulk import failed for SSO Integration Module in ME Production
description: We attempted to run a bulk import of user data into the SSO Integration Module in our Middle East production environment. The process started but failed completely after a few minutes. The logs indicate that the import was aborted and no records were updated. This impacts 51 users who were supposed to be provisioned via this batch. We need to know the cause of the failure to retry the process successfully.

title: Analytics Dashboard timeouts in EU-Central Production
description: We are noticing intermittent timeouts when loading specific views in the Analytics Dashboard in the EU-Central region. The dashboard takes too long to respond and eventually shows a timeout error. This is happening on a regular basis but currently does not seem to impact business operations or user workflows significantly. We would like to investigate the cause of these performance lags to prevent future issues.

title: Subscriptions being charged twice
description: We are seeing some users get billed twice for their subscriptions in the Payment Gateway v2. It's happening in dev. Not sure when it started or which specific transactions are affected, but roughly 60 people seem to have duplicates. Can you look into this?

title: Attribution Engine Data Mismatch in ME Production
description: We have identified a data mismatch within the Attribution Engine in our production environment in the Middle East. The data reported in the dashboard does not align with the source logs for a single user's activity. This is a low-impact issue affecting only one account, but we need to understand the root cause to ensure data integrity across the platform.

title: Webhook retries exhausted
description: Looks like webhook retries are getting exhausted for some payments in the Payment Gateway v2 production APAC env. About 40 users are affected. We don't have the exact times or error codes yet but it's causing moderate issues. Please check.

title: Federation metadata mismatch and expired password reset links in SSO ANZ
description: We are encountering two related issues with the SSO Integration Module in the ANZ production environment. First, we are seeing a 'federation metadata mismatch' error during authentication attempts. Second, when users attempt to use the password reset flow, the links provided in the email are expired immediately upon receipt. This is affecting 83 users and preventing them from accessing their accounts or resetting credentials. We need assistance in resolving the metadata configuration and the link expiration timeout.

title: CRITICAL: Analytics Dashboard Partial Outage and Unresponsiveness in APAC

This is impacting approximately 3,000 users and halting our daily reporting operations. The issue appears to be widespread across the region. Immediate investigation is required to restore service stability.

title: SSO Error Page and Expired Password Reset Links in EU-West
description: Users in the EU-West production environment are encountering a generic 'SSO error page' when trying to log in. Additionally, those who manage to initiate a password reset receive emails with links that are marked as 'expired' before they can be used. We are unsure if this is a configuration issue with the SSO Integration Module or if the underlying identity vault is rejecting the tokens. Currently, this has not impacted business operations, but it is confusing users.

title: Staging Payment Gateway: Undercharging and Incorrect Currency Conversion
description: We have identified billing discrepancies in the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment (EU-West). Transactions are being undercharged, and the currency conversion rates applied do not match the expected values. This affects 23 test users. We need to correct the pricing logic and currency mapping to ensure that our checkout flows are accurate before moving to production.

title: SSO Module Down in ME Production

The users report that they cannot access their vault items despite no recent changes to their roles or permissions on our end. Please investigate why these specific users are receiving permission denied responses.

Please check the recent API updates that might have altered the response format.

title: Analytics Dashboard timing out
description: Hey, the dashboard is just timing out for us in APAC. A couple of people are trying to use it and it never loads. Can you look into it?
