title: Corrupted Export and Data Mismatch in Staging
description: In our US-East staging environment, we are trying to generate an export via Notification Hub, but the file comes out corrupted and the data inside does not match what is shown in the UI. We aren't sure if the issue is with the Notification Hub interface itself or the underlying Notification Hub Engine processing the data. Only one user (myself) is testing this right now, so the impact is low, but we need to know if the engine is failing to aggregate the data correctly before it gets exported.

title: Subscription Not Renewing and Incorrect Invoice Amount
description: We have a single customer in the ANZ production environment whose subscription failed to renew automatically, and their subsequent invoice has an incorrect total. We've looked at the settings and we think this is absolutely a policy misconfiguration on our side regarding how renewal rules are applied, so we are fixing that now. Just opening this ticket to see if the system generated the wrong invoice data due to that config error or if there is something else going on with Payment Gateway v2.

title: Role Manager Full Outage in Development
description: The Role Manager in our EU-Central development environment is completely down. We cannot access the management console or push any role changes. It appears to be a full outage affecting the entire service for our 2 developers working in this sandbox. Please investigate as we cannot proceed with testing new role assignments.

title: Webhook Retries Exhausted - Ambiguous Cause
description: We are seeing webhook retries exhausted in the Payment Gateway v2 for a few transactions in the US-West production region. When we look at the payload, it seems related to tax calculations, but we can't tell if the webhook failure is a core Payment Gateway issue or if the Tax Jurisdiction Resolver is timing out and causing the delivery failure. It's affecting 2 users so far. Please help identify if the fault lies with the gateway delivery or the tax calculation component.

title: Issues with Payment Gateway
description: Hi, the payment gateway is acting up. We are getting timeouts and lots of 429 errors when we try to process transactions. It's really slow and failing for some of our customers. Please fix asap.

title: Analytics Dashboard Slow and Backup Failures
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in EU-West production is responding very slowly and we are getting errors about the index needing a rebuild. On top of that, our scheduled backup jobs are failing completely. We have a feeling this is all due to a version incompatibility between the dashboard module and the backend database service we updated recently, so we are rolling back that version. However, the slowness is impacting 670 users so we wanted to check if the platform sees anything else.

title: Access Denied and Wrong Tenant Data in Invoice Service
description: We are experiencing serious access control issues with the Invoice Service in the ME production environment. Some users are receiving 'Access Denied' errors when they should have permission, while others are seeing 'Access Granted' incorrectly and, more concerningly, seeing data from the wrong tenant. This is a moderate impact affecting about 81 users. Please check the permission mapping and tenant isolation logic immediately.

title: Partial Failure in SSO Bulk Import
description: We ran a bulk import for our SSO Integration Module in the EU-Central production environment to add new users. The process partially failed; while some accounts were created, approximately 142 users were not provisioned, and the status shows 'failed' without a specific error message for why those rows were rejected. We need help identifying the cause of these partial failures to re-run the import successfully.

title: Critical: Webhooks Not Firing and API Rate Limits in Analytics Dashboard
description: We have a critical outage affecting the Analytics Dashboard in the APAC production region. Webhooks are not firing at all for real-time events, and when we attempt to query the API manually, we are receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors and significant timeouts. This is impacting over 1,100 users who cannot access real-time data. The system appears to be completely unresponsive to webhook subscriptions and heavily throttling API access.

title: Autoscaling Failure and Rate Limit Issues in Staging
description: In our APAC staging environment, the Rate Limiter is throwing 'rate limit exceeded' errors even though traffic is low. We also noticed that autoscaling is not triggering for the associated service. It's unclear if the problem is within the Rate Limiter configuration itself or if the VPN Gateway is causing connectivity issues that prevent the autoscaler from reaching the control plane. We are the only users testing this right now, so impact is low, but we need to know which component is at fault to debug the scaling behavior.

title: Retention Policy Not Applied and Audit Log Gaps
description: We have identified a compliance issue with Payment Gateway v2 in the ME production environment. Our configured retention policies are not being applied to transaction data, resulting in missing consent records for several customers. Additionally, we have detected gaps in the audit logs where these deletion events should have been recorded. This is affecting 446 users and poses a high risk to our data governance. Please investigate the retention engine and audit logging mechanisms.

title: URGENT: Payment Gateway subscription failures and currency errors in Dev
description: We are seeing critical issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-West development environment. Subscriptions are not renewing, and when they do, the currency conversion is completely wrong, resulting in significant overcharges. This is affecting over 12,000 test users. We are certain this is caused by an outage or instability with our identity provider, as the auth logs seem spotty. Please investigate the identity provider connection immediately, as we believe that is the root cause of these payment failures.

title: Critical Data Loss in Analytics Dashboard (EU-Central Prod)
description: We have detected missing data points in the production Analytics Dashboard for the EU-Central region. The gaps appear in the real-time data streams starting from this morning. This is impacting our ability to monitor KPIs effectively for approximately 12,700 users. Please treat this as a critical priority and investigate the data ingestion pipeline for missing entries.

title: Identity Vault Export Issues: Duplicates and Corruption (ANZ)
description: We are experiencing issues when exporting data from the Identity Vault in our ANZ production environment. The exported files contain duplicate records, and the data structure appears corrupted, making it unusable for downstream processing. We are unsure if this is a core vault issue or related to our Certificate-Based Auth Module causing handshake failures during export. Please advise on the source of the data integrity errors.

title: Incorrect Proration and Overcharges in Staging (LATAM)
description: In the staging environment for Payment Gateway v2 (LATAM region), we are observing incorrect proration calculations on subscription upgrades. This has led to overcharges for a small subset of test accounts (approx. 11 users). The calculations do not match the expected pro-rata formula. Please investigate the billing logic in staging.

title: Critical: Unexpected Chargebacks in Staging (US-East)

This is critically impacting our test workflows for nearly 10,000 users. We are confident that this is due to an incomplete migration from our previous billing system, as the transaction IDs seem to be mismatched or orphaned. Please verify the migration status as the primary cause.

title: Data Loss and File Truncation in Analytics Dashboard (US-West Prod)
description: Two users in the US-West production environment have reported data loss when exporting reports from the Analytics Dashboard. description: Our monitoring systems have flagged critical disk usage levels and database connection pool exhaustion for the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West production environment. While no user impact is currently observed, these metrics indicate an impending failure. Please investigate resource utilization and connection pooling configurations to prevent service disruption.

title: Admin Console Errors: Index Corruption and DB Timeouts (US-East)

Please investigate the database health and query performance.

High impact on about 656 users.

title: SSO Provisioning stuck and duplicate accounts in Staging

title: Mobile App form submission issues
description: The mobile app in production (ME region) is having trouble with form submissions. It just fails to submit sometimes. Only a few users have complained about it so far. Can you check what's going on?

title: Slow performance on Analytics Dashboard and Mobile App

Several users have also noted that the mobile app is feeling sluggish during the same period. The impact is currently low, affecting about 5 users, but we want to identify the root cause before it spreads.

title: Intermittent failures in Analytics Dashboard Sandbox
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our LATAM sandbox environment is exhibiting intermittent failure behavior. Sometimes it loads correctly, other times it hangs or errors out without a clear pattern. This is happening during our testing phases. There is no impact on production users, but it is hindering our development workflow.

title: Audit log gaps and residency flag mismatches in Payment Gateway
description: We have detected discrepancies in our compliance monitoring for the Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-Central production environment. Specifically, there are gaps in the audit logs, and data residency flags are showing mismatches compared to expected configurations. This affects approximately 48 users and poses a moderate risk to our regulatory compliance status.

title: Critical API schema errors and webhook failures in Config Manager
description: Production users in the APAC region are experiencing critical issues with the Config Manager. We are seeing API schema validation errors that are preventing configuration updates. Additionally, webhooks are not firing as expected, which has caused significant downstream data sync issues. This is impacting nearly 9,000 users and is currently a critical priority.

title: Certificate expired warning in Secret Store
description: We are seeing 'certificate expired' warnings in our Secret Store in the APAC production environment. We believe this is definitely a capacity limitation issue where the store is full and can't process the renewal requests properly. We need this resolved as it's affecting about 54 users and causing moderate business impact.

title: SSO Login failures in Production

The values do not match the expected configuration for certain transaction types. While we have not received user complaints yet, we need to verify the logic to ensure financial accuracy.

title: SSO Lockouts and Audit Gaps - We are sure this is a firewall misconfiguration

Additionally, the audit logs are missing entries for these events and we are getting certificate warnings when trying to establish connections. 871 users are currently blocked. We have checked the internal services and everything looks fine on that side. This is definitely a firewall misconfiguration blocking the traffic or modifying the headers incorrectly. Please investigate the network edge immediately.

title: Invoice total incorrect in Payment Gateway v2
description: We have identified an issue where invoice totals are not reflecting the correct final price for a small subset of transactions in the EU-West production environment. The base amount is correct, but the final invoice total appears to be missing a specific line item calculation. This affects approximately 5 customers. Please review the billing logic for this scenario.

This is blocking our team of 343 developers from proceeding with the current sprint tasks. Please check if the config deployment pipeline is failing to inject these variables.

title: CRITICAL: Overcharging customers in US-East Staging

This is currently impacting 2123 test accounts with critical business impact. We need this resolved immediately as we are preparing for a launch. There is no business impact as this is a dev environment, and no end-users are currently affected. Please check the health of the upstream dependency service.

description: We are observing two distinct issues in the APAC sandbox: subscriptions are not renewing, and currency conversion rates are incorrect for several transactions. This is impacting 71 test users. We have ruled out the gateway application logic. This is definitely an incorrect load balancer routing issue, where traffic is being sent to the wrong regional cluster or backend pool that has outdated exchange rates and broken renewal jobs. Please check the LB configuration.

title: Mobile app blanking out and bad search results on US-West devices

title: Payment Gateway v2 Staging: Overcharges and Currency Issues
description: In our ME staging environment, we are seeing incorrect overcharges and currency conversion errors when using the Payment Gateway v2. This is affecting about 373 users. It is unclear whether the gateway itself is calculating the totals incorrectly or if the subsequent refund logic is failing to adjust for these errors, as the symptoms manifest during both the initial charge attempt and any subsequent attempts to reverse the transaction. We need help isolating whether the fault lies in the processing engine or the post-transaction handling.

title: Analytics Dashboard Development: Env Var Missing, Config Drift, Service Unresponsive
description: We are encountering multiple issues with the Analytics Dashboard in our US-West development environment. The service has become unresponsive, and upon investigation, we found that a critical environment variable is missing. Additionally, our configuration management tools have flagged config drift on the instances hosting the dashboard. This is currently only affecting one developer user, but we need to restore the correct configuration and ensure the service becomes responsive again. Please advise on the expected environment variables and how to resolve the detected drift.

title: Event Tracker: Data Loss and Duplicate Records Reported
description: We have received internal reports regarding data integrity issues with the Event Tracker in our APAC production environment. Users are claiming data loss, and we have also observed duplicate records appearing in the system. While the reported business impact is currently marked as none and no specific user count is affected at this moment, we need to investigate the root cause of the duplication and potential missing events to prevent broader data inconsistency. We need a review of the tracker's ingestion logic.

title: LDAP Connector: Data Loss and Corrupted Exports
description: In our US-East production environment, we are experiencing issues with the LDAP Connector. Approximately 20 users are affected by data loss and corrupted export files when attempting to sync or export directory information. The exports are coming through incomplete or malformed, and some expected data fields are missing entirely. We need to investigate why the connector is failing to produce valid exports and ensuring data integrity during these operations.

title: Subscription Manager: Database Connection Pool Exhausted
description: We are observing a 'database connection pool exhausted' error in the Subscription Manager within our EU-Central production environment. This is currently affecting a single user session, resulting in a low business impact, but we want to address it before it scales. We need to understand why the connection pool is hitting its limit for this specific user and if there are any configuration adjustments or clean-up tasks required to resolve this bottleneck.

title: Role Manager: Custom roles not applying to users in Staging (US-West)
description: We are experiencing an issue with Role Manager in our US-West staging environment. Approximately 661 users have been assigned specific custom roles, but the permissions are not being applied correctly. The users can still access restricted areas, indicating that the role assignment is effectively failing or not propagating. This is blocking our QA testing as we cannot verify role-based access controls. Please investigate why the role assignments are not taking effect for these users.

title: Data Export Service: Intermittent failures and high latency in ANZ Production
description: Our production environment in the ANZ region is seeing intermittent failures with the Data Export Service. When exports do complete, the latency is excessively high, causing timeouts for our downstream systems. This affects roughly 887 users who rely on these exports for reporting. The failures seem random but occur frequently enough to disrupt business operations. We need an analysis of the service stability and performance in this region.

title: SSO Integration Module: Users observing elevated privileges in EU-West
description: We have identified a security concern in our production SSO Integration Module in the EU-West region. Certain user groups are observing elevated privileges that they should not have access to. This has been noted by 110 users who are able to access admin-level functions or data views despite having standard user roles. This is a high-priority issue as it represents a potential security breach or misconfiguration in the integration. Immediate investigation is required.

title: SSO Integration Module: HTTP 429 errors and empty responses in EU-Central Staging
description: In our EU-Central staging environment, the SSO Integration Module is returning HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors and empty response bodies. This is impacting 3438 users who are attempting to authenticate or sync data. The empty responses suggest that the API is failing silently after hitting a rate limit or threshold. This is critical as it completely blocks SSO functionality in staging, preventing us from testing any new integrations or updates. Please check the rate limiting configuration and API response handling.

title: Cohort Builder issues with compliance and retention
description: The Cohort Builder in staging isn't working right. The compliance reports are missing data and the retention policy isn't applying correctly. It's affecting a lot of users. Please check why the reports are incomplete and why the retention rules aren't working. We need this fixed ASAP.

title: Token Service: Incorrect HTTP 403 responses and access issues
description: We are observing issues with the Token Service where valid requests are returning HTTP 403 Forbidden errors. Additionally, there are instances where access is granted to resources that should be restricted, indicating that the access control logic may be flawed. This discrepancy between denied and incorrectly allowed access is confusing and potentially risky. Please review the token validation and permission mapping logic.

title: Payment Gateway v2 currency conversion wrong
description: The currency conversion in the Payment Gateway v2 seems off. We are seeing incorrect rates applied to transactions. It's not clear which currencies are affected or how widespread it is, but it's definitely not matching the expected exchange rates. This is impacting a number of users. Please look into why the conversions are inaccurate.

title: Payment Gateway v2 data mismatch and flag issues
description: We're having problems with the Payment Gateway v2. The data coming back doesn't match what we expect, and some feature flags don't seem to be applying correctly. It's affecting about 50 users. Not sure exactly when it started or which specific flags are failing, but it's causing inconsistencies in the gateway behavior. Please advise.

title: Subscription Manager: Users charged twice due to token expiration bug
description: We are seeing a critical issue in the Subscription Manager where users are being overcharged and charged twice for the same subscription period. This is affecting around 409 users in our LATAM staging environment. We believe this is definitely caused by a token expiration handling bug. When tokens expire, the system seems to retry the payment process without checking if it was already completed, leading to double charges. Please fix the token expiration logic to prevent these duplicate transactions.

title: Wallet Service: Undercharging observed in US-East
description: We have identified an issue with the Wallet Service in the US-East production region where transactions are being undercharged. The final amount deducted is less than the expected total. This has been observed by a small number of users, but we want to ensure the billing accuracy is correct. Please investigate the calculation logic within the Wallet Service to determine why the charges are lower than anticipated.

description: There is a significant spike in payment declines using the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-West production environment. We need to understand if this is a gateway configuration issue, a provider-side problem, or something else within the integration. Please prioritize this investigation.

The notices appear to be triggered by transactions that should have been legitimate or were previously resolved. description: Our application is encountering 'rate limit exceeded' errors when interacting with the Secret Store. This is happening in the APAC production environment. title: Missing audit log entries and consent records in Payment Gateway v2 (EU-Central Sandbox)

Specifically, several entries that should correspond to transaction events are missing, and there is a detected gap in the continuity of the logs. This is affecting approximately 23 users who are unable to complete their authentication flows. The moderate business impact is due to blocked testing activities. title: Unexpected session expiration and account lockout in SSO Integration Module (ME Production)

This is a major compliance and financial issue. The invoice totals and line items do not match the expected values. Immediate resolution is required to prevent further incorrect billing.

title: Funnel Analyzer exports failing with encoding errors and missing data
description: We are seeing issues with our Funnel Analyzer reports in the ANZ production environment. When we try to export the data, the resulting files are corrupted and show encoding errors. Additionally, some of the expected data points are simply missing from the export. This is affecting about 4 users who rely on these reports for daily analysis.

title: Attribution Engine output file is truncated
description: Our team in the APAC region has noticed that the files generated by the Attribution Engine in production are coming through truncated. This is causing significant issues for our 23 affected users who cannot get the full dataset they need for their marketing attribution models.

title: Failover did not occur for Admin Console in US-East production
description: We observed that the failover mechanism for the Admin Console in the US-East production environment did not trigger as expected during a recent maintenance window. No users were affected, and there was no business impact, but we need to confirm the system state and ensure the failover configuration is correct for future events.

title: Funnel Analyzer experiencing high latency and intermittent failures in ME production
description: The Funnel Analyzer in our Middle East production environment is suffering from high latency and intermittent failures. This is severely impacting our operations, with 221 users reporting slow load times and occasional errors when attempting to generate funnels. Immediate attention is required to restore performance.

title: Garbled characters appearing in Cohort Builder output in EU-Central production
description: We are encountering an issue where garbled characters appear in the output of the Cohort Builder in our EU-Central production environment. This is affecting a large number of users (9367) and is causing critical problems with data interpretation. Please investigate the character encoding or rendering logic causing these artifacts.

title: Login loop occurring for Identity Vault users in EU-West
description: Users in our EU-West production environment are experiencing a login loop when attempting to access the Identity Vault. After entering credentials, the page refreshes and prompts for login again. This is affecting 22 users and causing moderate business impact as they cannot access their accounts.

title: HTTP 403 errors during SSO Integration Module authentication in EU-Central
description: We are seeing HTTP 403 Forbidden errors when users attempt to authenticate via the SSO Integration Module in the EU-Central production environment. This is blocking 175 users from accessing the platform, resulting in a high business impact. Please investigate the permissions or configuration causing these authorization failures.

title: Funnel Analyzer export issues
description: Hi, we're having trouble with exports in Funnel Analyzer. Files seem to be getting cut off and some data looks wrong. It's happening a lot recently. Please help.

title: Permission Engine login problems
description: Some users are seeing error pages when trying to log in. We think it's related to the Permission Engine but not sure. A few people can't get in. Needs checking.

title: UI elements not rendering in Funnel Analyzer staging
description: In our EU-Central staging environment, we are noticing that certain UI elements in the Funnel Analyzer are not rendering correctly. This is affecting a large number of users (545) and has a high business impact on our testing and development workflows. The issue seems to be related to the display of data, which might suggest a problem with the underlying stream processing or the frontend component itself. We are unable to determine if the data is arriving correctly or if it's just a display issue.

title: API schema errors and malformed JSON responses from Role Manager in US-East
description: We are encountering API schema errors and malformed JSON responses when interacting with the Role Manager service in our US-East production environment. This is affecting 44 users who are unable to manage roles and permissions correctly. The errors are consistent and prevent us from completing necessary administrative tasks.

title: Duplicate accounts and stuck provisioning in SSO Integration Module staging
description: In our ME staging environment, the SSO Integration Module is creating duplicate accounts and has stuck provisioning jobs. This is affecting 30 users in our test group and is causing moderate disruption to our development and testing processes. We need help identifying why duplicates are being created and why the provisioning pipeline is halting.

title: Critical performance degradation and backup failures in Secret Store staging
description: We are experiencing slow response times and failed backup jobs in the Secret Store service in our LATAM staging environment. This is affecting 8231 users and has a critical business impact on our development and testing capabilities. The combination of performance issues and backup failures is preventing us from proceeding with our release cycle.

title: Cohort Builder showing blank screens and broken sorting/filtering in EU-West
description: Users in our EU-West production environment are reporting blank screens when using the Cohort Builder. Additionally, the sorting and filtering features are not working correctly. This is affecting 35 users and causing moderate business impact as they cannot generate the necessary cohort reports. We believe the issue is with the Cohort Builder's frontend or data retrieval logic.

title: Severe slow response times in Analytics Dashboard for ANZ production
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ production environment is experiencing severe slow response times. This is affecting 3225 users and has a critical business impact on our daily operations and decision-making processes. The delays are making it impossible to retrieve timely insights, and we need immediate assistance to resolve this performance issue.

title: Report Builder missing records in production
description:
Hello, we are using Report Builder in our production environment to generate monthly sales reports. Recently, we noticed that the reports are incomplete. Specifically, several records that should be included based on our filter criteria are missing from the output.

This issue affects approximately 26 users across our sales team, and they cannot access the correct data for their daily operations. The impact is moderate as it requires manual reconciliation, which is time-consuming.

Can you please investigate why these records are being dropped from the report generation process? We have verified that the data exists in the source system but is not appearing in the final report.

title: Chat Widget missing after recent release in staging
description:
Hi Support,

We deployed a new release to our staging environment yesterday. Since then, the Chat Widget has completely disappeared from the interface. It was working fine before the update.

This is a high-impact issue because it blocks our testing for about 430 users who need to validate the chat functionality before we can push to production. We aren't sure if the issue is with the widget itself or if something in the broader Customer Portal UI is preventing it from loading. The rest of the portal seems okay, but the chat container is just empty. Can you please check what happened during the deployment?

title: Critical SSO Provisioning Issues: Duplicates and Stuck Imports
description:
Urgent: We are facing major issues with the SSO Integration Module in our development environment.

1. Duplicate accounts are being created for existing users when they log in via SSO.
2. The user provisioning process seems to be stuck; new users are not getting their accounts set up.
3. Our bulk import of users partially failed, with many records rejected.

This is critical because it affects over 2500 users and blocks our development cycle. We suspect this might be related to how messages are being processed between the SSO module and the backend, possibly involving the central message queue, but we can't pinpoint the exact failure point. The errors are inconsistent, and some requests go through while others fail or duplicate. Please assist ASAP.

title: Analytics Dashboard API errors: Empty responses, JSON format issues, and Rate Limiting
description:
Hello,

We are encountering issues with the Analytics Dashboard API in our sandbox environment. Specifically:
1. Some API calls return an empty response body (200 OK but no data).
2. Other calls return malformed JSON responses that cannot be parsed by our client.
3. We are frequently hitting HTTP 429 errors, suggesting rate limits are being exceeded even though our request volume is low.

This is affecting 2 users in our team who are developing integrations. The impact is currently low as we are only in the sandbox phase, but we need to understand the root cause to ensure stability before moving to production. Can you help clarify the expected behavior for these endpoints and if there are specific rate limit configurations we need to be aware of?

title: Chat Widget form submission failures
description:
Hi, we are seeing a problem with the Chat Widget in production. Users are unable to submit forms through the chat interface. The form fields fill out fine, but when they hit 'Submit', nothing happens. No error message is displayed, but the data is never sent.

This is definitely an identity provider outage issue on your end. Our internal systems are fine, and this only started happening when we tried to integrate with your chat. We've had 67 users complain about this, causing moderate business impact as support tickets are piling up. Please fix the identity provider connection so our forms can go through.

title: Slow performance in mobile app linked to OAuth Service
description:
Hello,

We've noticed that the mobile app performance has become very slow for a subset of users. Specifically, actions that require authentication are taking a long time to complete.

This is definitely a third-party service failure. We suspect the external service you rely on for token validation is down or experiencing severe latency, causing our OAuth Service to hang. It's affecting 8 users currently, so the impact is low, but it's annoying for our QA team. Please escalate with the third-party provider to get this resolved.

title: Refund Manager: Synchronization delays and 'Account not found' errors
description:
Hi Team,

We are experiencing issues with the Refund Manager in our staging environment. Two main problems are occurring:
1. There are significant synchronization delays between the refund initiation and the final status update.
2. Some refund attempts are failing with an 'Account not found' error, even though the account details appear correct in the admin panel.

This is impacting about 37 users who are testing the refund workflow, causing a moderate business impact due to the need for manual re-testing. Could you please investigate the sync process and the account lookup logic?

title: Payment Gateway v2: Certificate warnings in production
description:
Hello,

We are seeing certificate expired warnings and general certificate warnings in our production environment when using Payment Gateway v2. While transactions are still processing, the browser and client-side logs are flagging security issues.

This is affecting 56 users, primarily our finance team who access the dashboard frequently. The warnings are causing concern among stakeholders regarding data security compliance. The impact is moderate as it requires communication to users and potential workaround configurations. Please review the SSL/TLS certificate configuration for the gateway.

title: Queue Manager: Full outage, 503 errors, and failover failure
description:
Hi,

We are reporting a full outage of the Queue Manager in production. All services relying on it are returning HTTP 503 errors. It appears that the automatic failover did not occur as expected, leaving the system down.

This is currently affecting 5 users directly, mostly our on-call engineers investigating the issue. The business impact is rated low by our internal metrics because our main user-facing apps have cached states, but the queue processing is halted. Please confirm why failover didn't trigger and restore service.

title: Token Service: Truncated file output in development
description:
Hello,

When we call the Token Service in our development environment, the response file seems to be truncated. We expect a full JSON payload, but the file ends abruptly, cutting off the last part of the data.

This is affecting 2 developers who are unable to complete their testing. The impact is low as we are only in dev, but it prevents us from moving forward with the current feature branch. Can you check if there is a size limit or a bug in the file generation process?

title: Deploy Manager: API schema errors, rate limits, and malformed JSON
description:
Hi Support,

We are facing multiple issues with the Deploy Manager API in production:
1. We are receiving API schema errors when sending standard deployment payloads.
2. The system is throwing 'Rate limit exceeded' errors, even though our request volume is within the agreed-upon limits.
3. Some responses come back as malformed JSON, which our client cannot parse.

This is a high-impact issue affecting 363 users across our engineering teams who are blocked from deploying changes. The inconsistency makes it hard to debug. Please investigate the API validation and rate limiting configurations urgently.

title: Currency Converter: Slow performance, timeouts, and delayed responses
description:
Hello,

Our mobile app users are experiencing extremely slow performance when using the Currency Converter feature. Requests are timing out, and even when they succeed, the response times are very long.

This is affecting 101 users and has a high business impact because conversion functionality is critical for our checkout process. Users are abandoning carts due to the delays. We need to understand why the service is responding so slowly and if there are performance bottlenecks we can address.

title: Analytics Dashboard: Database query timeouts
description:
Hi,

I am seeing database query timeout errors when trying to load specific reports in the Analytics Dashboard. The page loads partially but then fails with a timeout message.

This is currently affecting only 1 user (me), so the business impact is low, but it prevents me from accessing necessary data for my daily tasks. Could you please check if there are performance issues with the backend database queries for this view?

title: SSO not working
description:
Hi,

The SSO service is broken. We are getting 503s and it's unresponsive. About 10 users are affected. Please fix.

title: Role Manager: Bulk import completely failed
description:
Hello,

We attempted a bulk import of users into the Role Manager, but the entire process failed. No records were imported, and we received a generic error message.

This is a critical issue for us as it affects 3269 users and blocks our role assignment workflow. We need immediate assistance to understand why the bulk import is failing and to successfully upload our data.

title: Feedback Collector UI elements missing and sorting broken
description: We are experiencing issues with the Feedback Collector module in our US-East production environment. Specifically, several UI elements are failing to render correctly, appearing as blank spaces in the dashboard. Additionally, the sorting and filtering functions are completely broken; when a user attempts to sort by date or filter by category, the table returns no results or throws a generic error. This is affecting approximately 39 users who rely on these tools for daily reporting.

title: Access denied errors in Config Manager (Staging ME)
description: Our team is receiving 'Access Denied' errors when attempting to view or edit configurations in the Config Manager. This issue is isolated to the Staging environment within the Middle East (ME) region. The permissions settings appear correct on our end, but none of the 11 affected users can access the necessary configuration pages. This is blocking our deployment pipeline for the upcoming release.

title: Funnel Analyzer connection pool exhausted in Sandbox
description: We are encountering a 'database connection pool exhausted' error when running queries in the Funnel Analyzer. This is happening in the Sandbox environment (US-East). The tool becomes unresponsive or returns a timeout error after a few minutes of activity. While this does not currently impact production, it is preventing our developers from testing new funnel configurations effectively.

title: Analytics Dashboard showing 429 errors and webhooks failing
description: Since this morning, our Analytics Dashboard (Dev environment, US-East) has been displaying HTTP 429 'Rate Limit Exceeded' errors. Concurrently, we have noticed that webhooks configured to fire on specific data threshold breaches are not triggering at all. We have not changed any settings on our side. This is causing delays in our development workflow for about 5 users. Can you check why the dashboard is rate limiting itself and why the webhook events are not processing?

title: Feature flags not applying in Analytics Dashboard (Sandbox LATAM)
description: We are facing a critical issue in the Sandbox environment for the LATAM region. Changes made to configuration settings and feature flags in the Analytics Dashboard are not taking effect. Users (approx. 329) are seeing the old version of the dashboard, and new features enabled via flags are not visible. We have verified that the flags are marked as 'Active' in the admin panel, but the application state remains unchanged. This is blocking our UAT phase.

title: White screen and missing localization in Data Export Service
description: Users in the EU-West production environment are reporting a complete white screen when accessing the Data Export Service. Furthermore, for those who do see the interface, localized text strings are missing, displaying default keys instead of translated text. This is impacting around 16 users and preventing them from exporting necessary reports. We suspect a rendering issue within the service itself as no external changes were made.

title: Subscriptions not renewing via Payment Gateway v2
description: We have identified a recurring issue where subscriptions are failing to auto-renew through Payment Gateway v2. This is affecting customers in the LATAM production region. Approximately 83 users have reported that their services were suspended due to non-payment, despite having valid credit cards on file. The system does not seem to be processing the renewal transactions, resulting in service interruptions for our end customers.

title: MFA prompt missing and session expiry issues in SSO Module
description: During development testing (US-East), two developers have reported that the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompt is not appearing when required by policy. Additionally, active sessions are expiring unexpectedly shortly after login. This behavior is inconsistent, making it difficult to test the full authentication flow. We need to understand why the MFA step is being bypassed and why session tokens are invalidating prematurely.

title: SSO Webhooks failing with 429 in EU-Central Staging
description: In our Staging environment (EU-Central), webhooks triggered by the SSO Integration Module are failing to fire. The endpoint is returning HTTP 429 errors. This has stopped the synchronization process for 35 test accounts, which is hindering our ability to validate identity provider changes. The issue started after a recent update to the integration configuration.

title: Feedback collector issues
description: Hi, the feedback collector is acting weird. We get a blank screen sometimes and the sorting doesn't work right. Several people on the team are complaining about it in LATAM. Please look into it.

title: LDAP Connector audit logs missing and cert warnings
description: We are seeing warnings about an expired certificate in the LDAP Connector logs, and concurrently, audit log entries for user access events are missing. This is in our Staging environment (EU-Central). We are concerned that the connector is failing to log critical security events properly. Approximately 14 users are affected by these gaps in visibility.

title: Mass account lockouts in Production (MFA Manager)
description: We are experiencing a severe issue in the Middle East production environment where a large number of users (over 100) are being locked out of their accounts. The system appears to be triggering account lockouts despite valid credentials. Users are receiving 'Account Locked' messages and cannot proceed even after waiting. This is a high-impact blocker affecting business operations.

title: Duplicate charges on subscriptions via Payment Gateway v2
description: Multiple customers in the LATAM region have reported being charged twice for their subscriptions through Payment Gateway v2. Approximately 21 users have contacted our support team regarding double billing. The transaction logs show two distinct successful charges within a short timeframe for the same subscription ID. This is causing financial discrepancies and customer dissatisfaction.

title: Incorrect invoices and duplicate charges in ANZ
description: We have encountered issues with invoice generation in the ANZ production environment. Specifically, invoices are showing incorrect totals, and some customers are being charged twice for the same billing cycle. This affects about 4 users so far. We need an urgent review of the billing logic to ensure correct amounts are calculated and charged.

title: Chargeback notices received via Subscription Manager
description: Our finance team has received chargeback notices for two accounts managed through the Subscription Manager in the Middle East region. We need assistance in understanding the transaction history associated with these specific accounts to determine the cause of the dispute. This is currently limited to two users but requires investigation to prevent further billing errors.

title: Subscriptions not renewing in APAC
description: We've noticed that several subscription renewal attempts are failing silently for our customers in the APAC region. The logs show the request leaves our system but never returns a success or failure code from the gateway. Is this an issue with the payment processor timeout or a routing problem at the edge?

title: Critical: Role Manager showing cert warnings and unexpected access
description: Our monitoring is flagging certificate warnings on the Role Manager portal, and worse, we are seeing users with elevated privileges who shouldn't have them. This is affecting 438 users in EU-West. Please investigate immediately as we suspect the auth module within Role Manager is compromised or misconfigured.

title: Analytics exports broken
description: Hey, the analytics dashboard is giving us corrupted files when we try to export data. The numbers don't match what's on the screen and the files cut off halfway. About 95 people are complaining. Can you fix this?

title: Quota issues in staging
description: We're hitting quota exceeded errors on Payment Gateway v2 in staging. Only 2 users are affected but it's blocking our testing. Not sure what the limit is or which specific endpoint is causing it, just know it's failing.

title: Timeout errors on Payment Gateway v2 (ME)
description: We are observing consistent timeout responses from the Payment Gateway v2 in the ME production environment. The requests are taking longer than our client-side threshold and eventually dropping. No specific error codes are returned, just a timeout. This started recently and affects all transaction types.

title: Export files truncated with garbled characters
description: When exporting reports from the Analytics Dashboard (US-East, Prod), the resulting CSV files are truncated and contain garbled characters in the last few rows. It seems to happen with larger datasets. Impact is low for us right now as only one analyst is blocked, but the data integrity is compromised.

title: Analytics Dashboard exports: Duplicate records and truncation
description: We are seeing duplicate records in the Analytics Dashboard exports along with file truncation in the EU-West production environment. This is affecting 14 users who rely on these reports for weekly analysis. The duplicates seem random, and the truncation occurs at different row counts each time.

title: Load Balancer feature flags not applying in Staging (US-East)
description: In our staging environment (US-East), feature flags configured via the Load Balancer are not taking effect. Some traffic is being routed incorrectly, leading to 503 errors for a significant portion of our test users (620 impacted). It's unclear if the LB isn't picking up the new config or if the underlying service instance it's talking to is stale. Could be a routing issue or a data sync problem with the config store.

title: DB Deadlocks and Disk Space errors in Dev Analytics
description: We are encountering database deadlock detected errors followed by 'out of disk space' messages in the Analytics Dashboard development environment (EU-West). This is impacting 38 users who cannot run queries. The deadlocks seem to trigger the disk cleanup failure. Please check the database instance limits and query patterns.

title: HTTP 429 Rate Limit Exceeded on Payment Gateway (APAC)
description: Our applications in the APAC region are receiving HTTP 429 Too Many Requests responses from the Payment Gateway v2. This indicates we are exceeding the rate limit, but our volume hasn't changed significantly. We need clarification on the current limits or if there is a specific endpoint causing this throttle.

title: Notification Hub config and feature flags not updating
description: Changes to configurations and feature flags in the Notification Hub (US-East, Prod) are not taking effect. Users (57 total) are reporting that they are still receiving old notification templates despite the updates being applied in the admin console. This has been happening for several hours.

title: MFA codes not working
description: Users in staging (EU-West) are getting their MFA codes rejected for Active Directory Sync. It's critical, 1109 users can't log in. We don't have the exact error message yet, just know it says 'invalid code'. Please look into this ASAP.

title: Intermittent failures and high latency in Cohort Builder (Staging)
description: We are experiencing intermittent build failures and high latency when using the Cohort Builder in the LATAM staging environment. The cohorts sometimes take over 2 minutes to generate or fail entirely with no specific error code. This is currently blocking our testing pipeline, though no end-users are impacted yet.

title: SSO Synchronization delay in Sandbox
description: In the APAC Sandbox environment, there is a noticeable delay in the SSO Integration Module synchronization. New users are not appearing in the downstream application immediately after being added to the identity provider. The delay is approximately 15-20 minutes. This affects 9 testers in our group.

title: Critical: Role Manager Certificate Expired Warning
description: We are seeing a 'Certificate Expired' warning on the Role Manager interface in APAC production. This is critical as 5756 users are potentially blocked from accessing their roles. The system seems to be rejecting the current certs. Please investigate the certificate management within Role Manager immediately.

title: SSO Module failing due to lack of monitoring
description: We are seeing issues with the SSO Integration Module in our dev environment. Specifically, webhook retries are exhausted and we are getting malformed JSON responses. This is definitely a problem with insufficient monitoring and alerting on your side; if you had better visibility into these failures, you would have caught this before it hit us. Please fix the monitoring gaps so this doesn't happen again.

title: High latency and slow performance in Mobile App (Production)
description: Our users in the US-West region are reporting significantly slow performance on the Mobile App in production. Screens take a long time to load, and interactions feel laggy. This is impacting approximately 108 users and is considered high priority for our business operations. We need investigation into what is causing these delays, as it started recently and is degrading the user experience.

title: Analytics Dashboard crashing intermittently
description: The Analytics Dashboard in the Middle East production environment is experiencing application crashes. The failures are intermittent, making it hard to reproduce consistently, but they are happening frequently enough to block work for about 189 users. This is a high-impact issue for our data analysis teams. We need help identifying the cause of these random crashes.

title: SSO Sync stuck and creating duplicate accounts in Staging
description: We are encountering two issues with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-Central staging environment. First, the user sync process gets stuck mid-operation. Second, when the sync restarts or resumes, it creates duplicate accounts instead of updating existing ones. This is affecting 23 users and is holding up our testing phase. We need a fix for the sync logic to prevent duplicates and ensure completion.

title: Analytics Dashboard API returning empty results
description: The API for the Analytics Dashboard is returning empty responses. We aren't getting any data back where we expect to see metrics. This is in the US-West production environment. It's not affecting anyone right now but we noticed it and wanted to report it. No specific error codes, just empty JSON objects.

title: Customer Portal webhook timeout and failure to fire
description: We are experiencing issues with webhooks not firing for the Customer Portal in the US-East production environment. When triggered, the requests time out and never reach our endpoint. This is currently affecting a single user scenario but is preventing that user from completing their workflow. We need the webhook delivery mechanism investigated.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Sandbox: 429 errors and webhook failures
description: In our APAC sandbox environment, the Payment Gateway v2 is returning HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors. Additionally, webhooks are not firing, and when they do attempt, retries are exhausted without success. This is blocking our integration testing for 32 users. We need clarification on the rate limits for the sandbox and a fix for the webhook delivery issues.

title: Garbled characters in Cohort Builder output
description: Users in the EU-West development environment are seeing garbled characters when exporting or viewing data in the Cohort Builder. The text appears corrupted with random symbols or question marks. This is affecting 57 users and is making the cohort definitions unreadable and unusable. We believe this is a bug in the Cohort Builder's rendering or export logic that needs to be fixed immediately.

title: Critical: SSO errors and duplicate accounts in Payment Gateway
description: We have a critical outage affecting the Payment Gateway v2 in the APAC production region. Users are encountering SSO error pages and federation metadata mismatches upon login. Furthermore, this is resulting in duplicate accounts being created for existing customers. This is impacting 1,197 users and is halting transactions. We need immediate assistance to resolve the authentication flow and account duplication issues.

title: Billing Disputes Handler refund and renewal issues
description: We are having trouble with the Billing Disputes Handler. A refund processed through it was not reflected in the customer's account, the subscription did not renew as expected, and there is an incorrect currency conversion applied. This is currently affecting one user in the APAC production environment. We need these billing actions to be corrected.

title: SSO Integration Module returning 503 errors
description: The SSO Integration Module in our ANZ staging environment is consistently returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors. This is blocking all authentication flows for 2,734 users. We believe this is a failure within the SSO Module itself as it is not responding correctly. This is a critical issue preventing us from proceeding with our release tests.

title: Analytics Dashboard webhooks and schema issues
description: We are seeing some problems with the Analytics Dashboard in ANZ production. Webhooks are not firing and we are getting API schema errors. It's a low impact for now, affecting about 2 users. Just wanted to flag it.

title: LDAP Connector timeout in Sandbox
description: The LDAP Connector is timing out in our ANZ sandbox environment. We are seeing upstream dependency timeouts, though we aren't sure exactly what they mean. It's happening sometimes and not others. Affecting a few users. Low priority.

title: Cache Service unresponsive / outage
description: We are reporting that the Cache Service is unresponsive in the US-West production environment. It looks like a full outage for the service. This is currently affecting 2 users. We need the Cache Service to be brought back online or investigated for why it is not responding.

title: Analytics Dashboard rate limiting and webhook failures
description: In the US-West production environment, the Analytics Dashboard is hitting rate limits, which is causing webhooks not to fire. This is affecting 33 users and is moderately impacting our data ingestion workflows. We need to adjust the rate limits or ensure webhooks are processed reliably despite the load.

title: Staging SSO Integration failing with MFA rejection and login errors
description: We are experiencing issues with the SSO Integration Module in our staging environment (LATAM region). Approximately 25 users are unable to log in. The flow initiates correctly, but upon receiving the MFA code, the system rejects it, causing the login to fail completely. Please investigate why the codes are being deemed invalid in staging.

title: Prod Rate Limiter unresponsive in EU-West; certificate warnings observed
description: Our production Rate Limiter service in the EU-West region is currently unresponsive. We are seeing 'connection refused' errors from client applications. Additionally, monitoring alerts triggered a 'certificate expired warning' shortly before the outage began. About 19 active users are impacted. We need immediate assistance restoring connectivity.

title: Security Alert: Elevated privileges and certificate warnings in Dev Config Manager
description: We have detected suspicious activity in our development environment using the Config Manager (EU-West). Several certificate warnings and a specific 'certificate expired warning' appeared in the logs. Concurrently, we observed elevated privileges being granted unexpectedly. This is impacting roughly 395 users and represents a high-severity security concern. Please check for potential compromise or misconfiguration immediately.

title: Dashboard acting weird
description: The analytics dashboard isn't working right. We think it might be related to the recent updates. It seems like it might have restarted or something? Hard to tell. Please look into it.

title: Payment Gateway timeouts in APAC development
description: We are seeing consistent timeouts when trying to process transactions in the Payment Gateway v2 dev environment (APAC). I am fairly certain this is caused by a schema mismatch in the database configuration we recently updated. It's just one test user hitting this, but it's blocking our integration testing.

title: MFA and SSO errors in Permission Engine sandbox
description: We are encountering multiple authentication issues in our LATAM sandbox environment, which we believe are stemming from the Permission Engine. Specifically, MFA codes are being rejected, password reset links are expiring prematurely, and users are landing on a generic SSO error page. Only 2 users are affected so far, but it's hindering our sandbox testing.

title: Critical: 7000+ users locked out of Production SSO in EU-West
description: URGENT. Our production SSO Integration Module in EU-West is failing for a massive number of users (approx 7677). We are getting generic 'login failure' messages. We checked the config and are confident this is a customer configuration error on our end. Please help us revert the changes or tell us what specific setting is broken.

title: Webhook events not firing from Staging Analytics Dashboard (ME)
description: In our Middle East staging environment, the Analytics Dashboard is not triggering webhooks as expected. We configured an endpoint for event notifications, but no POST requests are reaching it. This is affecting a single internal test user scenario. Please check if the webhook dispatcher is active in this region.

title: Cache Service connectivity issues in EU-Central Prod
description: We are seeing intermittent failures with the Cache Service in production (EU-Central). Monitoring indicates DNS lookup failures when clients try to resolve the cache endpoints. Additionally, there is a certificate expired warning on the service endpoint. About 41 users are experiencing slow response times or connection drops. Please investigate the network and cert status.

title: Critical MFA failures impacting Payment Gateway and Settlement in ME Dev
description: We are blocked in our Middle East development environment. We are getting 'MFA code rejected' errors. It is unclear if this is strictly a Payment Gateway v2 authentication issue or if it is affecting the Settlement Service downstream as well, as transactions fail at the validation step regardless of which module we isolate. This is impacting 1299 test accounts and halting our sprint.

title: Rate limit exceeded and webhook retries failing for Analytics Dashboard (APAC)
description: In the APAC production environment, the Analytics Dashboard is returning 'rate limit exceeded' errors. Consequently, the outgoing webhooks are retrying and then exhausting their retry attempts, leading to data loss. This is currently affecting one specific integration account. Please review the rate limiting thresholds for this region.
