Approximately 493 users have been affected. The duplicates are occurring when users submit feedback through specific forms. This is causing confusion in our CRM and impacting customer experience. We need to identify the trigger for this duplication and prevent it from continuing.

title: Security anomalies in Payment Gateway v2 (US-West)
description: We have observed several concerning signs in the Payment Gateway v2 production environment in US-West. First, we see evidence of elevated privileges being granted unexpectedly. Second, some administrative accounts are being locked out. Third, there are missing entries in the audit logs corresponding to these actions. While the number of affected users is small (5), this looks like a potential security incident or a serious bug in the access control module. Please investigate urgently.

title: Identity Vault connection issues - upstream timeout?
description: We are seeing errors in the Identity Vault service. It seems like there is an upstream dependency timing out. We noticed the vendor status page has an incident listed. Is this related to our Identity Vault instance? Only one user is affected but it's blocking an important workflow. Please check if the vault is properly handling the upstream errors.

title: Analytics Dashboard timeouts and rate limit errors in ME production
description: Users in the Middle East production environment are experiencing timeouts when accessing the Analytics Dashboard. Concurrently, we are hitting rate limit errors on the API calls the dashboard makes. This is affecting about 17 users. We need to understand if this is due to increased traffic on our side or if there are limits being enforced unexpectedly by the dashboard service. Please advise.

title: SSO sessions dropping out
description: People are getting logged out of the SSO Integration Module way too early. It's happening randomly. About 180 users are complaining. Can you fix?

title: Slow Analytics Dashboard and mobile performance in EU-Central dev
description: In the EU-Central development environment, the Analytics Dashboard is responding very slowly. We are also noticing that the associated mobile app performance is degraded, likely due to the same backend delays. This is hindering our development and testing cycle for about 26 developers. Please check the database or server load in the dev environment.

title: User provisioning stuck in SSO
description: New users aren't getting provisioned. The process just hangs. This is in the SSO Integration Module in LATAM dev. Affects 26 users. Please check.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Undercharges and declines in EU-Central
description: We are seeing issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in EU-Central production. Some transactions are being undercharged, while others are failing with 'payment declined' errors despite valid cards. We are also receiving chargeback notices. We are pretty sure this is due to resource exhaustion on the gateway servers causing these processing failures. Please check the server resources.

title: Subscription Manager billing customers incorrectly (APAC)
description: There is a critical billing error in the Subscription Manager for the APAC production region. Customers are being overcharged. This is affecting approximately 476 accounts. We need to stop the current billing cycle from processing these incorrect amounts and rectify the charges. This is a high-priority issue due to the financial impact and customer complaints.

title: SSO Module hanging during bulk import
description: We are seeing the SSO Integration Module get stuck whenever we attempt a bulk import. The provisioning process never completes and just hangs indefinitely. This has effectively blocked updates for about 20 users in our ANZ production environment. The sync status remains 'stuck' even after we try to restart the module from the dashboard.

title: Webhook Engine errors: Cert expired and privilege issues
description: The Webhook Engine in our production environment is throwing warnings about an expired certificate. Additionally, we have noticed elevated privileges being observed in the logs associated with the webhook triggers. This seems to be impacting about 19 users in the ANZ region. We are concerned about the security implications and the lack of reliability in the webhook delivery due to the cert warnings.

title: Backup job failure in Analytics Dashboard (Dev)
description: We are experiencing a high-impact issue in our development environment (EU-Central) where the backup job for the Analytics Dashboard has failed. This failure prevents us from restoring previous states, which is critical for our development workflow. Approximately 479 users are affected as they cannot proceed with data validation tasks that require recent backups. Please investigate the backup service integration with the dashboard immediately.

title: Payment Gateway v2 config changes not applying in Staging
description: We updated the configuration settings for Payment Gateway v2 in our staging environment (LATAM), but the changes are not taking effect. The system continues to use the old parameters despite a successful save confirmation. This affects our test group of 4 users, preventing them from validating new payment flows. The impact is low, but it is blocking our testing cycle.

title: Invoice Service: Double subscription charge observed
description: We noticed that a subscription was charged twice through the Invoice Service in the APAC production environment. This resulted in an overcharge for the affected account. There are no other users currently impacted (0 affected users), and the business impact is rated as none for the broader organization, but we need a credit issued for this specific transaction. Please check the invoice generation logic for this account.

title: Analytics Dashboard returning HTTP 429 errors
description: Users in the ME region are reporting frequent HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors when accessing the Analytics Dashboard in production. This is impacting approximately 35 users, causing significant delays and moderate business impact as data access is throttled. We believe the dashboard itself is misbehaving or misconfigured, leading to these rate limit hits.

title: Analytics Dashboard: Mixed 429 and 500 errors
description: We are observing a mix of HTTP 429 and HTTP 500 errors on the Analytics Dashboard in the EU-Central production environment. This instability is affecting 12 users and is causing moderate business impact as reports fail to load. The errors seem intermittent, but the combination of rate limiting and server errors is preventing reliable access to analytics data. Please investigate the dashboard's request handling and backend stability.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Certificate Expired Warning
description: Our production environment in ANZ is showing certificate expired warnings for Payment Gateway v2. This has impacted 64 users who are experiencing issues with payment processing reliability. We need the certificate renewed or the gateway configuration checked as soon as possible to avoid further disruption to our transaction flow. The business impact is currently moderate but could escalate.

title: Critical Data Loss: Missing data in Analytics Dashboard
description: We are experiencing a critical issue in the EU-West production environment where the Analytics Dashboard is showing missing data. This affects 6,793 users who rely on these metrics for daily operations. The data gaps are significant and prevent accurate reporting. Immediate investigation is required to restore the integrity of the analytics data.

title: Report Builder missing data in Development
description: In our EU-West development environment, the Report Builder is failing to include expected data in generated reports. This issue affects 612 users involved in the development and testing process, creating a high business impact due to blocked workflows. The data appears to be present in the source but is not being picked up by the report generator. Please check the data mapping logic.

title: Missing records in Analytics Dashboard (Dev)
description: We are seeing missing records when querying data in the Analytics Dashboard in the ME development environment. This affects 7 users and has a low business impact currently. The missing records make it difficult to validate segmentation logic. It is unclear if the issue lies with the dashboard's display layer or the underlying segment data source.

title: Payment Gateway v2 API issues in staging
description: The Payment Gateway v2 in our LATAM staging environment is acting up. We are getting weird responses from the API. It's breaking our tests and affects a large number of users. Please check why the API is behaving oddly. It's causing high impact for our team.

title: Token Service MFA failures in Staging
description: Users in the ANZ staging environment are reporting that the Token Service is not working correctly for MFA. Specifically, some users see an MFA prompt but their code is rejected, while others are not seeing the MFA prompt at all. This affects 41 users and has a moderate business impact as it prevents secure login testing. We believe the Token Service itself is malfunctioning.

title: Invoice Service payment errors and double charges
description: We are experiencing issues with the Invoice Service in our APAC production environment. Three users have reported that their payments were declined unexpectedly, and some subscriptions have been charged twice, resulting in overcharges. The business impact is currently low as the number of affected users is small, but these billing discrepancies need to be resolved quickly. We suspect a bug in the Invoice Service logic.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Webhook retries exhausted
description: In the EU-West production environment, we are observing that webhook retries are being exhausted for Payment Gateway v2. This has impacted 33 users, causing missed transaction updates and moderate business impact. The webhooks fail to deliver successfully after the retry limit is reached. We need to investigate the gateway's webhook delivery mechanism and retry policy to ensure reliable event notification.

title: Invoice Service missing consent records
description: We are seeing issues with the Invoice Service in production. Specifically, it looks like consent records are missing for some transactions. Can you help us investigate why the data isn't appearing?

title: Notification Hub config not applying due to hardware failure
description: There is config drift detected in the Notification Hub and our recent changes are not taking effect in production. We think this is definitely an infrastructure hardware failure causing the sync to break. Please check the underlying servers.

title: Critical: Customer Portal white screen and form submission failures
description: Users are reporting that the Customer Portal is completely broken. We are seeing a white screen of death, forms are failing to submit, and various UI elements are not rendering. This is impacting over 3000 users in LATAM production. Need immediate assistance.

title: SSO Integration Module password links expiring prematurely
description: In the sandbox environment for the SSO Integration Module, we are noticing that password reset links are expiring way too quickly. Additionally, sessions seem to be expiring unexpectedly during testing. This is blocking our high-priority user flows.

title: Rate Limiter account lockouts and certificate warnings
description: We are observing account lockouts on the Rate Limiter service in US-East production. Alongside the lockouts, there is a certificate expired warning being triggered. This is affecting approximately 323 users and has a high business impact. Please prioritize checking the certificate status and lockout rules.

title: Payment Gateway v2 generating incorrect invoices
description: The Payment Gateway v2 is producing incorrect invoice amounts for multiple customers in US-East production. We think this is definitely a customer configuration error on our end, but we need your team to verify the logic being applied to the billing calculations.

title: Webhook Engine TLS handshake failures and cert expiry
description: We are experiencing critical issues with the Webhook Engine in US-West production. Our servers are returning TLS handshake errors, and we see warnings indicating that a certificate has expired. This is impacting over 5,000 users. Please advise on the certificate renewal process and why the handshake is failing.

title: OAuth Service API returning empty responses in staging
description: The OAuth Service API in staging is currently returning empty responses for all requests. This is a critical blocker for 7,785 users. We have verified that the requests are well-formed, but the service is simply not sending back any data. Please investigate the backend logging.

title: Payment Gateway v2 webhooks failing due to race condition
description: In the dev environment, the Payment Gateway v2 is not firing webhooks correctly, retries are exhausted, and we are seeing API schema errors. We think this is definitely a race condition issue happening during the transaction commit phase. Please review the timing of the webhook triggers.

title: Analytics Dashboard showing duplicate records and garbled text
description: We are seeing some anomalies in the Analytics Dashboard in ANZ production. Specifically, there are duplicate records appearing in the reports, some characters are garbled, and exported files seem to be truncated. This is currently affecting 2 users and has a low business impact, but we need to ensure data integrity.

title: Analytics Dashboard webhooks not firing with HTTP 429 errors
description: We noticed that webhooks are not firing from the Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM production region. When we try to trigger them, we are receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors. There is currently no reported business impact, but we want to understand why the rate limiting is being applied.

title: Analytics Dashboard API empty responses and webhook failures
description: The Analytics Dashboard in staging is critically malfunctioning. The API is returning empty responses, and webhooks are not firing at all. This is impacting 4,381 users. We need a root cause analysis as soon as possible since this is blocking our release candidate testing.

title: Fee Analyzer timeouts in production
description: We are experiencing frequent timeouts with the Fee Analyzer service in ANZ production. The application hangs and eventually fails to load data for about 550 users. This has a high business impact as it prevents finance teams from closing their books. Please look into the performance of the Fee Analyzer.

title: Payment Gateway v2 issues
description: The payment gateway isn't working right. Seems like config changes aren't sticking and it gets unresponsive sometimes. In sandbox. Please check.

title: SSO Integration Module redirect loop in production
description: Users attempting to log in via the SSO Integration Module in US-West production are stuck in a redirect loop. The browser keeps bouncing between the application and the identity provider without completing authentication. This is a critical issue affecting approximately 2,900 users. Please investigate the callback URL configuration.

title: MFA codes rejected for two users during Active Directory sync
description: We are seeing issues with MFA authentication in our production environment (EU-Central) for users syncing via Active Directory. Specifically, valid TOTP codes are being rejected at the login prompt. This is currently affecting two distinct user accounts, while others are logging in without issue. We have verified the server time is correct and the users' devices are synced. Please investigate why the MFA validation is failing for these specific accounts.

title: Production SSO Error Page Blocking Tax Calculator Access (193 Users)
description: We are experiencing a high-impact issue in our EU-West production environment where approximately 193 users are unable to access the Tax Calculator. Upon attempting to log in via SSO, users are presented with a generic error page and are not redirected to the application. The issue started suddenly this morning. We need urgent assistance to restore access as this is halting critical financial calculations for a large portion of our workforce.

title: Critical SSO Integration Failures: MFA Prompts Missing/Rejected and Session Expiry
description: Our US-East sandbox environment is experiencing severe instability with the SSO Integration Module, impacting roughly 817 users. We are observing three distinct behaviors: 1) The MFA prompt is sometimes not appearing at all, allowing login without second-factor verification; 2) When the prompt does appear, valid MFA codes are frequently rejected; and 3) Active sessions are expiring unexpectedly shortly after login. This is blocking our development and testing cycles. Please prioritize investigation into these authentication flows.

title: Analytics Dashboard missing audit entries and incomplete compliance reports
description: In our US-West staging environment, the Analytics Dashboard is failing to display complete data for our audit logs and compliance reports. Specifically, entries are missing from the audit log view, and the generated compliance reports appear truncated or incomplete. We are assuming this is a rendering or indexing issue within the dashboard itself as the raw data seems to exist elsewhere. Please check the dashboard's data aggregation logic for these specific reports.

title: HTTP 403 Errors and Data Mismatch in SSO Integration (Production ME)
description: We are reporting a high-impact issue in the Middle East production region affecting 221 users of the SSO Integration Module. Users are encountering HTTP 403 Forbidden errors upon login. Furthermore, those who do manage to bypass the initial error are seeing incorrect data displayed in their dashboards, which does not match their assigned roles or permissions. This suggests a potential authorization or token mapping failure. Immediate investigation is required.

title: Duplicate accounts appearing
description: Hey, we're seeing some duplicate account createds in the system. It's affecting a few people. Can you look into it?

title: Blank Screen and UI Rendering Failure in Billing Disputes Handler
description: Our production environment in the APAC region is experiencing a critical failure in the Billing Disputes Handler. Approximately 387 users are reporting that the application loads to a completely blank screen. Upon inspection, it appears that key UI elements are not rendering, preventing any interaction with the dispute resolution interface. No error messages are displayed to the end-user. This is severely impacting our ability to process billing disputes.

title: MFA Rejections in EU-Central: Unclear if Sync or Security Module
description: We are seeing MFA codes being rejected for two users in our EU-Central production environment. These users are part of the Active Directory sync. We are unsure if this is a configuration issue with the AD sync mapping or if the security layer is incorrectly flagging their login attempts as suspicious. The users themselves are not reporting any unusual activity, just the standard rejection message. Please help us determine the root cause.

title: MFA Prompt Not Appearing for 682 Users in APAC Production
description: A significant number of users (approx. 682) in our APAC production environment are bypassing the MFA step entirely. The prompt is not appearing for them after initial SSO authentication. This represents a critical security gap as users are gaining access without second-factor verification. We need to know why the MFA challenge is not being triggered for these accounts and what needs to be fixed to enforce the policy.

title: Unexpected Logouts and Certificate Expiry Warnings in EU-West
description: Users in our EU-West production environment (46 affected) are reporting being logged out unexpectedly. Concurrently, some users are seeing warnings about an expired certificate. We are unsure if these issues are related or if one is causing the other. Please investigate the session management and certificate status for the Active Directory sync component in this region.

title: API Gateway Timeouts and Slow Responses in Staging
description: We are seeing database query timeouts and generally slow response times through the API Gateway in our EU-Central staging environment. This is impacting 153 users. We are pretty sure this is just a capacity limitation issue since it's a staging environment, but it's blocking our testing. Can you look into increasing the capacity or checking the load?

title: Malformed JSON Response in Sandbox Analytics Dashboard
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our APAC sandbox environment is returning malformed JSON responses. We've checked the source data and it looks fine, so this is definitely a data quality issue in the dashboard's parsing logic. No users are affected as it's just a sandbox, but it's annoying for the dev team. Please fix the data quality.

title: Performance Degradation: DB Timeouts and CPU Spikes in Analytics Dashboard
description: In our APAC production environment, the Analytics Dashboard is exhibiting significant performance issues. Users (approx. 25) are experiencing slow responses and database query timeouts. Monitoring also indicates a spike in CPU usage on the hosting instances during these periods. We need assistance identifying the bottleneck causing these resource spikes and timeouts.

title: Critical: Refunds Not Reflecting and Overcharges in Payment Gateway
description: We are experiencing a critical issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in the APAC production region. A large volume of transactions (approx. 1559 users affected) are showing overcharges, and subsequent refunds are not being reflected in the system. This is creating a major discrepancy in our financial records and impacting customer trust. Immediate resolution is required to correct the transaction states and ensure refunds are processed accurately.

title: Severe Performance Issues: Timeouts and Slow Mobile App in EU-West
description: Our EU-West production environment is seeing critical performance degradation affecting nearly 30,000 users. The Analytics Dashboard is suffering from database query timeouts and slow responses. Additionally, our mobile application performance has tanked, with users reporting slow load times and timeouts. We are unsure if the mobile app slowness is due to the same backend delays or if there is a separate issue with user segmentation or targeting data feeds. Please investigate the root cause of the widespread latency.

title: Attribution Engine dev environment permission issues
description: We are seeing inconsistent access controls in the Attribution Engine within our APAC development environment. Approximately 23 users are affected. Some team members are receiving 'access denied' errors when trying to view campaign data they should have permission for, while others are seeing 'access granted incorrectly' and can see data scopes they shouldn't have. This is blocking our QA testing cycles.

title: Mobile App staging failover not triggering
description: During recent load testing in our US-East staging environment for the Mobile App, we observed that failover did not occur as expected. When the primary endpoint was simulated to be down, the app did not switch to the backup endpoint, resulting in connection errors for about 59 test users. We need this verified before the next release candidate goes to production.

title: Login failures for SSO users in LATAM production
description: We are experiencing intermittent login failures in the production environment for the LATAM region. Users attempting to sign in via the SSO Integration Module are not getting authenticated. The error appears during the redirect phase. It is unclear if the issue stems from the core SSO module or the specific Social Login Connector being used for this region, as both seem involved in the handshake process. This is affecting approximately 34 users.

title: Payment Gateway v2 billing discrepancies (undercharges and duplicates)
description: We have identified significant billing errors in the Payment Gateway v2 production environment (EU-West). Since yesterday, we have seen invoices that are incorrect, specifically cases where the total charged is lower than the agreed amount (undercharge). Concurrently, some of these same customers are reporting duplicate charges on their bank statements despite only one successful transaction log on our side. This impacts nearly 800 users and has high business impact.

title: Analytics Dashboard 503 errors and application crashes
description: The Analytics Dashboard in the EU-Central production environment is currently unstable. Users are reporting that the application crashes upon loading, and the service returns HTTP 503 errors. We have effectively had a full outage for the dashboard for the last hour, affecting about 32 active users who cannot access their reports.

title: Customer Portal connection errors and timeouts
description: We are seeing a high volume of connection issues on the Customer Portal in the EU-West production environment. Users are encountering TLS handshake errors, followed by HTTP 504 gateway timeouts and connection resets. The issue seems to occur when the portal loads dynamic content. It is difficult to determine if this is a core portal infrastructure issue or related to the Analytics Instrumentation SDK that runs on the page, as the errors appear to happen during the resource loading phase for both.

title: Missing audit log entries
description: Hey, just wanted to flag that the audit logs for the Analytics Dashboard don't look right. We noticed some gaps in the history and it seems like the retention policy isn't working as expected for our APAC prod instance. About 14 users mentioned this. Can you check? Thanks.

title: Critical: Duplicate charges and incorrect invoices via Payment Gateway v2
description: We are facing a critical issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in the US-West production environment. Over 21,000 users are affected by billing errors. We are seeing invoices that are calculated incorrectly, and multiple users are reporting duplicate charges for single transactions. This is causing immediate financial reconciliation issues and high support ticket volume.

title: API empty responses and upstream timeouts in Payment Gateway v2 staging
description: In our ANZ staging environment for Payment Gateway v2, API calls are frequently returning empty responses. We suspect this is linked to upstream dependency timeouts occurring during the transaction processing step. This behavior is blocking integration testing for our team of 17 developers.

title: Webhook Engine failures due to outdated docs?
description: We are seeing TLS handshake errors and DNS lookup failures for the Webhook Engine in our EU-Central production environment. We think this is definitely because the internal documentation we are following is stale and we haven't been given the correct endpoints. Please update the docs so we can fix this. Only 3 users are impacted.

title: High latency on Fee Analyzer - capacity issue?
description: The Fee Analyzer in our US-East production environment is exhibiting high latency. Requests are taking much longer than normal to process. We think this is caused by insufficient capacity planning on your side, as traffic has been steady on our end. This is impacting 135 users and is considered high impact.

title: SSO Integration Module redirect loops in EU-West

Users are stuck in a login loop where the SSO redirect keeps cycling back to the login page without authenticating. This is affecting approximately 7,477 users and is preventing them from accessing the application.

title: Analytics Dashboard showing stale data in ME production
description: We are observing that the Analytics Dashboard in the Middle East production region is displaying stale data. Recent events and transactions are not reflecting in the dashboards, with data appearing to be delayed by several hours. This is a critical issue affecting 1,348 users who rely on real-time metrics.

title: Webhooks not firing for Analytics Dashboard
description: We have a critical issue where webhooks are not firing for the Analytics Dashboard in the EU-Central production environment. Events that should trigger downstream notifications are being silently dropped. It is unclear if the issue lies with the Dashboard's event emission logic or if the Data Catalog Service is failing to register the subscriptions. This affects 1,352 users.

title: Access denied errors for SSO Integration Module
description: We are seeing widespread 'access denied' errors for users attempting to authenticate via the SSO Integration Module in our US-East production environment. Approximately 7,923 users are affected and cannot log in. The error occurs after successful identity provider authentication, suggesting a permission check failure within the application.

title: Staging environment Attribution Engine returning 503 errors
description: We are experiencing a full outage in our ANZ staging environment for the Attribution Engine. All requests are returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors. This is affecting approximately 21 users who are trying to validate new campaign data. The issue started around 09:00 local time and has persisted since. Please investigate as soon as possible.

title: High memory usage on Payment Gateway
description: Noticed a spike in memory usage on the Payment Gateway v2 in production (US-East). Not sure when it started exactly but it seems to be happening intermittently. It's only affecting a couple of users right now so not urgent, just wanted to report it.

title: Production SSO failure: Error page and missing MFA prompt in APAC
description: We are seeing a critical issue with the SSO Integration Module in our APAC production environment. Users are being redirected to an error page immediately after authentication attempt, and the expected Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompt is not appearing. This affects approximately 111 users and is blocking their access to internal tools. We need urgent assistance to restore login functionality.

title: Config drift detected in Payment Gateway v2 (APAC Production)
description: Our monitoring systems have flagged a configuration drift in the Payment Gateway v2 instance located in the APAC production region. The current running configuration does not match the expected baseline. This has resulted in minor discrepancies for 1 affected user account. We request a review and synchronization of the configuration to prevent further issues.

title: Webhooks failing and API errors in Analytics Dashboard
description: Something is wrong with the Analytics Dashboard in EU-West. Webhooks aren't firing properly and we're getting some kind of schema error from the API. Lots of users are complaining (around 900+). It's impacting our reporting capabilities. Please check this.

title: Data Pipeline index corruption and disk space issues in ANZ Production
description: We are reporting two related issues with our Data Pipeline in the ANZ production environment. First, index corruption has been detected, which is causing query failures. Second, we are running out of disk space on the storage nodes. These issues are impacting approximately 52 users who rely on this data for daily operations. We need immediate assistance to resolve the disk space constraint and repair the indexes.

title: Deploy Manager issues: Rate limits, autoscaling fail, memory spikes
description: Having problems with Deploy Manager in ANZ production. We are hitting rate limits, autoscaling isn't triggering when it should, and memory usage is spiking. Seems to be affecting about 40 users. Need help figuring out why this is happening.

title: Password reset emails not received via SSO Module (APAC Production)
description: Users in our APAC production environment are reporting that they are not receiving password reset emails initiated through the SSO Integration Module. We have confirmed that the requests are being processed by our system, but the emails are never delivered. This affects approximately 12 users who are currently locked out of their accounts. Please investigate the email delivery mechanism linked to the SSO module.

title: Certificate warnings in Chargeback Handler staging (LATAM)

This issue is currently affecting 3 testers trying to validate the SSO flow. Please assist in correcting the metadata configuration to resolve the authentication errors.

title: Cache Service Performance Degradation: Disk Space, Replication Lag, Index Rebuild
description: We are experiencing multiple issues with the Cache Service in the APAC production environment. The primary nodes are running out of disk space, which appears to be contributing to high replication lag. Additionally, the system is indicating that an index rebuild is required to restore optimal performance. These issues are impacting around 32 users who are experiencing slow response times. We require urgent support to free up disk space and manage the replication and indexing processes.

title: Expired certificate warning on Payment Gateway
description: Seeing a certificate expired warning on the Payment Gateway v2 in ANZ production. Not sure if this is affecting everything or just some transactions. About 10 users mentioned issues. Can someone check the certs?

title: Analytics Dashboard Timeouts and API Schema Errors (US-West)
description: Users in the US-West production environment are reporting frequent timeouts when loading the Analytics Dashboard. We need assistance in identifying the cause of the schema errors and resolving the timeout issues.

title: LDAP Connector timeouts in Production
description: Lots of timeouts happening with the LDAP Connector in ME production. A ton of users are affected (700+). Can't access anything. Please fix.

title: Rate Limiter blocking MFA prompts and rejecting codes
description: We think our Rate Limiter configuration is too aggressive and is interfering with our authentication flow. title: Notification Hub webhooks not firing in EU-Central production
description: We are experiencing issues with our Notification Hub integrations in the EU-Central region. Since this morning, webhooks are not firing as expected for approximately 65 users. We have checked the configuration and it appears correct, but the system seems to be retrying and then exhausting the retries without delivering the payload. This is causing moderate disruption to our downstream automation workflows.

title: SSO Module bulk import failing with 'account not found' errors in ME Production
description: Our recent bulk user import via the SSO Integration Module in the Middle East production environment has partially failed. About 235 accounts are affected. This is blocking our onboarding process and has a high business impact.

title: Incorrect invoice generation in Payment Gateway v2 staging
description: We noticed that invoices generated in the APAC staging environment for Payment Gateway v2 are displaying incorrect amounts. This affects about 3 test accounts. While this is currently low impact as it is in staging, we need to ensure the logic is correct before pushing to production.

title: Missing entries in Self-Service Hub audit logs (US-East Staging)
description: In our US-East staging environment, the audit logs for the Self-Service Hub are missing entries for several actions performed by our QA team (approx. 17 users). We cannot verify who performed specific configuration changes, which is hindering our ability to debug other issues in this environment. This is a moderate impact to our internal testing workflow.

title: Invoice calculation error in Payment Gateway v2 dev environment
description: When generating test invoices in the EU-Central development environment for Payment Gateway v2, the totals are calculating incorrectly. This is isolated to our dev setup and has no immediate business impact, but we wanted to flag it so it can be investigated as part of our regular bug triage.

title: Analytics Dashboard showing missing data and suspected data loss (LATAM)

title: Status Page webhooks failing due to rate limit in ME Production
description: Our Status Page integrations in the Middle East region are experiencing high failure rates. The impact is high as customers are not receiving timely notifications.

title: Mobile App issues

title: Analytics Dashboard webhooks not firing and API returning empty responses
