title: Analytics API returning HTTP 500 and timeouts in Staging APAC
description: In the APAC staging environment, the Analytics Dashboard is failing to retrieve data via the API. We are consistently receiving empty responses, followed by timeouts and HTTP 500 errors. This issue is affecting approximately 22 users who are unable to view their analytics data. The instability is causing moderate business impact as it prevents us from validating new features before production deployment.

title: Incorrect charges appearing in Development ME environment
description: We are seeing overcharges in the Payment Gateway v2 sandbox in the ME region. The amounts on the test invoices do not match our expected totals. Some of these discrepancies look like they might be related to tax calculations or jurisdiction rules, while others seem to be direct payment processing errors. It is difficult to determine if the gateway is applying the wrong price or if the tax resolver is adding an incorrect amount on top of the correct base price. This affects 534 test transactions and has a high impact on our billing validation workflow.

title: SSO users locked out with rejected MFA codes in US-East Staging
description: In the US-East staging environment, users utilizing the SSO Integration Module are being locked out of their accounts. When they attempt to log in, the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) code provided is being rejected. This issue is currently affecting 27 users and is preventing them from accessing necessary tools. The moderate business impact requires a fix to the authentication flow or MFA validation logic.

title: Missing records and data loss in Production Analytics Dashboard
description: Users in the APAC production environment are reporting missing records and perceived data loss within the Analytics Dashboard. We have also observed truncated files during export operations. Approximately 38 users are affected. We think this is definitely a customer configuration error on our end, likely due to a recent update in our filtering settings. Please verify our configuration, though we are confident this is why the data appears incomplete.

title: Incorrect invoices and duplicate charge notices in APAC Production
description: We are receiving reports of incorrect invoices from the Payment Gateway v2 in the APAC production region. Specifically, users are reporting duplicate charges, and we have also received several chargeback notices related to these billing errors. Although no active users are currently blocked, the financial accuracy of the invoices is compromised. Please investigate the billing logic to resolve the duplicate charging and invoice generation issues.

title: Feature flag not applying in EU-West Development
description: In the EU-West development environment, we are unable to get a specific feature flag to apply to the Analytics Dashboard. The flag is set to 'on', but the corresponding UI elements or data views are not appearing for the 3 affected users. This low-impact issue is blocking our internal testing of new features. Please check why the flag configuration is not propagating to the dev instance.

title: Partial outage reported for Rate Limiter in US-West Production
description: We are experiencing a partial outage with the Rate Limiter service in the US-West production environment. Approximately 16 users are reporting service disruptions. The moderate business impact suggests that traffic is being throttled incorrectly or services are timing out. We need assistance in restoring full availability of the rate limiting functionality.

title: Critical SSO outage: Users locked out and MFA prompt missing in ANZ Development
description: There is a critical issue with the SSO Integration Module in the ANZ development environment. A large number of users (1,285) are being locked out of their accounts, and for many, the MFA prompt is not appearing at all during login attempts. This prevents any access to the system and has a critical business impact on our development workflow. Immediate investigation is required to fix the authentication entry point.

title: Critical Billing Errors: Undercharges and Incorrect Invoices in ANZ Sandbox
description: We are facing a critical issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in the ANZ sandbox environment. Tests are generating invoices with incorrect amounts, specifically undercharging for services. This has resulted in multiple chargeback notices being triggered in the test flow. With 10,442 affected transactions, this severely impacts our ability to validate billing logic before production. Please prioritize the correction of invoice generation and pricing calculations.

title: Incorrect data visibility and access rights in ME Production SSO
description: In the ME production environment, users of the SSO Integration Module are seeing wrong data sets. Additionally, access seems to be granted incorrectly, allowing users to view information they should not have access to. This affects 6 users and has a low immediate business impact, but poses a security and data integrity concern. Please review the access control configurations tied to the SSO tokens.

title: Feature missing after recent release in ME Staging Subscription Manager
description: Following the latest release, a previously available feature is missing from the Subscription Manager in the ME staging environment. Approximately 31 users are unable to access this functionality, which is expected to be present based on the release notes. This moderate impact is hindering our validation of the new release. Please check if the feature was accidentally disabled or omitted during the deployment.

title: URGENT: Payment Gateway session timeouts and MFA failures
description: We are seeing massive issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in production. About 250 users are getting their sessions expired unexpectedly and their MFA codes are being rejected. This is definitely a dependency failure on our side causing the gateway to hang. We need this fixed immediately as business impact is high.

title: Subscription Manager charging twice
description: Hey, the subscription manager is double charging some people in the dev environment. Not sure why. Can you check?

title: Identity Vault certificate warnings and missing logs
description: Our Identity Vault instance is throwing certificate warnings and we noticed that some entries are missing from the audit logs. This seems to be an issue within the vault configuration itself. Please investigate why the vault is behaving this way.

title: Invoice Service returning 403 errors
description: We are getting 403s from the invoice service in staging. Not sure when it started. Help.

title: SSO Module showing wrong tenant data
description: The SSO Integration Module is displaying data for the wrong tenant and then giving access denied errors. This looks like a bug in the SSO module's data mapping logic. Please fix the module.

title: Analytics Dashboard audit log missing
description: Audit logs are missing in the analytics dashboard in staging. Can you look into this?

title: SSO Login failures
description: SSO is broken. We are getting error pages, login failures, and the MFA prompt isn't appearing. Please assist.

title: Consent record missing in Analytics Dashboard
description: In the EU-West production environment, we have observed that a specific user's consent record is missing from the Analytics Dashboard. No other data appears to be affected, and there is no current business impact, but we need to ensure compliance records are accurate. Please verify the status of this consent entry.

title: Identity Vault critical issues
description: Production is down. Getting 401s, password reset links aren't working, and MFA codes are failing. Huge number of users affected. Fix ASAP.

title: Analytics Dashboard audit gaps
description: We are detecting gaps in the audit logs and the retention policy doesn't seem to be applied correctly in the dev environment. Lots of users are impacted. Please check.

title: Payment Gateway subscription issues
description: Subscriptions are not renewing and some are being charged twice in the sandbox environment. This appears to be a logic error within the Payment Gateway v2 subscription handling. Please investigate the gateway code.

title: Slow performance and mobile app slowness
description: Our production Analytics Dashboard is extremely slow, and this slowness is also affecting the mobile app performance. Users are experiencing long response times. It is unclear if the issue originates from the dashboard service or if it's related to data retrieval/cataloging, but the overall user experience is severely degraded.

title: Subscription Manager billing discrepancies in staging
description: We have identified billing inconsistencies in the US-West staging environment using the Subscription Manager. Some accounts were charged twice, while others were undercharged. Currently, there is no business impact as this is a test environment, but we need to resolve these calculation errors before promoting to production. Please verify the billing logic applied to these specific test cases.

title: Incorrect invoices generated by Payment Gateway v2 in staging
description: In the EU-West staging environment, the Payment Gateway v2 is generating invoices with incorrect amounts. This affects approximately 53 test users and has a moderate business impact on our billing verification process. The error occurs during the final invoice generation step. Please investigate why the calculated totals do not match the expected contract rates.

title: SSO Provisioning sync stuck in staging
description: The SSO Integration Module in the US-East staging environment has a stuck synchronization process. User provisioning is halted, and the sync status shows no progress. This affects about 37 test users and has a moderate impact on our onboarding workflow tests. Please check the status of the sync job and why provisioning is not completing.

title: Payment Gateway v2 API returning empty responses in ME production
description: We are experiencing a high-impact issue with the Payment Gateway v2 API in our production environment (ME region). Since approximately 09:00 UTC, the API has been returning empty JSON responses (HTTP 200 OK but with an empty body) for roughly 330 users attempting transactions. This is effectively blocking all payments for these users. We have verified that the request headers and payloads are correct, but the gateway is not populating the response fields. Please investigate immediately as this is causing significant revenue loss.

title: Cache service down / queries failing
description: Hey, we're seeing timeouts on database queries and something about index corruption in the dev environment cache service. It's affecting a bunch of our dev team (around 500 people) and we can't do any work. It's urgent. Please look into it.

title: Config Manager issues
description: Getting errors with the Config Manager in the ME dev environment. Seems like there is a certificate issue and we are getting 502s. Only two of us are seeing it but it's blocking our work. Please fix.

title: Customer Portal timeouts and status page discrepancy
description: Our Customer Portal in the US-West production environment is experiencing severe timeouts for about 590 users. We cannot access any pages or submit tickets. However, our internal monitoring and the public Status Page UI currently show the service as 'Operational' and green. We are unsure if the portal itself is down or if the status reporting mechanism is failing to detect the outage, as both services seem inconsistent with the actual user experience. We need help determining which system is malfunctioning.

title: API Gateway full outage in ANZ production
description: The API Gateway in the ANZ production environment is currently experiencing a full outage. All incoming requests are failing with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors. This started at 14:30 local time and has affected approximately 70 active users. The gateway dashboard shows no traffic, and our health checks are timing out. We have restarted the service nodes, but the issue persists. Please escalate as this is blocking our primary API traffic.

title: Metrics Engine data residency and retention policy mismatch in ME
description: We have identified a configuration issue with the Metrics Engine in the ME production environment. Data residency flags are mismatching with the actual storage locations for about 28 specific data streams, and more critically, the configured retention policies are not being applied. Data that should have been purged after 90 days is still present. This poses a compliance risk. Please investigate why the policy engine is not enforcing the defined rules and correct the residency tags.

title: Refund Manager webhook failures and JSON errors
description: We are encountering intermittent issues with the Refund Manager. We are receiving malformed JSON responses when calling the refund API, and our webhook retries for refund status updates are exhausting without success. This is affecting about 26 users. We are unable to determine if the Refund Manager itself is generating bad data or if the Disputes Workflow Engine, which consumes these webhooks, is failing to process them correctly and causing the retries. The symptoms appear across both systems.

title: Critical performance degradation and DB timeouts in Payment Gateway v2 staging
description: The Payment Gateway v2 in our US-West staging environment is severely degraded. We are seeing extremely slow API response times and frequent database query timeouts. This issue is impacting the entire QA team and automated test suites, affecting an estimated 5,822 transactions per day in the staging pipeline. Because this blocks all feature verification and release testing, the business impact is critical. Please investigate the database performance and API latency immediately.

title: High CPU usage and slow responses in Cohort Builder (ANZ Prod)
description: We are observing performance issues with the Cohort Builder in the ANZ production environment. Users are reporting slow response times when generating cohorts, and our monitoring shows a spike in CPU usage on the worker nodes coinciding with these requests. Approximately 24 users are affected. The issue seems to correlate with large cohort queries. Please investigate whether this is a resource bottleneck or a processing inefficiency.

title: Mobile app data issues
description: Users on the mobile app in APAC are seeing duplicate records and data mismatches. It's affecting a lot of people (147+) and is really bad for our brand. We don't know exactly when it started but it's happening now. Please fix.

title: Token Service timeouts and disk errors affecting auth
description: We are experiencing database query timeouts and critical disk usage alerts on the Token Service in US-West production. Additionally, our backup jobs have failed. This is causing intermittent failures for about 92 users. We are unsure if the Token Service infrastructure (disk/DB) is the root cause or if the failures are originating from the Authorization/Policy Engine which relies on these tokens, as both systems show errors during these incidents. Please help diagnose the source of the bottleneck.

title: Attribution engine timeouts
description: The Attribution Engine in ANZ is timing out. We think it's because a third party API is down or upstream dependency error. Not sure how many users are affected exactly, maybe 40. It's moderate impact but annoying. Please check.

title: SSO Integration Module returning HTTP 403 for specific users in ME
description: In the ME production environment, the SSO Integration Module is returning HTTP 403 Forbidden errors for approximately 29 users attempting to log in. Our analysis shows that these users have been granted access incorrectly in the underlying directory service, likely due to a group mapping error. Despite having the correct permissions on the IdP, the SSO module is denying access. Please investigate the permission validation logic and the user group synchronization.

title: Analytics Dashboard webhooks not working
description: Webhooks aren't firing from the Analytics Dashboard in EU-Central staging. About 73 users are waiting on data and nothing is coming through. We checked the config and it looks fine. Please help.

title: MFA code rejection during login in SSO sandbox (EU-West)
description: We are encountering a specific issue with the SSO Integration Module in the EU-West sandbox environment. Users are experiencing login failures where valid MFA codes are being rejected with a generic error message. This is affecting 4 testers who are trying to validate the new MFA flow. The login page loads correctly, but the second factor verification step consistently fails even when the code is generated correctly within the time window. Please investigate the MFA validation service connectivity.

title: Chat widget missing from UI in production (LATAM)
description: We are seeing an issue in our production environment within the LATAM region where the Chat Widget fails to render. The placeholder area is completely blank, and users cannot access support through the standard interface. This is impacting approximately 425 users. Please investigate why the UI element is not loading.

title: HTTP 403 Error in Attribution Engine (Dev)
description: While working in the development environment (US-East), I am consistently receiving an HTTP 403 Forbidden error when trying to interact with the Attribution Engine. I believe there is a permissions or configuration issue within the engine itself preventing access.

title: Rate limiter blocking requests
description: Our production app in US-West is hitting capacity limits with the Rate Limiter. Several users are getting blocked and we are seeing quota exceeded messages. Need help adjusting this.

title: Slow performance on Cohort Builder
description: The Cohort Builder in production (US-West) is responding very slowly. It takes a long time to load results for my queries. Please check if there is an issue.

title: Deployment failures and rollbacks in EU-Central
description: We are experiencing repeated deployment failures in our production environment (EU-Central). When a deploy attempt fails, a rollback is automatically triggered. We are unsure if the failure is originating from the Deploy Manager itself or if there is an issue with the region failover controller causing the deployments to be rejected.

title: Billing Engine sync and provisioning stuck
description: The Billing Engine in our ANZ production environment seems to be stuck. Sync processes are not completing, and new provisioning requests are hanging. This issue appeared recently.

title: Webhooks not firing from Analytics Dashboard (Staging)
description: In our staging environment (LATAM), the Analytics Dashboard is not triggering configured webhooks. Data updates appear correctly in the UI, but the downstream systems relying on these webhooks are not receiving any payloads. This is blocking our integration testing.

title: Incomplete compliance reports and audit log gaps (ANZ)
description: We have identified two issues in our production Analytics Dashboard (ANZ region). First, the generated compliance reports are showing incomplete data for the last quarter. Second, we have detected gaps in the audit logs where user activities should have been recorded but are missing. We need to understand why data integrity is compromised.

title: Corrupted export and missing records from Token Service
description: In the EU-West production environment, exports generated from the Token Service are arriving corrupted. Additionally, several specific records are missing entirely from the exported dataset. This affects our internal reconciliation process.

title: Incorrect invoices and chargebacks due to Tax Calculator
description: We are receiving numerous chargeback notices because invoices are being calculated incorrectly. We believe the Tax Calculator in our US-West production environment is applying the wrong rates. This is currently impacting over 1,700 users and causing significant financial disruption.

title: High latency and intermittent failures in Analytics Dashboard (Dev)
description: We are seeing high latency and slow response times in the Analytics Dashboard, leading to intermittent failures. This is affecting about 13 users in the EU-Central development environment. We think this is happening because the internal documentation we are following is stale and doesn't reflect the current configuration requirements.

title: Critical: Currency conversion errors and subscription renewals failing
description: We have a critical issue in the ME production environment with the Wallet Service. Currency conversions are displaying incorrect amounts, and a large number of user subscriptions are failing to renew automatically. This is currently affecting over 3,000 users and requires immediate attention.

title: Full outage and application crashes on API Gateway (Staging)
description: Our staging environment (US-East) is experiencing a full outage. The API Gateway is returning errors that are causing the connected applications to crash. We are confident this is caused by an incomplete rollback of a recent change to the gateway configuration.

title: UI elements not rendering or misaligned in Customer Portal
description: There is a critical visual regression in the Customer Portal staging environment (EU-West). Multiple UI elements are failing to render entirely, while others are severely misaligned, making the portal unusable for testing. This impacts our entire QA team.

title: SSO Integration Module sync stuck and bulk import failed
description: In our EU-West production environment, the SSO Integration Module has stopped syncing user data. The sync status is stuck. Furthermore, we attempted a bulk import of new users which failed completely, resulting in duplicate accounts being created for some existing users before the failure. This is affecting a subset of our user base.

title: MFA and password resets failing - definitely expired API key
description: We have 2 users in production US-East who cannot complete login. The MFA code is getting rejected and the password reset link says it's expired. We think this is because of an expired API key on our end causing the session tokens to invalidate prematurely. Please check the key status.

title: Incorrect currency conversion and refund delays in Dev APAC
description: During our development testing in the APAC region, we noticed that currency conversions are calculating incorrect amounts. Additionally, when we issue refunds, they are not being reflected in the dashboard. This is affecting 40 test users and causing moderate disruption to our integration testing.

title: Exported files corrupted and records missing in EU-West Analytics
description: We are experiencing issues with our Analytics Dashboard in the EU-West production region. Several exported files arrive corrupted and unreadable. Furthermore, we noticed that specific records are missing from the output data compared to what is visible in the UI. No business impact reported as this was noticed during a routine check, but it needs attention.

title: Rate limiting (HTTP 429) and webhook failures in Sandbox
description: In our US-East sandbox environment, we are receiving HTTP 429 errors when attempting to fetch data. Simultaneously, our configured webhooks are not firing for these events. This is affecting a small group of 2 developers and has low business impact, but we need to understand why the rate limit is being hit and why webhooks aren't triggering.

title: Provisioning stuck and duplicate accounts in SSO Sandbox
description: We have a critical issue in our US-East sandbox where user provisioning appears stuck, yet duplicate accounts are being created. This affects over 12,000 test users. We are unsure if this is a configuration issue within the SSO module itself or a problem with the underlying message queue processing the provisioning events.

title: Database query timeouts affecting Rate Limiter in APAC Prod
description: Our production Rate Limiter in the APAC region is experiencing database query timeouts. This is causing moderate impact for 20 users who are seeing latency or failures when hitting rate-limited endpoints. We need assistance investigating the timeout causes.

title: Refunds not reflecting - possible SSO or Payment Gateway issue
description: In our EU-West production environment, refunds processed via Payment Gateway v2 are not reflecting in the system for 33 users. We are currently unable to determine if this is a failure in the payment processing logic or if the user session/authentication (SSO Broker) is causing the status updates to fail to sync. Moderate business impact.

title: Mass account lockouts via LDAP in EU-West Production
description: We are seeing a critical issue where 1,258 users in the EU-West production environment are being locked out of their accounts. This is happening through the LDAP Connector. Users are unable to log in and the lockouts seem to be triggering unexpectedly. Immediate assistance required.

title: Intermittent 503 errors in Staging Data Pipeline (ME)
description: Our Data Pipeline in the ME staging region is returning intermittent HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors. This is affecting 3 testers with low business impact. The failures are sporadic, making them difficult to reproduce consistently, but they are preventing our team from completing current validation tasks.

title: High volume HTTP 429 errors in Payment Gateway Dev APAC
description: We are encountering a high volume of HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors in our development APAC environment for Payment Gateway v2. This is impacting 718 users and has a high business impact as it is blocking our integration tests. We need to know if the rate limits are set incorrectly or if there is an issue with the gateway.

title: API Gateway Outage and 503s in US-East Production
description: We are reporting a full outage on the API Gateway in the US-East production region. The service is returning HTTP 503 errors for all requests. This is affecting 18 users with moderate business impact. Please investigate the cause of the downtime and service unavailability.

title: HTTP 403 and wrong data in Attribution Engine - likely rate limit config
description: In our ME development environment, the Attribution Engine is returning HTTP 403 Forbidden errors and users are seeing incorrect data. We think it's because of a rate limit misconfiguration that is interfering with the API calls and causing permission errors. Please verify our rate limit settings.

title: App is slow and failing sometimes
description: Our mobile app performance is terrible. It's super slow and keeps failing intermittently. A lot of users in ANZ are complaining. It's happening with the metrics stuff too. Fix ASAP.

title: Login failures and infinite loop in SSO Module (ME Prod)
description: We are observing login failures in the production ME region for the SSO Integration Module. Users are getting stuck in a login loop where they are redirected back to the login screen repeatedly after authentication attempts. No specific business impact reported yet as the number of affected users is currently low, but this needs to be resolved to prevent wider issues.

title: Provisioning stuck and duplicate accounts in SSO Dev US-West
description: In our US-West development environment, user provisioning tasks are getting stuck in a pending state. Concurrently, we are seeing duplicate user accounts being created. This is happening for the SSO Integration Module. No immediate business impact or affected user count reported as this is isolated to dev testing.

title: Billing Engine performance degraded, DB timeouts and disk alerts
description: We are seeing significant latency in the Billing Engine in production (EU-Central). About 80 users are complaining that their invoices aren't generating or are timing out. On our infrastructure monitoring, we see the database connection pool is exhausted and queries are timing out. Simultaneously, the servers hosting the billing services are reporting 'out of disk space'. We aren't sure if the billing service is writing too much data causing the disk issue which then breaks the DB, or if the logging aggregator is failing to flush logs causing disk full, which then impacts the billing service. Please investigate urgently as this is impacting moderate business operations.

title: Subscriptions failing to renew in Payment Gateway v2 (US-East)
description: Hello, we have identified an issue with subscription renewals in our production environment (US-East). Starting around 09:00 UTC today, approximately 109 active subscribers have not had their recurring payments processed. The status remains 'Active' in our system, but the gateway does not show any transaction attempts for these accounts. This is a high-priority issue as it is directly impacting revenue and customer retention. We have verified that the card details on file are valid and the expiry dates are correct. Please check the renewal job scheduler and the gateway API logs.

title: Intermittent Data Pipeline crashes in Staging (US-East)
description: We are experiencing intermittent failures in the Data Pipeline service in the US-East staging environment. The application crashes randomly during large batch processing jobs. This happens roughly every 3rd or 4th run. The impact is currently low as it only affects one developer running test batches, but it is blocking our QA validation for the next release. The crash seems to happen when the pipeline tries to commit a large set of records, but there is no clear error pattern in the application logs. Please advise if there are known stability issues with the current build.

title: SSO Federation Metadata issue
description: Hi, our SSO Integration Module in ANZ production is having problems. We think there is a mismatch with the federation metadata. Users are complaining that they can't log in. It's affecting about 140 people and is causing a high business impact. We tried updating the metadata but it didn't work. Please help.

title: MFA Manager granting access incorrectly / 403 errors
description: Urgent issue with MFA Manager in LATAM production. We are seeing two conflicting behaviors: some users are getting HTTP 403 errors when trying to access resources they should have permission for, while other users are being granted access incorrectly without completing the required MFA challenge. This affects 313 users and has a high business impact. We suspect the MFA Manager's decision logic or policy enforcement is broken. Please investigate the core MFA service configuration immediately.

title: Analytics Dashboard partial outage in Sandbox (US-West)
description: We are reporting a partial outage of the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West sandbox environment. Approximately 78 users are affected, though business impact is moderate as this is a non-production area. Some widgets load successfully while others return blank screens or spinner indicators indefinitely. This started around 14:00 local time today. The underlying data sources appear to be up, but the visualization layer seems to be failing to render certain components. Please check the dashboard service health.

title: Critical Application Crashes in SSO Integration Module (EU-West)
description: The SSO Integration Module in our EU-West staging environment is crashing frequently, causing a critical outage for our integration testing. This affects 1737 test users and completely blocks our release pipeline. The application terminates with exit code 137 or similar resource exhaustion errors during authentication flow processing. We have checked the module logs and they stop abruptly before the crash. We believe the issue is within the SSO module's handling of authentication requests. Please investigate the module stability urgently.

title: Payment Gateway issues: double charges and declines
description: Hi, we are seeing some weird stuff in the Payment Gateway v2 staging (US-East). A few users (about 3) are getting overcharged or have their payments declined unexpectedly. One guy got charged twice for the same subscription. We don't have the exact timestamps or error codes handy, but it's happening intermittently. Low impact for now since it's staging, but we need it fixed before we go to prod.

title: MFA prompts not appearing in Payment Gateway v2 (US-West)
description: Critical issue in US-West production. The Payment Gateway v2 is failing to trigger MFA prompts for high-risk transactions. This is affecting 1463 users who are bypassing multi-factor authentication entirely. This is a severe security vulnerability and compliance risk. We expected the 3DS challenge or SMS OTP to appear, but the transactions are completing immediately. Please investigate the MFA integration logic within the gateway service immediately.

title: Login loops and MFA rejection in Payment Gateway v2 Dev (ME)
description: We are experiencing a login loop in the Payment Gateway v2 development environment in the ME region. When users attempt to log in, they are redirected to SSO, then bounced back to the login page repeatedly. If they try to bypass SSO, the MFA code is rejected. There are no actual users affected (impact is none, 0 users) as this is a dev environment, but it is blocking our testing team from progressing. We suspect an issue with the SSO redirect configuration and MFA token validation logic.

title: High latency in Cohort Builder (LATAM Production)
description: Users in our LATAM production environment are reporting significant delays when using the Cohort Builder. On average, cohort creation and query execution times have increased by 300% compared to last week. This affects 61 active users and is causing moderate business impact due to delayed marketing campaign analysis. The system eventually returns results, but the wait time is unacceptable for interactive exploration. We have confirmed that the underlying database load is within normal limits. Please investigate the Cohort Builder service performance.

title: API Gateway certificate warnings and circuit breaker trips
description: We are seeing 'certificate expired' warnings in the API Gateway logs in APAC production. While the gateway itself is accepting traffic, we are noticing intermittent connection drops that look like the circuit breaker is tripping. We aren't sure if the certificate issue is causing the handshake failures that then trigger the circuit breaker, or if the circuit breaker is misconfigured and falsely flagging healthy endpoints as down due to some unrelated SSL handshake delay. Only 1 user is reporting it currently, so low impact, but we want to understand the root cause.

title: Analytics Dashboard API returning empty/malformed responses (Sandbox)
description: In the US-East sandbox, the Analytics Dashboard is returning empty JSON responses, malformed JSON, and hitting rate limits when we query the API. No users are affected as this is a sandbox, so impact is none. However, this is blocking our development. We think this is definitely caused by incorrect DNS configuration on our end or the sandbox environment pointing to the wrong internal service host. Please check the DNS resolution and routing for the analytics service.

title: Token Service certificate warning affecting US-West Production
description: We are receiving persistent certificate warnings from the Token Service in our US-West production environment. This is affecting 89 users who are experiencing intermittent authentication failures. The business impact is moderate. We are concerned that the Token Service's SSL certificates are nearing expiration or are invalid, causing clients to reject the handshake. Please verify the certificate chain and validity for the Token Service.

title: SSO Sessions expiring unexpectedly in ANZ Production
description: Critical issue with the SSO Integration Module in ANZ production. Active user sessions are expiring unexpectedly after a very short duration (minutes instead of hours). This is affecting 1756 users and causing a high volume of helpdesk tickets as users are constantly forced to re-authenticate. This is severely impacting productivity and business operations. We have checked the session timeout configurations and they appear to be set correctly. Please investigate the session management logic within the SSO module.

title: Notifications not sending / API issues
description: We are seeing rate limit exceeded errors and our webhooks are retrying but failing. The API just returns empty responses sometimes. Not sure what's going on, please check.

title: Password reset links failing with invalid token in EU-West
description: Users in the EU-West region are unable to complete password resets. When they click the link sent via email, they receive an 'invalid token' error or the link appears expired. This is affecting approximately 18 users and preventing account access.

title: Intermittent event tracking failures in EU-Central
description: We are experiencing intermittent failures with the Event Tracker in our production EU-Central environment. Some events are successfully recorded while others are missing entirely from the dashboard. This affects about 20 users and is causing gaps in our behavioral data.

title: MFA prompt missing and unexpected session timeouts
description: Some users are reporting that the Multi-Factor Authentication prompt is not appearing during login, leading to unexpected session expirations and subsequent account lockouts. This seems to be isolated to the US-West production environment. We have not observed widespread impact yet, but it is causing friction for individual users.

title: Refunds not reflecting and incorrect tax calculations
description: In our development environment (EU-West), we are noticing that refund transactions are not being reflected correctly in the Subscription Manager. Additionally, the tax amounts calculated on these transactions are incorrect. We need to investigate why the Subscription Manager is not handling these adjustments properly.

title: Billing discrepancies: Incorrect tax, undercharges, and renewal failures
description: We are seeing significant billing issues in the ANZ production environment. Customers are being undercharged, tax amounts are calculated incorrectly, and some subscriptions are not renewing as expected. Approximately 673 users are affected. There is confusion regarding whether the transaction records match the actual amounts charged.

title: Missing consent records in Staging Analytics (LATAM)
description: In our staging environment for the LATAM region, the Analytics Dashboard is showing missing consent records for approximately 22 users. This is preventing us from accurately verifying compliance with local data regulations before pushing to production.

title: Unexpected permission denied errors and roles not applying in ANZ
description: Users in the ANZ production environment are encountering 'permission denied' errors even though they have the correct roles assigned in the SSO Integration Module. It appears that some roles are not being applied correctly during login, affecting about 54 users.

title: Duplicate charges and chargebacks reported by users
description: We are receiving numerous reports from customers of duplicate charges on their credit cards, followed by chargeback notices. This is happening in the US-West production environment and affects roughly 349 users. The duplicate transactions appear to occur shortly after the initial successful charge.

title: Missing data in Chat Widget transcripts
description: Chat conversations conducted via the Chat Widget in the ME production region are showing missing data. Specifically, some message contents or metadata are absent from the transcripts when viewed by agents. This affects approximately 30 users and hinders our support quality analysis.

title: Service unresponsive and failover failure in Dev APAC
description: Our Deploy Manager in the APAC development environment has gone unresponsive. We tried initiating a failover, but it did not occur, resulting in a partial outage. About 492 users are affected. We think it's because of an expired certificate on our end causing the handshake to fail.

title: Consent records missing and retention policies not enforced
description: In the ANZ production environment, the Analytics Dashboard is not showing consent records for some users, and it appears that the configured retention policies are not being applied. Data that should have been deleted remains present. This affects approximately 39 users.

title: Subscription charged twice in staging
description: While testing subscription flows in the US-West staging environment, we noticed that a test subscription was charged twice. The second charge appears immediately after the first one. No real users are affected, but we need to fix this logic before production release.

title: Login failures in SSO Module (Staging US-East)
description: A group of users in our US-East staging environment are experiencing login failures through the SSO Integration Module. They are unable to authenticate and access the application. This is affecting about 34 users and blocking our testing activities.

title: SSO redirect loop causing login issues
description: One user in the US-East production environment is stuck in a redirect loop when trying to log in via SSO. They are redirected back to the login page repeatedly and cannot access their account. This appears to be an isolated incident for now.

title: Received unexpected chargeback notices due to undercharged invoices
description: We started receiving multiple chargeback notices from our customers this week in the production environment for the LATAM region. Upon reviewing the billing records, it appears that the system is undercharging these accounts compared to their contracted rates. This discrepancy has affected approximately 123 users and is causing significant financial and reputational impact. We need help identifying why the charges are lower than expected and how to resolve the chargeback disputes.

title: UI rendering issues and broken search/sorting in Staging
description: In the US-East staging environment for Feedback Collector, we are seeing several functional regressions. First, certain UI elements are failing to render correctly, leaving blank spaces or broken layouts. Second, the search functionality is returning incorrect results that do not match the query terms. Third, the sorting and filtering options are not working as intended, producing inconsistent or empty outputs. These issues are impacting about 122 users who are testing the new features, and we consider this high priority as it blocks our release validation.

title: HTTP 403 errors and unexpected privilege escalation in Production SSO
description: We are experiencing two related issues with the SSO Integration Module in the US-West production environment. First, users are receiving HTTP 403 Forbidden errors when attempting to access protected resources that they should have permission for. Second, and more concerning, we have observed that some users are being granted elevated privileges upon login, even though their underlying identity records do not reflect these higher permission levels. This affects approximately 226 users and poses a significant security risk. We need an immediate investigation into the permission mapping and token issuance logic.

title: Audit logs missing and retention policies not enforced in Staging
description: We have detected gaps in the audit log data within our Staging (US-West) Analytics Dashboard. Specifically, certain user actions are not being recorded in the logs, and we are seeing inconsistencies with our data retention policies. Logs that should have been archived or deleted according to our retention configuration are still present, while others are missing entirely. This issue is affecting about 796 users who rely on these dashboards for compliance and behavioral analysis. We believe there is a problem with how the dashboard is processing and storing the log events.

title: SSO error page displayed during login failures
description: Users in the ANZ production environment are reporting that when they attempt to log in via the SSO Integration Module, they are met with a generic SSO error page instead of completing the authentication process. We do not have specific error codes at this time, but the issue is reproducible when users try to access the portal. Currently, there are no reported business impacts or affected users quantified, but we are flagging this for review to ensure authentication stability.

title: SSO Login issues and access weirdness
description: Hey, we are having some trouble with the SSO module in ANZ prod. A few accounts got locked out and some users seem to have extra privileges they shouldn't. It's only about 8 people but it's annoying. Can you check? Thanks.

title: Slow payment processing
description: The payment gateway in the ME production region is feeling really slow. Just wanted to let you know it's lagging.

title: Deployment fails with migration script errors in Staging APAC
description: When trying to push updates to the Staging environment in APAC, the Deploy Manager is failing. We see errors related to the migration scripts running during the deployment process. The pipeline halts, and we aren't sure if the issue is strictly within the deployment tool's handling of the scripts or if the notifications we are sending out as part of the migration are triggering something that blocks the process. This is affecting 53 users who are waiting for the update to be released. Moderate impact.

title: Incorrect data display and privilege issues in Identity Vault
description: In the ME production environment for Identity Vault, we have identified a security concern affecting 41 users. Some users are seeing wrong data associated with their profiles or other users' profiles. Additionally, we have observed cases where elevated privileges were granted incorrectly, allowing users to access resources beyond their intended role. This misalignment between expected access and actual behavior is causing moderate business impact and requires urgent review of the identity mapping and permission enforcement mechanisms.

title: Payment timeouts in EU-Central
description: We are seeing timeouts with the Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-Central production region. It's only affecting a few users (about 3), but it's frustrating. We think it's because of a bad deployment last week. This is definitely a deployment problem on your end.

title: Certificate warnings on gateway
description: Seeing some certificate warnings in EU-West. Not sure how many people see it or when it started.

title: MFA issues in APAC Production
description: We are encountering two issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in the APAC production region. First, valid MFA codes are being rejected by the system, causing login failures. Second, for some users, the MFA prompt is not appearing at all, preventing them from completing the authentication step. This affects approximately 6 users and has a low business impact, but it is blocking these specific transactions. We need assistance debugging the MFA integration.

title: Unexpected permission denials and privilege escalations in APAC SSO
description: In the APAC production environment, users of the SSO Integration Module are reporting two distinct issues. First, some users are receiving 'permission denied' errors unexpectedly, even when they have valid sessions. Second, we have observed that other users are gaining elevated privileges without proper authorization, suggesting a mismatch in how roles are being mapped during the SSO handshake. This affects 20 users and has a moderate business impact. We need to investigate the access control logic.

title: Missing password reset emails in Staging LATAM
description: Users in the Staging (LATAM) environment are reporting that they are not receiving password reset emails when requested. We aren't sure if this is an issue with the SSO Integration Module failing to trigger the email, or if the external email service is not delivering the messages. Since we rely on social logins and standard auth, it's hard to tell where the break in the chain is. This is affecting 72 users and is slowing down our testing cycles.

title: Rate Limiter pods restarting and outage
description: We are seeing the Rate Limiter pods restarting repeatedly in the ANZ production environment, leading to what looks like a full outage for our API. We think it's because of an incomplete rollback you guys did last night. This is definitely a rollback problem.

title: High latency in Payment Gateway v2 production - definitely a firewall issue
description: We are seeing extremely slow response times and high latency on the Payment Gateway v2 in production (ME region). This is affecting over 600 users. We've checked our side and this is definitely a firewall misconfiguration on your end blocking or throttling traffic. Please fix the firewall rules immediately as this is impacting our ability to process payments.

title: Missing records and truncated files in Funnel Analyzer - credential propagation issue
description: Our Funnel Analyzer reports in production (ANZ) are missing records and the exported files are truncated. We know this is because the credential rotation wasn't propagated correctly to the service. Please sync the credentials so we can get complete data again.

title: Malformed JSON responses in Staging Payment Gateway - hardware failure?

title: Onboarding Wizard issues

The service is returning 500 errors and we cannot perform any administrative actions. This is a critical blocker; please provision additional storage or clean up logs immediately.

title: Cohort Builder timeouts causing critical performance degradation
description: We are experiencing critical issues with Cohort Builder in the sandbox (EU-West). title: Load Balancer issues

Please advise on the cause of the partial failure and how to resolve it.

title: Overcharges and chargebacks in Payment Gateway v2 Sandbox

This happened on two specific transactions today. We need to understand why the sandbox is processing real-world-style overcharges and triggering chargebacks, as this is confusing our integration testing.

title: CRITICAL: Audit log gaps detected in Analytics Dashboard
description: Our compliance team has flagged missing entries in the audit logs within the Analytics Dashboard (Production, EU-Central). Please investigate the logging pipeline immediately.

title: SSO Redirect Loop - definitely a firewall problem
description: Users in US-West production are getting stuck in a login loop with the SSO Integration Module. The federation metadata seems mismatched, causing the redirect to fail. title: Data loss report in Help Center

title: Encoding errors and missing data in Analytics Dashboard

Please check the data ingestion pipeline.

title: Connection refused error in Chat Widget Sandbox

title: SSO users locked out

title: Secret Store returning 502 errors and timeouts

title: SSO API issues in staging: 429s and empty responses

Furthermore, the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompt is not appearing at all; it seems to skip directly to the lockout error or fail silently. This is affecting multiple accounts.

Additionally, we have confirmed that password reset emails are not being delivered, likely due to the same underlying failure in the auth flow. This is impacting a massive volume of users (approx. 25k+) and is currently blocking all customer access. Priority is critical.

title: Severe latency in mobile app performance via Payment Gateway v2
description: We are observing extremely slow performance in our mobile application when interacting with the Payment Gateway v2. The delays are significant enough to cause timeouts and user abandonment. This is isolated to the US-East production region and is affecting approximately 1,855 users. Business impact is critical as transaction completion rates are dropping.

title: MFA prompts failing to appear for LATAM users
description: In our LATAM production environment, users authenticating through the SSO Integration Module are not receiving MFA prompts. The system appears to bypass the second factor entirely or hangs without generating the challenge. This is a security concern and is impacting roughly 2,500 users. We need immediate assistance to restore the expected authentication flow.

This constitutes a full outage of the webhook service, impacting approximately 800 users and critical integrations. Immediate investigation is required.

title: Session Controller hitting rate limits for US-East users
description: We are encountering 'rate limit exceeded' errors from the Session Controller in our US-East production environment. This is preventing a significant portion of our user base (approx. 1,950 users) from maintaining sessions or logging in. The impact is critical as it is effectively blocking access for these users.

title: API schema error on Payment Gateway v2 integration
description: A small number of users (3) in our APAC production environment are encountering an API schema error when attempting to process transactions via the Payment Gateway v2. The error prevents the successful submission of payment details. While the impact is currently low, we need a fix to ensure schema validation does not block future requests.

title: Bulk user provisioning stuck and failed in EU-West
description: We initiated a bulk import of users via the SSO Integration Module in our EU-West production environment, but the provisioning process has stalled and ultimately failed for the entire batch. Approximately 25,000 users are affected. We are unsure if the hang is occurring during the identity lookup phase or if the connector itself is failing to write back to the directory. Please investigate as this is blocking our user onboarding.

title: Analytics Dashboard exports containing garbled characters

This affects any user attempting to download these reports (approx. 27 users identified so far). The issue seems specific to the export functionality, as viewing data within the dashboard appears normal.

This does not seem to impact functionality or user access, but it affects the professional appearance of the status reports. No users are reporting login issues, but the display glitch persists.

title: SSO Webhooks failing to fire with rate limit errors
description: In our APAC production environment, webhooks configured within the SSO Integration Module are failing to fire. We are seeing 'rate limit exceeded' errors in our logs correlated with these failures. This is impacting approximately 35 users who rely on these events for downstream processes. We need to determine if the limit is being hit by our volume or if there is an issue with how the events are being throttled.

title: Incorrect tax calculations and billing errors in EU-Central
description: Our billing system is applying incorrect tax rates to invoices generated via the Tax Calculator in the EU-Central production region. This has resulted in a small number of customers (3) being overcharged and having their subscriptions fail to renew due to payment mismatch flags. The issue seems specific to the calculation logic within the calculator itself, leading to invoice discrepancies.

title: Analytics Dashboard crashing and unresponsive
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our US-East production environment is intermittently crashing and becoming unresponsive to user inputs. While we have not identified a specific number of affected users yet, the instability makes the tool unusable for data analysis tasks. We are observing application-level crashes when attempting to load complex queries or heavy datasets.

title: Payment Gateway v2 experiencing database timeout errors
description: We are seeing slow response times from the Payment Gateway v2 in our US-West production environment. Error logs indicate that the issue is stemming from database query timeouts during transaction processing. This is affecting approximately 34 users and causing delays in payment confirmation. We need to investigate why these queries are timing out.

title: Billing issues in staging
description: We're seeing weird stuff in the Billing Disputes Handler in LATAM staging. Some subs aren't renewing, some got charged twice, and the currency looks wrong on the invoices. Only a couple of users are seeing this right now. Can you check?

title: Mobile app is crawling, definitely expired API key on our end
description: We are seeing extremely slow performance in the mobile app when users try to process payments. We've checked the integration and this is definitely an expired API key problem. Please help us figure out how to fix the credential issue so the app speeds up again.

title: Received chargeback notices in sandbox testing
description: While testing refund workflows in the sandbox environment (APAC), we received several chargeback notifications that were not expected based on the transaction history. We have two specific cases where the status changed to 'chargeback' without any user dispute being filed on our end. Could you help us understand why this is happening during testing?

While this does not impact production users, it is affecting our load testing benchmarks. We are seeing average response times spike to over 2 seconds, which is outside our acceptable threshold for staging. Please investigate.

title: Data Pipeline: Missing records and truncated files in dev

title: Config drift detected - likely due to duplicate processing

title: Undercharge incidents in staging environment

The amounts deducted from test accounts were lower than the configured prices. This is a low-impact issue for us right now, but we need to ensure the pricing logic is correct before pushing to production. Please review.

title: Report Builder: Missing records and garbled characters

We are unsure if this is a display issue within the Report Builder tool or if the underlying data source (possibly the Data Catalog Service) is providing corrupted data. Please investigate.

title: Analytics Dashboard: Discrepancies and reported data loss
description: We have observed missing records in our production Analytics Dashboard (ANZ region). Several users have reported that data they expected to see is completely gone. title: Throttling and scaling issues

title: Audit log gap detected in sandbox environment

description: A few users (4) in our production environment (US-West) are receiving HTTP 429 errors when interacting with the Payment Gateway v2. The business impact is low, but we want to understand why rate limiting is being triggered. Please review the API usage logs.

The timeout errors are clearly visible in our application logs when the Rate Limiter attempts to fetch current threshold data from the backend database. description: In our APAC development environment, the Analytics Dashboard is returning empty JSON responses for several data widgets. This seems to happen intermittently when we trigger manual refreshes. Since our dev environment also relies on scheduled jobs to populate these datasets, I'm not sure if the dashboard is failing to retrieve the data or if the background tasks that generate the analytics data didn't run at all. The API calls themselves return a 200 OK but with an empty payload, so it's hard to tell where the break in the chain is.

title: SSO and MFA issues for some users
description: A few users are reporting problems with logging in. Some say their sessions end too quickly without warning. Others are not getting the MFA prompt when they try to access the portal. One user got locked out completely after trying multiple times. We have 3 people affected in our APAC production tenant. Please check why this is happening.

description: We are experiencing a critical outage on the Analytics Dashboard in our EU-West production environment affecting over 12,000 users. The primary symptom is that the API returns an empty response body for key metrics endpoints. Additionally, when we try to call other endpoints, we are getting schema validation errors on the client side. We suspect either the data ingestion pipeline or the dashboard service is failing, but we cannot isolate which one is at fault because the lack of data makes it look like a schema mismatch.

title: Incorrect fee calculations on invoices
description: The Fee Analyzer is showing wrong numbers. Some customers are being charged too little, and others are being charged too much. This is happening in our APAC production account. We have about 1,200 users affected. This is critical because it is causing billing discrepancies. Please fix the calculation logic.

title: AD Sync failing with SSO errors and missing MFA
description: Our Active Directory Sync tool in ANZ production is throwing SSO error pages for some groups, and the MFA prompts aren't showing up for them either. We think this is definitely a resource exhaustion issue on our servers causing the sync to choke and fail to present the correct authentication steps. The sync jobs just die out halfway through.

title: Cache Service health degradation: Backup failures and replication lag
description: We have observed multiple issues with the Cache Service in our EU-Central production cluster. Our nightly backup jobs have failed for the last two days with generic I/O errors. Concurrently, monitoring shows that index corruption has been detected on several shard nodes, and the replication lag between primary and secondary nodes has spiked significantly above our thresholds. These symptoms appeared simultaneously around 02:00 UTC. While user-facing latency is currently normal, the infrastructure health is critical. We need assistance determining if the backup failure and index corruption are related to the replication issues.

title: Payment Gateway login and MFA problems
description: Users cannot log in properly. MFA codes are being rejected even when correct. Some users don't see the MFA screen at all. Others are getting logged out unexpectedly. This is happening in ANZ production. Huge impact on 10k users. Fix ASAP.

title: Funnel Analyzer UI elements not rendering in US-East production
description: In the Funnel Analyzer dashboard (US-East production), several key UI components are failing to render. Specifically, the conversion rate visualization charts and the drop-off step indicators are displaying as blank white spaces or broken image icons. This affects approximately 146 users who rely on these visuals for daily reporting. The issue appears to be consistent across Chrome and Edge browsers. We have checked our network tab and see 404s for some static asset files, but the main application shell loads correctly. This is a high-impact issue for our marketing team.

title: Unexpected chargeback notices in Fee Analyzer staging (ME)
description: We are receiving chargeback notifications within the Fee Analyzer tool in our Middle East staging environment. This is unexpected as these test accounts should not be generating real chargebacks. The issue is impacting our 575 test users by cluttering their dashboards with false fraud alerts. We need to understand why the staging environment is connecting to production payment processors or if the mock data generator is incorrectly flagging transactions as chargebacks. Please investigate the configuration of the Fee Analyzer in the ME staging region.

title: Subscription Manager audit logs missing entries
description: We are noticing gaps in the audit logs for the Subscription Manager in our US-East production environment. Actions performed by users, such as plan upgrades or cancellations, are not being recorded, affecting around 268 users. We are pretty sure this is caused by a firewall misconfiguration on our end blocking the traffic from the subscription service to the logging aggregator. Please confirm if the logs are being dropped at the network level.

title: Payment Gateway v2 dev environment: Undercharges and duplicate transactions
description: In our US-West development environment for Payment Gateway v2, we are seeing inconsistent transaction outcomes. Specifically, some test transactions result in an undercharge (the total amount is less than the sum of items), while other identical transactions are being processed as duplicates, charging the test account twice. This affects about 23 internal testers and is causing moderate friction in our QA process. We need to determine if this is a logic error in the gateway's calculation engine or a retry mechanism failure in the dev sandbox.

title: Refunds not showing up and overcharges
description: Refunds are not being reflected in the customer accounts. Also, we are seeing overcharges. This is in EU-Central production. No one is complaining yet but we found it during a review. Please look into why refunds aren't processing and why charges are too high.

description: We are observing that webhook retries are being exhausted for our Analytics Dashboard integration in the APAC production region. The error logs indicate timeouts when the Analytics service attempts to push data to the client endpoints. This is a low-impact issue currently, but we need to adjust the retry configuration or timeout settings to ensure these customers receive their data. The affected endpoints are documented in the attached log snippet.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Duplicate subscription charges and incorrect invoices
description: In our US-East production environment using Payment Gateway v2, we have identified an issue where approximately 8 users are being charged twice for their subscriptions. Additionally, the invoices generated for these users are incorrect, showing only one charge despite the double deduction. This discrepancy between the payment gateway transaction logs and the billing invoices is causing confusion for the affected customers. We need immediate assistance to reverse the duplicate charges and regenerate the correct invoices for these 8 accounts. The issue seems isolated to users on the 'Premium Monthly' plan.

This appears to be related to the MFA Manager module. Users are unable to authenticate and are seeing an 'account locked' message immediately upon attempting login. This is blocking all testing activities for the team. Please investigate the lockout threshold settings or any recent changes that might have triggered this mass lockout.

Specifically, the canary rollout has stalled, and we are seeing version mismatches across different environments. This has resulted in a deployment failure. Currently, only about 10 users are affected, so the impact is moderate, but it is blocking our release pipeline. We need assistance in unblocking the canary and ensuring version consistency.

title: Subscription Manager: Critical overcharging in US-West Staging
description: We are encountering a critical issue with the Subscription Manager in our US-West staging environment. Despite being in staging, this is affecting 2,216 test users with overcharges. This is disrupting our QA process for billing features. We need to understand why the billing logic in staging is behaving unexpectedly and charging users more than their subscription tier allows. Please prioritize this as it blocks our upcoming release validation.

title: Login Failures and Redirect Loops in ME Staging
description: Users in our Middle East staging environment are unable to log in. The issue manifests as login failures followed by an SSO redirect loop. It is unclear whether the LDAP Connector is failing to authenticate users or if the redirect process itself is broken. This is affecting a massive number of test accounts (over 11,000) and is halting our authentication flow testing. We need a diagnosis to see if this is a connector configuration issue or something else.

title: Slow Mobile App Performance linked to Secret Store
description: A single user in the ME production environment is reporting slow performance on the mobile app. Preliminary checks suggest that the issue might be related to the Secret Store, possibly due to slow response times when fetching credentials or tokens. The impact is currently low as only one user is affected, but we are concerned about potential latency issues in the Secret Store. Please check the response times and performance metrics for the Secret Store.

title: Rate Limiter issues causing DB timeouts and disk alerts in ANZ
description: In the ANZ production environment, we are seeing database query timeouts and disk usage critical alerts. We believe the root cause lies within the Rate Limiter configuration. The limiter seems to be throttling requests in a way that backs up the database connections, leading to timeouts. The high disk usage might be a side effect of logging these throttled requests. This is affecting nearly 1,000 users and is causing significant latency. Please review the Rate Limiter settings and its interaction with the database.

title: Rate Limiter: Webhooks not firing and timeouts in LATAM Dev
description: We are experiencing issues with the Rate Limiter in the LATAM development environment. We are hitting rate limits unexpectedly, and as a result, webhooks are not firing. This is also causing timeouts in our integration tests. While there is no business impact on live users (0 affected), this is blocking our development progress. We need to reset or adjust the rate limits for the dev environment to allow our webhooks to function correctly.

title: Currency Converter: Payments declined and double charges in APAC
description: The Currency Converter in our APAC production environment is causing payment declines for users paying in certain currencies. Additionally, some users who initially experienced a decline are reporting that they were charged twice once the payment eventually went through. This is affecting about 138 users and is leading to customer complaints about billing accuracy. We need to investigate the conversion logic and the retry mechanism for declined payments.

title: SSO Integration Module: Missing entries in audit logs
description: We have noticed that the audit logs for the SSO Integration Module in the EU-Central production environment are missing entries. This is a high-impact issue for our security compliance, as we cannot track all user login events. Approximately 820 users are involved in the affected timeframes. We need to ensure that all authentication events are being logged correctly by the SSO module.

title: Federation Metadata Mismatch in US-East Staging
description: We are seeing a federation metadata mismatch in the SSO Integration Module in our US-East staging environment. We are confident that this is due to a hardware failure in our infrastructure. The physical servers handling the SSO requests seem to be degraded, causing the metadata to be outdated or inconsistent. This is affecting about 22 users in the staging environment. Please check the hardware status of the servers.

title: SSO Sandbox: Federation Metadata Mismatch in ANZ
description: In the ANZ sandbox environment, the SSO Integration Module is reporting a federation metadata mismatch. This is affecting around 254 users and is preventing them from accessing the sandbox applications via SSO. The metadata seems to be out of sync with the identity provider configuration. We need to refresh the metadata or troubleshoot why the mismatch is occurring in the sandbox.

title: Admin Console: Database query timeouts in US-West Production
description: Users of the Admin Console in the US-West production environment are experiencing database query timeouts. This is affecting about 3 users who are trying to perform administrative tasks. The impact is currently low, but we need to ensure the console is responsive. The queries seem to hang when performing complex searches. Please investigate the database performance related to the Admin Console.

title: Subscription renewals failing / undercharges in US-West production
description: We are seeing issues with subscription renewals in our US-West production environment. Approximately 65 users are reporting that their accounts were not renewed this month, and when we check the transaction logs, the amounts charged are significantly lower than expected (undercharge). It looks like the payment process might be timing out or hitting a limit somewhere, but we aren't sure if this is an issue with the Payment Gateway v2 itself or if the requests are getting blocked before they reach it. Can you help investigate why the renewal logic is failing to process the correct amount?

title: Wallet Service APAC: Incorrect currency conversion and duplicate billing
description: Hello, we have identified several anomalies in the Wallet Service within the APAC production region. First, currency conversions are calculating incorrectly; for example, USD to JPY conversions are returning rates that are off by approximately 15% compared to market rates. Second, some users are reporting that they have been charged twice for the same subscription renewal. Third, despite these charges, the subscription status for some of these affected users remains 'not renewed' or 'past due' in the dashboard. Please advise on how to resolve the conversion logic and reverse the duplicate charges.

title: Fee Analyzer sandbox: Feature flags and configuration changes not applying
description: In our EU-West sandbox environment, we are unable to apply new configurations to the Fee Analyzer. Specifically, we have updated the feature flags to enable the 'dynamic-tier' calculation model, but the system continues to use the legacy static tier logic. Additionally, any changes made to the global configuration parameters (such as default fee caps) do not take effect after saving; the system reverts to previous values upon refresh. This is impacting 47 test users who are blocked from validating new fee structures.

title: Mobile App US-East sandbox: Search functionality returns zero results
description: The search feature in the Mobile App (US-East sandbox) is completely broken. When users enter any query into the search bar, the API returns a 200 OK status but the response body contains an empty list `[]`. This is affecting all 351 active testers in the sandbox, preventing them from finding products or content. The issue is consistent across Android and iOS clients. Please check if the search index is populated or if there is a connectivity issue with the backend search service.

title: Data Pipeline LATAM dev: Webhook endpoint not receiving events
description: We are testing the Data Pipeline in the LATAM development environment. We have configured a webhook to trigger on 'order_complete' events, pointing to our staging URL. However, the webhook is not firing at all. The event logs show that the order status was updated successfully, but no outgoing HTTP request is being made to the configured endpoint. We are seeing this for 3 specific test accounts. Please verify if the webhook dispatcher is active for this region.

title: Issues with Payment Gateway v2 in ANZ
description: Hey, we're seeing some weird stuff in ANZ prod. Looks like some env vars are missing or data isn't matching up right. Can you check it out?
