title: Event Tracker APAC staging showing data mismatches
description: Hi, we are experiencing data mismatch issues with the Event Tracker in the APAC staging environment. The counts reported by the tracker do not align with the raw logs we have on our side. This is affecting about 50 users. Can you help look into why the Event Tracker is showing incorrect data?

title: SSO Integration Module US-East staging: MFA rejection and error pages
description: We are encountering authentication failures in the US-East staging environment. Users attempting to log in via the SSO Integration Module are receiving 'MFA code rejected' errors even when using valid, timely TOTP codes. Furthermore, after the initial failure, the user is redirected to a generic SSO error page instead of being prompted for a second attempt. This issue started occurring intermittently this morning and is blocking our QA team from testing the new login flow.

title: LDAP Connector issues in LATAM prod
description: Users in LATAM production can't log in. MFA codes are getting rejected and there's a redirect loop. Urgent.

title: Payment Gateway v2 EU-Central sandbox: Double charges and renewal failures
description: In the EU-Central sandbox environment, we are observing inconsistent billing behavior for subscriptions. For a subset of 19 test accounts, the Payment Gateway v2 is charging the subscription fee twice within the same billing cycle. Despite the duplicate charges, the subscription renewal process fails to update the 'next_billing_date' correctly, leaving some accounts marked as 'not renewed' in the portal. We need this resolved to ensure our testing data is accurate.

title: SSO Module ME staging: Certificate warnings and missing audit logs
description: We are seeing two distinct issues in the ME staging environment. First, the SSO Integration Module is throwing 'certificate expired' warnings during the handshake, although the cert is valid until next month. Second, we noticed that audit logs for recent login attempts are missing entries entirely. We are unsure if the certificate warning is causing the logging service to fail silently or if these are two separate configuration issues. Could you please investigate both the SSL validation process and the log ingestion pipeline?

title: Report Builder LATAM prod: Incorrect total calculations
description: Our production reports in the LATAM region are displaying incorrect totals. The 'Grand Total' field in the Report Builder does not match the sum of the individual line items. We suspect this might be related to how the data is being fetched or aggregated. Since some data sources are external, we aren't sure if the calculation error is in the reporting engine itself or if the underlying file storage/retrieval is providing incomplete data sets. Please check the aggregation logic and data integrity.

title: SSO redirect loop in US-West sandbox
description: Getting a redirect loop with SSO in the US-West sandbox. A few users are stuck.

title: Payment Gateway v2 APAC: Duplicate charges and renewal failures
description: We have identified a billing issue in the APAC production environment affecting 2 high-value accounts. The Payment Gateway v2 processed duplicate charges for their monthly subscriptions. Additionally, despite the successful (albeit duplicated) payment, the system failed to mark the subscriptions as 'renewed', leaving them in a 'pending' state. We need these charges reversed and the subscription statuses corrected immediately.

title: Duplicate records and data corruption in Admin Console exports
description: We are seeing significant issues with data integrity in the Admin Console. When we run exports, the files contain duplicate entries for the same record IDs. Additionally, some fields appear truncated or contain corrupted characters, causing mismatches between the console view and the exported data. This is affecting our ability to reconcile records accurately.

title: Analytics Dashboard loading failures due to query timeouts
description: Users are reporting that the Analytics Dashboard is frequently failing to load reports. The interface hangs for a long time and then returns a generic error. Our internal logs indicate that database query timeouts are occurring consistently when these dashboards are accessed. It seems the connection pool is being exhausted, preventing new queries from running. This is impacting about 40 active users in the US-West region.

The status page does not show any incidents, but our team of 39 users is blocked from performing necessary subscription changes. This has been occurring for the last hour and is impacting our moderate business operations.

No other products are affected.

title: Incorrect invoices and duplicate charges via Payment Gateway v2

The invoices generated by the Payment Gateway v2 do not match the actual amounts captured. We need this investigated to ensure proper refunding and invoice correction.

description: We are experiencing issues with the Chargeback Handler. We suspect there might be a configuration drift issue, as the applied settings do not match what we configured in the console. Three users have reported that their chargeback processing workflows are behaving unexpectedly.

title: SSO sync stuck in sandbox

title: Critical issue: Refunds and tax calculations incorrect in Payment Gateway v2

Furthermore, the tax amounts calculated on these refunds are incorrect, leading to significant accounting discrepancies. This is severely impacting our financial reconciliation processes and requires immediate attention.

title: Audit logs missing and account lockouts in Billing Disputes Handler

title: Malformed JSON responses and webhook failures in Analytics Dashboard

Additionally, webhooks that should trigger upon dashboard updates are not firing as expected. We believe this is an issue within the dashboard's data serialization logic or its event dispatching mechanism.

title: Provisioning stuck in Chargeback Handler - likely config error
description: We are seeing provisioning stalls in the Chargeback Handler. We think it's because of a customer configuration error on our end, specifically with the environment variables or initial setup steps. This is definitely a setup issue, not a platform bug. It's blocking 200 users from completing their onboarding.

title: Analytics Dashboard hitting rate limits
description: The Analytics Dashboard is frequently blocking requests due to rate limit exceeded errors. This is happening for our standard user traffic and is preventing 128 users from accessing real-time data. We need to understand why the dashboard is throttling these normal request volumes.

title: Payment Gateway v2 displaying SSO error pages
description: Users attempting to log in to the Payment Gateway v2 are encountering SSO error pages instead of proceeding to the dashboard. This is affecting high-traffic operations in the APAC region and has impacted approximately 126 users. The login flow breaks immediately after redirection.

title: Missing env vars and data mismatch in Payment Gateway v2
description: Looks like an environment variable is missing in prod for the Payment Gateway v2. Data doesn't match up either. Only one user affected.

title: Production outage: Payment Gateway v2 API returning empty responses and HTTP 500s
description: We are experiencing a critical issue in our production APAC environment with Payment Gateway v2. Since approximately 14:00 UTC, the API is returning empty JSON responses or throwing HTTP 500 errors for roughly 60% of requests. Additionally, our webhooks are not firing, which means order confirmations are not reaching our downstream systems. This is impacting about 618 users and blocking transactions. Please investigate the gateway status and webhook delivery immediately.

title: MFA codes failing in SSO staging due to expired cert
description: We are testing the SSO Integration Module in our APAC staging environment and the MFA codes are being rejected. One of our developers cannot log in. We checked the server logs and this is definitely an expired certificate problem causing the handshake to fail. Please renew the cert on your end so we can continue testing.

title: Payment Gateway v2 bulk import failures
description: We are seeing significant errors when attempting to bulk import transaction data into Payment Gateway v2 in our US-West production environment. The import process starts but fails halfway through for many records, affecting 234 users. We need this resolved urgently as it is blocking our settlement reconciliation.

title: Refund Manager filtering broken in Staging
description: In our LATAM staging environment, the Refund Manager module has broken sorting and filtering capabilities. When we try to filter refunds by date or status, the list returns no results or incorrect data. This is currently blocking our QA team from validating the new refund workflow, impacting 1012 test scenarios. Please prioritize fixing the query logic.

title: Double charges and undercharges in Production APAC
description: We are observing billing irregularities with Payment Gateway v2 in our APAC production environment. Several customers report being charged twice for the same subscription renewal, while others have been undercharged. This affects approximately 41 accounts and has resulted in support tickets for billing discrepancies. Please audit the transaction logs for the past 24 hours to identify the root cause.

title: Elevated privileges observed in Cache Service
description: Our security monitoring has flagged unusual activity in the Cache Service in our EU-Central production environment. Specifically, we are observing elevated privileges being granted to certain service accounts that should have restricted access. This affects 16 users/accounts. Please investigate if this is a configuration drift or a potential security exposure.

title: Unexpected elevated permissions in LDAP Connector
description: We have detected that the LDAP Connector in our US-West production environment is allowing elevated privileges to 33 users who should be restricted. This appears to be a mapping issue where group permissions are not being enforced correctly. Please review the connector configuration and fix the privilege escalation bug.

title: Critical API Gateway timeouts and 429s in Sandbox
description: We are encountering widespread issues in our US-East sandbox environment affecting over 12,000 users. The API Gateway is consistently timing out and returning HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors. We aren't sure if the bottleneck is at the gateway level or if the underlying job queue workers are saturated and causing the gateway to hang. Please check both components to determine where the failure is occurring.

title: Capacity limits hit in Staging without autoscaling
description: Our staging environment for Payment Gateway v2 in US-East has reached its capacity limit, resulting in 'quota exceeded' errors for 113 users. Despite high traffic, autoscaling is not triggering to provision additional resources. This is preventing us from completing load testing. Please investigate why the autoscaling rules are not being applied.

title: Duplicate charges in Invoice Service
description: We are seeing subscription charges duplicated in the Invoice Service in our LATAM production environment. There are no active users currently reporting issues, but the system logs show multiple charges for single transactions. We think this is because of a customer configuration error on our side, specifically regarding how we set up the billing triggers. Please confirm if this is a config issue or a platform bug.

Additionally, some users with valid permissions are receiving 'access denied' errors, and there are reports of elevated privileges being observed unexpectedly. This affects 26 users and is compromising our ability to track changes. Please investigate the logging and permission verification mechanisms.

Please check if the log ingestion pipeline is dropping events.

description: Users in our US-East production environment are encountering a generic SSO error page when trying to log in via the Session Controller. This is affecting about 10 users at random. The error page does not provide specific details. Please investigate the authentication flow to identify why these sessions are failing.

For 39 affected users, webhook retries are being exhausted without successful delivery, and the API is intermittently returning empty responses. We are also seeing HTTP 429 errors during peak times. This suggests a bottleneck or failure in the event delivery system. Please investigate the webhook health and API rate limiting.

description: We are experiencing intermittent issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in our production environment (ANZ region). Please investigate if there are any upstream throttling changes or capacity issues.

description: Our finance team has flagged a critical issue with the Fee Analyzer. Multiple subscribers are reporting duplicate charges on their credit cards. title: MFA codes rejected in US-West production
description: We are seeing intermittent failures where MFA codes generated via the SSO Integration Module are being rejected as invalid for users in US-West production. This affects login attempts sporadically. No error codes are provided by the UI, just a generic 'invalid code' message.

title: Duplicate subscription charges observed
description: In the ME staging environment, we are seeing subscriptions being charged twice. We are trying to determine if the Chargeback Handler is incorrectly processing the reversal or if the issue stems from the reconciliation logic not catching the initial duplicate. This impacts 374 test accounts.

title: Audit log gaps and certificate warnings in EU-Central
description: We have identified several issues in the Payment Gateway v2 production environment in EU-Central. First, there are missing entries in the audit log for successful transactions. Second, we are seeing warnings related to SSL certificates during connection establishment. Finally, some service accounts appear to have elevated privileges that were not requested. These symptoms affect 518 users and represent a high business impact.

title: SSO redirect loop in OAuth Service (US-West)
description: Users attempting to log in via SSO in US-West production are stuck in an infinite redirect loop. The OAuth Service initiates the handshake, but the browser continues to reload the login page without authenticating. This is blocking 1,394 users from accessing the platform.

title: MFA codes rejected in LATAM staging SSO
description: We are testing the SSO Integration Module in LATAM staging and are encountering issues with MFA. Codes generated by the authenticator app are consistently rejected, preventing testers from proceeding. This affects approximately 95 users in our test cohort.

title: Overcharged transactions in US-West Production
description: We are noticing that some transactions processed through Payment Gateway v2 in US-West are resulting in overcharges. We are unsure if the gateway is calculating the total incorrectly or if the Refund Service is failing to reverse an initial overbilling correctly. 57 customers have been affected so far.

title: URGENT: Exporting reports shows data for the wrong client!
description: We are seeing a massive issue with the Data Export Service. Users are downloading reports and seeing data belonging to other tenants entirely. It looks like they also have elevated permissions they shouldn't have. 65 people in our ANZ production environment are affected right now and we are worried about a data breach. Please check your export module immediately.

title: Identity Vault is completely broken - SSO redirect loop and expired reset links
description: Our Identity Vault deployment is failing. Users cannot log in because the SSO gets stuck in a redirect loop. Furthermore, if they try to use the forgot password flow, the reset link is already expired by the time they receive it. This is a high impact issue affecting 523 users in our Middle East production environment.

title: Payment Gateway v2 double-charging customers and applying incorrect currency conversion
description: We are observing some issues with Payment Gateway v2 in our Middle East production environment. Some users report being charged twice for the same subscription. Additionally, when cross-border transactions are processed, the currency conversion rate applied does not match the agreed-upon rate. We have reviewed the transaction logs and confirmed the duplicate billing, but no customers have complained yet.

title: Chat Widget form submission failing for APAC production users
description: We are experiencing a high-impact issue with the Chat Widget in our APAC production environment. Since this morning, users are unable to submit their contact forms. The form simply hangs and eventually shows an error message without sending the data. 536 users have been affected and this is blocking our customer service operations. Please investigate the widget's submission endpoint.

title: MFA prompt not appearing and login failures on SSO Integration Module
description: Users are reporting login failures when trying to access our system via the SSO Integration Module. The main issue is that the MFA prompt is not appearing after they enter their credentials, causing the authentication to fail. 588 users in our ANZ production environment are affected. We know this is definitely a policy misconfiguration on our end, so please prioritize fixing the policy rules.

title: SSO Integration Module says account not found
description: The SSO Integration Module is saying 'account not found' when people try to log in.

title: Overcharge and incorrect proration in Payment Gateway v2 development environment
description: We are seeing discrepancies in billing within our Payment Gateway v2 development environment (EU-West). Customers who upgrade their plans in the sandbox are being overcharged, and the proration calculations for mid-cycle upgrades are incorrect. This is affecting 79 users on our dev team, and we are considering it a moderate impact issue since it's preventing us from validating our new billing logic.

title: Critical: Missing entries in Payment Gateway v2 audit logs and data residency flag mismatch
description: We are experiencing a critical issue with Payment Gateway v2 in our ANZ production environment. We noticed that there are missing entries in the audit logs, and on top of that, the data residency flag is mismatching the actual geographic location of the transaction processing. 1,846 users are affected, and this poses a severe compliance risk. We urgently need an investigation into the logging and data routing mechanisms.

title: Overcharges happening
description: Some users in the development environment for Payment Gateway v2 are getting overcharged. Only a couple of accounts are doing it so far.

title: Payment Gateway v2 not applying retention policy in EU-Central development environment
description: We have noticed that the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-Central development environment is not respecting the data retention policy. We configured it to delete old transactions after 30 days, but records older than that are still present in the database. There is currently no business impact or affected users as it's a background process in dev, but it's a bug we need to fix.

title: Database deadlock detected when accessing Analytics Dashboard in APAC staging
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in the APAC staging environment is failing to load for about 74 users. The error we are getting is 'database deadlock detected'. This seems to happen when multiple users try to run complex queries simultaneously. We need to resolve this database locking issue so our internal team can test the new dashboard features.

title: Session Controller issues: Account lockouts, missing audit logs, and certificate warnings
description: We are experiencing multiple issues with the Session Controller in our US-East production environment. Some users are being locked out of their accounts unexpectedly. Additionally, our audit logs for session management are missing entries, and we are seeing a certificate expired warning during the token exchange. 27 users are affected with moderate impact.

title: High latency and slow response times on Status Page in EU-West staging
description: We are noticing that the Status Page in our EU-West staging environment is experiencing high latency and slow response times. It takes a long time to load the latest status updates. This is currently only affecting one user (myself), so the impact is low, but it is slowing down our review process.

title: CRITICAL: Failover did not occur on Mobile App, service is unresponsive in ME production
description: Our Mobile App in the Middle East production environment is completely unresponsive. We noticed that a failover should have occurred, but it didn't. The service is currently down for 10,831 users, which is a critical business impact. We need immediate assistance in restoring service and understanding why the failover mechanism did not trigger.

title: Intermittent failures and high latency affecting Payment Gateway v2 and Refund Service
description: We are experiencing intermittent failures, high latency, and slow mobile app performance in our ANZ development environment. The issues seem to affect both the Payment Gateway v2 and the Refund Service. We have 635 users in our dev team experiencing this, and it's causing high impact on our release schedule. We are unsure which component is causing the bottleneck.

title: Payment Gateway v2 experiencing timeouts and slow responses in EU-Central production
description: We are seeing significant latency issues with Payment Gateway v2 in our production environment located in the EU-Central region. Since approximately 14:00 UTC, API calls that normally complete in under 500ms are taking upwards of 10 seconds, often resulting in client-side timeouts. This is affecting about 15 active users who are unable to process payments reliably. The business impact is currently moderate, but it is causing friction for our checkout flow. Please investigate the backend performance.

title: Pagination broken in Chat Widget
description: The pagination controls on the Chat Widget are not functioning correctly. When attempting to navigate to the next page of chat history, the view does not update. This seems to be happening consistently across all interfaces.

title: SSO Integration Module security issue
description: We noticed some strange privilege escalations happening with our users through the SSO Integration Module. It looks like people are getting access they shouldn't have. This is affecting a large number of users in our US-West production environment. We need this looked at immediately as it is a critical security concern.

title: Billing Engine connection resets and TLS errors in LATAM production
description: Our production environment in the LATAM region is experiencing connectivity issues with the Billing Engine. We are observing frequent connection resets and TLS handshake failures when attempting to communicate with the service, which occasionally renders it unresponsive. Currently, this is impacting one specific user workflow, resulting in a low business impact, but the error logs indicate a persistent network-level issue. Please check the certificate configuration and network stability.

title: Payment Gateway v2 autoscaling failure and resource spikes in ME dev
description: The Payment Gateway v2 in our development environment (ME region) is failing to trigger autoscaling events. We are seeing sudden spikes in both CPU and memory usage that do not result in new instances being spun up, leading to performance degradation for approximately 820 users. This is causing a high business impact on our testing capabilities. Please review why the scaling metrics are not being picked up.

title: Access denied errors in SSO Integration Module (ANZ Production)
description: Three users in our ANZ production environment are receiving 'access denied' errors when attempting to authenticate via the SSO Integration Module. The issue appears to be isolated to these specific accounts as other users are logging in successfully. We have verified their credentials and group memberships are correct. Please advise on next steps to resolve these authentication failures.

title: Data Export Service configuration drift and feature flags failing
description: In our EU-West sandbox environment, we are detecting configuration drift in the Data Export Service. Additionally, feature flags that have been applied are not taking effect on the exported data. This is affecting a small group of about 5 users and has a low business impact, but it is blocking our validation testing. Please investigate the consistency of the configuration settings.

title: Attribution Engine timeouts and HTTP 429 errors in LATAM
description: We are encountering timeout issues and HTTP 429 errors when interacting with the Attribution Engine in our LATAM production environment. This is currently affecting two users and has resulted in a low business impact, but the rate limiting seems excessive given our current traffic volume.

title: SSO Integration Module audit logs missing and permissions issue
description: We are seeing missing entries in the audit logs for the SSO Integration Module in US-East production. Additionally, some users appear to have elevated privileges unexpectedly. We are confident this is just an operator error from one of our admins making a mistake in the console configuration. It's affecting about 68 users with moderate impact. Please help us identify who made the change so we can correct it.

title: SSO sync stuck
description: The SSO Integration Module seems to be stuck during synchronization. Users in EU-Central are not seeing updates. We need this fixed as it is impacting our team's ability to access resources.

title: Notification Hub API returning empty responses
description: Our Notification Hub API is returning empty response bodies for several requests in the APAC production region. This is affecting about 40 users and has a moderate business impact as notifications are not being delivered. The API endpoints seem reachable but fail to return data.

title: Rate Limiter issues with database deadlocks and disk space
description: We are detecting database deadlock errors and 'out of disk space' issues associated with the Rate Limiter in our APAC production environment. This is currently impacting one user and has a low business impact, but the underlying infrastructure alerts are concerning. Please investigate the resource consumption of the Rate Limiter component.

title: Role Manager duplicate accounts and sync issues in ANZ staging
description: In our ANZ staging environment, the Role Manager is creating duplicate user accounts. Furthermore, the synchronization process appears to be stuck, preventing role updates from propagating correctly. This is affecting 26 users with a moderate business impact. Please check why duplicates are being generated and why the sync halted.

title: Load Balancer configuration drift in LATAM Sandbox
description: We have detected significant configuration drift in the Load Balancer within our LATAM sandbox environment. The current running configuration does not match the intended state defined in our Infrastructure as Code repository. This discrepancy is impacting the stability of the environment for approximately 2,484 users, resulting in a critical business impact due to potential routing errors and service instability. Immediate investigation into the source of the drift and restoration of the correct configuration is required.

title: Payment Gateway v2 configuration not applying in LATAM Production
description: Changes made to the Payment Gateway v2 configuration in our LATAM production environment are not taking effect. We are also observing configuration drift between the deployed state and the expected configuration. This issue is critical as it affects 4,389 users and disrupts payment processing capabilities. Please verify if the configuration updates are being pushed correctly and why the gateway is ignoring the new settings.

title: High timeout rates on Payment Gateway API in US-East
description: We are seeing significant latency and timeouts with the Payment Gateway v2 API in the production environment (US-East). About 661 users are affected. The API sometimes just returns an empty response body with a 200 OK status, but other times it hangs until timeout. This is impacting checkout flows. Is this a gateway processing issue or could it be related to tax calculations hanging up the request? We can't tell which component is failing.

title: Cohort Builder audit logs missing and retention policy ignored
description: In our development environment, the Cohort Builder is not logging actions to the audit trail correctly. Several recent cohort creation and modification events are missing entirely. Additionally, the configured data retention policy has not been applied to expired cohorts; they are still persisting beyond their TTL. This affects about 118 users and is critical for our compliance testing.

title: TLS handshake errors and HTTP 504 in Rate Limiter staging
description: Our staging environment in APAC is experiencing issues with the Rate Limiter service. Requests are failing with TLS handshake errors followed by HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout responses. This is blocking integration testing for 261 users. The errors started occurring around 09:00 UTC.

title: SSO MFA prompts not appearing or codes rejected
description: Users in APAC production are reporting issues with SSO login. For some users, the MFA prompt never appears after password entry. For others, the MFA code is generated but rejected immediately upon submission. This affects Social Login flows as well, making it unclear if the issue is with the core SSO module or the social connector. Only 2 users reported it so far, but impact seems low priority unless it spreads.

title: SSO Outage: Failover did not trigger
description: We experienced a full SSO outage in US-East production. The primary instance went down, but failover did not occur as expected, leading to downtime for 40 users. The health checks showed the primary as unhealthy, but the secondary never picked up traffic. Please investigate the failover logic.

title: Data Pipeline sandbox missing audit logs
description: We noticed gaps in the audit logs for the Data Pipeline in the US-West sandbox environment. The logs simply stop for certain time windows. We think this is definitely a monitoring/alerting problem because we didn't get notified when the logging stopped. It's likely just an observability gap rather than a data loss issue.

title: Payment Gateway v2 overcharging customers in ME region
description: We are seeing overcharges in the Payment Gateway v2 for customers in the Middle East region. The final charge amount is higher than the expected total for 143 users. This is a high-impact issue affecting revenue and customer trust. Please check the calculation logic.

title: Chat Widget form submission and UI rendering issues
description: In the EU-Central production environment, the Chat Widget's contact form is failing to submit. Additionally, certain UI elements within the chat interface are not rendering correctly on mobile browsers. No users have reported issues yet (impact none), but we want to get ahead of it.

title: SSO Sandbox: Provisioning and Bulk Import Stuck
description: Our SSO Integration Module in the EU-West sandbox is having trouble with user provisioning. The sync process gets stuck, and a recent bulk import failed completely. We think this is definitely a duplicate processing failure causing conflicts, like the system is trying to import the same users twice and locking up.

title: SSO Webhooks not firing in ANZ production
description: Webhooks configured for the SSO Integration Module in the ANZ production region are not firing for user creation events. This is impacting 22 users who rely on downstream systems being updated. The webhook endpoint is healthy and accepting other requests.

title: Funnel Analyzer missing consent records and audit logs
description: We believe the Funnel Analyzer is broken in the development environment (ANZ). It seems to be missing consent records and creating gaps in the audit log. This is affecting 719 users and is high impact for our analytics integrity. Please check the Funnel Analyzer.

title: Billing Disputes Handler tax calculation errors in staging
description: The Billing Disputes Handler in US-East staging is calculating incorrect tax amounts, resulting in undercharges. No users are affected currently (impact none), but we need to fix this before promotion to production. The tax logic in the dispute resolution flow seems flawed.

title: Config Manager changes not taking effect in Dev
description: Configuration changes made through the Config Manager in the US-West development environment are not taking effect. The service continues to run with old values despite successful update confirmations. This is affecting 58 users and has moderate impact on our development velocity.

title: SSO Full Outage with Failed Failover in APAC Dev
description: The SSO Integration Module experienced a full outage in the APAC development environment. Failover did not occur, leaving 171 users unable to log in. We suspect the module itself is failing to switch over.

title: Analytics Dashboard slow
description: The Analytics Dashboard in LATAM production is running very slowly. It's taking too long to load reports for 33 users. Please check it.

title: Cache Service TLS issues due to unsupported config
description: We're seeing TLS handshake errors in our EU-West sandbox environment when connecting to the Cache Service. Only two users are affected so far, but this is definitely caused by an unsupported configuration setting on our side. We need to fix the setup to make the handshake succeed.

title: Payment Gateway v2 overcharging and bad currency rates
description: In our US-East production environment, we have about 47 users experiencing overcharges and incorrect currency conversions with Payment Gateway v2. We think it's because of a stale cache not updating the rates properly. Please look into clearing this or checking the cache state, as moderate business impact is occurring.

title: Subscriptions failing to renew with incorrect currency in ANZ
description: We are experiencing a high-impact issue in the ANZ region with Payment Gateway v2 where approximately 148 users are having their subscriptions fail to renew. Additionally, the currency conversion applied during these attempts appears to be incorrect. This is disrupting revenue and user access for our region.

title: Critical: Duplicate accounts created by SSO Integration Module
description: Our SSO Integration Module in the ANZ staging environment is creating duplicate accounts for existing users. This has affected roughly 1,293 users and is causing a critical disruption to our test data integrity. We need this investigated urgently as it is blocking our staging promotion process.

title: MFA prompts missing and accounts locked out in US-East
description: We are seeing an issue in production (US-East) where MFA prompts are not appearing for users, which subsequently leads to account lockouts. This is affecting around 441 users with high business impact. It seems related to Identity Vault, but the symptoms could also stem from identity synchronization delays. Please advise.

title: Cohort Builder exports are corrupted and truncated
description: Users in the ANZ region are reporting that Cohort Builder exports are coming out corrupted, truncated, or with missing records. This has affected 5 users with low business impact so far, but the data quality is compromised. We need a fix for the export mechanism in production.

title: Overcharging occurrences in Payment Gateway v2 (EU-Central Dev)
description: We have identified 29 instances of overcharging in our EU-Central development environment using Payment Gateway v2. The issue is consistent when testing specific transaction flows. Business impact is currently moderate within the dev team, but we need to understand why the gateway is calculating charges incorrectly in this environment.

title: Critical webhook failures in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are seeing webhooks not firing at all in our US-West development environment, which is impacting 8,137 users and causing a critical business issue. We think it's because of incorrect permissions on the webhook service account. Please check the permission settings as we believe that is the root cause.

title: Currency Converter causing overcharges and incorrect prorations
description: In our US-West sandbox, the Currency Converter is applying incorrect values resulting in overcharges and faulty prorations. This is affecting 396 users with high business impact. We need an investigation into why the conversion logic is failing to produce accurate billing amounts.

title: Role Manager: Lockouts and elevated privileges in EU-West
description: We are observing 59 users in the EU-West production environment experiencing account lockouts, and separately, some users are showing elevated privileges that they shouldn't have. The Role Manager seems to be behaving inconsistently. Moderate business impact is noted as we try to balance security and access.

title: Connection resets and TLS errors in Subscription Manager
description: Users in the APAC production region are encountering connection resets and TLS handshake errors when using the Subscription Manager. This is affecting approximately 25 users with moderate business impact. We need to determine if this is a network-level issue or specific to the service's endpoint configuration.

title: SSO Login failures and expired password reset links
description: In our ANZ production environment, we have 41 users unable to log in via the SSO Integration Module. Some users also report that password reset links sent through the module have expired prematurely. This is causing moderate business impact and requires an investigation into the token expiration and authentication flow.

title: Account lockouts and missing MFA prompts in EU-Central
description: We are seeing 53 users in EU-Central production getting locked out of accounts, and for those who do get in, MFA prompts are not appearing. This is a moderate impact issue. It looks like a problem with the SSO Integration Module, but it might also be related to the OAuth authorization server not sending the correct challenge. Please investigate.

title: Critical login failures with MFA Manager
description: We have a critical issue in ANZ production where 2,938 users are failing to log in. The MFA Manager seems to be involved, but the symptoms could also indicate a problem with the underlying Authentication Service. We need immediate assistance to restore login functionality as business impact is severe.

title: SSO Module causing duplicate accounts and import failures
description: In our LATAM staging environment, the SSO Integration Module is creating duplicate accounts for users. Additionally, bulk import operations are failing completely. This is affecting 580 users and has a high business impact on our staging workflows. We need to resolve the duplication logic and the import failure.

title: MFA codes rejected during SSO login for ANZ users
description: We are seeing a significant issue with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment here in ANZ. Approximately 29 users are reporting that their Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) codes are being rejected upon submission, preventing them from logging in. The issue appears intermittent for some but persistent for others. This is causing moderate business impact as these users cannot access necessary workflows. Please investigate why valid MFA codes are not being accepted by the integration.

title: Billing Engine UI misalignment and incorrect total calculations
description: There are two distinct issues occurring with the Billing Engine in production. First, several UI elements are misaligned, making the invoice view difficult to read for our customers. Second, and more critically, the calculation engine is showing the wrong total amount on recent invoices. About 40 users are affected by the display error, and the incorrect totals are causing moderate business impact due to customer inquiries and potential billing disputes. We need both the visual layout and the calculation logic checked urgently.

title: Staging environment issues: Overcharges, missing refunds, and non-renewed subscriptions
description: In our staging environment (Payment Gateway v2), we are observing multiple data consistency issues that are blocking our release testing. We see instances where accounts are overcharged, followed by refunds that are not reflected in the ledger, and subscriptions that are not renewing as expected. While there is currently no production business impact or affected users, these bugs prevent us from validating our new payment flows. We need these scenarios resolved to proceed with our deployment plan.

title: Critical: Subscriptions not renewing in Payment Gateway v2 (EU-West)
description: We are experiencing a critical failure in the Payment Gateway v2 production environment within the EU-West region. Subscriptions are not renewing, impacting over 15,000 users. This is causing a major revenue risk. We think this is definitely a configuration issue on our end or perhaps a sync delay with the upstream identity provider, but we have checked our settings and they look correct. We need immediate assistance to restore renewal functionality.

title: High impact: Autoscaling failure and rate limits hit in Payment Gateway v2 (US-East)
description: The Payment Gateway v2 in our US-East production environment is failing to autoscale during peak traffic. Consequently, we are hitting rate limits, which is degrading performance for approximately 900 users. The system does not seem to be reacting to increased load as it should. We believe the autoscaling policies configured within the gateway itself are not triggering properly. This is a high-impact issue affecting our active user base and requires urgent attention to restore capacity management.

title: Analytics Dashboard returning HTTP 429 and timeouts in Sandbox
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in the APAC sandbox environment is throwing HTTP 429 errors and timing out frequently. This is blocking testing for 21,500 users in our internal sandbox workflow. Despite it being a sandbox environment, this is critical because it prevents our development team from validating new dashboard features. The API is refusing connections or closing them after a delay. Please check the quota limits or performance bottlenecks affecting the sandbox instance.

title: KPI Tracker UI failing to render (White Screen of Death)
description: We are seeing a UI rendering issue with the KPI Tracker in the EU-Central production environment. A small number of users (2) are encountering a complete white screen of death when trying to access the tracker, indicating that the UI elements are not rendering at all. The business impact is currently low due to the limited number of affected users, but it prevents these specific users from accessing their performance metrics. Please investigate the frontend rendering logic.

title: Data integrity issues in Analytics Dashboard: Duplicates, missing records, and encoding errors
description: The Analytics Dashboard in EU-Central production is displaying incorrect data. Users are reporting duplicate records appearing in reports, other records are missing entirely, and we are seeing encoding errors that garble text fields. This affects about 16 users and is causing moderate business impact as reports cannot be trusted for decision-making. We need the data pipeline and display logic audited to resolve these integrity issues.

title: Data Export Service returning 503 errors and causing app crashes
description: The Data Export Service in our EU-Central production environment is frequently returning 503 Service Unavailable errors. This is leading to application crashes for roughly 8,000 users attempting to export data. The service seems unstable and is not handling requests reliably. This is a critical issue preventing users from accessing necessary reports and data exports. Please investigate the service availability and stability immediately.

title: Chargeback Handler issues: Overcharges, wrong currency conversion, and declined payments
description: We are observing irregularities in the Chargeback Handler within our APAC production environment. Specifically, we are seeing overcharges applied to accounts, incorrect currency conversions in transaction records, and payments being declined unexpectedly. This affects a small group of 4 users but is a low-impact issue compared to broader outages. However, the financial discrepancies need to be corrected to ensure accurate accounting. Please review the logic for chargebacks, currency exchange rates, and payment authorization.

title: Report Builder data mismatch in LATAM production
description: Users of the Report Builder in the LATAM production environment are reporting significant data mismatches between the generated reports and the source data. About 84 users are affected, causing moderate business impact as they cannot rely on the output for their analyses. We think this is definitely a load balancer routing issue, causing requests to hit inconsistent backend nodes. Please verify the distribution logic or backend consistency.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Undercharges and subscription renewal failures in US-West
description: In the US-West production environment for Payment Gateway v2, we are seeing undercharges on transactions and subscriptions failing to renew. There are currently no reported business impacts or affected users in production, suggesting this might be a pre-production or low-volume issue, but it needs to be resolved. We think this is definitely a customer configuration error on our side, perhaps related to tax settings or plan mappings. Please help us identify if our configuration is causing these billing discrepancies.

title: Overcharge detected in Payment Gateway v2 Development Environment
description: We have detected an overcharge in the Payment Gateway v2 development environment in US-East. While there is no business impact or affected users since this is a dev instance, it is a bug that needs fixing before promotion to higher environments. We think this is definitely an improper access review issue, where permissions or rules are incorrectly applied during the transaction simulation. Please investigate the logic causing the inflated charge amounts.

title: Critical: Malformed JSON and webhook failures in Analytics Dashboard (Staging)
description: The Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM staging environment is returning malformed JSON responses and failing to fire webhooks. This is blocking 24,964 users from completing their testing workflows and is considered a critical blocker for our release. The API responses are not adhering to the expected schema, causing downstream integration failures. Please investigate the serialization and webhook triggering mechanisms.

title: Audit log gaps detected in Payment Gateway v2 Sandbox
description: We have identified missing entries in the audit logs for the Payment Gateway v2 in our APAC sandbox environment. Approximately 16 users are impacted by this visibility gap, which has a moderate business impact as it hinders our compliance checks and debugging capabilities in the sandbox. The logs are not recording all transactional events as expected. Please investigate the logging pipeline to ensure complete audit trails.

title: Discrepancies in Analytics Dashboard data (staging)
description: We are seeing significant data mismatches and missing records in our staging environment for the Analytics Dashboard. The numbers don't align with what we expect, and some entries are just gone. This is affecting about 495 users and is blocking our validation. I'm not sure if the dashboard is failing to render the data correctly or if the underlying queries are returning incomplete results.

title: SSO and MFA failures on Payment Gateway v2 staging
description: Users are unable to log in to the staging environment for Payment Gateway v2. When attempting to access via SSO, they are redirected to an error page. Additionally, when users try to bypass SSO or reset passwords, the reset links appear expired, and MFA codes are being rejected despite being generated correctly. This is impacting approximately 170 users and halting our testing efforts.

title: Funnel Analyzer unresponsive in sandbox - config issues
description: The Funnel Analyzer service in our EU-West sandbox environment is completely unresponsive. We recently updated our configuration to include new environment variables, but it seems these changes are not taking effect. The service does not load, and we cannot determine if the issue is due to the missing/incorrect environment variables or a deeper configuration propagation failure. This is blocking our sandbox testing for 110 users.

title: Provisioning sync stuck in production SSO Integration Module
description: We have observed that user provisioning synchronization is stuck in our production environment for the SSO Integration Module. The sync process has been delayed and is not completing, leaving newly added users without access. While this has not yet impacted active user sessions, the backlog of unsynchronized accounts is growing. No current user impact is reported, but the sync state remains stuck.

title: Fee Analyzer showing double subscriptions and overcharges
description: Our finance team is reporting that the Fee Analyzer is displaying incorrect billing data. Specifically, several accounts show subscription charges applied twice, resulting in perceived overcharges. This discrepancy is affecting about 49 accounts. We need to understand why the Fee Analyzer is reflecting these double charges, as it is causing confusion in our reconciliation process.

title: Invoice Service generating incorrect prorations
description: We are seeing inaccuracies in invoices generated by the Invoice Service in our US-West production environment. When customers change their plan mid-cycle, the proration calculations are incorrect, leading to final invoice amounts that do not match the expected terms. This is affecting approximately 8 customers so far. We need this investigated to ensure billing accuracy.

title: Export corruption in Analytics Dashboard
description: The Analytics Dashboard is producing garbled characters and corrupted files when we try to export data. This is happening in production for many of our users. We have a high impact here with hundreds of users affected. The exports are unusable.

title: Critical webhook failures in Event Tracker
description: We are experiencing critical issues with the Event Tracker system where webhook retries are being exhausted. This is resulting in significant data loss for our event pipeline. The problem is widespread, affecting over 2000 users in our US-East production environment. The retries fail and then stop, leaving our downstream systems out of sync.

title: Incorrect access grants via SSO Integration Module
description: In our EU-Central production environment, the SSO Integration Module is granting access incorrectly. Certain users are receiving permissions they should not have, or are missing permissions they should have. This has been identified for about 23 users. We need to review the attribute mapping and access logic within the SSO module to resolve these inconsistencies.

title: Active Directory Sync index corruption
description: We have detected index corruption within the Active Directory Sync service in our EU-West production environment. This is causing delays and errors in directory synchronization. Approximately 51 users are affected by the inconsistencies caused by the corrupted indexes. The sync process is not failing hard, but the data integrity is compromised.

title: SSO Access Errors and Privilege Issues in ME Production
description: Users in our Middle East production environment are encountering HTTP 403 errors when trying to access resources via the SSO Integration Module. Furthermore, some users are reporting that they have elevated privileges that were not assigned to them, while others are denied access entirely. It is unclear if this is a failure in the SSO validation logic or an issue with message propagation through the backend queues. The impact is high, affecting over 750 users.

title: LDAP Connector session and MFA failures
description: We are observing a pattern of session expirations and MFA failures related to our LDAP Connector in the US-East production environment. Users' sessions are expiring unexpectedly, and when they attempt to re-authenticate, the MFA prompt often does not appear or the codes are rejected. This is severely impacting about 884 users. We need to check the connector's configuration regarding session timeouts and MFA enforcement.

title: Payment Gateway config not working
description: The configuration updates for Payment Gateway v2 in our development environment aren't taking effect. We changed some settings but the behavior remains the same as before. Not sure why this is happening.

title: Webhook delivery issues and rate limiting in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are experiencing two distinct issues in our staging environment for Payment Gateway v2. First, webhooks are not firing as expected for certain transaction events. Second, when we do see activity, we are receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors. Currently, this has not impacted live users, but it is blocking our integration testing. We need to understand if the 429s are preventing the webhooks from being triggered or if these are separate configuration issues.

title: SSO provisioning stuck in staging
description: Provisioning seems to be stuck for our SSO Integration Module in staging. The sync is not completing and users aren't being created. It's a major issue for our team.

title: Duplicate accounts and expired password reset links in Dev Environment
description: We are seeing issues with user account management in our development environment (EU-West). Specifically, when users attempt to reset their passwords, the system creates duplicate account entries instead of updating the existing one. Additionally, the password reset links are expiring almost immediately after generation, making it impossible for the affected users (about 6 of them) to regain access without admin intervention.

title: HTTP 500 errors and timeouts on Payment Gateway v2 in Staging
description: In our US-West staging environment, we are encountering persistent HTTP 500 errors and connection timeouts when interacting with Payment Gateway v2. This is affecting our integration testing for about 2 users. The timeouts seem to occur intermittently, but the 500 errors are consistent when the timeout happens.

title: Critical: Missing audit logs and account lockouts in SSO Sandbox
description: We are experiencing a significant issue in our EU-Central sandbox environment with the SSO Integration Module. A large number of users (approx. 147) are being locked out of their accounts unexpectedly. Furthermore, the audit logs are missing critical entries related to these lockout events, which is hindering our ability to troubleshoot. This is impacting our high-priority compliance testing.

title: Analytics Dashboard: Missing audit logs and data residency mismatches
description: Our production Analytics Dashboard in the APAC region is showing gaps in the audit logs. We have also detected that the data residency flags do not match the configured values for certain datasets. Given the scale of affected users (779), this is a high-impact issue. We think this is caused by resource exhaustion on the server side, as we noticed high CPU usage prior to the errors appearing.

title: Queue Manager production issues: Privilege escalations and lockouts in ME
description: In the Middle East production environment, we are observing elevated privileges being assigned to certain service accounts in the Queue Manager. Alongside this, we are receiving certificate expiration warnings and have seen 28 users get locked out. This is disrupting our message processing workflows and needs investigation into why these security controls are behaving abnormally.

title: Analytics Dashboard Staging: Missing consent records and audit log gaps
description: We have noticed that consent records are missing from the Analytics Dashboard in our EU-West staging environment. Additionally, there are gaps in the audit logs that correspond to when these records should have been created. While no users are currently impacted (impact is none), we need to ensure data integrity before promoting changes to production.

description: Our production Webhook Engine in US-East is failing to process events because it claims that required environment variables are missing. This is affecting 14 users and causing moderate business impact. We have checked our configuration, but the engine insists the variables are not present. Please investigate why the engine is not picking up these settings.

title: Audit log entries missing for Payment Gateway v2 in Production
description: We are seeing missing audit log entries for transaction events in our US-West production environment for Payment Gateway v2. About 14 users are affected, and this is causing a moderate impact on our financial reconciliation processes. The logs should record every transaction, but there are gaps that do not correspond to any known system downtime.

This is severely impacting our user segmentation and marketing campaigns. Immediate attention is required.

The dashboard loads initially but then freezes or times out when trying to query data. This is currently affecting about 3 users with low business impact, but we want to ensure it doesn't escalate.

Subscriptions are not renewing automatically, and we are seeing cases where users are charged twice for the same period. This is resulting in overcharges for 501 users in our test pool. We believe the issue lies within the Billing Disputes Handler logic itself, as it is mishandling the renewal triggers and payment deduplication.

title: Audit log gaps and missing consent records in Payment Gateway v2

This affects compliance reporting for approximately 51 users and is causing a moderate business impact. The logs are not capturing all user interactions, and some consent flags are absent from the transaction metadata.

Low impact since it's only dev, but we need this fixed to continue testing.

First, the configured data retention policy is not being applied, causing data to remain longer than compliant limits. Second, we have detected significant gaps in our audit logs during our monthly review. These issues affect approximately 4,371 users and pose a serious compliance risk. Please investigate the retention job failures and log ingestion pipeline immediately.

title: Payment Gateway v2 declining transactions for APAC customers
description: We are experiencing a moderate impact issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in our APAC production environment. Approximately 98 users are having their payments declined unexpectedly. The error messages are generic and do not specify why the transaction is failing. We need assistance troubleshooting why valid payment methods are being rejected.

title: Audit log gaps detected in Cohort Builder - LATAM Production
description: We have noticed missing entries in the audit logs for the Cohort Builder tool. This issue is affecting our LATAM production environment. While the impact is currently moderate, we have identified gaps for around 17 users who performed actions that were not recorded. We need to ensure all cohort modifications are properly logged for our internal compliance.

Users are reporting that their subscriptions are not renewing automatically, many are being overcharged, and refund requests are not being reflected in their accounts. This is affecting over 1,000 users and causing significant customer support volume. Please prioritize investigation into these billing calculations and status updates.

description: Our Chat Widget in the ANZ production environment is creating duplicate user accounts. This is a high-impact issue affecting roughly 150 users. When customers initiate a chat, a new profile is often generated even if the user already exists, leading to fragmented support history. We need to fix the account matching logic within the Chat Widget to prevent these duplicates.

User provisioning is getting stuck in a pending state, and there are significant synchronization delays between the token issuance and the service availability. Approximately 167 users are currently unable to access services due to these delays. Please investigate the provisioning queue and sync mechanisms.

description: In our ME staging environment, the Analytics Dashboard is frequently returning HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors. Additionally, when the requests do go through, the API often returns empty response bodies despite valid query parameters. This affects about 24 users in the staging team and is hindering our ability to validate dashboard changes before moving to production. Please review rate limit configurations and response handling.

title: Audit Log Gaps Detected in Production Analytics Dashboard (ME Region)
description: We have detected inconsistencies in the audit logs generated by the Analytics Dashboard in our ME production environment. Specifically, there are gaps where user actions appear to be missing from the log records. This affects approximately 58 users and is a moderate impact on our compliance reporting capabilities. We request an investigation into the log transmission pipeline to ensure complete audit trails.

The lockouts appear to happen after a single failed attempt or sometimes without any visible error prompt. This is a high-impact availability issue preventing staff from accessing critical applications. Please review the authentication flow and lockout policies.

Additionally, when manual triggers are attempted, the system often times out. While this currently has no immediate business impact or affected users, it is a configuration reliability issue we need to resolve before we scale usage. Please check the webhook delivery status and timeout settings.

title: Duplicate Records Appearing in Analytics Dashboard - US-East Production
description: Users are reporting seeing duplicate records when viewing data in the Analytics Dashboard. This is a moderate impact issue affecting about 46 users in our US-East production environment. It is unclear whether the duplication is happening during data aggregation in the dashboard or during the segment creation process, as the affected datasets involve complex segments. The duplicates are skewing metrics and causing confusion in reporting.

title: UI Misalignment and Form Submission Failure in Billing Engine
description: In our ME production environment, we are encountering UI issues with the Billing Engine. Specifically, certain form elements are misaligned, which makes the interface difficult to use. More critically, when users attempt to submit these forms, the action fails without a clear error message. This is currently a low-impact issue affecting 1 specific user workflow, but it blocks the completion of the billing update process.

title: Duplicate Charges and Subscription Issues in Billing Disputes Handler - Definitely a race condition
description: We are seeing issues in our EU-West staging environment where users report duplicate charges, and the Billing Disputes Handler is recording subscriptions as charged twice. We think it's because of a race condition in the payment processing logic. This is affecting about 9 users in the test group. Please verify the transaction concurrency handling as we are confident this is the root cause.

title: Subscription not renewing and invoice amounts incorrect in Payment Gateway v2 (LATAM)
description: We are experiencing issues with our Payment Gateway v2 integration in the LATAM production environment. Specifically, the subscription renewal process is failing to trigger, resulting in accounts being marked as inactive even though payment methods are valid. Additionally, when manual invoices are generated for these periods, the amounts listed do not match the expected plan pricing or prorated calculations. We have verified that the customer accounts and payment tokens are correct on our side. This is affecting our billing accuracy and needs investigation.

title: Overcharges observed on Invoice Service for ANZ customers
description: Our finance team in the ANZ region has reported that approximately 80 users are seeing overcharges on their latest invoices processed through the Invoice Service. The amounts appear higher than the contracted rates. We are unsure if the issue originates from the invoice generation logic itself or if the underlying ledger balances used for calculation are incorrect. Could you please investigate the billing data flow for these accounts?

We are receiving HTTP 200 responses but with empty bodies, meaning notifications are not being delivered. Furthermore, we are frequently encountering 'rate limit exceeded' errors, which seems disproportionate to our actual request volume. This is currently impacting one specific automated workflow. Please check if there are configuration issues or upstream throttling affecting our API key.

This has resulted in a delay for 103 users who rely on real-time export completion notifications. The export jobs themselves complete successfully, but the callback URL receives no traffic. This is a high-impact issue for our downstream automation.

title: Webhook issues in Analytics Dashboard
description: Webhooks seem to be failing. It's affecting about 15 users. We aren't sure when it started or if there are specific error codes. Please check.

title: Rate limit errors and suspected memory leaks in Payment Gateway v2 (APAC)

We are seeing 'rate limit exceeded' errors even when traffic volume is within expected thresholds. Concurrently, monitoring tools indicate a spike in memory usage on our gateway instances, suggesting a potential memory leak associated with the payment processing flow. This is currently impacting 4 active users. We need assistance determining if the rate limiting is a side effect of the memory issues or a separate configuration problem.

title: Analytics Dashboard unresponsive in Dev (US-West)
description: The Analytics Dashboard in the US-West development environment is completely unresponsive. We are seeing a partial outage status. We think this is definitely because of an incomplete rollback from the last deployment cycle. Please investigate the deployment history.

title: Garbled characters displayed in Funnel Analyzer (Staging/ME)

This issue affects approximately 65 users on the team. The data appears to be stored correctly in the backend, but the rendering layer is failing to interpret the encoding properly. This is making the analytics views difficult to read and interpret.

title: Blank screen and missing UI elements in Feedback Collector
description: Users are reporting a blank screen and missing UI elements when accessing the Feedback Collector in the US-West production environment. This is affecting 2 users. It is unclear if the issue lies within the Feedback Collector service itself or if it is a conflict with the Chat Widget integration on the same page. Please investigate the rendering failures.

title: Form submission failing in Feedback Collector
description: Some users can't submit the form. The UI looks wrong or missing parts. Not sure exactly when it started. It's affecting a few people. Please look into it.

title: High latency in Analytics Dashboard (LATAM)
description: We are experiencing high latency and slow response times when loading the Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM production environment. This is currently affecting 1 user who reported the issue. We think it's because of a schema mismatch between the dashboard query layer and the underlying data source. Please check the database schema definitions.

title: MFA Manager outage and crashes in Staging (ME)
description: The MFA Manager is currently in a full outage state in the Middle East staging environment. The service is unresponsive, and attempts to authenticate result in application crashes. This is impacting 34 users who are blocked from logging in. We need this resolved urgently to continue our testing cycles.

title: Event Tracker unresponsive and feature flags failing in Production (LATAM)
description: Our Event Tracker service in the LATAM production environment has become unresponsive. Additionally, we are observing that feature flags are not applying correctly for users, leading to inconsistent application behavior. This critical issue is affecting 387 users and is blocking core functionality. Immediate assistance is required.

title: Double subscription charge in Report Builder (Dev/EU-Central)
description: We noticed that a test subscription was charged twice in the EU-Central development environment while using the Report Builder billing simulation. The duplicate charge occurred approximately 5 minutes after the initial successful transaction. This affects our 4 test accounts used for validating billing flows. We have the transaction IDs for both charges if needed for investigation.

title: Incorrect invoice amounts for ANZ users in Payment Gateway v2
description: In the ANZ production environment, we are receiving reports of incorrect invoice amounts generated via Payment Gateway v2. Approximately 46 users have been billed the wrong amount, primarily undercharged. The issue seems isolated to specific product SKUs. We need to identify the cause of the calculation error to rectify the billing records.

title: Analytics Dashboard backup failing due to network config error
description: Our production Analytics Dashboard in EU-Central is having issues. We are seeing the backup job fail and it keeps saying we are out of disk space. We think it's definitely a network configuration error on our side causing the backups to write to the wrong location and filling up the local drive. Please advise as this is impacting over 600 users.

title: Fee Analyzer crashing in staging - credential rotation issue?
description: The Fee Analyzer application in our EU-West staging environment keeps crashing. We recently rotated some keys and we are sure this is because the credential rotation didn't propagate properly to the service. 47 users are affected with moderate impact. Can you check the propagation status?

title: LDAP Connector cert warning due to capacity planning
description: We are getting certificate expired warnings on the LDAP Connector in our EU-Central dev environment. This is definitely an issue with insufficient capacity planning on our end, we probably allocated too few resources for the cert renewal process to complete. Need help clearing these warnings for 74 users.
