As a result, we are seeing duplicate accounts being created in the downstream system for the same user identifier. This seems to be a logic error within the SSO module itself regarding how it handles provisioning state. Please advise on how to clear the stuck jobs and prevent duplicates.

title: SSO Integration Module Sync Stuck in Production
description: We are observing that the SSO Integration Module sync process in production (US-West) is stuck and not completing its cycle. This affects two specific users whose changes are not propagating. This is definitely a idempotency/duplicate-processing failure on your end causing the lock-up. We need this resolved quickly to ensure data consistency for our enterprise clients.

title: Permission Engine Issues: Expired Certificate Warnings and Unexpected Elevated Privileges
description: We are reporting issues with the Permission Engine in our production environment (APAC). The system is generating warnings about expired certificates, which may be affecting secure communication channels. More critically, some users are observing elevated privileges that they should not have access to. This impacts 393 users and represents a high business risk. We believe the root cause lies within the Permission Engine's configuration or update mechanism.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Data Residency Flag Mismatch and Retention Policy Failures
description: We have detected critical compliance issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in production (EU-West). The data residency flags for certain transaction records do not match the required geographic locations. Additionally, retention policies are not being applied correctly, leading to data being kept longer than permitted. This affects 1,003 users and poses a significant regulatory risk. Immediate investigation is required to ensure GDPR and local data law compliance.

title: SSO Integration Module: MFA Rejections and Unexpected Session Expirations
description: Users of our SSO Integration Module in production (ME) are reporting that valid MFA codes are being rejected during login attempts. Furthermore, active sessions are expiring unexpectedly without user interaction. These symptoms are preventing approximately 485 users from accessing their applications securely. We need to determine if this is an issue with the SSO module's validation logic or if there are underlying infrastructure problems causing the timeouts and failures.

title: Database query timeouts occurring in Admin Console staging
description: We are experiencing frequent database query timeouts when accessing the Admin Console in our staging environment (ME region). This is currently affecting about 8 internal users who are unable to complete configuration tasks. The queries hang for approximately 30 seconds before returning a timeout error. Please investigate the database performance in this environment as it is blocking our deployment testing.

title: Analytics Dashboard crashing
description: The Analytics Dashboard in production (APAC) keeps crashing. Many users are seeing this. It's causing big issues for us. Please fix ASAP.

title: Intermittent failures and high latency on Production Analytics Dashboard (ME)
description: Users in our Middle East region are reporting intermittent failures and significant latency when using the production Analytics Dashboard. Approximately 668 users are affected. The dashboard loads very slowly, often timing out or displaying incomplete data, and occasionally crashes entirely. This is impacting daily business reporting. We need urgent assistance to stabilize the service.

title: Subscriptions being charged twice
description: We have some customers in the ME production environment who are getting overcharged. Their subscriptions are being billed twice. About 129 users are affected. This is causing a lot of complaints. Please check what is going on with the billing.

title: Incorrect currency conversion on Payment Gateway v2 (EU-West)
description: We are observing incorrect currency conversion rates on the Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West production environment. The system is applying the wrong exchange rate, resulting in inaccurate transaction amounts. This affects approximately 69 users and is causing moderate business impact due to potential revenue discrepancies. Please verify the currency configuration and recent updates to the conversion engine.

title: Slow response and high latency during data exports
description: Our Data Export Service in the APAC production region is exhibiting very slow response times and high latency. It is unclear if the bottleneck is in the export service itself or downstream in the Data Warehouse Store, as queries from both areas seem sluggish. This delay is affecting 163 users who rely on timely reports. We need to determine which component is at fault to resolve the business impact.

title: Critical missing entries in MFA Manager audit logs
description: We have identified a critical issue with the MFA Manager in our development environment (APAC) where audit logs are missing entries. This affects compliance tracking for over 9,500 users' test activities. The logs are incomplete, which is a significant blocker for our security audits. Please investigate why log entries are being dropped or not written to the system.

title: SSO Integration Module pods restarting repeatedly in production
description: In the LATAM production environment, the SSO Integration Module pods are restarting repeatedly. This instability is affecting 22 users who cannot maintain stable login sessions. The restarts appear to be happening frequently, causing moderate business impact. Please check the health of the pods and any resource limits or error logs associated with these restarts.

title: MFA prompts not appearing and unexpected session expirations
description: Users in the ME production environment for Payment Gateway v2 are not receiving MFA prompts, and their sessions are expiring unexpectedly. This is a critical security issue affecting 1,024 users. The combination of missing authentication steps and forced logouts is disrupting access and posing a compliance risk. Immediate investigation into the authentication flow and session management is required.

title: Webhook retries exhausted and HTTP 429 errors
description: We are seeing webhook retries exhausted and HTTP 429 errors on the Payment Gateway v2 in staging (EU-West). It is difficult to tell if this is an issue with the Payment Gateway's outbound webhooks or if the SSO Broker (Shared) is rate-limiting the requests. The impact is high, affecting 310 users' ability to complete integrations. We need help diagnosing which service is throwing the rate limit errors.

title: MFA codes rejected and accounts locked out in sandbox
description: In the EU-Central sandbox environment for Payment Gateway v2, users are finding that valid MFA codes are being rejected, leading to account lockouts. This is affecting 15 users and has a moderate business impact on our testing capabilities. Please review the MFA validation logic and account lockout thresholds to resolve this blocking issue.

title: Timeouts on Analytics Dashboard in development
description: We are experiencing timeouts when loading the Analytics Dashboard in our development environment (LATAM). This is affecting 4 users and has a low business impact, but it is hindering our ability to test new features. The page loads indefinitely before failing. Please check the backend services or database connections responsible for dashboard data retrieval.

title: Subscriptions not renewing in Payment Gateway v2 staging
description: Subscriptions are not renewing automatically in the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment (ANZ). This is a critical issue affecting 1,056 users' test accounts, preventing us from validating the renewal logic for upcoming releases. Please investigate the scheduling and execution of renewal jobs to determine why transactions are failing to process.

title: Elevated privileges observed in Payment Gateway v2 staging
description: During a routine security scan, we observed elevated privileges being granted to certain accounts in the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment (APAC). While there is no immediate business impact reported (0 users currently affected), this poses a potential security risk. Please verify the permission settings and ensure that privilege escalation paths are closed or properly justified.

title: Data residency flag mismatch on Analytics Dashboard
description: We are seeing a data residency flag mismatch on the Analytics Dashboard in the ME production region. This is affecting 335 users and has a high business impact due to compliance concerns. We think this is definitely an incorrect load balancer routing issue, where requests are being sent to the wrong geographic node. Please check the load balancer configuration to resolve the routing.

title: Cache configuration changes not applying in production
description: We updated the cache service configuration parameters yesterday evening, but the changes are not taking effect on the instances. We have verified that the config file is saved correctly and the service has been restarted multiple times. The old values are still being served to approximately 9945 users. This is impacting our performance targets significantly.

title: Garbled text and truncation in analytics export
description: When downloading large reports from the dashboard, the file often cuts off or shows weird symbols instead of text. We know this is just a known product limitation with the export size, so we aren't asking for a fix, just confirming if there's a workaround or if we need to upgrade tiers to get full exports.

title: API returning empty responses for dashboard metrics
description: Our production environment in the Middle East is experiencing an issue where the Analytics Dashboard API calls are returning empty JSON responses ({}) instead of the expected data payload. This affects about 84 users who rely on these real-time metrics. The requests are reaching the server, but the body is empty. No errors are thrown, so it's hard to debug on our end.

title: MFA prompt missing or code rejected in Payment Gateway
description: Some users in our US-East production environment are reporting issues with the two-factor authentication flow. For some, the MFA prompt does not appear at all during login, allowing them to bypass it. For others, the prompt appears but rejects valid codes generated by authenticator apps. We need to understand if this is a recent regression or a configuration mismatch.

title: Critical: Customers being overcharged in Chargeback Handler
description: We are seeing instances in our staging environment where the Chargeback Handler is calculating incorrect totals, resulting in overcharges for approximately 1049 test accounts. The fee amounts are higher than the configured rates. This is a critical blocker for our upcoming release as we cannot validate billing accuracy.

title: SSO sync issues and duplicate accounts
description: Hey team, our SSO module is acting up. Users are getting stuck during provisioning and we're seeing duplicate accounts popping up in the system. Sync seems delayed or broken. It's affecting a few hundred people and causing a lot of confusion. Can someone look into this?

title: Incorrect currency conversion and overcharges
description: We noticed that payment amounts are being converted incorrectly, leading to overcharges for about 145 users. We checked the logs and it looks like this started right after the latest release. We are pretty sure this is definitely a bad deployment issue on your side where the exchange rate tables weren't updated properly.

title: Missing entries in Audit Logs for Analytics Dashboard
description: In our staging environment, we are unable to see certain user actions in the Audit Log for the Analytics Dashboard. Specifically, report generation events are missing, though other actions are logged. This affects our compliance verification process for 33 internal users. We have checked the time range filters but the events are simply not there.

title: Role Manager UI glitches and pagination errors
description: The Role Manager interface in the ANZ sandbox is displaying misaligned elements, making it difficult to assign permissions. Additionally, the pagination controls are broken and do not load subsequent pages of users. This is blocking about 700 users from completing their role setup. We think it's because of a firewall misconfiguration on our end that is blocking some static assets, but we can't confirm.

title: Webhooks not firing and empty API responses
description: One of our integration points in the ANZ production environment is failing. The Payment Gateway API returns empty responses for status checks, and consequently, webhooks are not firing as expected. We suspect this is an incorrect DNS configuration issue because we recently changed some records on our side, but we want you to check if there is a deeper connectivity problem.

title: Cohort Builder missing records in development
description: When building cohorts in our EU-West development environment, specific user records are missing from the final dataset despite matching the filter criteria. We have verified that the source data exists in the database. This affects 31 users testing the new segmentation logic. The issue appears intermittent but is consistent for certain user IDs.

title: Bulk import failures and stuck provisioning
description: We tried a bulk import into the SSO module in US-East and it partially failed. Now some users are stuck in provisioning. It's messy and affecting 229 people. Not sure what went wrong exactly, need help sorting this out ASAP.

title: Audit log gaps and certificate warnings in dev
description: In our ANZ development environment, we are seeing warnings about expired certificates when trying to authenticate certain services. Additionally, when we look at the audit logs, entries for those failed authentication attempts are missing entirely. This is confusing our security team as they cannot trace the failures. Affects about 53 developers.

title: MFA codes not working in dev
description: Hey, a few of us in the EU-Central dev env are getting our MFA codes rejected by the Payment Gateway. Just saying it doesn't work, even though it's valid. Any ideas? Thanks.

title: Backup job failures and query timeouts in Secret Store
description: We are experiencing intermittent backup job failures in our ME development environment for the Secret Store. When we try to investigate, the associated database queries often time out. We aren't sure if the issue is with the storage backend itself or if the cluster management layer is throttling the requests. This is impacting 25 users who are unable to restore previous configurations.

title: Attribution Engine UI missing elements
description: We are seeing an issue in the Attribution Engine interface where specific UI elements are not rendering correctly on our screens. This appears to be affecting the display of the dashboard components. The problem started recently and is causing confusion for our users who rely on these visual cues. Please investigate why the UI is failing to load these parts.

title: Password reset links expiring immediately in Payment Gateway v2
description: Users are reporting that password reset links sent through the Payment Gateway v2 system are expiring before they can be used. This issue is affecting approximately 133 users in the US-East production environment. When a user requests a reset, the link generated appears to have a validity window of zero or near-zero seconds, resulting in an 'expired' error message upon click. We need this fixed urgently as it is locking users out of their accounts.

title: Critical billing errors in Report Builder staging
description: We are observing multiple severe billing-related issues within the Report Builder environment in LATAM staging. First, we are receiving chargeback notices for transactions that should not have been disputed. Second, the tax amounts calculated in the reports are incorrect, leading to compliance concerns. Third, several subscriptions that should have auto-renewed are showing as not renewed. This combination of errors is impacting 2,305 users and is considered a critical blocker for our launch timeline.

title: Intermittent timeouts in Payment Gateway v2
description: Our production environment in ANZ is experiencing occasional timeout errors when interacting with the Payment Gateway v2 API. While this has not resulted in any reported business impact or affected users currently, the instability is concerning. We are seeing connection timeouts on standard transaction endpoints. Please review the gateway health to ensure this does not escalate.

title: Analytics Dashboard API returning empty responses
description: In our EU-West staging environment, the Analytics Dashboard API is returning empty responses for valid requests, and webhook retries are being exhausted without success. This is affecting 23 users. We have reviewed our recent changes and are confident that this issue is caused by a bad deployment that occurred earlier this week. The codebase seems to have introduced a regression that is stripping the data from the payload. Please roll back or fix the deployment artifacts.

title: Missing entries in Analytics Dashboard audit logs
description: We have detected gaps in the audit log entries for the Analytics Dashboard in the US-East production environment. Specifically, certain administrative actions are not being recorded, resulting in missing entries. While there is currently no reported business impact or affected users, the integrity of our audit trail is compromised. We need an investigation into why these log events are not persisting.

title: Data residency flag mismatch in Payment Gateway v2
description: In the EU-Central staging environment, we are observing a mismatch in data residency flags for transactions processed via Payment Gateway v2. Two users have reported this anomaly. We are certain that this is a clock/time synchronization issue between our servers and the gateway, causing the system to misinterpret the data origin timestamps and apply the wrong residency rules. Please check the NTP settings and time synchronization protocols.

title: Billing issues
description: Hey, something is wrong with billing. Subscriptions aren't renewing and people are being undercharged. Lots of users affected. Please check.

title: SSO Module API errors in Sandbox
description: The SSO Integration Module in the EU-West sandbox environment is returning malformed JSON responses and occasionally empty API responses. This is severely impacting our testing, with 632 users unable to authenticate correctly. The high business impact is due to our inability to validate upcoming features. We have isolated the issue to the SSO module's response handling and require immediate assistance to restore standard JSON formatting.

title: SSO Provisioning stuck and duplicate accounts
description: In the APAC production environment, the SSO Integration Module is exhibiting provisioning issues. Specifically, the sync process is getting stuck, leading to the creation of duplicate user accounts. This has affected 29 users, resulting in a moderate business impact due to data cleanup requirements. We need support to resolve the stuck sync jobs and prevent further duplicate account generation.

title: Analytics Dashboard performance and webhook failures
description: We are encountering HTTP 429 errors, webhook firing failures, and general timeouts within the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West staging environment. This is affecting 2 users and has a low business impact currently. We believe the issue lies within the Analytics Dashboard's rate limiting or internal processing logic. Please investigate why the dashboard is rejecting requests and failing to trigger webhooks.

title: Attribution Engine data integrity issues in Sandbox
description: The Attribution Engine in the EU-Central sandbox environment is experiencing critical data integrity failures. Backup jobs are failing, replication lag is excessively high, and we have detected index corruption. This is impacting 231 users and has a high business impact due to the unreliability of the data for development purposes. We need to address the storage and replication subsystem issues immediately.

title: Data loss and corrupted exports in Analytics Dashboard
description: Users in the ANZ staging environment are reporting data loss when using the Analytics Dashboard. Exports are often corrupted, and individual records are missing from the generated reports. This affects 39 users and has a moderate business impact. We need to understand why the export process is failing to retrieve all data and why the file integrity is compromised.

title: Slow responses and timeouts in API Gateway
description: We are observing slow response times and occasional timeouts when calling the API Gateway in the APAC sandbox environment. This is affecting 2 users and has a low business impact. We are requesting an investigation into the gateway's performance to identify the source of the latency and connection issues.

title: Notification Hub connection errors
description: In the ME production environment, we are seeing timeout errors and TLS handshake failures when trying to send notifications via the Notification Hub. Although there is currently no reported business impact or affected users, these connectivity issues are concerning. The symptoms suggest a problem either within the Notification Hub's network configuration or potentially with the recipient endpoint's certificate validation. Please investigate the source of these TLS and timeout errors.

title: High volume of payment declines in Production (US-West)
description: We are seeing a significant spike in failed transactions on our production environment in the US-West region. Since about 09:00 UTC, roughly 865 users have reported that their payments are being declined immediately upon submission. The error message is generic ('Payment Failed'), but the volume is unsustainable for our business operations. Please investigate the gateway status urgently as this is causing high business impact.

title: Invoice Service double-charging subscribers
description: Our billing team has flagged an issue with the Invoice Service. Approximately 126 users have been charged twice for their monthly subscriptions in the US-West production environment. The invoices reflect the duplicate charges, leading to customer complaints and refunds. This is a high-priority issue affecting revenue accuracy and user trust.

title: Customer Portal experiencing high latency and intermittent errors
description: I am the only one currently affected, but the Customer Portal in the US-West production environment is extremely slow. Pages take upwards of 10-15 seconds to load, and about 1 in 5 requests results in a timeout or a blank screen. I've tried clearing cache and using different browsers, but the issue persists. It seems intermittent, occurring mostly during peak hours.

title: Forms not submitting in Dev environment (APAC)
description: In our development environment (APAC region), users are unable to submit forms via the Event Tracker. When clicking 'Submit', the UI freezes for a moment and then displays an error, but the data doesn't seem to be sent. We aren't sure if this is a backend processing issue with the tracker itself or a frontend rendering problem on the dashboard. About 30 testers are blocked from proceeding with workflow validation.

title: 502 errors on Subscription Manager
description: Getting HTTP 502 errors when trying to manage subscriptions. Happening in production (ME region). Affects around 46 users. Please fix.

title: Queue Manager slowdown and CPU spikes in Sandbox (EU-West)
description: We are observing severe performance degradation in the Sandbox environment for the Queue Manager in the EU-West region. CPU usage is spiking to 100% and response times have increased drastically, impacting 385 active sandbox users. We think this is definitely a third-party service failure causing the bottleneck, as our internal logs show requests hanging while waiting for external responses. This is causing high business impact due to blocked testing pipelines.

title: Event Tracker health checks failing and failover not working
description: In the APAC development environment, we are seeing health check failures for the Event Tracker. The system reports a partial outage, but the automatic failover did not occur as expected. It's unclear if the issue lies within the tracker's internal health monitoring or if the alerting engine failed to trigger the failover procedure correctly. Only 1 user is currently impacted, but it's blocking deployment verification.

title: Staging Payment Gateway v2 authentication and data issues (ME)
description: We are encountering multiple issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in the Staging environment (ME region). First, MFA codes are frequently rejected despite being valid. Second, we are seeing federation metadata mismatches during SSO integration. Finally, some test accounts are being created as duplicates. These combined issues are blocking our integration testing for 396 users and have a high business impact on our release timeline.

title: Rate Limiter hitting capacity limits in Production (US-East)
description: Our production environment in US-East is seeing a high volume of requests blocked due to 'capacity limit reached' errors on the Rate Limiter. This is affecting 789 users. We suspect the issue might be related to how the rate limiting rules are interacting with the Secrets Rotation Service, as requests seem to be flagged as invalid more often than usual. It's difficult to determine if the limiter itself is misconfigured or if the secret rotation is causing authentication failures that trigger the limits. High business impact.

title: Webhooks failing with HTTP 500 in Staging Payment Gateway v2 (LATAM)
description: In the LATAM staging environment, webhooks from the Payment Gateway v2 are not firing correctly. When they do attempt to send, we are receiving HTTP 500 errors. This affects approximately 8 internal test users. The issue seems isolated to the webhook delivery mechanism rather than the payment processing itself. Please investigate the server-side logs for the webhook endpoints.

title: UI element missing in Self-Service Hub (US-East Production)
description: A specific UI element is not rendering in the Self-Service Hub for the US-East production environment. It appears to be a non-critical widget that should display account status details. No users have reported issues yet, and there is no business impact, but it was noticed during a routine QA check. Please verify if this is a deployment artifact or a code regression.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Development Environment: Declines and Overcharges (EU-West)
description: We are seeing inconsistent payment behaviors in the EU-West development environment for Payment Gateway v2. Some transactions are being declined unexpectedly, while others are resulting in overcharges where the amount billed exceeds the agreed price. This affects 901 users and has a high business impact on our development and testing cycles. We need to know if this is a configuration issue with the sandbox accounts or a bug in the gateway's calculation engine.

title: Report Builder Full Outage in Production (EU-West)
description: The Report Builder service in the EU-West production environment is experiencing a full outage. Health checks are failing, and users are unable to generate or view any reports. This is impacting 482 users and has a high business impact as critical daily reporting cannot be completed. Please escalate this immediately.

title: Active Directory Sync login failures and MFA issues (EU-West Production)
description: Users in the EU-West production environment are reporting login failures when trying to access systems synced via Active Directory Sync. Additionally, MFA codes are being rejected for valid attempts. This affects about 45 users. We believe the sync service is not properly propagating the user attributes needed for authentication and MFA validation. Moderate business impact.

title: Data Pipeline UI and Search issues in Sandbox (US-West)
description: In the US-West sandbox environment, the Data Pipeline interface is malfunctioning. Sorting and filtering options are not working as expected. Additionally, search queries are returning incorrect results, and some UI elements are failing to render entirely. This is currently affecting 1 user during testing. It appears to be a combination of backend data retrieval issues and frontend rendering bugs.

title: Analytics Dashboard exports truncated and missing records in EU-Central Production
description: We are experiencing data integrity issues with our scheduled exports from the Analytics Dashboard. Since yesterday morning, the CSV files generated for our key performance reports are arriving truncated. When we compare the row counts against the dashboard UI, approximately 15% of the expected records are missing entirely from the exported files. This is affecting 962 users who rely on these reports for daily operations. The environment is Production (EU-Central). Please investigate the export pipeline immediately as this is impacting business-critical decision making.

title: Certificate warning displayed when accessing Currency Converter in Staging
description: Our QA team is reporting a security certificate warning when they attempt to load the Currency Converter tool in the Staging environment (EU-Central). The browser flags the connection as potentially insecure, preventing them from proceeding with exchange rate verification tests. This has blocked testing for 44 users. The error appears to be related to an invalid or self-signed certificate configuration. Please update the SSL certificate for the staging instance so we can resume validation work.

title: Incorrect invoice and tax calculations in Payment Gateway v2 (APAC Production)
description: We have identified a discrepancy in the invoicing logic within our Production APAC instance of Payment Gateway v2. Specifically, the generated invoices are showing incorrect total amounts, and the tax calculation field is returning values that do not match the configured tax rules for several customer segments. This affects approximately 16 merchants who are seeing these errors on their billing statements. The issue seems to occur during the final invoice generation step. We need this corrected urgently to avoid billing disputes.

title: High volume of chargeback notices in LATAM Production - likely monitoring gap
description: We are seeing a sudden spike in chargeback notices through Payment Gateway v2 in the LATAM Production environment, impacting 145 users. This is causing significant revenue leakage and administrative overhead. We think this is definitely a monitoring and alerting problem on your side. It seems like the system failed to flag these fraudulent transactions in real-time because the alerts weren't configured correctly or were suppressed. We need you to fix the alerting thresholds immediately so we stop receiving these unexpected chargebacks.

title: Critical: Unauthorized access granted via SSO Integration Module in Dev (ANZ)
description: We have detected a severe security flaw in the SSO Integration Module within our Development environment (ANZ). Users are being granted access to restricted resources incorrectly, bypassing the intended permission sets. This affects 11,221 test accounts. The issue appears to be in how the module parses the user attributes from the identity provider, resulting in overly permissive role assignments. Given the critical nature of this access control failure, we require an immediate patch or configuration review to prevent this from propagating to Production.

title: Rate limit exceeded (HTTP 429) on Analytics Dashboard in US-West Production
description: A small subset of users (8 total) in our US-West Production environment are encountering HTTP 429 'Too Many Requests' errors when interacting with the Analytics Dashboard. This occurs intermittently during peak hours when multiple concurrent sessions are active. While the impact is currently low, we are concerned about scalability. Please advise if we need to adjust our API call frequency or if the rate limits for our account tier need to be increased.

title: Help Center blank screen after recent release (US-East Production)
description: Following the recent deployment to the US-East Production environment, one of our support agents is seeing a completely blank screen when trying to access a specific article in the Help Center. The feature used to be visible before the release. It is unclear if this is a rendering error or if the content was accidentally removed. Since only one user is affected so far, it might be a browser-specific issue, but we need confirmation that the backend content is intact. Please investigate.

title: Critical: Duplicate accounts and MFA failures in SSO Integration Module (APAC Production)
description: We are facing a critical identity management issue in our APAC Production environment. The SSO Integration Module is creating duplicate user accounts for existing identities, leading to data fragmentation. Furthermore, users with these duplicate accounts are unable to log in because their MFA codes are being rejected, despite being valid. This affects 12,719 users. The combination of duplicate provisioning and authentication failures is halting business operations. Immediate intervention is required to stop account creation and restore login functionality.

title: Audit logs seem incomplete in Dev
description: Hi, we noticed some gaps in the audit logs for the Analytics Dashboard in our LATAM development environment. Not sure when it started or what exactly is missing, but the logs aren't capturing all the actions we expect. Could you check on this?

title: Config Manager API returning schema errors and empty responses
description: In our LATAM Production environment, calls to the Config Manager API are failing intermittently. We are receiving schema validation errors indicating that the response structure does not match the expected definition, followed by empty response bodies. This affects one specific integration flow. The requests are standard GET calls for configuration parameters. Please verify the API contract and response serialization for these endpoints.

title: Multiple issues in Staging ME
description: We have a few problems in the Analytics Dashboard staging environment in the Middle East. Some users are locked out of their accounts, we're seeing expired certificate warnings, and the audit logs are missing entries. Not sure if these are related or separate issues, but it's affecting about 600 people trying to do testing. Please look into this.

title: SSO Federation Metadata Mismatch in ME Production
description: Our users in the ME Production environment are failing to authenticate. The SSO Integration Module is reporting a federation metadata mismatch error. We are unsure if this is a configuration error on our IdP side or if the Central Identity Vault is serving outdated metadata. The issue is blocking 301 users from accessing services. We need support to determine which component is providing the incorrect metadata and to restore connectivity.

title: Malformed JSON and webhook failures in SSO Dev (US-West)
description: In our Development environment (US-West), the SSO Integration Module is returning malformed JSON responses during user provisioning events. Additionally, webhooks intended to trigger downstream processes are not firing. We cannot determine if the issue originates from the SSO module's output or if the Identity Lifecycle Manager is failing to consume the events correctly. This affects 33 users in the testing cohort and is halting our automation workflows. Please investigate the data flow between these components.

title: Expired certificate warning on Wallet Service in LATAM Production
description: Customers in our LATAM Production environment are receiving security warnings due to an expired certificate on the Wallet Service. This is causing transaction failures and panic among 112 active users who cannot complete payments. The service appears to be rejecting connections due to SSL validation errors. We need the certificate for the Wallet Service updated and redeployed immediately to restore trust and functionality for our end-users.

title: Subscription not renewing in US-East Production
description: One user in our US-East Production environment has reported that their subscription did not renew automatically as expected. We are trying to determine if this is a billing failure within Payment Gateway v2 or if the Usage Metering Service failed to record the necessary activity to trigger the renewal. The impact is currently isolated to one account, but we need to understand the root cause to prevent this from affecting other subscribers. Please check the transaction logs and metering data for this account.

title: Session Controller expiring active sessions randomly
description: We are seeing a massive issue in our production environment (US-East) where user sessions are dropping unexpectedly. This has been happening for about 2 hours and is affecting roughly 487 users who are being forced to log back in repeatedly. The business impact is high as we are losing transactions. Please check the Session Controller configuration or logs immediately as this component seems to be failing to maintain session state.

title: Analytics Dashboard export shows garbled characters and corrupted data
description: When exporting reports from the Analytics Dashboard in the US-East production environment, the resulting CSV file contains garbled characters for non-ASCII text fields. Additionally, the file appears corrupted when opened in Excel, with missing columns in some rows. This issue is reproducible on all recent exports taken in the last hour. No specific users are blocked, but the data is unusable.

title: SSO Integration Module webhooks failing with 429 errors
description: Our development environment SSO Integration Module is not firing webhooks for user provisioning events. When we manually trigger a sync, we receive HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) responses from the module itself. This is preventing us from testing new integration flows for about 40 developers in the team. It seems the rate limiting logic within the SSO Module is broken or misconfigured.

title: Subscription Manager generating incorrect invoices with overcharges
description: The Subscription Manager in our LATAM production environment is generating invoices that do not match the contracted rates. We have identified overcharges on approximately 744 accounts. The invoices reflect higher prices than what is set in the plan configuration. This is causing significant customer disputes and financial reconciliation issues.

title: Analytics Dashboard compliance report missing audit log entries
description: In the EU-West production environment, the Analytics Dashboard's compliance report is incomplete. Specifically, audit log entries from the past 24 hours are missing from the export, although they appear correctly in the raw view. This affects the reporting capabilities for our 6 internal compliance officers. Please investigate why the report generator is omitting these records.

title: Password reset emails not arriving in staging
description: Hi, we are having trouble with password resets in the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment (EU-West). The emails just aren't showing up for our testers. It started recently. Please check why this is happening. Thanks.

title: Rate Limiter feature flag issues and data mismatch

description: We are seeing undercharges on Payment Gateway v2 in EU-Central production. 5 users are affected. description: We are seeing sessions expire unexpectedly in our US-East staging environment when interacting with the Permission Engine. There is no business impact currently as it's just staging, but it's annoying. We think this is definitely caused by an incomplete rollback from last week's deployment. The previous version's session handling seems to be conflicting with the current state. Please check the rollback status.

description: Our SSO Integration Module in the EU-West production region has suffered a full outage. We observed that the automatic failover did not occur as expected, leaving users unable to authenticate. This has impacted approximately 15 users with moderate business impact. description: We are reporting an outage of the KPI Tracker in the ME sandbox environment. Since this is a sandbox environment, there is currently no reported business impact or affected user count, but we need this resolved to continue our testing phase.

title: MFA code rejected in SSO
description: MFA code is not working. Just one user affected in ANZ prod. Low impact. Please fix.

title: Critical Performance Issues: Rate Limits, Memory Leaks, and Autoscaling Failure in Payment Gateway v2 (US-West)
description: We are experiencing a critical outage-level event in our US-West production environment with the Payment Gateway v2. Approximately 6,890 users are affected. We need immediate assistance to stabilize the gateway and investigate why autoscaling is not responding to the defined policies.

title: Certificate Warnings in Token Service (ME Production)
description: We are seeing certificate expired warnings and general certificate warnings in the Token Service in our ME production region. The way our token payloads are structured doesn't align with what the service expects for the certificate validation handshake. Please look into the schema alignment for the certificates.

title: Analytics Dashboard Issues in ANZ Development: Cert Warnings, Priv Escalation, and Audit Gaps
description: We have identified multiple issues with the Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ development environment. First, we are receiving certificate expired warnings. Second, security scans are flagging elevated privileges observed in the dashboard's backend processes. Third, we have noticed that audit log entries are missing for several administrative actions. This is currently impacting 33 users internally with moderate business impact. We need these resolved before we can promote this build to staging.

title: Data Loss and Missing Records in Analytics Dashboard (ME Production)
description: We are seeing missing records in the Analytics Dashboard in our ME production environment. Users are explicitly reporting data loss, which is a high-impact issue affecting 211 users. We think this is definitely due to a rate limit misconfiguration. The API calls fetching the analytics data are being throttled too aggressively, causing batches of records to be dropped or never retrieved. Please adjust the rate limiting thresholds for the data feed endpoints.

title: Double charge on subscription in Payment Gateway v2 dev
description: Subscription charged twice in EU-Central dev env. Moderate impact. Please check.

title: SSO Integration Module Timeouts Linked to Upstream Vendor Incident (EU-Central)
description: We are observing upstream dependency timeouts within our SSO Integration Module in the EU-Central production region. Our internal logs show requests timing out waiting for responses from the external identity provider. We have checked the vendor's status page, and they have posted an active incident regarding their API availability. This is causing a low business impact for us, affecting roughly 4 users. We are opening this ticket to confirm if our retry logic is sufficient or if we need to adjust our timeout configurations to handle these vendor-side hiccups better.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Returning Empty Responses (LATAM Sandbox)
description: In our LATAM sandbox environment, the Payment Gateway v2 is returning empty responses for transaction processing calls. This is also coinciding with empty responses when we attempt to query refund statuses. Because the response is empty, we cannot tell if the gateway itself is failing or if the underlying refund service is the one returning the null data. We need to determine which component is generating the empty payload. This is currently blocking 622 test scenarios.

title: Account Lockouts and Unexpected Session Expiry in SSO (LATAM Staging)
description: We are seeing issues with the SSO Integration Module in our LATAM staging environment. Specifically, user accounts are getting locked out unexpectedly, and valid sessions are expiring sooner than the configured timeout allows. This is affecting 2 users and has low business impact. We need to understand why the session handling and lockout policies are behaving erratically in staging.

title: Federation Metadata Mismatch in SSO (US-East Staging)
description: We are encountering a federation metadata mismatch error in the SSO Integration Module in our US-East staging environment. This is a critical issue blocking our deployment pipeline, affecting 1,319 test users. We believe this is an unsupported configuration problem. It seems like the metadata format we are uploading is not compatible with the current version of the SSO module, or perhaps we are using a configuration flag that isn't actually supported for this region. Please review the metadata validation logic.

title: Login Failures in Billing Engine (APAC Production)
description: We are receiving reports of login failures for users trying to access the Billing Engine in our APAC production environment. Approximately 211 users are affected, resulting in high business impact as they cannot view their invoices. Please investigate why authentication against the Billing Engine is failing.

title: Form issues
description: Hey, the form on our dev site isn't working right. The box just doesn't show up and when we try to send it nothing happens. Lots of users are complaining but I don't have logs. Please check.

title: Chargebacks happening due to DB locking
description: We are seeing a spike in chargeback notices on the production gateway. This is definitely a database contention problem on your side. The system is locking up and causing double processing or errors that lead to disputes. You need to optimize the database locks immediately.

title: Webhooks not triggering for recent transactions
description: Our integration with Payment Gateway v2 in the LATAM production environment has stopped receiving webhook notifications. Transactions are processing successfully on your end, but our server logs show no incoming requests to our configured endpoint. This started happening around 08:00 UTC. We need these events to update our order status.

title: Customers being overcharged
description: We are noticing that about 20 users are being charged more than the displayed price. We think it's because of a policy misconfiguration on your platform. The tax or fee rules must be set up incorrectly. Please fix the pricing policy settings.

description: We are experiencing significant delays in transaction processing through the Payment Gateway v2 API in the US-East region for LATAM traffic. Average response times have increased from 200ms to over 4s during peak hours (6 PM - 9 PM local time). This is causing timeouts for approximately 63 users per hour. No changes were made to our integration.

title: Critical: Payment declines and currency errors in ME Production
description: Our Invoice Service integration is failing for Middle East customers. This is affecting over 7,000 users and stopping revenue. Immediate investigation required.

title: Security alerts and missing audit logs on Dashboard
description: We are reviewing the Analytics Dashboard security posture and have noted three anomalies: 1) Browsers are throwing certificate warnings when accessing the dashboard, 2) Some user accounts appear to have elevated privileges that were not granted by our admins, and 3) Audit logs are missing entries for several configuration changes made last week. Please investigate the integrity of the platform.

title: Overcharges and tax errors due to race condition
description: We have a few cases of customers being overcharged with incorrect tax amounts. This is clearly a race condition in your Chargeback Handler. When multiple requests hit at the same time, the calculation logic is breaking. Please fix the concurrency handling.

title: MFA and Password Reset failures for US-West users
description: Several users in our US-West production environment are unable to log in. They report that the MFA codes sent via SMS are being rejected as invalid, even when entered immediately. Additionally, password reset emails contain links that show an 'expired' error upon clicking. This affects about 6 accounts currently. Please check the delivery and validation logic.

We are also seeing '429 Too Many Requests' errors despite staying within our contracted API limits. It's unclear if the portal application itself is overloaded or if the static assets are being blocked by a CDN issue, as both API calls and asset loads seem affected.

title: Sync stuck
description: The SSO sync in our LATAM dev env is hanging up. Provisioning doesn't finish and users don't get created. We don't have specific error codes. Please help.

description: We are testing the Webhook Engine in the ME sandbox environment. We are receiving 'certificate expired' warnings on outbound webhook attempts, and occasionally seeing DNS lookup failures preventing delivery to our test endpoint. The webhook configuration was verified recently. Please check the SSL certificates and DNS resolution for the sandbox region.

description: The Analytics Dashboard in APAC production is intermittently returning 503 Service Unavailable errors, which eventually leads to a full application crash in the browser. We are not seeing specific error details in our UI, and it's difficult to determine if the core analytics service is down or if the audit log ingestion layer is failing, causing a backlog that impacts the frontend. No specific metrics available.

description: We are encountering an error in the EU-Central production environment with the Permission Engine. Please regenerate or update the federation metadata.

title: Gateway is broken and slow
description: The Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-Central staging environment is responding very slowly. This is a product defect. The code is just bad. It needs to be fixed now because we are blocked.

description: We are seeing issues with data exports from the Analytics Dashboard in our EU-Central staging environment. This is currently affecting 3 users in our QA team. Impact is low as it is staging only, but we need this resolved before we promote these dashboards to production.

description: The Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompt is not appearing when users attempt to log in via the SSO Integration Module in our Middle East production environment. We haven't received any user complaints yet (0 affected users reported), so there is no immediate business impact, but this needs to be investigated as a potential security configuration drift or bug.

The converted amounts for refunds appear to be missing or zeroed out for about 5 users. The business impact is low at this moment, but the data mismatch is causing confusion for customers who have been refunded.

description: We are experiencing a critical issue with the Billing Disputes Handler in our US-West production environment. The tax amounts calculated during dispute resolutions are incorrect. We need immediate assistance to identify why the tax logic is failing for these accounts.

Customer Ops Team
