The issue seems to occur when saving complex configuration sets. We have checked network connectivity from our end and it appears stable. Please investigate if there are timeout settings on the server side or issues with the session handling.

title: Massive Rate Limiting and Empty Responses from Data Pipeline
description: Our Data Pipeline in US-East production is completely degraded. We are receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors, but also getting 200s with empty response bodies, which is breaking our downstream ETL jobs. This is affecting 2624 users and is a critical incident. This is definitely a rate limit misconfiguration on your side. The limits set for our account are too low for our standard volume, causing us to hit throttling unexpectedly. Please increase our quotas immediately.

title: MFA Manager - Password reset emails not arriving causing login issues
description: We have two users in the US-East production environment who are unable to log in. They reported that they triggered a password reset but never received the confirmation email after waiting for over an hour. Because they can't get the link, they are completely locked out of their accounts. This is currently affecting only these specific users, so the impact is low, but we need to know why the emails are being dropped.

title: Analytics Dashboard - Severe timeouts impacting mobile app performance for 600+ users
description: We are experiencing significant degradation in our production Analytics Dashboard in the US-East region. The underlying database queries are timing out, which has caused a cascade effect where our mobile application is running extremely slowly. This is affecting approximately 679 users and is having a high business impact due to the sheer volume of complaints and dropped sessions. Please investigate the query performance immediately.

title: Payment Gateway v2 - Refunds not appearing and currency conversion errors
description: In our EU-West production environment, we have identified issues with the Payment Gateway v2. Specifically, refunds processed recently are not being reflected in the system balance, and when they are, the currency conversion rates appear incorrect. This has affected 9 users so far. The impact is currently low, but we need these discrepancies resolved to ensure accurate accounting.

title: Analytics Dashboard - Service unresponsive in dev env, failover failed
description: Our development environment for the Analytics Dashboard in EU-West is completely down. The health checks are failing, the service is unresponsive, and it looks like the automatic failover did not occur when the primary node went offline. This is a critical issue blocking our entire team of 1451 users. We are certain this is caused by an incorrect DNS configuration on your side, as the resolution paths seem broken. Please fix the DNS records urgently.

title: LDAP Connector - Bulk import failure and duplicate accounts created
description: We attempted a bulk import using the LDAP Connector in the EU-Central production environment, but it failed completely. Worse, before failing, it created several duplicate accounts. This has affected 3 users directly. The impact is low, but we need to clean this up. We strongly believe this is due to incorrect DNS configuration preventing the connector from talking to the directory correctly, so please check your DNS settings.

title: SSO Integration Module - MFA prompt missing leading to account lockouts in Staging
description: In our APAC staging environment, users attempting to access the SSO Integration Module are not seeing the expected MFA prompt. Instead, the authentication flow stops abruptly, causing their accounts to become locked out. This is affecting roughly 36 users and has a moderate business impact as it is blocking QA testing. The issue seems specific to the staging environment configuration.

title: CRITICAL: SSO Integration Module - Elevated privileges observed in Development
description: We have detected a critical security issue in the SSO Integration Module within our ME development environment. It appears that users are observing elevated privileges that they should not have. This affects a large user base of over 10,000 individuals in that environment. Immediate investigation is required to understand how privilege escalation is occurring and to remediate this security risk.

title: Payment Gateway v2 - Duplicate subscription charges affecting hundreds of users
description: Customers in our EU-Central production environment are reporting duplicate charges for their subscriptions via Payment Gateway v2. Approximately 289 users have been charged twice. This is causing a high business impact due to customer frustration and potential support ticket volume. We need to halt this duplication and process refunds or adjustments as soon as possible.

title: Billing Disputes Handler - High latency and intermittent failures
description: We are seeing significant issues with the Billing Disputes Handler in the EU-Central production environment. The system is suffering from high latency, and requests are intermittently failing. This is impacting 267 users and has a high business impact as dispute processing is stalling. Please prioritize a fix for the stability and response times.

title: Analytics Dashboard - Critical slowness and latency for LATAM users
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our LATAM production environment is performing terribly. Users are experiencing slow response times, high latency, and the mobile app performance is degraded. This is affecting over 15,000 users and has a critical business impact. We are convinced this is a data quality issue on your end causing the queries to hang. Please fix the data integrity problems immediately.

title: Payment Gateway v2 - MFA codes rejected and accounts locked
description: Three users in our APAC production environment are unable to authenticate with Payment Gateway v2. They report that their MFA codes are being rejected, which leads to their accounts being locked out. The impact is low given the small number of users, but it is disruptive. We suspect this is due to an expired API key on your side, so please check the credential validity.

title: CRITICAL: Payment Gateway v2 - MFA prompts not appearing in Staging
description: In our US-West staging environment, the MFA prompt is not appearing for users trying to authenticate via Payment Gateway v2. This is breaking the entire authentication flow for 9,572 users, resulting in a critical business impact as we cannot proceed with testing. The expected security challenge is simply absent.

title: Payment Gateway v2 - Subscriptions failing to renew in Production
description: We are seeing a critical issue in the US-West production environment where subscriptions are not being renewed via Payment Gateway v2. This is affecting approximately 1,750 users who believe they have active service but are not being billed or renewed correctly. This has a high risk of churn and revenue loss. Please investigate why the renewal jobs are not completing.

title: Payment Gateway v2 - Duplicate charges, undercharges, and renewal failures in Staging
description: Our US-East staging environment for Payment Gateway v2 is exhibiting erratic billing behavior. We are seeing subscriptions charged twice, some users reporting duplicate charges, and others being undercharged. This affects a massive user base of nearly 6,400 and has a critical impact on our test data integrity. We need to stabilize the billing logic in staging before we can release.

title: Payment Gateway v2 - Subscription renewals failing and chargebacks received
description: In the ANZ staging environment, we have noticed that subscriptions are not renewing properly. Additionally, we have started receiving chargeback notices for these transactions. This is affecting 56 users and has a moderate business impact. We need to understand why the renewal process is failing and triggering disputes.

title: Slow performance on Event Tracker mobile app
description: We've been noticing that the Event Tracker mobile app has become really slow recently. Everything takes forever to load or respond. This is definitely a version incompatibility issue with our latest app update, so please check compatibility logs.

title: Rate limit exceeded causing SSO failures
description: Our SSO Integration Module is throwing rate limit errors constantly. Over 20k users are affected and it's a critical blocker. We think it's because of a version incompatibility between your service and our IdP configuration. Please investigate the version mismatch immediately.

title: SSO Integration Module failing intermittently
description: We are seeing intermittent failures and high latency when using the SSO Integration Module in our dev environment. This is impacting our CI/CD pipeline for about 3600 users. Please look into why the SSO module is unstable.

title: Analytics Dashboard data retention and audit issues
description: In the EU-West production environment, the Analytics Dashboard is not applying retention policies correctly. We also see missing entries in audit logs and data residency flag mismatches. This is definitely a data migration defect from the last update. Please fix the migration scripts.

title: Data loss and corrupted exports in Admin Console
description: Users in the US-East development environment are reporting data loss when using the Admin Console. Specifically, export functions are producing corrupted files. Approximately 21 users are affected. This is a moderate impact issue requiring investigation into the export mechanism.

title: Incorrect proration and undercharging in Payment Gateway v2
description: In the US-West sandbox, Payment Gateway v2 is calculating proration incorrectly, resulting in undercharges. This has a high business impact and affects 291 users. Please review the billing logic for proration calculations.

title: SSO sync issues: duplicate accounts and stuck imports
description: We are experiencing problems with the SSO Integration Module in production (US-East). Some bulk imports partially failed, causing the sync to get stuck. Additionally, duplicate accounts are being created. This affects one user currently but needs resolution to prevent broader issues.

title: MFA prompt not appearing causing login failures
description: Users in the LATAM region are unable to log in via the SSO Integration Module because the MFA prompt is not appearing. This is a high-impact issue affecting 461 users in production. Please investigate why the MFA challenge is being skipped.

title: SSO duplicate accounts in sandbox
description: Sandbox is acting weird. Getting duplicate accounts and sometimes account not found errors. SSO module seems broken. Lots of users affected. Fix please.

title: SSO error page and MFA rejection
description: Getting SSO error page and MFA code is rejected. Can't log in. EU-West prod. One user. Urgent.

title: API schema errors and 429s in Analytics Dashboard
description: The Analytics Dashboard in US-East production is returning HTTP 429 errors and API schema mismatches. This is affecting 20 users with moderate impact. Please investigate the rate limiting and schema validation on the dashboard API endpoints.

title: API Gateway deployment failed after upgrade
description: Upgraded API Gateway in LATAM and now deployment is failing. Migration script error. Breaking changes everywhere. 800+ users impacted. High priority.

title: Config Manager settings not applying in staging
description: In the EU-West staging environment, changes made in the Config Manager are not taking effect. Feature flags are also not applying correctly. There are no users affected at the moment, but this blocks our testing. Please investigate the configuration propagation.

title: Webhooks failing with malformed JSON in Analytics Dashboard
description: The Analytics Dashboard in EU-West production is failing to fire webhooks correctly. The responses are coming back as malformed JSON. This is a moderate impact issue affecting 10 users. Please check the webhook payload structure.

title: Account locked out in Payment Gateway
description: Payment Gateway v2 staging ME region. Accounts locked out. 137 users. High impact. Fix.

title: Double billing and invoice mismatch in dev
description: We are seeing an issue where a subscription is being charged twice and the resulting invoice has incorrect amounts. This is definitely just an operator error on our end, someone probably clicked the button twice or entered the wrong value. Please fix the invoice data so we can proceed with testing.

title: SSO login loop and MFA rejection
description: Two of our admins are stuck in a redirect loop when trying to log in via SSO, and when the MFA prompt appears, the code is rejected. We think this is due to a configuration error on our side, maybe the trust settings are wrong. Can you help us verify the config?

title: Rate Limiter service completely unresponsive in Staging
description: The Rate Limiter service in our US-West staging environment has stopped responding to all requests. This is blocking our QA team as approximately 28,000 users are simulated against this endpoint during load tests. The service times out immediately with no response body. We need this resolved urgently as it is critical for our current release cycle.

title: Critical overcharging issue in Chargeback Handler (Dev)
description: We are experiencing severe overcharging anomalies in the Chargeback Handler within our Middle East development environment. Approximately 15,933 test transactions are being processed with incorrect higher amounts. This is a critical blocker for our compliance testing and financial reconciliation simulations. Please investigate the calculation logic immediately.

title: Connectivity failures: 504, TLS, and DNS errors in Config Manager
description: Our Config Manager in EU-Central production is returning HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors. Additionally, we are observing TLS handshake failures and intermittent DNS lookup failures for the service endpoint. This is affecting 139 users who are unable to sync configurations. The errors seem to correlate with network timeouts.

title: SSO Integration Module not triggering MFA and locking accounts
description: The SSO Integration Module is failing to present the MFA prompt to users during login attempts. As a result, 138 users are getting locked out of their accounts after failed authentication attempts. This is happening in the staging environment and is preventing us from testing the new security flows. The module seems to be skipping the second factor entirely.

title: Webhooks not firing for SSO Integration Module
description: We have noticed that webhooks are not being sent out when specific SSO events occur in production. This affects 2 users currently. We think this is an unsupported configuration issue on our side, perhaps we aren't using the right event types. Please check if our webhook setup is valid.

title: Analytics Dashboard latency and intermittent failures
description: Users in EU-Central production are reporting high latency when loading the Analytics Dashboard, with about 16 users experiencing intermittent page load failures. The dashboard often spins for over 30 seconds before timing out or displaying incomplete data. This is impacting our ability to review real-time metrics.

title: Chat Widget issues after recent release
description: Since the latest release, the Chat Widget in our US-West sandbox environment is missing a key feature, forms fail to submit, and some UI elements are misaligned. This is affecting 81 test users and blocking our validation of the new chat interface. The missing feature was present in the previous version.

title: Invoice Service returning malformed JSON and 429s
description: Our integration with the Invoice Service in ANZ production is failing due to malformed JSON responses in the payload and frequent HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors. This is disrupting billing operations for 59 users. The JSON errors occur intermittently, making it hard to parse the invoice data correctly.

title: Payment Gateway issues
description: Hi, we are having problems with the Payment Gateway v2 in APAC. Seems like webhooks aren't working right and we are getting errors. It's affecting some transactions. Please help.

title: Critical intermittent failures in Analytics Dashboard (Dev)
description: We are observing intermittent failures in the Analytics Dashboard within our US-West development environment. This is impacting 1,197 users during our internal beta testing phase. The dashboard loads correctly about 70% of the time but fails or displays empty states in the remaining instances. This is critical as we are approaching a milestone release.

title: Secret Store pods restarting and service unresponsive
description: The Secret Store service in our EU-Central development environment is experiencing repeated pod restarts, leading to an unresponsive service and a reported full outage for our dev team. We think this is caused by an idempotency or duplicate processing failure in the service logic. Please investigate the duplicate handling mechanism.

title: Role Manager: Account lockouts and MFA rejections
description: 16 users in our LATAM production environment are reporting that their accounts are locked out and MFA codes are being rejected when attempting to log in via the Role Manager. This prevents them from accessing their required roles and permissions. The issue started recently and persists across multiple attempts.

title: Refund Manager connectivity errors: TLS, DNS, and 502s
description: The Refund Manager in our LATAM development environment is throwing HTTP 502 Bad Gateway errors, accompanied by TLS handshake failures and DNS lookup issues. This is affecting 730 users and is a high-priority blocker for our refund processing tests. The network errors seem to be preventing any communication with the service.

title: MFA codes rejected and password reset links expiring for EU users
description: We are seeing issues with the SSO Integration Module in our production EU-Central environment. Approximately 46 users are reporting that when they try to reset their passwords, the link expires immediately before they can use it. Additionally, legitimate MFA codes are being rejected. Please investigate.

title: User provisioning stalled and duplicate accounts created (High Impact)
description: In our production ME environment, the SSO Integration Module's provisioning process has stopped working. It is currently stuck, and worse, it has created duplicate accounts for some users. This is affecting 413 people and blocking our onboarding process. We need urgent assistance.

title: Incorrect proration calculations affecting thousands of US-West customers
description: We have a critical issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in production (US-West). The proration logic is calculating incorrect amounts for subscription upgrades and downgrades. This is impacting approximately 2,407 users and causing billing disputes. Immediate fix required.

title: Funnel Analyzer timeouts due to third-party API outage
description: Our Funnel Analyzer in the LATAM production region is timing out. We suspect this is related to a known incident on the vendor's status page regarding their API being unavailable. This affects about 23 users and is causing moderate delays in data visibility. Please confirm if we need to do anything on our end or wait for the vendor to resolve.

title: Billing issues with invoices and proration
description: Hi, our invoices are wrong and the proration is messed up. It's happening in EU-Central on the Payment Gateway v2. Not sure how many people it affects but it's bad. Please fix.

title: Certificate warnings appearing in Session Controller
description: We are receiving certificate warning messages, specifically regarding an expired certificate, in our US-West production environment using the Session Controller. No users are currently blocked, but we want to address this proactively to avoid future issues. Please advise on the renewal process.

title: SSO errors and metadata mismatch in ANZ production
description: Users in our ANZ region are hitting SSO error pages. The logs show a federation metadata mismatch. We've checked everything and this is definitely a policy misconfiguration on your side. Please correct the policy settings immediately as this is high impact for 228 users.

title: Webhook failures and API schema errors in APAC
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in APAC production is having issues. Webhooks are not firing, we get API schema errors, and HTTP 429 responses. This is clearly a schema mismatch problem with the data payload format. Please update the expected schema to fix this.

title: API schema errors affecting EU-West dashboard
description: We are encountering API schema errors in the production environment for the Analytics Dashboard in EU-West. This is impacting about 41 users with moderate business impact. The errors seem to occur when specific data structures are passed. Please investigate the schema validation logic.

title: Staging environment billing anomalies: double charges and non-renewals
description: In our EU-West staging environment for the Payment Gateway v2, we are seeing inconsistencies. Some test subscriptions are being charged twice (overcharge), while others are not renewing when they should. No production users are affected, but we need these behaviors clarified for QA purposes.

title: Malformed JSON responses from SSO module in APAC
description: We are receiving malformed JSON responses from the SSO Integration Module in our APAC production environment. This affects a small number of users (9). We think this is due to insufficient capacity planning on the server side causing data truncation. Please scale up the resources.

title: Slow mobile app performance and response times (High Impact)
description: Users of our mobile app connected to the Analytics Dashboard in APAC production are experiencing significant slowness and delayed responses. This is affecting 733 users and has a high business impact. The dashboard is failing to load data efficiently. Please optimize the backend response times.

title: Bulk import failure and sync delays in SSO Sandbox
description: In our US-West sandbox environment, bulk imports for the SSO Integration Module have fully failed. We are also seeing synchronization delays. This is blocking our testing for 184 users. Please check the import service status.

title: Audit log gaps in Payment Gateway Sandbox
description: We noticed a gap in the audit logs for the Payment Gateway v2 in our ANZ sandbox environment. Events are missing. While this is not affecting production users, we need accurate logs for compliance testing. Please investigate the logging pipeline.

title: High latency and intermittent failures in US-East Dashboard
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our US-East production region is suffering from high latency and intermittent failures. This affects 83 users and is causing moderate disruption to reporting capabilities. Please investigate the stability of the service.

title: Incorrect billing amounts on recent invoices for Middle East enterprise accounts
description: We have noticed that invoices generated for the last billing cycle in our ME region are significantly undercharged compared to the agreed-upon contract rates. This affects approximately 757 users across multiple enterprise tenants. The line items for data storage and API usage are showing lower totals than expected based on our actual consumption logs. We need these invoices corrected urgently to prevent revenue leakage and ensure accurate client billing.

title: SSO login issues
description: Some users in APAC are getting into the system when they shouldn't be, or not getting in when they should. Not sure which groups exactly. Please fix.

title: Total outage of SSO Integration Module in staging
description: Our staging environment in LATAM is completely inaccessible. The SSO Integration Module is failing to authenticate any requests, resulting in a full outage for the 119 users on our test team. We attempted to trigger the failover mechanism to switch to the secondary authentication path, but the failover did not occur as expected. The module appears to be hung or returning timeouts, preventing any deployment or testing activities. This is blocking our release schedule.

title: Refunds not showing up
description: We processed a bunch of refunds in the sandbox but they aren't reflecting on the customer side. Numbers look wrong.

title: Provisioning process stuck for Feedback Collector accounts
description: In the LATAM production environment, the provisioning workflow for the Feedback Collector is hanging. New tenant accounts remain in a 'pending' state and never transition to 'active.' We have identified 19 affected users who cannot access the system. The provisioning logs do not show any explicit errors, but the state machine appears to have stalled after the initial configuration step. We need these accounts unblocked so the users can begin providing feedback.

title: Billing Engine ignoring retention policies and missing audit logs
description: We are observing critical failures in the Billing Engine within our staging environment. Specifically, the data retention policies are not being applied, causing old transaction records to persist beyond their configured lifespan. Additionally, the audit log is missing entries for these deletion attempts, making it impossible to track compliance. This affects the ability of our 299 staging users to validate compliance scenarios, creating a high risk for our upcoming production rollout. Please investigate why the retention engine is not executing.

title: SSO Authentication failures due to upstream dependency outage
description: We are experiencing intermittent authentication failures in the SSO Integration Module in the EU-Central sandbox. Upon investigation, we found that the underlying identity provider (upstream dependency) is currently reporting an incident on their status page. Our logs show connection timeouts and 503 errors originating from the vendor's endpoint. This affects a single test user account. We are monitoring the vendor's status page and will confirm when their service is restored. We believe this is an external issue but wanted to log it for tracking purposes.

title: UI alignment issue in Mobile App settings screen
description: In the staging environment for the EU-West region, the 'Notifications' toggle switch in the Mobile App settings screen is misaligned. It overlaps slightly with the description text below it on devices with smaller screen resolutions (specifically tested on iPhone SE and Android equivalents). This is a cosmetic issue and does not impact functionality, but it looks unprofessional. Please adjust the CSS or layout constraints to ensure proper spacing.

title: Analytics Dashboard slow to load due to database connection pool exhaustion
description: Users in the APAC production region are reporting significant delays when accessing the Analytics Dashboard. The application logs indicate that the database connection pool is exhausted, leading to timeout errors for new requests. This impacts approximately 105 active users during peak hours. We suspect the dashboard queries are holding connections too long or there is a leak. Immediate attention is required to stabilize the dashboard availability.

title: Unexpected chargeback notices received via Payment Gateway
description: We are receiving a high volume of chargeback notices (approx. 1905 cases) for transactions in the APAC development environment. The payment processing flow seems to be triggering disputes incorrectly. It is unclear if this is an issue with the Payment Gateway v2 logic itself or if the authentication token passed during the transaction is being mishandled by the SSO Broker, causing the processor to reject the legitimacy of the charge. We need to determine if the fault lies in the payment calculation/service or the identity verification step preceding it.

title: Configuration changes not applying in Payment Gateway staging
description: In the US-West staging environment, changes made to the Payment Gateway v2 configuration are not taking effect. Specifically, we added a required environment variable for the new fraud detection API key, but the service continues to behave as if the variable is missing. The logs show 'Variable not found' errors, confirming the configuration isn't being picked up. This affects the testing of new payment flows for our 15 internal users. Please check if the deployment pipeline is correctly injecting the environment variables.

title: Duplicate charges and incorrect invoices for US-West users
description: Two users in the US-West production region reported being charged twice for the same subscription. Upon checking their invoices, we see duplicate line items and incorrect total amounts. We are unsure if the Payment Gateway v2 is processing the transaction twice or if the Global API Gateway is retrying the request due to a timeout, resulting in a duplicate charge on the billing side. We need clarification on whether the duplication happened at the payment execution layer or the API request routing layer.

title: Attribution Engine config drift causing data visualization errors
description: Our development team in EU-Central has detected configuration drift in the Attribution Engine. As a result, the data being pushed to the visualization layer is incorrect, causing charts to display null values or wrong aggregations. We cannot determine if the Attribution Engine is failing to calculate metrics correctly due to the drift, or if the Visualization Renderer is failing to parse the correct data due to a schema mismatch caused by the drift. The issue affects 144 users trying to view campaign reports. We need to isolate whether the calculation logic or the rendering logic is at fault.

title: Rate limit exceeded errors in Payment Gateway production
description: We are seeing sporadic '429 Too Many Requests' errors from the Payment Gateway v2 in the US-West production environment. This is affecting about 6 specific integration partners who are bursting traffic. The rate limits appear to be set correctly, but the gateway is throttling them more aggressively than the contract states. This is causing payment failures for those partners. We need to verify if the rate limiting rules have been updated incorrectly or if there is a bug in how the counters are reset.

title: Webhooks failing and API errors in LATAM prod
description: Payment webhooks aren't firing for a lot of users in LATAM. Also getting schema errors on the API. Critical impact.

title: Undercharges on Payment Gateway v2 resulting in chargebacks (US-West)
description: We are seeing a significant number of chargebacks in the US-West region for transactions processed through Payment Gateway v2. Upon investigation, it appears that the amounts being charged to customers are lower than the total order value, leading to underpayments. This is currently affecting approximately 46 users. We need to understand why the gateway is calculating the final charge amount incorrectly, as this discrepancy is causing financial loss and dispute fees. The issue was first noticed yesterday morning and is still ongoing in production.

title: Event Tracker displays blank screen for LATAM users
description: A few users in the LATAM region are reporting that when they try to access the Event Tracker, the page loads but displays a completely blank white screen. No error messages are visible, and the page seems to stall indefinitely. This is happening in the production environment and affects about 4 users so far. We have verified that their network connections are stable and they are using supported browsers. Please check if there are any known issues with the tracker UI rendering in this region.

title: Subscriptions not renewing in EU-West
description: Hi, we have a problem with Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West region. It seems like subscriptions are not renewing automatically anymore. A lot of customers are complaining. Can you look into this ASAP? It's urgent.

title: Severe latency and slow responses on Cohort Builder (US-East)
description: Users in the US-East region are experiencing extremely high latency when using the Cohort Builder tool. Simple actions like filtering or saving a cohort are taking upwards of 30-40 seconds to complete, whereas they previously took under 2 seconds. This slowdown is impacting roughly 571 users and is severely hampering our data analysis workflow. The issue is present in the production environment. We haven't changed any configurations recently. Please investigate performance bottlenecks related to the builder service.

title: Missing consent records in Analytics Dashboard reports (EU-Central)
description: We are noticing that several compliance reports generated via the Analytics Dashboard in the EU-Central region are missing consent records for certain user segments. When we query the raw data separately, the consent flags seem to be present, but they are not reflecting correctly in the dashboard aggregations. This creates a discrepancy between what the dashboard shows and what our backend databases contain. We are concerned about potential compliance risks due to these gaps in reporting. It's unclear if this is an issue with how the dashboard retrieves the data or a problem with the underlying query engine itself, as both the UI presentation and the data retrieval logic seem suspect. This affects around 848 users who rely on these reports.

title: Missing notification records reported by user (US-East)
description: A single user in the US-East region has reported that they did not receive expected push notifications via Notification Hub. Upon checking the logs, we see that the notification events are indeed missing from the hub's record database for this specific user ID. The user claims they have enabled all notifications and have a stable connection. We need to verify if this is an isolated incident of data loss or a broader sync issue. Please investigate why the records were not stored or why they are not visible to the user.

title: Onboarding Wizard failing due to database connection pool exhaustion (APAC)
description: We are encountering errors in the Onboarding Wizard within the APAC production environment. Specifically, users are hitting failures during the data submission step, and backend logs indicate that the database connection pool is being exhausted. This is currently affecting about 7 users who are unable to complete their onboarding process. The issue seems to occur when multiple users are onboarding simultaneously, suggesting that the wizard is not releasing connections properly or the pool size is insufficient for the current load. Please advise on configuration adjustments or code fixes to resolve the connection leaks.

title: HTTP 429 errors and webhooks not firing in Payment Gateway v2 (EU-Central Dev)
description: In our development environment (EU-Central), we are consistently receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors when making API calls to Payment Gateway v2. Additionally, the configured webhooks are not firing at all during these test transactions. This is blocking our integration testing as we cannot verify the end-to-end payment flow. Approximately 8 developers are affected. We need clarification on the rate limits for the dev environment and whether there is a configuration issue preventing webhook delivery.

title: Audit log inconsistencies and data residency flags mismatch in Cohort Builder (US-East Staging)
description: We are seeing critical issues in the US-East staging environment related to the Cohort Builder. Specifically, the audit logs are missing entries for recent cohort creation and modification actions. Furthermore, there is a mismatch in the data residency flags; cohorts that should be marked as US-Resident are appearing with global or EU-Resident flags. This is impacting a large number of test users (13k+) and raises serious concerns about data governance and auditability. We are unsure if the missing audit entries are a result of the logging service failing to write, or if the data itself is being corrupted/misflagged during the historical data backfill process. The correlation between the missing logs and the wrong residency flags suggests that either the logging pipeline or the data migration/backfill worker is behaving unexpectedly, but we cannot pinpoint which one is the root cause. Please investigate both the logging mechanism and the data processing pipeline.

title: SSO Bulk Import failed with 'Account Not Found' errors (APAC Staging)
description: In the APAC staging environment, our attempt to perform a bulk import of users into the SSO Integration Module has failed completely. The import process aborted with 'Account Not Found' errors for every user in the batch. This is preventing us from testing new identity provider configurations. Approximately 493 users were intended to be imported. We need to understand why the SSO module is unable to locate these accounts during the import process, as the accounts exist in our directory. Please check the integration logs for any mapping errors.

title: Invoice Service generating undercharges/incorrect invoices (EU-West)
description: We have observed that the Invoice Service in the EU-West production environment is generating invoices with incorrect amounts, specifically undercharging our customers. This affects a small subset of users (approx. 6). The line items appear correct, but the final total calculation is lower than expected. We need to know if there is a bug in the tax calculation or discount application logic within the invoice generation process. Please investigate why the final totals do not match the sum of the line items.

title: SSO Login loop/failure in EU-Central Staging
description: Testers in the EU-Central staging environment are experiencing a login loop when trying to authenticate via the SSO Integration Module. After entering credentials, the page redirects back to the login screen without authenticating, or returns a generic failure message. No users are currently impacted in production, but this is blocking our pre-release testing. Please check the SSO configuration and certificate validity for the staging environment.

title: Incomplete compliance reports in Analytics Dashboard (LATAM)
description: Users in the LATAM region are reporting that the compliance reports generated by the Analytics Dashboard are incomplete. Data for certain date ranges is missing, resulting in inaccurate totals. While no active business processes are currently halted, this poses a risk for upcoming audits. Please investigate the data aggregation logic for the LATAM region to ensure all historical records are included in the reports.

title: Notification Hub features not working in ANZ Staging
description: We are having issues with the Notification Hub in the ANZ staging environment. Some features are just not applying, and it seems like some environment variables are missing. It's affecting a bunch of users. Please fix.

The accounts are inaccessible, and we cannot reset them via the standard self-service portal. We need to know why these accounts were locked and how to unlock them.

title: SSO Development environment redirect loops and expired reset links
description: We are encountering issues in our APAC development environment with the SSO Integration Module. Users are getting stuck in SSO redirect loops when trying to log in. Additionally, password reset links are expiring prematurely, preventing users from regaining access. This affects 27 developers and testers. Please investigate the authentication flow and token expiration settings.

title: Payment Gateway v2 charging twice and incorrect tax in ME production
description: We are seeing critical billing errors in the Payment Gateway v2 for our ME production environment. Subscriptions are being charged twice, and the tax amounts applied are incorrect. 168 users have reported duplicate charges. This seems to be a logic error within the gateway's billing calculation engine. Please fix the duplicate charge issue and the tax calculation discrepancy.

title: SSO ANZ production provisioning stuck and accounts not found
description: There is a high-impact issue in the ANZ production environment with the SSO Integration Module. Provisioning for new users is getting stuck, and many users are reporting that their accounts cannot be found. This is affecting 742 users who are unable to access their applications. We need to resolve the provisioning failures and account visibility issues immediately.

title: Payment Gateway v2 EU-West production timeouts and malformed JSON
description: We are experiencing critical failures in the Payment Gateway v2 production environment for EU-West. The API is returning timeout errors and malformed JSON responses. This is affecting 4,178 users and disrupting transactions. Please investigate the gateway's response handling and network stability.

title: Rate Limiter causing app crashes and outage in LATAM
description: Our application in the LATAM production environment is crashing and we are seeing a full outage report. This seems to be triggered by the Rate Limiter. We are convinced this is a capacity limitation issue where the limiter is rejecting valid traffic because it thinks we are out of resources. Please increase the capacity limits.

title: Duplicate accounts created in Chargeback Handler - definitely an expired API key issue
description: We've noticed that the Chargeback Handler is creating duplicate account entries in production (EU-West). About 3 users have been affected so far. The impact is low for now, but it's annoying. This is definitely a problem with an expired API key on our end. We think it's because the key expired and the system just keeps retrying the creation request without checking for duplicates properly. Can you please help us clean up the duplicates? We will probably just replace the key on our side but need the data fixed.

title: High Priority: Mobile App missing localizations and features - blaming Identity Provider outage
description: Our Mobile App in the ANZ region is showing broken text where localization should be, and several features are completely missing from the interface after the recent release. This is affecting 170 users and has a high business impact. We are convinced this is caused by the Identity Provider outage we saw yesterday. We think it's because the identity provider was down that the app couldn't fetch the proper config files and localization strings, leading to this broken state. Please check this ASAP as the user experience is severely degraded.

title: MFA Manager sandbox environment timing out on upstream dependencies
description:
Hello,

We are encountering consistent timeouts in our MFA Manager sandbox environment (US-East) when it tries to communicate with upstream services. Specifically, we are seeing 'upstream dependency timeout' errors. This is impacting 42 users who are currently unable to complete their MFA flows in the test environment. The issue seems to be isolated to the sandbox. Could you please investigate why the upstream dependencies are timing out? We need this resolved to proceed with our upcoming release testing.

Thank you.

title: SSO Module Dev Environment: MFA Prompt Missing and Redirect Loop
description: In our development environment (US-East), the SSO Integration Module is behaving incorrectly. Users are reporting that the MFA prompt is not appearing at all, and subsequently, they get stuck in an SSO redirect loop when trying to log in. This affects 33 developers and QA testers on our team. The behavior is consistent and blocking our development workflow. Please advise on how to resolve the missing MFA prompt and the redirect loop issue.

title: Mobile App Sandbox (US-West): Form Submission Failures, Localization Errors, and UI Misalignment
description: We are observing multiple issues in the Mobile App sandbox environment in the US-West region. First, form submissions are failing silently without any error message returned to the user. Second, the localized text is incorrect, displaying placeholder or wrong language strings. Third, several UI elements are misaligned, causing a poor visual experience. This combination of issues is impacting 56 users in the sandbox and hindering our ability to test the new release. Please investigate these three distinct problems.

title: KPI Tracker Sandbox (ANZ): UI Element Not Rendering and Missing Features Post-Release
description: After the recent release to the KPI Tracker sandbox in the ANZ region, we noticed that a specific UI element is not rendering on the dashboard. Additionally, some previously available features are now missing entirely from the interface. This is affecting 31 users who rely on these metrics for their daily analysis. The missing features and rendering issues are preventing us from validating the release. Could you please check why the UI elements and features are not appearing as expected?

title: Onboarding Wizard text looks wrong
description: Hi, we are seeing some text in the Onboarding Wizard that looks incorrect. It's in production for the APAC region. Not sure when it started. A few people mentioned it. Please check.

title: Critical: SSO Integration Module Bulk Import Failures and Stuck Sync/Provisioning in ANZ Production
description: We are experiencing a critical issue with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment (ANZ). A recent bulk import partially failed, and as a result, the user sync and provisioning processes are currently stuck. This is impacting 179 users who cannot access necessary resources. The business impact is high as these users are blocked from their workflows. We need immediate assistance to unblock the sync and resolve the provisioning backlog. Please let us know the steps to recover from this state.

title: Permission Engine Production (APAC): MFA Code Rejected, Missing Prompt, and Unexpected Session Expiry
description: In our production environment for the Permission Engine (APAC), two users are experiencing issues with authentication. Specifically, they are seeing their MFA codes rejected by the system, the MFA prompt is not appearing when expected, and their sessions are expiring unexpectedly. This is a low-impact issue affecting only 2 users at the moment, but it is confusing for them. We would like to understand why the MFA flow is breaking and why sessions are dropping prematurely. Please investigate these symptoms.

title: SSO Module ANZ Production: Audit Logs Missing & Cert Warning - Caused by Credential Rotation
description: We are seeing a high-impact issue in our ANZ production environment with the SSO Integration Module. 638 users are affected. We noticed that audit log entries are missing for recent activities, and we are also getting a 'certificate expired' warning. We are certain this is due to the credential rotation not propagating correctly across the environment. We think it's because the new credentials weren't synced properly that the system is throwing cert warnings and failing to log audit trails. Please confirm if this is the case and help us fix the propagation.

title: Payment Gateway v2 (US-West Production): Undercharging Customers and Subscription Renewal Failures
description: We have identified a significant issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in our US-West production environment. 176 users are being affected. We are observing that customers are being undercharged for their transactions. Furthermore, subscription renewals are not being processed correctly, leading to service interruptions for these users. This has a high business impact due to revenue loss and customer dissatisfaction. Please investigate why the charging amounts are incorrect and why renewals are failing.

title: Secret Store Staging (ANZ): Database Timeouts, Deadlocks, and Index Corruption
description: Our Secret Store staging environment in the ANZ region is experiencing severe database issues. We are seeing frequent database query timeouts, deadlocks detected in the database logs, and indications of index corruption. This is impacting 33 users who are unable to access or update secrets in the staging environment. The moderate business impact is due to the blocking of development and testing workflows. Please advise on how to resolve the database stability issues and repair the corrupted indexes.

title: Analytics Dashboard (US-West Production): Webhooks Not Firing, HTTP 429 Errors, and API Schema Issues
description: In our production Analytics Dashboard (US-West), we are encountering several technical issues. Webhooks are not firing as expected, resulting in missed data triggers. We are also receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors, indicating rate limiting issues. Additionally, there are API schema errors when trying to query data. While there are currently no reported affected users or business impact, these issues need to be addressed to ensure system reliability. Please investigate the root cause of the webhook failures, rate limiting, and schema errors.

title: SSO Integration Module (EU-Central Production): Session Expiry, MFA Rejection, and Missing Prompts
description: We are seeing authentication issues in our production SSO Integration Module for the EU-Central region. A small number of users (4) are experiencing unexpected session expirations. When they try to re-authenticate, the MFA prompt is not appearing, and if it does, the MFA code is rejected. This is a low-impact issue but is confusing for the affected users. Please help us troubleshoot why the MFA flow is failing and why sessions are dropping unexpectedly.

title: Analytics Dashboard Dev (APAC): Duplicate Records Caused by Clock Sync Issues
description: In our development environment for the Analytics Dashboard (APAC), we are seeing duplicate records appearing in the reports. This is affecting 15 users and has a moderate business impact due to inaccurate data representation. We are confident that this is caused by a clock/time synchronization issue between our servers. We think it's because the time drift is causing the system to process the same events multiple times, leading to duplicates. Please verify if the server clocks are out of sync and help us resolve the time configuration.

title: Subscription failed to renew and refund not showing in account
description: I noticed that my subscription was not automatically renewed this billing cycle, even though the payment method on file is valid. Additionally, I requested a refund for the previous period last week, but the credit has not appeared on my statement or in the customer portal yet. This seems to be affecting only my account currently, and the business impact is minimal, but I need these resolved before the next billing attempt.

title: Staging SSO login failures: Error page and missing MFA prompts
description: We are experiencing persistent login failures in our staging environment (EU-West) using the SSO Integration Module. Approximately 57 users are affected. When attempting to log in, users are either presented with a generic SSO error page or are redirected without the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompt appearing, which halts the authentication flow. This is blocking our QA team from proceeding with release testing, so the impact is moderate.

title: Critical latency and timeouts in Metrics Engine (Dev)
description: Our development environment for the Metrics Engine in EU-Central is suffering from severe performance degradation. We are seeing extremely high latency on all data ingestion endpoints, leading to frequent timeouts and slow response times for queries. This issue is critical as it is currently blocking development and testing for nearly 8,600 users. Immediate investigation into the responsiveness of the engine is required.

title: Analytics Dashboard timeouts in Sandbox (ME)
description: Users in our Middle East sandbox environment are reporting that the Analytics Dashboard frequently times out when attempting to load reports or dashboards. This is affecting around 211 users and has a high impact on our ability to validate new analytics features. The issue appears consistent when accessing larger datasets.

title: MFA prompt not appearing during staging transactions
description: In our APAC staging environment, we are observing that the MFA prompt is not appearing for certain transaction flows. Users are proceeding without the expected secondary authentication step. We are unsure if this is a configuration issue within the Payment Gateway itself or related to the tax/geo-location checks that trigger the MFA requirement. 10 users are affected, and this poses a moderate risk to our compliance testing.

title: Certificate warnings and missing audit logs in AD Sync
description: We are seeing intermittent certificate warnings when connecting to the Active Directory Sync service in production (US-West). Concurrently, we have noticed that several expected entries are missing from the audit log for user provisioning events. This does not seem to impact user experience directly (0 affected users, no business impact), but we need to investigate for security compliance and audit integrity.

title: High volume of account lockouts via SSO in APAC Production
description: There is a sudden spike in account lockouts for users attempting to log in via the SSO Integration Module in the APAC production region. Approximately 283 users are currently locked out and unable to access their accounts. This is having a high business impact on our regional teams who are blocked from starting their workday. Please investigate the lockout thresholds and SSO authentication logic.

title: Database query timeouts in Refund Manager (Dev)
description: The Refund Manager in our ANZ development environment is experiencing database query timeouts. This prevents us from processing test refunds and simulating refund workflows. The issue affects the entire dev team (441 users) and has a high impact on our development velocity. We need assistance optimizing the queries or checking the database connectivity within this environment.

title: Mobile app provisioning stuck and sync delays in Staging
description: We are encountering critical issues with the Mobile App in our APAC staging environment. Device provisioning processes are getting stuck indefinitely, and data synchronization between the app and the backend is experiencing severe delays. This affects 1,072 test devices and completely blocks our mobile release pipeline. We suspect an issue with the provisioning service logic or data handling within the app itself.

title: HTTP 500 errors and malformed JSON in Payment Gateway (LATAM)
description: Our production payment processing in the LATAM region is returning HTTP 500 errors for approximately 35 users. In some instances, the response body contains malformed JSON, which causes our client-side parsing to fail. This is resulting in failed transactions and a moderate business impact. We need logs to determine why the gateway is returning invalid responses.

title: Missing consent records in Payment Gateway (APAC Staging)
description: During testing in the APAC staging environment, we found that consent records for certain user agreements are missing from the database after a payment transaction is processed. This affects 22 test cases and has a moderate impact on our compliance verification process. The consent flag should be recorded alongside the transaction but is currently absent.

title: Unexpected chargeback notices in APAC Production
description: We are receiving chargeback notices for transactions that appear to have been successful and completed without dispute. This is happening in the APAC production environment and affects 37 customers. The business impact is moderate, but we need to understand why these charges are being contested or if there is an issue with how the transaction status is being communicated to the banks.

title: Admin Console down with DNS failures and 502 errors
description: The Admin Console in our ANZ staging environment is inaccessible. Users are reporting DNS lookup failures followed by HTTP 502 Bad Gateway errors. This affects 18 users and has a moderate impact on administrative tasks. We believe the issue lies within the Admin Console's routing or service discovery, as the DNS resolution seems to be failing entirely for the console URL.

title: Webhook retries exhausted in Load Balancer (Dev)
description: In our EU-Central development environment, we are observing that webhook deliveries are failing, and the retry count is being exhausted without success. This is logged by the Load Balancer component. There are no affected users or business impact at this time, but we want to ensure this is not a precursor to a configuration issue in higher environments.

title: Event Tracker 503s and pod restarts in Dev
description: The Event Tracker service in our APAC development environment is returning 503 Service Unavailable errors. We have also noticed a partial outage status reported for the service, with underlying pods restarting repeatedly. This is affecting 3 users (dev team) and has low business impact, but the instability is hindering our ability to test event ingestion.

title: Payment Gateway v2 currency conversion errors in LATAM production
description: We are seeing incorrect currency conversions on our Payment Gateway v2 integration. Transactions in the LATAM region are being processed with the wrong exchange rates, resulting in significant discrepancies for our customers. This is affecting about 600 users currently and causing high business impact. Please investigate why the gateway is not applying the correct conversion logic.

title: Slow response in Payment Gateway v2 (APAC)
description: Our Payment Gateway v2 is experiencing severe latency and slow response times in the APAC region. This is critical as it affects nearly 9000 users. We think it's because of operator error; someone on our side must have messed up the configuration or inputted the wrong parameters. Please check this first.

title: Webhook engine issues in staging
description: The Webhook Engine in our US-East staging environment is timing out database queries and responding very slowly. Not sure exactly when it started happening. Need help.

title: SSO Integration Module provisioning stuck and bulk import partial fail
description: We are having issues with the SSO Integration Module in our ANZ staging environment. Some users from a bulk import are stuck in a provisioning loop, and others are showing up correctly, but their login experience seems broken or inconsistent. It's unclear if the issue is with the SSO module itself or how it interacts with other authentication components, as some users seem to have trouble logging in generally. Moderate impact on about 30 users.

title: Report Builder timeouts in production
description: The Report Builder tool in US-East production is timing out on database queries. Only affecting a couple of users so far, but it's annoying. Please look into why reports are failing to generate.

title: Event Tracker high latency and slow response in LATAM dev
description: We are noticing that the Event Tracker in our LATAM development environment is running very slowly with high latency. However, when we check the associated reports, the data also seems delayed or missing. It's hard to tell if the tracker itself is the bottleneck or if the reporting service is failing to ingest the events promptly. This is impacting our team's workflow moderately.

title: Deploy Manager failures in ANZ production
description: Deploy Manager is failing in our ANZ production environment. We are seeing deployment failures, migration script errors, and what looks like breaking changes after the latest upgrade. High impact on over 900 users. Please check ASAP.

title: Wallet Service tax calculation errors in ME production
description: Our Wallet Service in the Middle East production region is calculating incorrect tax amounts for transactions. This is a critical issue affecting approximately 2,880 users. The tax values are consistently off, leading to financial discrepancies. We need immediate investigation into the tax logic implementation within the Wallet Service.

title: Role Manager HTTP 403 errors and wrong data display
description: We are experiencing HTTP 403 Forbidden errors and incorrect data visibility for users in the Role Manager module in our ME staging environment. About 204 users are affected. We believe there is a bug within the Role Manager itself preventing proper permission checks. Please prioritize this fix as it blocks our testing.

title: Payment Gateway v2 login loop and SSO error page (APAC)
description: Users in APAC are stuck in a login loop and seeing SSO error pages when trying to access services via Payment Gateway v2. This is affecting over 300 users with high business impact. We are sure this is due to a data migration defect; the recent data move must have corrupted the authentication records. Please check the migration logs.

title: Cache Service config drift and data mismatch in LATAM
description: The Cache Service in our LATAM production environment is showing configuration drift and data mismatches. New configurations are not taking effect. We think it's because of a bad deployment; our last push likely broke the cache configuration sync. Please revert or fix the deployment artifacts.

title: Event Tracker duplicate records and missing data in US-West
description: Our Event Tracker in the US-West production region is creating duplicate records and also missing some data points entirely. This is causing significant issues for our analytics, affecting around 317 users. We need the Event Tracker team to investigate why the ingestion process is failing in this way.

title: Overcharges occurring in Payment Gateway v2 dev
description: We are seeing overcharges in the Payment Gateway v2 development environment in US-East. This is critical and affects a large number of test transactions. Please check why the gateway is charging more than the expected amount.

title: Chargeback Handler: Missing audit logs and certificate warnings in LATAM
description: In our LATAM production environment, the Chargeback Handler is displaying certificate expired warnings and also seems to be missing entries in the audit log for recent chargebacks. There is currently no direct business impact on users, but we need to ensure compliance and stability. Please investigate the certificate status and logging mechanism.

title: Analytics Dashboard high latency and slow mobile performance in EU-Central staging
description: We are observing high latency on the Analytics Dashboard in our EU-Central staging environment. This is also correlating with slow performance on the mobile app when it queries these analytics data points. While there is no business impact yet, this blocks our performance testing. We need to understand if the dashboard itself is slow or if the mobile integration is the bottleneck.

title: SSO Provisioning sync stuck in staging affecting large user base
description: We are experiencing critical delays in the SSO Integration Module within our EU-Central staging environment. The user synchronization process appears to be completely stuck; it has not progressed for several hours. This is impacting provisioning for approximately 18,689 users, preventing us from validating new identity flows. Please investigate why the sync is hanging as this is blocking our release testing.

title: Analytics Dashboard unresponsive in APAC staging due to DB timeouts

We are observing significant CPU usage spikes on the hosting infrastructure, which coincides with frequent database query timeouts. When users attempt to load reports, the dashboard hangs or fails to render data. This issue is affecting around 10,929 test users and is critical for our upcoming performance benchmarks.

title: Inconsistent charge amounts and declines in LATAM production
description: We have noticed irregularities in the Chargeback Handler for our LATAM production region. Specifically, we are seeing instances of both undercharging and overcharging customers, alongside unexpected payment declines. While we have not identified any affected users in our immediate scope yet, the inconsistency in transaction processing needs to be reviewed to ensure financial accuracy.

We have detected a mismatch in the data residency flags, which contradicts our compliance settings. Additionally, there appears to be a gap in the audit logs for recent transactions. This impacts a small subset of roughly 5 users but requires attention for regulatory reasons.

title: Status page issues
description: Hey, the Status Page in dev is broken. It's just showing a blank screen and search doesn't work right. Some UI elements are missing too. Lots of people can't see anything. Please fix ASAP.

title: Certificate warnings blocking session creation in APAC production
description: Users in our APAC production environment are encountering certificate warnings when interacting with the Session Controller. This is preventing successful session establishment for approximately 52 users. The browser displays security errors, causing users to abandon the flow. We need to validate the certificate chain configuration as this is moderating impact on our active user base.

This combination of errors is blocking about 520 users from managing their accounts. We need immediate assistance to restore basic functionality to the hub.

title: Data Export Service MFA issues caused by bad data
description: We are facing a critical outage with the Data Export Service in APAC. Users are getting locked out, MFA prompts are not appearing, and codes are being rejected. We have analyzed this on our end and this is definitely a data quality issue. Our internal records suggest the user data feeding into the export service is corrupted, which is breaking the authentication flow. Please verify and correct the data quality.

title: API schema error in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are encountering an API schema error when using the Payment Gateway v2 in our US-East production environment. The error occurs during specific transaction types. Currently, this has affected 1 user, but the error message indicates a structural mismatch in the API response. Please review the schema validation as this could impact wider payment processing if not addressed.

description: Our API Gateway in the EU-West production region is failing to perform failover during high-traffic events. Instead of routing to a backup, the service returns HTTP 503 errors. This has resulted in downtime for approximately 259 users. The lack of automatic failover is critical as it exposes our primary instance to single points of failure. Please investigate the health check and failover configuration.

title: Mobile App unresponsive due to pod restarts
description: Users of our Mobile App in the EU-West region are experiencing service unresponsiveness. We noticed that the underlying pods are restarting repeatedly, causing the app to hang or crash. We think this is insufficient information to determine root cause on your side, so we are providing all logs. Please investigate the pod lifecycle and memory limits.

title: Duplicate records appearing in Analytics Dashboard for ME region
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our Middle East production environment is displaying duplicate records for key metrics. This issue is affecting approximately 4,108 users and is critical for our reporting accuracy. We are unsure if the duplication originates from the dashboard's aggregation logic or if it is reflecting incorrect data entry from upstream systems like the audit logs. Please help us identify the source of these duplicates.

title: Critical: Data residency and retention failures in Fee Analyzer (US-West)

Specifically, we have observed that consent records are missing from the logs, there is a mismatch in the data residency flags, and the configured retention policies are not being applied as expected. This is blocking our compliance audits and requires immediate attention.

title: High impact: Memory usage spike in Payment Gateway v2 (ANZ)
description: Our monitoring tools have detected a significant spike in memory usage for the Payment Gateway v2 service in the ANZ production region. This issue is currently impacting 582 users and is causing performance degradation. We need assistance in identifying the source of the memory increase and stabilizing the service.

title: Analytics Dashboard showing 'Out of Disk Space' in EU-West

We have investigated and this is definitely a breaking API contract change causing the data accumulation that filled the disk. Please review the recent API updates as this is the root cause.

title: Mobile App: White screen on launch for LATAM users
description: A small group of users (4) in the LATAM region are reporting that the Mobile App shows a white screen of death upon launch. The rest of the user base is unaffected, but we want to ensure this is isolated and documented. Please let us know if further logs are required.

title: Dev environment: Token Service returning HTTP 401 on login
