Although there are currently no reported affected users or business impact, we want to flag these potential billing errors for review.

title: Dashboard settings not working
description: Hi, we're trying to enable a new feature for our team but it doesn't seem to be applying. The config looks right but nothing changes on the dashboard. Only a few people are affected. Can you check?

title: URGENT: 1000+ users overcharged due to policy config error
description: We have a critical issue in our dev environment affecting over 1000 users. Subscriptions aren't renewing and some are getting double billed. We think this is definitely a policy misconfiguration on our side or yours that's causing the billing logic to fail. Please fix the policy rules immediately.

title: Analytics API returning empty results and hitting rate limits
description: Our production Analytics Dashboard in EU-Central is broken. The API calls are returning empty responses instead of data, and we are consistently hitting rate limits even though our usage hasn't changed. This is impacting 382 users and high-priority reporting. Please investigate why the dashboard component is failing to fetch data.

title: SSO Provisioning jobs stuck in production for 27 users
description: Hello, we are experiencing an issue with the SSO Integration Module in our production LATAM environment. User provisioning processes have been stuck and not completing for the last 2 hours. Approximately 27 users are currently unable to access the system due to this delay. Please advise on how to clear the stuck jobs.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Duplicate charges and declines in ANZ production
description: We are seeing inconsistent behavior with the Payment Gateway v2 in our ANZ production environment. Some payments are being declined when they should succeed, while others are resulting in the customer's card being charged twice for a single subscription renewal. This is also causing overcharges on affected accounts. Please investigate the transaction flow.

title: Fee Analyzer showing duplicate subscription charges
description: Our internal team is reporting that the Fee Analyzer tool is displaying duplicate charges for user subscriptions. We have identified 56 unique instances where the same subscription appears to be charged twice in the analyzer view. This is causing moderate disruption to our reconciliation process. Please check if the Fee Analyzer is correctly deduplicating transaction data.

title: CRITICAL: Full outage of Cache Service in EU-West
description: We are reporting a critical full outage of the Cache Service in our EU-West production environment. The service is completely unresponsive, and all dependent applications have failed. This impacts over 11,000 active users. Please escalate immediately and provide an ETA for restoration.

title: Analytics Dashboard exports are corrupted and truncated
description: When attempting to export data from the Analytics Dashboard in EU-Central production, the resulting files are often corrupted or truncated. The download completes but the file cannot be opened or is missing the last few rows of data. This is affecting a small number of internal reports. Please investigate the export functionality.

title: Refunds not reflecting and double charges in Payment Gateway sandbox
description: In our EU-Central sandbox environment for Payment Gateway v2, we are encountering issues with refund processing. Refunds are not being reflected in the user's balance, and there are instances where subscriptions are being charged twice, leading to overcharges. This is affecting our testing for 49 users. Please check the sandbox billing logic.

title: Single user experiencing unexpected session expiration and SSO errors
description: One of our users in the ANZ production region is reporting that their SSO session expires unexpectedly frequently. When this happens, they are redirected to an error page instead of being logged out gracefully. This is currently isolated to one user account. Please investigate the SSO Integration Module behavior for this user.

title: MFA Password reset links expiring prematurely in staging
description: We are seeing a high impact issue in our APAC staging environment with the MFA Manager. Password reset links are expiring before users can click them, effectively locking out 117 test users. The links seem to become invalid almost immediately upon generation. Please check the token expiry settings for the MFA Manager.

title: CRITICAL: Mass payment declines and duplicate charges in US-West
description: We are facing a critical outage in the Payment Gateway v2 production environment in US-West. Thousands of users (approx. 22,898) are experiencing payment declines for valid transactions, and those that do go through are sometimes being charged twice for subscriptions. This is causing severe financial and reputational damage. Immediate intervention is required.

title: Help Center UI misalignment and incorrect localized text
description: Our Help Center in the ANZ production region is displaying UI elements misaligned, causing overlapping text. Additionally, several localized strings are incorrect or displaying in the wrong language. This is affecting the user experience for 16 customers who have reported the visual glitches. Please review the frontend rendering for the Help Center.

title: Staging dashboard loading issues
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ staging environment is failing to load properly. We are getting connection errors and it seems like the database is struggling. A lot of users are affected. Please look into why it's so slow and crashing.

title: CRITICAL: Webhook Engine unresponsive and connection resets
description: The Webhook Engine in our APAC production environment is completely unresponsive. We are receiving constant connection reset errors when trying to dispatch events. This is causing a critical backlog of transactions affecting over 16,000 users. Please investigate the service availability and error logs immediately.

title: Help Center search issues in US-West (Production)
description: We are experiencing two distinct issues with the Help Center in the production environment (US-West region). First, the search functionality is returning incorrect results for common queries; users are seeing articles that do not match their keywords. Second, several UI elements are missing localization text, appearing as blank spaces or raw keys instead of translated strings. This is currently affecting about 3 users who have reported it to us directly. Impact is low, but it is confusing for those users.

title: Analytics Dashboard failing due to backup and index errors
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in EU-Central (Production) is behaving erratically. We noticed that a recent backup job failed to complete successfully. Shortly after, the dashboard started throwing errors related to index corruption. We believe the dashboard component itself is at fault for these data integrity issues. Approximately 54 users are unable to view their reports correctly. This is causing moderate business impact as reporting deadlines are approaching.

title: Critical: Config Manager API timeouts and empty responses in Dev
description: We are facing a critical issue with the Config Manager in the Development environment (EU-Central). When making API calls to fetch configuration details, the requests consistently time out or return an empty response body (200 OK but no JSON). This is blocking our deployment pipeline for over 3,500 developers. We need immediate investigation into why the API is failing to return data.

title: API Gateway outage in ANZ - suspected credential rotation issue
description: We are reporting a full outage of the API Gateway in the ANZ production region. The pods are restarting repeatedly and the service is unavailable. We are confident this is definitely caused by the recent credential rotation not propagating correctly to the gateway nodes. This has been a recurring theme with updates, so we need you to check the propagation logic immediately. Currently only 1 user (our admin) can confirm the total blockage, but the impact on business metrics is rated low by our internal standards, though the technical severity is high.

title: Wallet Service payment errors and overcharges
description: We are seeing multiple payment issues in the Wallet Service in EU-Central production. Customers are reporting overcharges, followed by payment declines, and subsequently receiving chargeback notices. Interestingly, our monitoring shows 0 affected users and no immediate business impact, likely because the volume is low or self-correcting, but the symptoms are clear. We need to ensure the Wallet Service is handling transaction states correctly to prevent these financial discrepancies.

title: Webhooks not firing in Payment Gateway v2 (Dev, ME)
description: In the Development environment for the Middle East region, webhooks configured for the Payment Gateway v2 are not firing. We expect notifications for successful transactions, but the endpoint receives nothing. This is affecting about 25 internal testers and is causing a moderate delay in our integration testing. Please check if the webhook dispatcher is functioning correctly in this region/environment.

title: Tax Calculator causing double subscriptions
description: Users in EU-West production are being charged twice for their subscriptions. We suspect this issue originates in the Tax Calculator component, as the tax calculation steps seem to trigger a retry or duplicate billing logic. This is affecting 52 users and causing a moderate business impact due to the need for refunds and support tickets. We believe the Tax Calculator itself is malfunctioning and causing the duplicate charges.

title: Access Denied and Certificate Warnings on Analytics Dashboard
description: A high-impact issue is occurring with the Analytics Dashboard in EU-Central production. Users are receiving 'Access Denied' errors and seeing browser certificate warnings. Additionally, we have observed elevated privileges being granted unexpectedly to some sessions. This affects 783 users. The combination of security warnings and access failures suggests a serious configuration or authentication issue within the dashboard service that needs urgent attention.

title: Payment Gateway v2 undercharging and declines in APAC
description: We are observing inconsistent payment processing in the APAC production region using Payment Gateway v2. Some transactions are being undercharged (less than the total amount due), while others are being declined incorrectly. This affects approximately 54 users and is causing moderate business impact. We need to understand why the gateway is calculating totals incorrectly and rejecting valid payments.

title: SSO Integration Module displaying wrong user data
description: After logging in via the SSO Integration Module in US-West production, users are seeing data that does not belong to them. This is a high-impact privacy and functional issue affecting 924 users. The SSO handshake appears to complete successfully, but the subsequent application view is populated with incorrect user context. We need to investigate how the SSO module passes user identity to the application.

title: Slow Analytics Dashboard due to database timeouts
description: The Analytics Dashboard in EU-West production is experiencing significant performance degradation. Users are reporting slow response times, and we have identified database query timeouts as the primary symptom. This is impacting 193 users with high business priority. We need assistance in optimizing the queries or identifying why the database is timing out on standard dashboard loads.

title: Analytics Dashboard returning 500 errors and empty responses
description: We are encountering critical failures with the Analytics Dashboard in EU-West production. The API returns HTTP 500 errors or completely empty responses to user requests. This is affecting 4,420 users. It is unclear if the issue lies within the dashboard's own API layer or if it is related to data availability or logging issues that might be contributing to the instability. The system is effectively unusable for most users right now.

title: Data residency flag mismatch in Payment Gateway v2 (Staging, LATAM)
description: In the LATAM staging environment, we are detecting a mismatch in the data residency flags within the Payment Gateway v2. Transactions are being processed with incorrect residency metadata, which is a critical compliance issue. This affects 14,060 test scenarios/users in the staging environment. We need to ensure the gateway correctly identifies and applies the right data residency rules for the LATAM region before promoting to production.

title: Token Service errors: Certificate expired, audit gaps, and privilege issues
description: We are seeing a cluster of issues with the Token Service in US-East staging. Users are receiving 'certificate expired' warnings, audit logs are missing expected entries, and we have observed elevated privileges being granted without clear justification. This affects 50 users and is causing moderate impact. It is difficult to determine if the root cause is the token generation service itself or the policy enforcement mechanisms that govern these actions, as both symptoms are present.

title: SSO Module bulk import failures and duplicate accounts
description: Our SSO Integration Module in ANZ staging is failing during bulk user imports. The sync process gets stuck, and we are seeing duplicate accounts created for the same users. This is a high-impact issue affecting 211 users in the test group. We need to resolve the synchronization logic to prevent data duplication and ensure imports complete successfully.

title: Payment Gateway logs/retention issues
description: Hi, something seems off with the payment gateway in our dev environment. The retention policy isn't working and there are gaps in the audit logs. Not sure when it started happening but it's affecting a bunch of us. Please check.

1. Users are being redirected to a generic SSO error page when attempting to log in.
2. Those who get past the initial login are having their MFA codes rejected as invalid.
3. Additionally, several users reported that password reset links they generated expired immediately or within seconds.

This is affecting approximately 71 users and is causing moderate disruption to our workflow. We have verified that the LDAP directory itself is healthy.

title: Undercharging on invoices via Payment Gateway v2
description:
We are seeing incorrect invoice amounts where customers are being undercharged. This is happening in our US-West production environment and is affecting about 380 users.

We've looked into it and we think it's definitely a customer configuration error on our end, maybe a missing tax rule or discount setting that got wiped out during the last update? Please let us know how to fix our config.

description: URGENT: Our API Gateway in the ANZ production region is down. We are seeing widespread HTTP 502 errors, 'connection refused' messages, and warnings about an expired certificate. This is a critical issue affecting nearly 20,000 users. We need immediate assistance restoring connectivity.

2. The localized text for the 'Submit' button is displaying the wrong language code instead of the translated string in the Japanese locale.

Could you please investigate these behaviors?

title: Tax Calculator overcharges and renewal failures

title: SSO Module issues in EU-Central Staging
description: Hi, we're seeing problems with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-Central staging environment. Users are reporting that their MFA codes are being rejected during login. Additionally, several test accounts have been locked out. title: Session Controller sync delays and stuck provisioning

title: Critical underbilling via Subscription Manager
description: URGENT: We are detecting a critical issue with the Subscription Manager in our US-East production environment. A large number of customers (approx. 14,538) are being undercharged. This is a significant revenue leak and requires immediate investigation to identify why the billing amounts are incorrect.

title: Data mismatch in Analytics Dashboard

title: Secret Store 503 errors and failover failure
description:

title: Payment Gateway declines and currency issues
description: Hello, we are seeing payment declines with the Payment Gateway v2 in ANZ production. Some transactions also have incorrect tax amounts and wrong currency conversions. It's affecting about 59 users. We need help figuring out why this is happening.

title: Duplicate accounts via SSO Module

title: API Gateway cert warnings and privilege issues

title: Duplicate subscription charges and chargebacks in Staging (EU-West)
description: We are seeing a consistent issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-West staging environment. Approximately 42 test users are being charged twice for a single subscription renewal. Memory usage has spiked significantly, but the autoscaling policies are not triggering to add more instances. This has led to service latency and errors for 25,977 users. Immediate investigation into the resource scaling configuration is required.

title: Missing entries in Payment Gateway v2 Audit Logs
description: Our compliance team has flagged that the audit logs for Payment Gateway v2 in the US-East production environment are missing entries for specific transactions. Approximately 1,080 users' activities are not being recorded, which is a critical security and compliance issue. We need to determine why the logging mechanism is failing to capture all events.

title: Deploy Manager reporting outages in EU-West Prod
description: The Deploy Manager dashboard in our EU-West production environment is currently reporting a mix of full and partial outages across various services. However, we have not received any direct complaints from users, and our internal monitoring shows services are up. We suspect a false positive or display issue within the Deploy Manager itself.

title: Login failures with Payment Gateway v2 in ME
description: Users in the ME production environment are reporting login failures when attempting to access Payment Gateway v2. No specific error codes are provided, and the issue seems sporadic. We have 0 reported affected users currently but want to log this to track the pattern.

title: Help Center pods restarting repeatedly in APAC Sandbox
description: In our APAC sandbox environment, the Help Center service is unstable. The underlying pods are restarting repeatedly, causing intermittent availability for the 16 users testing the feature. The restarts happen every few minutes without any clear trigger in the application logs.

title: High latency and slow response times on staging Data Pipeline impacting mobile app
description: We are experiencing significant performance degradation on our staging environment for the Data Pipeline service. The mobile app is extremely slow to respond, with many requests timing out. This is currently affecting about 110 users and is severely impacting our ability to test the new release. We need someone to look at the pipeline performance immediately.

title: Missing localization text in Funnel Analyzer dashboard (Dev)
description: Our development team is noticing that the localization text is completely missing from the Funnel Analyzer dashboard. We are seeing blank fields where the translated labels should be. This is a critical blocker for our ME launch as the dashboard is unreadable for local stakeholders. There are approximately 11,290 users in the dev cohort affected by this issue.

title: Double subscription charges and missing refunds in Payment Gateway v2 sandbox
description: We are encountering an issue in the sandbox environment where subscriptions are being charged twice for a single billing cycle. Additionally, when we attempt to process a refund for the duplicate charge, the refund amount is not reflected in the transaction history. The issue is intermittent but happening frequently enough to disrupt our testing. Approximately 50 users are affected.

title: Accounts locked out following SSO login attempts
description: A number of users are reporting that their accounts are getting locked out immediately after attempting to log in. The standard SSO login flow seems to fail, and the lockout occurs on the second attempt. It is unclear if the authentication request is failing or if the lockout policy is being triggered incorrectly by the login sequence itself. This affects about 30 users on production EU-West.

title: SSO Integration Module completely unresponsive (Production)
description: Our SSO Integration Module on the APAC production environment has stopped responding completely. Users are unable to authenticate, and the service is throwing timeouts. This is a critical outage affecting over 16,000 users. We require immediate assistance to restore authentication services.

title: Payment declines occurring for valid users
description: We are seeing a high volume of payment declines in production for users with valid payment methods. Some users report being logged out unexpectedly just before the payment fails, while others can authenticate but the payment itself is rejected. It is unclear whether the decline is happening at the payment authorization stage or if there is an issue with how the user session is being handled during the transaction. Approximately 8,681 users are affected.

title: User sync is stuck in SSO Integration Module
description: We noticed that the user sync process in the SSO Integration Module is stuck. No new users are being added or removed, and the status just hangs indefinitely. It is unclear if the sync job itself is failing or if there is a bottleneck in the session handling that is preventing the updates from committing. This is affecting a very small number of users (3).

title: Config Manager intermittent failures and failover issues
description: We are experiencing intermittent failures when trying to push updates using the Config Manager in the staging environment. More concerning is that the failover mechanism did not trigger during the most recent outage window, leaving our services down. We need to understand why the Config Manager is behaving unpredictably.

title: MFA prompt not appearing on login
description: Several users in the APAC production environment are reporting that they are not seeing the MFA prompt during the login flow. They are able to authenticate but the second factor step is bypassed entirely. This is affecting about 16 users.

title: Webhook Engine triggering database deadlocks
description: We are seeing frequent database deadlock errors originating from the Webhook Engine. These errors are causing transaction failures and impacting our integration partners. The deadlocks seem to happen during high-volume events. Currently affecting about 34 users/partners.

title: Incomplete compliance reports and missing audit logs in Analytics Dashboard
description: Our compliance team has flagged that the monthly reports generated from the Analytics Dashboard are missing data. Upon investigation, we found significant gaps in the audit logs which appear to be the source of the report inaccuracies. This is a critical issue for our regulatory requirements and affects 752 users who rely on these reports.

title: Login failures and rejected MFA codes
description: We are seeing a spike in login failures in the LATAM region. Users report that even after entering the correct MFA code, it is rejected, forcing them to retry and often locking them out. It is unclear if the authentication service is rejecting the token or if there is an issue with the user lifecycle management that is causing the codes to be invalid or out of sync. This affects approximately 54 users.

title: Subscriptions being charged twice in staging
description: We have identified an issue in our staging environment where subscription billing is occurring twice for the same period. This is happening with the Payment Gateway v2. We need this fixed before we move to production. Affects about 5 users.

title: Login issues in ME
description: Hi, some of our users are complaining that they cant get in. They say the code is wrong or they get locked out. Not sure how many people or when this started. Can you check? Thanks.

title: UI rendering issues and incorrect localization text
description: We are seeing two problems on the mobile app. Some UI elements are not rendering correctly, and the localized text is appearing in the wrong language or with incorrect values. It is hard to tell if this is a display bug on the client side or if the data being fetched for the UI is incorrect due to a metrics or configuration pipeline issue. Affects a small number of users.

title: Cache Service returning HTTP 504 and connection refused errors in Development
description: We are seeing persistent failures with the Cache Service in our development environment. Approximately 21 users on the dev team are unable to connect. The errors are primarily 'connection refused' followed by 'HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout' when attempting to write data. This is blocking our local testing pipeline.

title: SSO showing wrong data

title: Currency Converter billing issues: double charges and chargebacks

title: Config Manager connection issues

title: Payment gateway undercharging

description: We are seeing garbled characters and missing records when viewing the Analytics Dashboard in US-West production. Articles that should have been archived or deleted based on their age are still visible and active. This issue is occurring in our production environment in the US-West region. Symptoms include database connection pool exhaustion, backup job failures, and database query timeouts. It is difficult to determine if the root cause lies within the Report Builder tool itself or the underlying Reporting Service infrastructure it relies on.

title: KPI Tracker displaying wrong totals and blank screens
description: The KPI Tracker in the LATAM sandbox is showing incorrect totals and blank screens for 1111 users. This is a critical issue for our data validation. We believe this is definitely caused by an incomplete rollback of a recent update to the tracking logic. Please check if the previous version was fully restored.

title: MFA and Session Issues in Payment Gateway Dev
description: In the ME development environment, users of the Payment Gateway v2 are reporting that MFA codes are being rejected. This often leads to accounts being locked out or sessions expiring unexpectedly. Approximately 33 users are affected. We need assistance troubleshooting why the MFA verification is failing and causing these account locks.

title: Webhooks from Analytics Dashboard not firing in Production (LATAM)
description: We are experiencing an issue where webhooks configured on the Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM production environment are not triggering. This started around 09:00 UTC yesterday. The dashboard data updates correctly, but the downstream systems rely on the webhook notification to pull the latest stats, so about 67 users are currently seeing stale data in their internal reports. We have verified that the endpoint URLs are correct and accessible, and other services are reaching them fine. Please investigate why the event emission is failing.

title: Rate Limit Errors and Empty API Responses in EU-Central Staging
description: Our integration team is reporting frequent 'rate limit exceeded' errors when calling the Analytics Dashboard API in the EU-Central staging environment. Additionally, when the request does succeed, we are often receiving an HTTP 200 status but with an empty response body, which causes our parser to fail. This is blocking our QA testing for the upcoming release. Approximately 35 internal testers are affected. We haven't changed our request frequency recently, so this seems to be a server-side constraint or configuration change. Please advise on the current limits or if this is a known bug in staging.

title: Users stuck in login loop via SSO in APAC Production
description: We are seeing a persistent login loop issue with the SSO Integration Module in the APAC production environment. Users attempt to log in, are redirected to the identity provider, authenticate successfully, but then get bounced back to the login screen without being signed in. This happens for all users attempting to access the platform. We have cleared cache and cookies on client side, and tried different browsers, but the loop persists. No business impact reported yet as it's a test batch, but it needs fixing before wider rollout.

title: SSO Login Failures and Redirect Loops in US-West Sandbox
description: In the US-West sandbox environment, the SSO Integration Module is failing to authenticate users properly. We are observing two distinct behaviors: some users get a generic 'login failure' error after entering credentials, while others enter an infinite redirect loop between the app and the IdP. This is affecting our development team's ability to test new features, with roughly 58 users currently blocked. We have checked the assertion consumer service URL and it looks correct. Can you help us diagnose whether this is a token parsing issue or a configuration mismatch?

title: Missing UI Elements and Features in Mobile App (APAC Prod)
description: After the latest release deployment to the APAC production mobile app, several key UI elements are not rendering, and specific features that were working previously are now missing entirely. For example, the 'Settings' tab is blank, and the 'Sync' button is absent from the main dashboard. We are unsure if this is a build packaging issue where the assets didn't make it into the binary, or if the state management layer is failing to hydrate the UI components correctly. No users have reported errors, just silent failures in the interface. We need help determining if the app bundle is corrupted or if there is a runtime logic error.

title: SSO Outage due to Third-Party IdP Unavailability (US-West Prod)
description: We are currently experiencing a complete SSO outage in the US-West production environment. Our users cannot log in because the SSO Integration Module is returning upstream dependency errors. We checked the status page of our Identity Provider (IdP) and they have an active incident reported for the last 2 hours. Our support team is flooded with tickets (approx 500 affected users). We need confirmation that this is indeed an external vendor issue and guidance on any potential workarounds or fallback authentication methods we can enable temporarily.

title: Funnel Analyzer Data Missing in Sandbox - Likely Third-Party Issue
description: We noticed that the Funnel Analyzer in the US-West sandbox is showing missing data for several key conversion steps. We think it's because of a third-party service failure on our end. We have been seeing timeouts from our external analytics collector recently, so we assume that's the root cause. Please verify if your system received the events or if the issue is actually within the Funnel Analyzer ingestion pipeline. We need to know if we should fix our external connector or if this is a bug in your sandbox.

title: Duplicate Subscription Charges on Tax Calculator Subscribers (EU-Central Dev)
description: We are detecting that the Tax Calculator module is triggering duplicate subscription charges in the EU-Central development environment. This is a high-priority issue because it is affecting our billing logic testing. Approximately 652 test accounts have been charged twice for the same service period. The overcharges are appearing in our internal ledger, but the actual payment gateway logs show only one successful transaction per user, which suggests the Tax Calculator service itself might be sending multiple 'activate subscription' signals or the billing hook is being called twice. Please investigate the event trigger logic.

title: Critical Security Alert: Account Lockouts and Elevated Privileges in SSO Dev (US-East)
description: We have identified a severe anomaly in the US-East development environment related to the SSO Integration Module. Two issues are occurring simultaneously: 1) A large number of user accounts (178) are being unexpectedly locked out after successful authentication. 2) Several low-privilege test accounts are showing elevated administrative privileges in the session tokens. This indicates a potential security flaw in how roles are mapped during the login process or a race condition in the session manager. We have paused all testing and need immediate assistance to understand the scope and fix the privilege escalation vector.

title: Subscription Charged Twice in Staging Payment Gateway (EU-West)
description: Our QA team in the EU-West staging environment is reporting that subscriptions are being charged twice. This affects about 25 test users. The payment gateway v2 processes the initial charge correctly, but a second identical charge is generated shortly after, sometimes with a slight delay. We are checking if this is due to retry logic on timeouts, but the logs show the first transaction was successful. We need to ensure this behavior is not present in production. Please check the webhook handling for 'payment.success' events.

title: Feedback Collector Broken After Release: Missing Features and Form Errors (APAC Prod)
description: Following the recent release, the Feedback Collector module in the APAC production environment is malfunctioning. Users report that the 'Submit' button does not work (form fails to send), and several UI elements like the star rating widget are not rendering. Additionally, the 'Comment' field is completely missing from the form. This is blocking user feedback collection for 288 active users. We suspect the new release introduced a JavaScript error that breaks the form submission logic and prevents certain components from loading. Please advise on a fix or rollback.

This is causing our pipeline to hang, affecting 475 users who are waiting for reports. We need to know if the timeout threshold is too low for our dataset size or if the webhook delivery system is dropping messages during high load. Please check the logs for export job IDs starting with 'EXP-2023'.

title: Incorrect Currency Conversion and Overcharges in Payment Gateway v2 (ME Prod)
description: We are seeing incorrect currency conversions leading to overcharges for customers in the Middle East production environment. For example, transactions in SAR are being converted at the USD rate. No actual customer complaints yet, but the financial data is skewed. We need you to confirm if the region-specific currency tables are up to date or if we need to change our config.

title: Payment Gateway: HTTP 429 Errors and Timeouts in Production
description: We are seeing a moderate increase in failed transactions in the EU-West production environment for Payment Gateway v2. Please check if there is a throttle limit being applied incorrectly or if the gateway is experiencing performance degradation.

description: We have identified two issues in the Help Center production environment (EU-West) affecting our compliance reporting. First, audit logs are missing entries for specific ticket updates made by agents over the last 24 hours. Second, our data residency scanner is flagging a mismatch, indicating that some user data may have been processed or stored outside the designated EU region. We need to understand why the logging is failing and whether the residency flag is a false positive or an actual breach of our data governance policies.

We are seeing server instances running out of memory, and we suspect there is a memory leak in the gateway application code itself. This is impacting 599 users with slow response times and failures. We need the engineering team to investigate the gateway's resource usage and fix the scaling configuration or code leak.

title: Token Service: Missing audit logs
description: We are having trouble with the Token Service in our EU-West production environment. We noticed that several token generation and validation events are not appearing in the audit logs. This affects about 18 users' ability to be tracked for compliance purposes. Please look into why the Token Service is not writing these log entries.

They are seeing browser certificate warnings when accessing the dashboard, and subsequently, the system is displaying 'elevated privileges observed' errors in the UI, preventing them from viewing their reports. We need to resolve the certificate issue and clarify why the user's permissions are being interpreted incorrectly.

title: Webhooks failing with schema errors - looks like an operator mistake
description: We are seeing API schema errors and our webhook retries are exhausting. Please check if we can undo this quickly as it's affecting our production data syncs in the APAC region.

title: Billing disputes tool acting up
description: The billing disputes handler in the US-West production environment is having issues. We are getting blocked or rate limited when trying to process some disputes for two users. It's a minor issue but annoying. Please take a look.

title: Subscriptions not renewing in Payment Gateway v2 sandbox
description: We are testing subscription renewals in the US-West sandbox environment using Payment Gateway v2. The transactions are initiated but the subscription status never updates to 'renewed'. This is impacting about 18 test accounts. It seems like the renewal logic within the gateway itself is failing to commit the state change after payment capture. Please investigate why the product isn't processing the renewal correctly.

title: Analytics Dashboard slow response times in US-West production
description: We are experiencing significantly slower response times on the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West production region. Queries that usually complete in under 2 seconds are taking over 10-15 seconds. This is affecting about 5 users who rely on real-time metrics. The issue seems consistent across different report types. Please check the performance metrics for this region.

title: Billing Disputes webhook failures in US-East
description: We are having issues with the Billing Disputes Handler in our US-East production environment. Specifically, webhooks are not firing as expected, and we are seeing retries exhausted for several events. This is impacting our ability to process disputes in a timely manner.

The notification itself is never delivered to the end user. No user impact has been reported yet, but we need to understand why the controller is hanging on these upstream calls.

title: Mobile app is slow and failing intermittently
description: The analytics dashboard seems to be causing issues with the mobile app. It's really slow and sometimes just doesn't load. We are seeing this in staging but it's hard to pin down when it happens. No specific errors showing up on the frontend, just hanging.

description: We are seeing a critical issue in production (ANZ) where subscription renewals are failing. The initial invoice generation appears to be calculating the tax amount incorrectly. Because the total charged does not match what the customer expected, several banks are flagging these as unauthorized, resulting in chargeback notices. It's unclear if the Invoice Service is generating the wrong numbers or if the renewal logic is failing to process the correct amounts properly. Approximately 739 users are affected by these billing errors.

description: In the US-East production environment, we have identified a discrepancy between our configured retention policies and the actual audit logs available in the Analytics Dashboard. We have checked our receiving endpoint and it is online and accepting requests. The issue seems to be that the Dashboard itself is not initiating the outbound webhook calls. One user reported this behavior.

description: Can't log into the SSO module. Getting 401 errors. A few people in the dev team are blocked. We haven't changed anything recently.

The Session Controller appears to be dropping the valid session tokens after a very short duration, which conflicts with our configured idle timeout of 30 minutes. We need to investigate why these specific sessions are invalidating early and triggering the security lockout protocol.

title: Data mismatch in Cohort Builder export vs UI

When we view a cohort in the UI, the user count is significantly different from the number of records returned when we export that same cohort definition. For example, a cohort showing 12,000 users in the interface exports as 11,850 rows. This affects approximately 56 users who rely on these exports for campaign targeting. The filters applied are identical in both the UI query and the export request, so we are unsure why the data sets are diverging.

title: Feature flags not applying correctly in Staging

It is unclear whether the issue lies within the Dashboard's configuration layer not propagating the flags correctly, or if the underlying audit/log tracking system is failing to register the user attributes required for the flag targeting logic. The expected behavior is that these users should see the new UI elements, but they are seeing the legacy view. We need to determine if the flag injection is happening or if the user identity resolution is failing.

Simultaneously, the companion mobile app, which pulls data from the same backend, is experiencing similar slowdowns and occasional freezes. This is impacting about 37 testers. We need to check if there is a resource bottleneck in the staging cluster causing both the web dashboard and the mobile API endpoints to degrade.

title: Critical Payment Gateway 429 Errors and Missing Webhooks
description: We are experiencing a critical outage in the staging EU-Central environment for Payment Gateway v2. We are receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors for almost all transaction attempts, suggesting the gateway itself is rate-limiting us despite low traffic volume. Additionally, confirmation webhooks are not being sent to our endpoints after successful or failed transactions. This is blocking 21,361 simulated users from completing flows. We believe the gateway service is overloaded or misconfigured regarding its internal rate limits and event dispatching.

title: Password reset links expiring immediately in MFA Manager

When a user clicks the reset link sent via email, they are redirected to an error page stating the token is invalid or expired. This is affecting 2,891 users who are currently locked out or need to update credentials. The MFA Manager seems to be generating these reset tokens with an extremely short TTL or failing to validate them correctly upon return.

title: Certificate warnings in Staging
description: Getting security warnings about expired certificates when trying to connect to the session service. Not sure if it's impacting everyone or just some clients. It started recently.

title: Refunds not reflecting in customer accounts

The transaction status shows 'success' in our internal logs. It's unclear if the issue is with the gateway's processing of the refund instruction or if the subsequent update to the customer's balance via the API interface is failing to commit. 14 users are currently experiencing this delay. We need to verify if the refund transaction is being correctly relayed and acknowledged by the downstream balance update service.

title: Dev analytics data mismatches and flag issues - definitely a token expiration bug?
description: We are seeing some weird behavior in our EU-Central development environment with the Analytics Dashboard. Specifically, an environment variable seems to be missing, the data we see doesn't match what we expect, and our feature flags aren't applying correctly. We think this is definitely a token expiration handling bug causing these sync issues. It's only affecting about 2 users right now so impact is low, but we need this confirmed.

This seems to happen when a user logs in via SSO for the first time or after a specific session timeout. No business impact or affected user count is known at this moment, but it needs investigation as it corrupts our user directory.

title: Analytics Dashboard missing consent records in APAC
description: We are seeing missing consent records in our Analytics Dashboard for the APAC production environment. This affects 547 users. We think it's definitely a policy misconfiguration on your end that is causing these records to be dropped. Please check the configuration settings as we are confident this is the root cause.

title: Feedback Collector form submission failure in dev
description: In our development environment (US-East), the Feedback Collector form is failing to submit. When we click the submit button, nothing happens or it returns a generic error. This is currently only affecting one developer account. No business impact on production, but it is blocking our local testing workflow.

title: SSO Integration Module API schema errors and webhook retries exhausted (Staging)
description: Our SSO Integration Module in the US-West staging environment is encountering API schema errors which are causing webhook retries to be exhausted. This is leading to a failure in authentication propagation for approximately 4,974 test users. The issue is critical for our release testing as we cannot proceed with integration validation.

title: Pagination broken in Mobile App dev (ANZ)
description: We are experiencing issues with pagination in our Mobile App (ANZ development environment). When scrolling through lists, the load-more triggers either do not fire or return data that seems to overlap or come from an unexpected source. It's unclear if this is a client-side rendering bug or if the underlying billing/transaction data feed is returning malformed pagination links. Low priority, affecting one tester.

title: Self-Service Hub missing audit log entries in APAC
description: We have identified missing entries in the audit logs within our Self-Service Hub production environment (APAC region). Approximately 356 users are affected, and their recent actions are not being recorded in the compliance logs. This is a high-impact issue regarding our data retention and auditing obligations. Please investigate the log ingestion pipeline immediately.

title: Report Builder unresponsive and flags not applying (US-West)
description: Our Report Builder tool in the US-West production environment is currently unresponsive for a large portion of our users (7,152 affected). Additionally, we are noticing that our feature flags are not applying correctly within the tool, preventing users from accessing new reporting capabilities. This is a critical blocker for our sales team's ability to generate necessary client reports.

title: Chat Widget billing errors: double charges and incorrect currency (ANZ)
description: We are receiving multiple reports from our Chat Widget users in the ANZ production region regarding billing discrepancies. Specifically, subscriptions are being charged twice, and currency conversions are applied incorrectly, resulting in overcharges. This affects 869 users and has a high business impact due to the financial nature of the errors.

title: Chat Widget timeout due to upstream dependency (EU-Central)
description: Our Chat Widget in the EU-Central production environment is experiencing timeouts and errors. We have traced this to an upstream dependency failure. The vendor status page currently shows an active incident for this service, which correlates with our drop in performance. This is impacting 44 users with a moderate business impact.

title: SSO Integration Module audit gaps and certificate warnings (EU-Central)
description: We are observing two issues with our SSO Integration Module in EU-Central production. First, there are missing entries in the audit logs, affecting security compliance visibility. Second, users are encountering certificate warnings during login attempts. Approximately 85 users are affected, resulting in moderate business impact due to confusion and potential security concerns.

title: Cache service broken in staging
description: Hey, the Cache Service in our US-West staging environment seems to be down. We're getting connection errors and 502s. Not sure if it's just us or if it's a wider issue. 35 people are blocked.

title: Chargeback Handler issues in LATAM production - payments declined and overcharges
description: We are experiencing problems with the Chargeback Handler in our production environment for the LATAM region. Specifically, we are seeing payments being declined unexpectedly, and there are instances of overcharging customers. This is affecting about 2 users at the moment. The business impact seems low so far, but we need this investigated as it involves financial transactions.

title: HTTP 502 errors from Load Balancer in LATAM production
description: Our Load Balancer in the LATAM production region is throwing HTTP 502 Bad Gateway errors. This started recently and is affecting approximately 12 users. The issue has a moderate impact on our business operations. We have confirmed that the backend services are up, but traffic through the LB is failing with 502s. Please investigate the configuration and health checks.

title: Refunds not reflecting in Payment Gateway v2 dev environment (EU-West)
description: In our EU-West development environment, refunds processed through Payment Gateway v2 are not being reflected in the transaction history or balance. We have initiated several test refunds, but the status remains 'pending' or simply does not update. This is affecting our QA team of about 26 users who cannot verify refund logic. The impact is moderate as it blocks our testing workflow.

title: Active Directory Sync failing in LATAM prod: time outs, index corruption, disk space
description: We are facing multiple issues with Active Directory Sync in the LATAM production environment. We are seeing database query timeouts, alerts indicating index corruption, and an 'out of disk space' error. These issues are occurring simultaneously and have been reported by about 12 users. The business impact is moderate, but the combination of errors suggests a deeper infrastructure or resource problem. Please check the storage and database health immediately.

title: Users locked out of SSO Integration Module - clock sync issue suspected
description: We have 4 users in the EU-West production environment who are getting locked out when trying to use the SSO Integration Module. We think it's because of a clock/time synchronization issue between our servers and the identity provider. The tokens are being rejected as invalid, and we are sure the time drift is the culprit. Please check the NTP settings on our end and the SSO module configuration to resolve this.

title: Payment Gateway v2 API returning empty responses in EU-Central
description: The Payment Gateway v2 API in our EU-Central production environment is intermittently returning empty responses (200 OK with no body) instead of the expected transaction data. This is affecting about 8 users and has a low business impact, but it is causing parsing errors on our client side. We have ruled out authentication issues as the headers are correct. Please investigate why the response body is missing for these requests.

title: High volume of 429s, JSON errors, and webhook failures in Payment Gateway v2 (ANZ)
description: We are experiencing severe issues with Payment Gateway v2 in the ANZ production region. A large number of users (487) are affected. We are seeing HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors, malformed JSON responses from the API, and webhook retries exhausting without success. This has a high business impact and is disrupting payment processing. Please prioritize investigation into rate limits and response validation.

title: UI element not rendering in Self-Service Hub dev (EU-Central)
description: In the Self-Service Hub development environment for EU-Central, a specific UI element is failing to render. There are no console errors related to the component, but it appears blank. This does not impact production users at the moment, so the business impact is none. It is a visual glitch that needs to be fixed before promotion to staging. Please check the frontend deployment.

title: Slow performance on Analytics Dashboard in ANZ sandbox
description: The Analytics Dashboard in the ANZ sandbox is very slow. It is taking a long time to load and respond to queries. This is affecting many users and the impact is considered high. We are not sure why it is lagging. Please look into it.

title: Session Controller timeouts and missing webhooks in EU-Central prod
description: We believe the Session Controller is malfunctioning in our EU-Central production environment. One user has reported that sessions are timing out unexpectedly, and webhooks that should be triggered by session events are not firing. This is causing disruption for that specific user flow. The business impact is low as it is isolated to one account. Please investigate the Session Controller's event handling and timeout settings.

title: Critical access issues with Data Export Service in ANZ
description: The Data Export Service in the ANZ production region is not working. Users are getting blocked. This is a critical issue affecting a huge number of people. We need help ASAP.

title: Onboarding Wizard UI and localization bugs in US-West prod
description: We are seeing two issues with the Onboarding Wizard in the US-West production environment. First, a specific UI element is not rendering correctly on some browsers. Second, the localized text for the Spanish translation is incorrect. This is affecting about 32 users and has a moderate business impact as it confuses new customers. Please check the frontend assets and the localization files.

title: Refunds missing in Payment Gateway v2 EU-Central
description: Refunds are not showing up in Payment Gateway v2. This is happening in the EU-Central production environment. It is affecting many users and the impact is moderate. Please check why.

title: MFA rejection and SSO errors in Session Controller (US-West)
description: Users in the US-West production environment are encountering issues with the Session Controller. Specifically, valid MFA codes are being rejected, and users are seeing generic SSO error pages when trying to log in. This is affecting 18 users and has a moderate business impact. It appears to be an authentication flow failure. Please investigate the MFA verification logic and SSO token handling within the Session Controller.

title: Admin Console config issues and unresponsiveness in APAC prod
description: The Admin Console in the APAC production environment is exhibiting several problems. Configuration changes are not taking effect, we have detected config drift, and the service is frequently unresponsive. This is affecting 23 users and has a moderate business impact. We cannot manage settings reliably due to these issues. Please check the backend service health and the configuration synchronization process.

title: SSO Login failing with Access Denied for 1000+ users
description: We are experiencing a critical outage with the SSO Integration Module in our US-East production environment. Starting around 09:00 AM EST, users attempting to log in are being redirected to an error page stating 'Access Denied' instead of being authenticated. This is affecting approximately 1,017 users who cannot access the platform. The issue seems to be isolated to the SSO handshake as direct local logins are still working for admins.

title: Data retention not working in staging
description: Hi, I noticed that the retention policy doesn't seem to be applying correctly on the Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-Central staging environment. I tried deleting some old test records but they are still showing up in the UI. Can you check this?

description: We have a full outage on the Token Service in the ANZ production region. The pods are stuck in a crash loop and restarting repeatedly, preventing any token generation. We suspect rate limiting might be misconfigured or the webhook listeners are down.

title: Subscription renewals failing with incorrect tax amounts
description: We are seeing issues with subscription renewals in our EU-West staging environment. Approximately 25 test users report that their renewals are failing. When we inspect the attempts, the calculated tax amount appears to be incorrect for certain jurisdictions, which causes the payment to be rejected by the gateway. It is unclear if the issue is with the payment processing logic or the tax calculation engine.

title: Security warnings: Expired certificates and privilege escalation in Token Service
description: In the EU-West production environment, our monitoring tools have flagged two issues with the Token Service. First, we are receiving 'certificate expired' warnings for internal service endpoints. Second, security auditing has detected elevated privileges being observed on several token requests. This affects about 21 users and is a moderate impact, but requires investigation to ensure compliance.

title: Users stuck in login loop after payment actions
description: Several customers (approx. 36) in our EU-West production environment are reporting that they get stuck in a login loop when trying to access their accounts after performing certain payment-related actions. The page just refreshes the login form. We aren't sure if this is a session issue with the Payment Gateway or if it's related to how refunds/charges are being processed and returned to the front end.

They are stating that historical tax data is missing from their records, and there are significant data mismatches between what is calculated and what is stored. About 34 users have submitted tickets regarding this data loss/inconsistency issue. This is a moderate impact as it affects financial reporting.

We have traced the bottleneck to the Webhook Engine, which is showing high latency when processing events. This is causing a lag in the app UI updates for about 22 active users during peak hours. We need to optimize the webhook delivery to restore app performance.

The constant throttling is halting our development progress and needs a higher limit or configuration change immediately.

They mentioned the app hangs when contacting the Payment Gateway v2. We have not seen this pattern with other users, but want to check if there is an isolated performance issue.

title: Load Balancer unresponsive causing outage in dev
description: The Load Balancer in our APAC development environment is currently unresponsive, leading to a full outage for our testing team. Approximately 43 developers are unable to deploy or access services. The health checks are failing and traffic is not being routed. We need this restored ASAP as it is blocking our sprint activities.

description: Our QA team in the ANZ staging environment is reporting that the Payment Gateway v2 API is returning empty responses for valid requests. This is affecting about 30 test users and is blocking our integration testing. The HTTP status codes are 200, but the body is null/empty, which is not the expected JSON structure.

title: Duplicate records appearing in Admin Console

It doesn't seem to be impacting any specific users or critical workflows right now, but it is cluttering the database. I wanted to flag this in case it leads to data integrity issues later.

title: KPI Tracker downloads are cutting off the last few rows
description: Hey team, we're seeing an issue with the KPI Tracker in our dev environment. When 23 of us try to export the daily metrics report to CSV, the file comes out truncated. It stops abruptly, usually right after the 500th line. We need the full dataset for our analysis scripts to run without errors. Please look into why the tracker is generating incomplete files.

title: Analytics Dashboard hitting rate limits in US-West Production
description: We are encountering "rate limit exceeded" errors on the Analytics Dashboard. This started happening around 08:00 AM PST. The impact is currently low as it's affecting a single user account (API key ending in 4f2a), but it prevents us from pulling hourly aggregation data. The error occurs specifically when making batch requests for the last 7 days of data. Please advise on how to increase the limit or if this is a temporary glitch.

title: Refunds processing slowly in Payment Gateway v2
description: We have 2 customers in EU-Central whose refunds haven't shown up yet. This is definitely an insufficient capacity planning issue on your end. Your servers clearly cannot handle the current transaction volume, causing the refund queue to back up. We need you to provision more infrastructure immediately so these refunds reflect in the users' accounts. The delay is unacceptable given the traffic we are sending.

title: 85 users locked out and seeing elevated privilege warnings
description: Urgent: We have a security concern affecting 85 users in our EU-Central production environment. Approximately 1 hour ago, these users were locked out of the Payment Gateway v2 portal. Simultaneously, our internal audit logs are flagging "elevated privileges observed" for these same accounts. We need to verify if this is a bug causing false positives or a real security incident. Please check the access logs and unlock the accounts if safe to do so.

title: Intermittent failures in Billing Engine affecting 700+ users
description: Our Billing Engine in the APAC region is experiencing intermittent transaction failures. This is a high-impact issue affecting approximately 744 users over the last 4 hours. The failures occur randomly—sometimes successful, sometimes returning a generic 500 error. This is causing significant drop-offs during checkout. We need this stabilized ASAP. Please check for any underlying instability in the processing pipeline.

title: Users getting "Access Denied" after unexpected session expiry
description: We are seeing a spike in "access denied" errors for our EU-West production users. The flow is: users get logged in, but their sessions expire unexpectedly after about 5 minutes of inactivity (standard setting is 30). When they try to refresh, they hit an access denied error instead of being redirected to login. This affects 630 users and is severely impacting workflow continuity. Please investigate the session management logic in the SSO Integration Module.

title: High timeout rate on Analytics Dashboard in Staging
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our EU-Central staging environment is timing out consistently. 113 users are currently blocked from running reports. The load time exceeds the 30-second gateway limit, resulting in a blank screen or error message. This is critical for our QA team as they cannot validate new dashboard features. The issue seems to start when filtering by more than 5 data points. Please help optimize the query performance or check for resource constraints in staging.

title: SSO Redirect Loop preventing login for 2 users
description: Two of our US-East production users are stuck in a login loop. They click "Login with SSO," get redirected, but then bounced back to the login screen repeatedly. The browser console shows a redirect loop error in the SSO Integration Module. Clearing cookies and cache does not resolve the issue. It appears to be specific to their user accounts as other users are logging in fine. Please check their SSO mapping or token generation.

title: Subscription Manager API throwing schema errors and rate limits
description: We are having trouble integrating with the Subscription Manager. Our dev team in ANZ is seeing consistent "API schema error" responses when trying to fetch plan details. Additionally, we are hitting "rate limit exceeded" errors much earlier than expected (after only 100 requests). This is blocking 25 developers on our team. It seems like the Subscription Manager endpoint is unstable or the documentation is out of date regarding rate limits. Please clarify the expected behavior.

title: SSO Integration Module granting wrong access levels
description: There is a logic flaw in the SSO Integration Module in our ME development environment. We are seeing users granted access to resources they shouldn't have, while simultaneously, some users are getting "permission denied unexpectedly" for resources they own. The access control lists seem scrambled or not applying correctly after login. This is a functional bug in the module itself and needs to be fixed to test our role-based access control features.

title: Analytics Dashboard returning malformed JSON
description: Critical Issue: The Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ development environment is returning malformed JSON responses. This is breaking the frontend for 722 users who are testing the new UI components. The response headers look okay, but the body contains unescaped characters or truncated streams. This prevents any data visualization from rendering. We need the API to return valid JSON so we can proceed with integration testing.

title: User provisioning stuck and sync delays in SSO Module
description: We are experiencing significant delays in user provisioning via the SSO Integration Module in our ANZ production environment. New users are not appearing in the system, and existing users show "provisioning stuck" status. The synchronization delay is now over 2 hours, impacting 737 users who cannot access their applications. This high-impact issue needs immediate attention to clear the sync queue.

title: Notification Hub webhooks not firing in Staging
description: We are testing the Notification Hub in our EU-West staging environment. The webhooks configured for order updates are not firing. We have verified the endpoint is reachable and returns a 200 OK when tested manually, but the Hub does not send the payload automatically. This is affecting 38 testers who cannot validate the notification flow. Please check if the webhook trigger service is running correctly in this environment.

title: Currency Converter causing declined payments and chargebacks
description: Users in EU-West are reporting that payments are being declined, and we are receiving chargeback notices. The Currency Converter seems to be applying incorrect exchange rates or failing to convert amounts properly before sending to the processor. This has impacted 101 users and resulted in a high volume of failed transactions. We need the converter logic checked immediately to prevent further financial discrepancies.

title: Payment Gateway v2 undercharging customers in ME
description: We have detected an issue where the Payment Gateway v2 in our ME production environment is undercharging customers. Several transactions (affecting 22 users) have been processed for less than the intended amount, and we have already started receiving chargeback notices from the banks. This is a moderate business impact but needs to be resolved before more incorrect amounts are processed. Please investigate the calculation logic in the gateway.

title: Federation metadata error and MFA rejection on login
description: We are experiencing issues with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment (LATAM). Approximately 44 users are unable to log in. The initial error indicates a mismatch between the federation metadata we have configured and what is being presented. Additionally, when users attempt to bypass the initial prompt or proceed with the flow, their MFA codes are being rejected immediately as invalid. We have verified that the metadata file hasn't been changed on our end recently.

title: Subscription double-charging and subsequent declines
description: Support, we are seeing irregular billing behavior in the Payment Gateway v2 (US-West, Production). About 20 users reported being charged twice for their subscription renewal. Following these duplicate charges, some users are experiencing payment declines on subsequent attempts or when trying to access their account, likely due to hitting credit limits or fraud flags. We need this investigated as it is impacting user experience and billing accuracy.

title: Slow performance in mobile app during dashboard loads
description: Hi team, we are noticing that the mobile app is running very slowly specifically when loading the Analytics Dashboard in our development environment (ANZ). The latency is significant enough to make testing difficult. We aren't sure if the issue originates from how the dashboard data is being aggregated/queried or if it is related to the event ingestion layer (Event Schema Registry) causing delays in data availability. Any help narrowing down the bottleneck would be appreciated.

title: Webhooks not firing for Payment Gateway v2 in staging
description: We are encountering an issue where webhooks are not firing as expected from the Payment Gateway v2 in our LATAM staging environment. This is affecting approximately 38 users who rely on these events for downstream processing. The transactions appear to complete successfully, but the notification callbacks are absent. We have verified the endpoint URLs and SSL certificates are correct. Please advise.

title: Duplicate subscription charges visible in Currency Converter flow
description: Hello, we are seeing a high-impact issue where customers are being charged twice for their subscriptions. This seems to be happening within the context of the Currency Converter module in production (APAC). It is unclear whether the double charging is a logic error in the conversion process or if it is related to data inconsistencies in the central metrics pipeline affecting how transaction states are tracked. Nearly 800 users are affected. We need urgent assistance.

title: Unexpected permission denied errors and missing roles
description: In our EU-Central production environment, 9 users are reporting that they cannot access sections of the app they normally have access to. They receive a 'permission denied' error despite having the correct role assigned in the admin panel. It appears their roles are not being applied correctly during session creation or validation via the Session Controller. We haven't made any changes to the RBAC configuration recently.

title: Config drift and feature flag failures in Load Balancer
description: We are observing critical issues in the APAC production environment related to the Load Balancer. Feature flags are not applying correctly to end-users, resulting in a degraded experience for approximately 427 users. Furthermore, monitoring tools are detecting configuration drift between our intended state and the actual running configuration on the load balancers. This combination is causing inconsistent behavior across the fleet.

title: Incorrect invoices and charge discrepancies
description: We have identified that 4 users in US-West production are receiving invoices with incorrect amounts, including both overcharges and undercharges. This is definitely a policy misconfiguration on our end regarding tax or discount rules, but we need your help to pinpoint exactly which rule is failing to update the invoice totals correctly via the Payment Gateway v2.

title: Double subscription charges and refund delays
description: Our support team has escalated 24 tickets from users in EU-Central production stating they were charged twice for their subscription. Additionally, for those who were refunded the duplicate charge, the refund is not yet reflected in their account balance or on their statements. This involves the Subscription Manager and Payment Gateway interactions. Please investigate why the second charge occurred and why the refund status is lagging.

title: Analytics Dashboard latency and failures
description: The dashboard is slow and keeps failing for many users in LATAM production. It's been happening all day. Please fix.

title: Invoice errors, undercharges, and tax miscalculations
description: We are seeing issues in the EU-West production environment with Payment Gateway v2 where 42 users have invoices that are incorrect. Specifically, there are undercharges and the tax amounts are wrong. We think it's because of an expired API key used by our invoicing service to fetch the latest tax rates, which is defaulting to old values. Please confirm and help us regenerate valid keys.

title: HTTP 401 errors and data mismatch in SSO
description: About 9 users in US-West production are getting HTTP 401 errors when using the SSO Integration Module. When they do manage to get in, they are seeing data that doesn't belong to them or is outdated. This is definitely a version incompatibility issue between our IdP and your SSO module after our last update. Please help us resolve the version mismatch.

title: Incomplete compliance reports and data residency flags
description: In our US-East staging environment, using Payment Gateway v2, we have 2 users who are seeing incomplete compliance reports. We need to ensure that the compliance reporting module is correctly interpreting the data residency metadata before we push to prod.

title: Users logged out unexpectedly (Session Expiry)
description: We are experiencing a critical issue in US-East production where a large number of users (over 20,000) are being logged out unexpectedly. Their sessions are expiring much faster than the configured timeout via the SSO Integration Module. This is severely impacting user experience and support ticket volume. We need immediate investigation into why session tokens are becoming invalid prematurely.

title: Feature flags and config drift issues in Queue Manager
description: Our LATAM production environment is showing signs of configuration drift. Specifically, feature flags are not applying correctly to consumers of the Queue Manager. This is affecting about 48 users. We are unsure if the drift is originating from the CI/CD pipeline deployments or if the Queue Manager itself is failing to sync its configuration state. Both scenarios seem plausible given the current logs.

title: Slow performance observed on mobile app within Analytics Dashboard
description: We are experiencing significant latency when accessing the mobile view of our Analytics Dashboard. This seems to be affecting the dashboard specifically on mobile devices.

title: Customer Portal showing blank screen

title: Critical SSO Login Loop and Missing Reset Emails

title: Mobile App UI Rendering Issues and Search Results Inaccuracy in EU-West
description: In our production Mobile App (EU-West region), we are encountering two main issues: 1) Certain UI elements are failing to render, causing layout breaks, and 2) The search function is returning incorrect results. title: Chat Widget not scaling correctly
description: We are hitting capacity limits with the Chat Widget in the LATAM production environment. Autoscaling doesn't seem to be triggering properly, leading to quota exceeded errors. Roughly 45 users are currently impacted.

title: Payment Gateway Webhook Failures and Bad JSON Responses
description: Our Payment Gateway v2 (EU-West, production) is failing to process webhooks correctly. We are seeing retries exhausted and malformed JSON responses. title: Incorrect Currency Conversion Leading to Overcharges

description: We are experiencing constant timeouts on the Analytics Dashboard in our EU-West production environment. Additionally, we are seeing rate limit exceeded errors. title: Payment Gateway API returning empty responses and webhooks failing
description:
Team,

We are facing issues with Payment Gateway v2 in production (EU-West). We observe three specific symptoms:

title: Overcharging customers via Payment Gateway v2 in APAC
description: We have identified a critical issue in the APAC production environment where the Payment Gateway v2 is overcharging customers. 113 users have been affected with incorrect billing amounts. Immediate investigation required.

title: Failover did not occur for Analytics Dashboard in EU-West
description: During a recent outage in the EU-West production region, the failover mechanism for the Analytics Dashboard did not trigger as expected. This low-impact event affected 3 users temporarily. We need to know why failover failed.

title: Elevated privileges observed in Analytics Dashboard (ME)
description: We have detected elevated privileges being observed within the Analytics Dashboard in the Middle East production environment. This is a high-impact security concern affecting 308 users. Please investigate immediately.

description: In the US-West production environment, we are finding that consent records are missing and audit log entries are absent. This critical issue impacts 8622 users.
