title: SSO creating duplicate accounts and sync delays in ANZ Production
description: We are experiencing issues with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment (ANZ region). Over the last 48 hours, we have noticed that when new users are provisioned via SSO, duplicate accounts are sometimes created in our local directory. Additionally, there is a noticeable delay in user data synchronization; changes made upstream are not reflecting in our system for approximately 2-4 hours. This has affected about 2 specific users so far, but we are concerned it may scale. We have verified that the unique identifiers are being passed correctly from the identity provider. Please investigate the synchronization logic and account creation rules.

title: Webhook Engine failing due to database connection pool exhaustion
description: Our Webhook Engine in the APAC production environment is currently failing to process outgoing events. The application logs indicate that the database connection pool is exhausted, causing timeouts on all webhook deliveries. We attempted to restart the service, but the connections were immediately consumed again. This issue is preventing any data from flowing out to our downstream partners. We are unsure if this is a configuration issue with the engine's max connection limit or if there is an underlying network/dns resolution delay causing connections to hang open. Business impact is currently reported as none by our monitoring, but this is clearly a blocker for future data syncs. Please check the connection state and any recent changes to database endpoints.

title: Mobile App Search returning incorrect results - Stale Cache Issue
description: We are seeing a critical issue in the Mobile App development environment (ME region) where the search functionality is returning completely incorrect results. For example, searching for recently added items yields nothing or returns old, deprecated records. This is affecting approximately 562 users in our internal testing cohort. We are confident this is a stale cache problem; the search index isn't being invalidated properly when new content is pushed. Please flush the cache and ensure the invalidation hooks are firing correctly on content updates. We need this fixed urgently as it is blocking our UAT sign-off.

title: SSO Password Reset Links Expired and Error Pages in EU-West Staging
description: In our EU-West staging environment, testers are reporting that password reset links generated via the SSO Integration Module are expiring almost immediately. When users click the link within the standard time window, they are redirected to a generic SSO error page rather than the password reset form. This issue has affected 19 users during our recent test cycle. We have checked the email logs, and the links are being sent out, but the token validation seems to be failing on arrival. This is moderating our release timeline for the authentication update. Please verify the token expiration settings and the redirect URL configuration for the staging environment.

title: SSO Redirect Loop in ME Development Environment
description: We are encountering an infinite redirect loop when trying to log in using the SSO Integration Module in our development environment (ME region). When users initiate the login flow, they are bounced back and forth between our application and the identity provider until the browser times out. This is affecting all 35 developers working on the authentication feature branch. We have confirmed that the callback URL is correctly registered in the IDP. The issue started after our last configuration sync. This is a moderate blocker as we cannot test any post-login functionality. Please review the redirect logic and session cookie settings.

title: Fee Analyzer 504 Timeouts and DNS Failures - Likely Stale Cache
description: The Fee Analyzer tool in production (EU-Central) is experiencing severe performance issues. Users are receiving HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors, and we are also seeing DNS lookup failures and certificate warnings in the browser console. About 35 users are reporting this. We think it's because of stale cache on the CDN or load balancer side; the service is trying to fetch outdated resource locations which is causing the DNS and connection issues. It definitely feels like a caching layer problem rather than an application bug. Please clear the caches associated with this domain and verify the DNS records are propagating correctly. This is impacting our ability to calculate fees for pending transactions.

title: SSO login issues in ANZ production
description: Hi, we are having trouble with SSO. Users can't log in. It says MFA code is rejected or session expired. Lots of people are complaining. It's urgent. Please fix.

title: Critical: AD Sync locking out accounts and rejecting MFA codes in US-West
description: We are facing a critical issue with Active Directory Sync in our US-West production environment. A large number of users (approx. 25,000) are reporting that their accounts are being locked out unexpectedly, and subsequent attempts to authenticate are failing with 'MFA code rejected' errors, even when valid codes are entered. This seems to be happening in batches. We suspect the sync process is overwriting security attributes or causing a race condition with the MFA provider. This is completely halting business operations for these users. Please prioritize investigation into the sync logs and MFA integration points immediately.

title: Payment Gateway v2 declining valid payments in EU-Central
description: We are observing an increase in declined transactions for valid payment attempts using Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-Central production environment. Approximately 22 customers have reported being declined despite having sufficient funds and correct card details. The error responses are generic 'Payment Declined' codes. We need to determine if this is a gateway configuration issue or if specific BIN ranges are being flagged incorrectly. This is impacting our conversion rate and customer satisfaction. Please review the recent transaction logs for these failures to identify any patterns.

title: SSO API returning empty responses and schema errors in US-West
description: The SSO Integration Module API in our US-West production environment is behaving erratically. We are receiving two types of errors: first, HTTP 200 responses with empty JSON bodies when we expect user profile data, and second, validation errors indicating that the response schema does not match the expected format (e.g., missing mandatory fields). This is breaking our downstream applications for approximately 563 users. We have not changed our client-side code recently. Please check if there have been any backend changes to the API response structure or if the data source for user profiles is failing to populate correctly.

title: Invoice Service currency issues
description: The currency conversion in the Invoice Service is wrong. Amounts are not matching up. It's affecting a lot of our dev tests. Please look into it.

title: Data Pipeline deadlocks and high disk usage in ME production
description: Our Data Pipeline in the Middle East production environment is experiencing frequent database deadlocks, causing job failures. Concurrently, we are seeing critical alerts for disk usage exceeding 90% on the storage nodes associated with this pipeline. This combination is preventing data from being processed for about 33 users/tenants. The deadlocks seem to happen during peak load times. We suspect the disk pressure might be impacting I/O performance, leading to the timeouts and locks. Please investigate the storage capacity and optimize the database queries to reduce lock contention.

title: Currency Converter producing incorrect invoices and undercharges
description: We are seeing discrepancies in final invoice amounts generated via the Currency Converter tool in the LATAM production region. Some invoices are incorrect, specifically resulting in undercharges for customers. The symptoms span both areas: the rate displayed might be right, but the exported invoice value is wrong, or vice versa. We need to isolate whether the fault is in the conversion logic or the data export mapping. Approximately 14 customers have been affected so far.

The invoices show the correct intended amount, but the payment capture is higher. We need to understand if this is a calculation error in the gateway or a synchronization issue between the payment capture and the invoicing module. Please review the transaction logs for these specific accounts to pinpoint where the amount is being altered.

description:
Hello,

Our Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM production region is throwing timeout errors and 'rate limit exceeded' messages for about 132 users. We cannot load reports or query data. We suspect the dashboard application itself is hitting its own internal limits or failing to handle the load. Please investigate the dashboard performance and configuration.

title: Tax Calculator Staging: Missing and stale data issues
description:
Hi,

We are testing the Tax Calculator in the ME staging environment and seeing two main data problems:

1. Some tax rates are completely missing from the dropdowns and calculation results.
2. Other rates appear to be stale, reflecting old data rather than the recently updated tables.

This is affecting about 23 internal testers. We need to ensure the data feed to the calculator is refreshing correctly.

title: Chat Widget Dev: Config changes not applying and missing env vars
description:
Hello,

In the ME development environment, changes to the Chat Widget configuration are not taking effect even after deployment. Additionally, we noticed that a required environment variable is missing from the pod/service definition, which might be why the config updates are ignored. No production impact. Please help us troubleshoot why the configuration pipeline isn't pushing updates correctly.

title: Queue Manager APAC: HTTP 429 and empty API responses
description:
Hi,

We are encountering errors with the Queue Manager in the APAC production region. API calls are returning HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) status codes, and when we retry or use different endpoints, we sometimes receive empty JSON responses instead of queue data. This is affecting 2 users specifically. Please check if there is a throttling issue or a data serialization problem.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Double charges and currency conversion errors
description:
Hello,

We are reporting issues with Payment Gateway v2 in the US-East production environment. We have identified two problems:

1. Several customers have been charged twice for a single subscription renewal.
2. The currency conversion applied during checkout is incorrect, leading to wrong total amounts.

This affects about 6 users. We need to identify why the gateway is duplicating transactions and miscalculating exchange rates.

title: KPI Tracker throwing HTTP 500 errors in US-East
description: We are seeing a high volume of HTTP 500 errors when trying to access the KPI Tracker dashboard. This is happening in our production environment in the US-East region. About 59 users are currently blocked from viewing their metrics. Can you please check why the service is failing?

title: Subscription Manager charged customer twice
description: One of our customers in the ANZ region reported being charged twice for their subscription via the Subscription Manager. We verified the transaction logs and indeed see two distinct charge events for the same subscription ID in production. Please investigate why the duplicate charge occurred and if it can be reversed automatically.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Sandbox: Renewal failures and missing refunds
description: In our EU-Central sandbox environment, we are experiencing issues with Payment Gateway v2. Specifically, subscriptions that should have renewed are not updating their status, and refunds processed through the gateway are not reflecting in the customer ledger. This has resulted in an overcharge discrepancy for 7 test accounts. We need this resolved to proceed with integration testing.

title: Fee Analyzer generating incorrect invoices in Staging
description: Our staging environment in EU-West is showing significant errors with the Fee Analyzer tool. The invoices generated are incorrect, leading to misleading financial data for our team. This is blocking our release validation as we cannot trust the fee calculations. Please check the logic in the staging instance of Fee Analyzer.

title: Customer Portal returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
description: We are consistently hitting HTTP 429 rate limit errors when interacting with the Customer Portal API in the LATAM development environment. The requests are basic GET calls with standard parameters, and we are not exceeding any documented limits. This is halting our development workflow. Please advise on the current rate limits or if this is a configuration issue.

title: SSO Integration Module login failures and missing password emails
description: Users in the ME production region are unable to log in using the SSO Integration Module. They receive HTTP 401 errors upon authentication attempts. Additionally, password reset requests are not sending out the necessary emails. This affects approximately 35 users and is severely impacting their ability to access the platform. Please investigate the SSO configuration and email service.

title: Critical: Payment Gateway v2 double charging and proration errors
description: We are facing a critical issue with Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West production environment. Customers are being charged twice for their subscriptions, and the proration calculations on mid-cycle upgrades are incorrect. This has affected over 1400 users and is causing significant billing disputes. Immediate attention is required to stop further double charges and correct the existing billing records.

title: MFA Manager experiencing high replication lag
description: In the EU-West production region, we are noticing high replication lag within the MFA Manager service. This is causing delays in authentication data synchronization for about 4 users, leading to occasional MFA token validation failures. While the impact is currently low, we want to understand the cause of the lag to prevent it from affecting more users.

title: Funnel Analyzer queries timing out due to disk usage
description: The Funnel Analyzer tool in US-East production is suffering from database query timeouts. Monitoring indicates that disk usage is at a critical level, which seems to be the root cause of the performance degradation. This is currently impacting a small group of 4 analysts who are unable to generate reports. Please advise on clearing disk space or optimizing the database to resolve the timeouts.

title: Admin Console timeouts and webhooks failing to fire
description: We are experiencing frequent timeouts when accessing the Admin Console in the EU-West production environment. Furthermore, webhooks configured through the console are not firing, resulting in missed events for 630 affected users. This is a high-impact issue disrupting our automation workflows. Please check the stability of the Admin Console and the webhook delivery service.

title: Analytics Dashboard Sandbox: Malformed JSON and API schema errors
description: In the ANZ sandbox environment, the Analytics Dashboard API is returning malformed JSON responses and throwing API schema errors. This is preventing webhook retries from succeeding, as the payloads are invalid. Approximately 17 test users are affected, and we cannot validate our analytics integrations. Please investigate the API response format and schema validation logic.

title: Identity Vault returning HTTP 401 in Staging
description: A single user in our EU-West staging environment is consistently receiving HTTP 401 errors when trying to access secrets via the Identity Vault. We have verified that the token is valid and has the correct permissions, but the request is being rejected. Please check the authentication mechanism for the staging instance of Identity Vault.

title: Secret Store unresponsive, causing HTTP 504 timeouts
description: The Secret Store service in US-West production is becoming unresponsive, resulting in HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors for our applications. This is affecting approximately 50 users who are unable to retrieve necessary configuration data. The service appears to be hanging during peak loads. We need this stabilized to prevent further application failures.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Critical Billing Errors: User reports of double charges
description: We are seeing a massive spike in user reports regarding double charges and incorrect invoices from Payment Gateway v2 in the APAC production region. Over 7,000 users are affected. We think this is likely caused by insufficient information being passed during the renewal handshake or a race condition in the billing trigger logic. Please investigate why the system is allowing duplicate transactions despite our safeguards.

title: SSO Integration Module provisioning stuck in Development
description: User provisioning through the SSO Integration Module in our APAC development environment is getting stuck. New users are not being created in the downstream system, and the provisioning jobs hang indefinitely. This is a critical blocker for our development team of 4,240 users who rely on this for testing access controls. Please check the provisioning queue and integration logs.

title: Money stuff wrong in dev
description: Hey, we're seeing weird numbers in the payment gateway on our dev box. Like the exchange rates are off and people are getting charged too much or refunds aren't showing up. Not sure exactly when it started or which transactions are bad, just looked wrong. Needs looking at.

title: Subscriptions failing to renew in Staging
description: In our staging environment, subscription renewals have stopped working entirely. We have about 35 active test accounts that were scheduled to renew this week, but none of them have updated their status or triggered a new payment event. This is blocking our UAT cycle for the new billing logic.

title: Data residency flags inconsistent in EU-Central Staging
description: We are observing mismatches in the data residency flags within the Payment Gateway v2 interface in the EU-Central staging region. Records that should be tagged for specific geographic compliance are showing incorrect flag values, causing our compliance checks to fail for roughly 30 test datasets. This seems to be a configuration issue within the gateway itself.

title: SSO API returning empty responses and rate limit errors
description: The SSO Integration Module API is returning empty JSON responses instead of user data. Additionally, webhooks configured for post-login events are not firing. We are also hitting rate limits unexpectedly despite low traffic volume (1 user testing). This started happening after our last integration update.

title: Analytics Dashboard failing to load data
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our EU-West staging environment is not loading. We are receiving HTTP 429 errors followed by timeouts, and when it does respond, the API returns empty objects. This is affecting about 80 users trying to view reports. It looks like the dashboard service is struggling to fetch or render the data.

title: Critical CPU spikes causing downtime in Payment Gateway Staging
description: We are experiencing severe CPU usage spikes in the Payment Gateway v2 service in the US-West staging environment. This has caused widespread instability and effectively critical impact for our test suite of 1317 users. The high load seems to originate from the gateway processing logic, causing request timeouts and failures across the board.

title: MFA prompts missing during login in Development
description: In our US-East development environment, the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompt is failing to appear for approximately 236 users. The login process completes as if MFA was skipped or accepted by default, which is a major security concern for our dev testing. The Payment Gateway v2 integration handles the auth flow here.

title: Deploy Manager API returning empty responses and 429s
description: The Deploy Manager API in the LATAM production region is returning empty responses for deployment status queries. We are also encountering HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors intermittently. Currently, this has no business impact as we are not deploying, but the API instability is concerning for future releases.

title: SSO MFA failures and invalid token errors
description: Users in the ANZ production region are unable to complete MFA via the SSO Integration Module. They receive 'invalid token' errors. About 333 users are affected, causing high impact. We think it's because of clock/time synchronization issues on our servers causing the tokens to expire too quickly or fail validation checks.

title: Payment declines and overcharges in ME Sandbox
description: In the Middle East sandbox environment for Payment Gateway v2, we are seeing a mix of issues. Some legitimate payments are being declined, while others are being overcharged compared to the expected amount. This affects 47 test users and is moderate in impact for our local compliance testing.

title: Refunds and double charges not working correctly
description: We have three users in ANZ production who reported that refunds they requested are not reflected in their accounts, yet they were also charged twice for their subscription renewal. The overcharges are visible on the invoice. It is unclear if this is a display issue in the gateway or a problem with the underlying payment processing API.

title: OAuth Service down due to database connection issues
description: The OAuth Service in LATAM production is completely failing. We believe this is because the database connection pool is exhausted, leading to 503 errors for all 1785 affected users. The service cannot establish new connections to the backing store, effectively breaking all authentication flows.

title: Complete outage of SSO Integration Module
description: We are reporting a full outage for the SSO Integration Module in the US-West production region. The service is returning 503 Service Unavailable errors for all requests. Approximately 605 users are currently locked out of the system. This is a high-impact event requiring immediate investigation.

title: Currency Converter unreachable due to DNS and timeout errors
description: The Currency Converter tool in US-East production is failing to load. We are seeing DNS lookup failures followed by HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors. This is impacting 1018 users who rely on real-time exchange rates. The service appears to be down or unreachable at the network layer.

title: Event Tracker completely down
description: The Event Tracker service in US-East production has reported a full outage. No events are being recorded or displayed. We think this is definitely a known product limitation with the tracker's capacity under certain loads, rather than a new bug. Impact is currently zero as we are not actively monitoring, but the downtime is notable.

title: Downloaded analytics report file is truncated
description: I attempted to export a summary report from the Analytics Dashboard in our staging environment (APAC). The generated file appears to be cut off prematurely; when I open it, the data stops in the middle of the last table without any closing tags or footer information. This seems to happen specifically when exporting reports with over 50 rows. Can you please check if there is a size limit being enforced on exports?

title: Form submission failures and missing UI elements in Notification Hub
description: We are experiencing issues with the Notification Hub in production (ANZ). Users report that the settings form fails to submit, and certain configuration options are not rendering on the screen. We have about 85 users affected. We think this is definitely an incorrect permissions problem with the service account accessing the backend, as other apps are working fine.

title: Audit log gaps and retention policy not applied in Analytics Dashboard
description: In our production environment (LATAM), we noticed that the audit logs for the Analytics Dashboard have missing entries for several critical operations. Additionally, it appears that the configured data retention policy is not being applied, as old logs are still visible beyond the expected cleanup window. This affects 15 users who rely on these logs for compliance. Please investigate why the retention job seems to be failing or skipped.

title: Localization text missing and feature not visible after release in Config Manager
description: Following the recent release to our staging environment (ME), several UI strings are missing localization text, showing raw keys instead of translated values. Furthermore, a new feature that should be enabled via configuration is completely missing from the interface for approximately 309 users. We verified the feature flags are set correctly, but the UI does not reflect the changes. This is blocking our localization QA team.

title: Rate limit exceeded errors in Notification Hub
description: Our production instance of Notification Hub (EU-West) is returning rate limit exceeded errors and capacity limit reached messages to roughly 400 users. This is causing significant delays in alert delivery. We are certain this is due to a data migration defect that corrupted the user count metrics, triggering the wrong throttling thresholds.

title: Overcharge and chargeback notices for Payment Gateway v2
description: In our ANZ production environment, we have received chargeback notices for several transactions processed through Payment Gateway v2. Investigation shows that customers were overcharged by a small margin. This affects about 5 users. Can you check if there are any known billing calculation issues?

title: Incorrect currency conversion and overcharges in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are seeing discrepancies in currency conversion rates for transactions in our ME production environment using Payment Gateway v2. This has resulted in overcharges for approximately 44 users. The converted amount does not match the expected rate based on the source currency. Please review the exchange rate integration.

title: SSO lockouts and MFA code rejection
description: Users in our ME production environment are reporting account lockouts when trying to access services via the SSO Integration Module. Additionally, valid MFA codes are being rejected. This affects 19 users. We need to know why the authentication flow is failing at the MFA step.

title: Duplicate subscription charges and incorrect currency in Payment Gateway v2
description: In our US-East staging environment, we are observing subscription charges being applied twice, along with incorrect currency conversions. This impacts 25 test accounts. We believe this is definitely caused by incorrect load balancer routing, where requests are being duplicated across different instances.

title: Incorrect currency conversion rates in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are noticing that currency conversions are consistently incorrect for transactions in our US-West production environment. This affects 565 users and is causing significant billing disputes. The rates applied do not match the standard market rates for the currencies involved. Please investigate the conversion logic within the gateway.

title: API schema error when fetching analytics data
description: We encountered an API schema error while attempting to pull data from the Analytics Dashboard in our EU-Central production environment. The response format does not match the expected schema defined in the documentation. Currently, no users are impacted as we are using a fallback method, but we need this fixed for upcoming integrations.

title: Incorrect tax amounts and duplicate charges in Payment Gateway v2
description: Critical issue in our ANZ staging environment. Tax calculations are returning incorrect amounts, and users are reporting duplicate charges on their invoices. This is impacting a large test dataset of 13,680 records. We need immediate assistance to determine if the tax engine or the payment processing logic is at fault.

title: SSO sync issues and duplicate accounts
description: Hey, we're seeing some weird stuff in our dev environment with SSO. Sometimes users get duplicated when we sync from the directory, and the sync seems to lag a bit. Not sure how long it's been happening or if it's affecting everyone. Just wanted to flag it.

title: Webhooks not firing and empty API responses in Queue Manager
description: We are observing that webhooks configured in the Queue Manager are not firing as expected. When we manually trigger the associated API endpoint, we receive an empty response instead of the queued message payload. This is in our APAC production environment. No end-users are currently reporting issues, but the automation pipeline is stalled.

title: Invalid token errors in SSO Integration Module
description: A large number of users (605) in our ME production environment are encountering 'invalid token' errors when attempting to authenticate via the SSO Integration Module. The tokens appear to be generated correctly on the client side but are rejected upon validation. This is causing a complete stop in access for these users.

title: High latency in API Gateway staging responses
description: We are seeing significantly high latency on all requests passing through our API Gateway in the APAC staging environment. The response times have degraded from normal levels to several seconds, impacting our integration tests and development workflows. There are about 344 users affected in our dev team right now. We need this checked urgently as it is blocking our current sprint progress. No changes were made to the gateway configuration on our end.

title: Production SSO loop and MFA rejection affecting 650+ users
description: We are experiencing critical issues with our SSO Integration Module in the EU-Central production environment. Users attempting to log in are getting caught in an infinite redirect loop. Additionally, when the MFA challenge is presented, valid codes are being rejected with an 'invalid token' error. This is affecting approximately 652 users, preventing them from accessing our platform. We need immediate assistance to restore authentication services.

title: Subscription renewals failing and overcharges occurring in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are facing a major issue with Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-West production environment. A large number of users (around 2968) are reporting that their subscriptions were not renewed properly, and many have been charged incorrect amounts or overcharged. We think this is definitely a capacity planning problem on your side, as we've seen traffic spikes recently. Please investigate why the system couldn't handle the load and caused these billing errors.

title: Cache service issues in dev
description: Cache service is acting up in US-West dev. We are getting timeouts and some 504s. It's only happening to me right now. Can you help? I don't have exact times but it's been flaky all morning. Business impact is low.

title: Billing Engine overcharging test accounts in dev
description: Our Billing Engine in the EU-Central development environment seems to be malfunctioning. We have 26 test users who are being charged amounts higher than expected for their subscriptions. The calculations appear wrong, leading to significant overcharges in our staging tests. This is disrupting our billing logic validation. Please check the Billing Engine configuration.

title: Status Page showing HTTP 500 and schema errors
description: Our Status Page in the ANZ production region is displaying multiple errors. Users are seeing HTTP 500 responses, along with API schema errors and messages indicating that the rate limit has been exceeded. This is affecting our ability to communicate with customers during incidents. Approximately 22 users are impacted. The page is essentially broken and not updating correctly.

title: Double charges on subscriptions via Payment Gateway
description: We are seeing duplicate charges for subscriptions in our US-West production environment using Payment Gateway v2. About 37 users have been charged twice for the same billing cycle. We aren't sure if the issue originates from the gateway service itself or the underlying API interactions, but the financial impact is real. Please investigate the transaction logs to identify the cause of these double billings.

title: Incorrect access grants in Role Manager
description: Our Role Manager tool in the US-West production environment is granting access incorrectly. We have a group of 18 users who have been assigned permissions they shouldn't have, while others are missing expected roles. This is a security concern and is causing operational disruption. We believe the issue is within the Role Manager component itself.

title: SSO login errors and missing MFA prompts in production
description: Users in our EU-Central production environment are encountering an SSO error page when trying to log in. Furthermore, the MFA prompt is not appearing at all, blocking users from completing authentication. This affects 922 users. We are pretty sure this is a schema mismatch issue between your SSO Integration Module and our IdP configuration. Please check the data format compatibility.

title: MFA Manager showing wrong tenant data and role issues in LATAM
description: In our LATAM production environment, the MFA Manager is displaying incorrect tenant data for some users. Additionally, specific roles are not being applied correctly after authentication. This affects about 15 users and is causing confusion in user management. The symptoms include seeing data from a different tenant context and failing to inherit the correct permission sets. Please investigate the MFA Manager behavior.

title: Wallet Service errors in EU-West dev
description: We are experiencing issues with the Wallet Service in our EU-West development environment. Subscriptions are not renewing as expected, there are overcharges occurring, and currency conversions are displaying incorrect values. This is affecting 2 developers testing these flows. The impact is low since it's dev, but we need this fixed to proceed with our payment flow integration tests.

title: Cache Service outage and pod restarts in EU-Central production
description: Our Cache Service in the EU-Central production environment has gone unresponsive. We are seeing pods restarting repeatedly, resulting in a full outage of the caching layer. This is impacting 489 users and causing high latency and errors in downstream applications. We believe the Cache Service itself is the point of failure and requires immediate attention to restore stability.

title: MFA prompt not appearing in SSO Integration Module sandbox
description: We are testing the SSO Integration Module in our LATAM sandbox environment. A critical issue is that the MFA prompt is not appearing for users during the login flow. This is blocking our integration team of 1212 users from proceeding with security testing. The initial SSO handshake works, but the second factor authentication step is completely skipped. Please investigate why the MFA trigger is not firing.

title: Duplicate accounts and sync delays in Permission Engine
description: Our Permission Engine in the LATAM production environment is creating duplicate user accounts during synchronization. Additionally, there are significant delays in propagating permission changes. This affects 385 users and is causing operational chaos as users have multiple identities or outdated permissions. The duplicate entries are appearing in our directory, which is a serious data integrity issue.

title: Analytics Dashboard missing records and truncated files in LATAM
description: In our LATAM production environment, the Analytics Dashboard is showing missing records in the reporting views. Also, when exporting data, the files are getting truncated. This affects 73 users who rely on these reports for business decisions. The data inconsistency is noticeable and is impacting our ability to track KPIs accurately. Please check the dashboard data fetching and export mechanisms.

title: Webhooks failing to send and retrying indefinitely in Staging
description: Hello, we are experiencing issues with the KPI Tracker webhook configuration in our staging environment. Since this morning, no outgoing webhooks have been triggered for any events in the Middle East region. The system appears to be attempting retries, but all of them are exhausting and failing without delivering the payload to our endpoint. We have verified that our receiving server is up and accessible. Please investigate why the webhook listener isn't firing.

title: Analytics API returning empty data due to rate limits (Staging)
description: We are seeing high impact issues in our ANZ staging environment with the Analytics Dashboard. When our integration queries the analytics data, it consistently returns an empty JSON response `{}`. However, checking the API headers reveals that we are hitting the rate limit (429 errors) intermittently before getting the empty payload. It's unclear if the gateway is throttling us prematurely or if the backend service is actually returning no data despite the quota. This is blocking our testing for about 120 users.

title: Urgent: Overcharging customers via Chargeback Handler
description: We have a critical billing issue. The Chargeback Handler is generating invoices with incorrect amounts, resulting in significant overcharges for our clients. Our finance team noticed that the total values on the generated invoices do not match the original transaction amounts, leading to double-billing scenarios. This is affecting 248 users in the ME region on production. Please fix the calculation logic immediately as this is causing severe financial discrepancies.

title: Payment Gateway v2 ignoring new configuration settings
description: Our payment configuration updates are not taking effect in the EU-Central production environment. We applied specific feature flags and settings via the console, but the gateway continues to behave as if the old configuration is still active. It seems like the changes are being ignored or there is a drift between what is saved and what is running. Only 2 users are currently impacted, but it prevents us from rolling out a small pilot.

title: Notification Hub webhooks failing with schema errors
description: We are unable to receive notifications via webhook from the Notification Hub in our US-East production environment. The webhook trigger is not firing successfully. When we inspect the logs, we see that the payload generation is failing due to an API schema error, which prevents the message from being dispatched. This is impacting 183 users who rely on these alerts for workflow management. The error seems to suggest a mismatch between the expected structure and the actual data being sent.

title: High latency on Analytics Dashboard (LATAM)
description: Users in the LATAM region are reporting significant slowness when loading the Analytics Dashboard in production. The time to first byte (TTFB) is consistently high, and pages take upwards of 10-15 seconds to render. This affects approximately 19 users who are using the dashboard for real-time monitoring. Network checks indicate standard latency, so the issue appears to be on the application side.

title: Data retention policies not being enforced on Analytics Dashboard
description: We configured a data retention policy to automatically purge analytics data older than 90 days. However, we are observing that old records are persisting in the ME production environment beyond this limit. The dashboard continues to show historical data that should have been deleted according to the compliance settings we established. This affects the view for about 40 users and poses a compliance risk.

title: Discrepancies and missing records in Analytics Dashboard (US-East)
description: We have noticed some inconsistencies in the reporting data on the US-East production dashboard. A subset of users reports that specific transaction records are missing entirely from the view, while others see a mismatch between the summary metrics and the detailed table data. It feels like partial data loss or a sync issue. The impact is currently low, affecting 8 users who noticed the anomalies.

title: SSO Module causing account lockouts and permission errors (APAC Staging)
description: We are experiencing a critical security and access issue in our APAC staging environment involving the SSO Integration Module. Multiple users (approx. 600) are reporting that their accounts are getting locked out unexpectedly after successful login. Additionally, some users are observing elevated privileges that do not match their assigned roles. We suspect this might be related to message processing delays or a queue backlog affecting the authorization handshake, but we cannot pinpoint whether the fault lies with the SSO provider or the internal message flow.

title: Extreme latency on Payment Gateway v2 - Likely Firewall Issue
description: We are seeing very high latency and slow response times on the Payment Gateway v2 in the LATAM production environment. This is causing our mobile app to freeze and timeout for nearly 500 users. We have traced this back to network packets getting stuck or dropped. We are confident that this is caused by a firewall misconfiguration blocking or throttling traffic from our mobile clients to the gateway endpoints. Please check your firewall rules immediately.

title: Access issues with Identity Vault
description: Hi, some of our users in US-West are getting 403 errors when trying to access certain secrets in the Identity Vault. It seems like permissions aren't working right, or maybe the access is being granted incorrectly for some groups while blocked for others. Not sure exactly when it started or which specific paths are failing, but it's annoying. Can you help?

title: Duplicate charges on subscriptions in Staging (ME)
description: We have identified a billing bug in the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment. Subscriptions are being charged twice within the same billing cycle. This overcharge issue is affecting test accounts in the ME region, specifically impacting 36 active subscription trials. The gateway appears to be processing the charge request multiple times for a single trigger event. Please investigate the idempotency handling.

title: Autoscaling not triggering for Payment Gateway v2
description: In our ME development environment, the Payment Gateway v2 is not scaling up when we increase the load. We have set the autoscaling thresholds correctly, but the instance count remains static despite high traffic simulation. We believe this is definitely an incorrect DNS configuration problem where the load balancer isn't resolving to the correct backend pool to trigger the scale event. Please check the DNS records associated with the gateway.

title: SSO Redirect Loop in Payment Gateway v2 (Staging)
description: Users in the LATAM staging environment are encountering an infinite redirect loop when attempting to log in via SSO. After authenticating with the identity provider, the browser bounces back and forth between the login page and the callback URL without completing the session. This is blocking access for 28 users who are testing the new payment flows. Clearing cookies does not resolve the issue.

title: Missing Consent Records in Analytics Dashboard (LATAM)
description: We are seeing a critical compliance issue in the LATAM production environment. The Analytics Dashboard is failing to display consent records for a large portion of our user base (410 users). Specifically, the field indicating whether a user has opted in to data collection is missing or null, even though the consent was captured via the mobile SDK. This prevents us from accurately filtering data based on privacy preferences.

title: Analytics Dashboard exports are corrupted and missing records
description: We are experiencing issues with data exports from the Analytics Dashboard in our US-East production environment. When attempting to download CSV or PDF reports, the files appear corrupted or incomplete. Specifically, many records that should be included in the date range are missing from the export entirely. This has affected two of our analysts who rely on these reports for weekly metrics.

title: Critical: Currency conversion errors and failed subscription renewals in dev
description: We are seeing widespread issues in our ANZ development environment affecting over 1800 users. Subscription renewals are failing, and when they do go through, the currency conversion amounts are incorrect. We are convinced this is a race condition within the Payment Gateway v2 update process. It seems like multiple threads are trying to calculate the exchange rate and renewal status simultaneously, causing the data to get mixed up or overwritten before the transaction completes.

title: Payment Gateway webhooks timing out and not firing in production
description: Our production environment in the ME region is experiencing critical issues with Payment Gateway v2. Webhooks are not firing as expected, and when they are attempted, they result in timeout errors. This has impacted approximately 1100 users and is disrupting our ability to process transactions reliably. We need immediate assistance to resolve the connectivity and delivery issues.

title: Intermittent Analytics Dashboard failures in US-West production
description: We are encountering intermittent failures with the Analytics Dashboard in our US-West production environment. The dashboard sometimes loads correctly, but other times it fails to display data or throws errors. This inconsistency is affecting around 1450 users and has a critical impact on our operations, as we rely heavily on real-time analytics. We need to identify the cause of these sporadic failures.

title: Chat Widget issues reported by vendor status page
description: We have noticed issues with the Chat Widget in our ANZ production environment. The vendor status page currently shows an active incident related to this service. This has moderately affected 36 users, causing delays or disruptions in customer support interactions. We need confirmation on the impact and expected resolution time for the incident.

title: Session Controller timeouts and 502 errors in sandbox
description: In our US-East sandbox environment, the Session Controller is experiencing timeouts and returning HTTP 502 errors. Additionally, there are warnings about expired certificates. This is affecting 14 users and has a moderate business impact, disrupting development and testing workflows. We need assistance to resolve these connectivity and certificate issues.

title: Payment Gateway retention and data residency issues in US-West production
description: We are facing problems with the Payment Gateway v2 in our US-West production environment. The retention policy is not being applied correctly, and there is a mismatch in the data residency flags. This has affected 26 users and has a moderate business impact. We are confident this is due to an unsupported configuration on our end, as we recently changed some settings that may not be compatible with the current version of the gateway.

title: Login and MFA issues
description: Some users can't log in. The MFA prompt doesn't show up, sessions expire too fast, and accounts get locked. It's affecting a bunch of people in APAC. Please help.

title: Incorrect invoice and chargeback notice in Subscription Manager
description: In our APAC production environment, we have received an incorrect invoice through the Subscription Manager. Additionally, we have received a chargeback notice related to this billing discrepancy. This has affected two users and has a low business impact, but we need to resolve the billing errors and understand the cause of the chargeback.

title: Double subscriptions and missing refunds in LATAM production
description: We are experiencing issues with Payment Gateway v2 in our LATAM production environment. Subscriptions are being charged twice, and refunds are not being reflected correctly.
