description:
Hi,

Users are reporting timeouts when accessing the Customer Portal in the EU-West production environment. The page loads for a few seconds and then fails with a timeout error.

Approximately 46 users are affected, causing a moderate impact on support ticket resolution times. Please investigate.

title: Provisioning stuck in SSO module - EU-West Production
description: We are experiencing a significant issue with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-West production environment. User provisioning appears to be completely stuck, with no further progress being made. This has been happening for about 4 hours now. There are approximately 22 users impacted, and they cannot access their accounts until this is resolved. We need someone to look into why the module is hanging during the provisioning process immediately, as it is affecting our business operations.

title: Chat Widget UI not rendering - definitely a data quality issue
description: The Chat Widget UI element is not rendering in our Middle East production instance. We think it's because of a data quality issue. This is definitely a Y problem caused by bad records coming through. No one is seeing the widget at all. Please fix the data quality, it's blocking the UI.

title: Webhook Engine DB pool exhausted in US-West
description: Our Webhook Engine in the US-West production region is failing due to a database connection pool exhaustion. The webhooks stop firing, and we see errors related to the database connections being maxed out. There is currently no business impact reported as we have a fallback, but we need to know why the Webhook Engine is consuming all the DB connections.

title: CRITICAL: Massive account lockouts in MFA Manager
description: We are seeing a critical outage in the MFA Manager product in EU-West. Approximately 1528 users are currently locked out of their accounts. They cannot bypass the MFA challenge or reset their status. This is bringing down our business operations. Please help us unlock these users ASAP.

title: Refund Manager UI element missing
description: In our LATAM production environment, a specific UI element within the Refund Manager is failing to render. This affects our ability to view certain options, though no users are blocked from core tasks. There is no critical business impact at this time. Please advise on why this component is missing.

title: High latency and slow app performance in Payment Gateway v2 (EU-Central)
description: We have noticed significant performance degradation in the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-Central production environment. Users are reporting slow mobile app performance and we are seeing high latency on payment processing requests. This is impacting 54 users and has a moderate business impact, causing payment delays. Please investigate the root cause of this slowness.

title: Cache Service: Privilege Escalation and Audit Log Gaps in Development
description: We have identified several security and compliance issues with the Cache Service in our LATAM development environment. Specifically, we observed elevated privileges, a missing entries in the audit log, and unexpected access denied errors. These issues are affecting 6 users, with low business impact. We need assistance understanding the root cause of these behaviors.

title: Chargeback Handler SSO Issues
description: Hey team, something is wrong with the Chargeback Handler in US-East. We are getting SSO error pages and there seems to be a mismatch with the federation metadata. A lot of users (5355) are seeing this. It is critical. Please check it out.

title: Analytics Dashboard HTTP 429 and Webhooks
description: In our EU-Central production environment, the Analytics Dashboard is returning HTTP 429 errors. Concurrently, our webhooks are not firing. We aren't sure if the dashboard is throttling the webhooks or if another backend service like the Segment Builder Service is causing this bottleneck. 30 users are impacted, moderate business impact.

title: Event Tracker Export Corrupted and Duplicated
description: We are having issues with the Event Tracker in LATAM production. Data exports are coming out corrupted, files are being truncated, and we are seeing duplicate records in the output. This is affecting 2 users and is a low impact issue, but we need it fixed.

title: SSO Integration Module showing incorrect data for users
description: Our SSO Integration Module in US-East production is displaying the wrong data to users. This affects a high impact situation with 197 users reporting seeing incorrect information. We need to know why the module is fetching wrong data.

title: Analytics Dashboard full outage in EU-West
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our EU-West production environment is completely down. We are reporting a full outage. Only 2 users are impacted right now, and the business impact is low, but we need to know when this will be back up.

title: Staging Payment Gateway v2: Chargebacks and Invoice Errors
description: In our ME staging environment, the Payment Gateway v2 is behaving unexpectedly. We are receiving chargeback notices and the generated invoices are incorrect. This is affecting 9 users in our test environment, with low business impact. Please help us troubleshoot.

title: Session Controller Memory and CPU Spikes in Staging (ANZ)
description: We are observing severe resource issues with the Session Controller in our ANZ staging environment. There are major memory usage spikes and CPU usage spikes occurring. This is impacting 213 users and causing a high business impact. We need to understand why this is happening.

title: SSO Integration Module Webhook Timeouts
description: In our EU-Central production environment, the SSO Integration Module is failing to fire webhooks. Users are experiencing timeouts when these events should occur. This is affecting 39 users, with a moderate business impact. Please investigate the root cause.

title: Federation metadata mismatch in EU-Central production
description: We are encountering an issue with Payment Gateway v2 in our production environment (EU-Central). Specifically, we are seeing a federation metadata mismatch error. This is currently affecting our ability to validate metadata correctly. Please advise on next steps to resolve this discrepancy.

title: Significant synchronization delay in SSO Integration Module (US-East)
description: Our SSO Integration Module in the US-East production environment is experiencing noticeable synchronization delays. This issue is impacting approximately 30 users, causing moderate business disruption due to lagged updates. We need assistance in investigating the cause of this latency.

title: Elevated privileges observed and audit log gaps in Permission Engine
description: We have detected two concerning issues in our production environment (ME region): users are observing elevated privileges that they should not have, and simultaneously, there are missing entries in our audit logs. It is unclear whether the permission granting mechanism or the logging infrastructure is at fault. This affects 469 users and has a high business impact. Immediate investigation required.

title: Unexpected elevated privileges and missing audit entries in SSO Integration Module
description: In our EU-Central production environment, we are seeing instances where elevated privileges are observed for certain users, alongside gaps in the audit logs. We are unable to determine if this stems from the SSO Integration Module itself or the underlying SSO Broker. There is currently no reported business impact, but this inconsistency needs review.

title: Critical outage: Rate limit exceeded and empty API responses in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are facing a critical issue in the EU-Central production environment with Payment Gateway v2. The system is throwing 'rate limit exceeded' errors and subsequently returning empty responses for API calls. This is affecting approximately 9,800 users and has a critical business impact. Urgent assistance is needed to restore service.

title: Overcharge detected in Payment Gateway v2 (US-West)
description: A small number of transactions (7 affected users) in our US-West production environment are showing overcharges through Payment Gateway v2. The impact is currently low, but we require verification of the billing logic to ensure customers are not being incorrectly charged.

title: Refund not reflected, double subscription charges, and overcharges in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are reporting multiple billing discrepancies in the US-West production environment for Payment Gateway v2. Specifically: 1) Refunds are not appearing as expected. 2) Some users are being charged twice for subscriptions. 3) General overcharges are being observed. This affects 2 users and has a low business impact, but requires resolution of the billing synchronization issues.

title: Critical: Rate limit exceeded errors impacting 10k+ users in ANZ production
description: Our Payment Gateway v2 instance in the ANZ region is hitting rate limits, resulting in service failures. This is a critical issue affecting over 10,000 users in the production environment. We need immediate support to address the capacity or configuration settings causing these rate limit breaches.

title: Unexpected session expirations in SSO Integration Module (LATAM Sandbox)
description: In our LATAM sandbox environment, the SSO Integration Module is causing sessions to expire unexpectedly. This is impacting 17 users and causing moderate disruption to our testing activities. Please investigate why session timeouts are occurring prematurely.

title: Intermittent SSO failures and failover issues in EU-Central Sandbox
description: We are seeing intermittent failures with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-Central sandbox environment. When failures occur, the failover mechanism does not trigger as expected, leaving 28 users unable to access services. We believe this is definitely a breaking API contract change issue, as recent updates seem to have introduced incompatibilities that standard failover cannot handle.

title: Stuck provisioning and partial bulk import failures in SSO Integration Module (ME Staging)
description: Our staging environment in the ME region is experiencing issues with the SSO Integration Module. User provisioning is getting stuck, and bulk imports are failing partially. This is affecting 268 users and has a high business impact on our deployment timelines. Please review the provisioning queue and import logs.

title: Full outage of Analytics Dashboard in US-West Development
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our US-West development environment is completely down, reporting a full outage. This is impacting 679 users and has a high business impact. We are confident that this is caused by credential rotation not propagating correctly to the dashboard services, leading to authentication failures across the board.

title: Funnel Analyzer returns no search results in APAC Development
description: Users in the APAC development environment are reporting that the Funnel Analyzer is returning no results for any search queries. This affects 63 users and has a moderate business impact. We currently have insufficient information to determine the root cause ourselves, so we need your team to investigate the indexing or query engine status.

title: Config drift and data mismatches in Notification Hub (EU-West Production)
description: We have detected configuration drift and subsequent data mismatches in the Notification Hub production environment (EU-West). This is affecting 63 users with moderate impact. We suspect this is a data quality issue, possibly stemming from upstream data ingestion errors rather than a configuration problem, but we need confirmation and assistance in reconciling the data.

title: Audit log gaps detected in Payment Gateway v2 (US-West Production)
description: A gap in the audit logs has been detected for Payment Gateway v2 in our US-West production environment. While there is currently no reported business impact or affected users, we need to investigate the cause of these missing log entries to ensure compliance and traceability.

title: Database Query Timeouts on Load Balancer in EU-West Production
description: We are experiencing frequent database query timeouts on our production Load Balancer in the EU-West region. Since about 2 hours ago, roughly 32 users have reported delays or failures when accessing data-heavy reports. The timeout seems to happen consistently under moderate load. Could you please investigate the backend connection health?

title: Analytics Dashboard Staging - High Replication Lag
description: Our staging environment Analytics Dashboard is showing high replication lag, affecting about 10 users. We've traced this down and this is definitely a race condition in the data sync process causing the delay. The updates aren't propagating fast enough, leading to stale data on the dashboard. Please prioritize fixing the concurrency issue.

title: Critical: HTTP 429 and API Schema Errors on Production Analytics Dashboard (LATAM)
description: We are facing a critical issue in the LATAM production environment with the Analytics Dashboard. Starting this morning, the API is returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors along with API schema validation errors. This is impacting over 4,000 users and preventing them from accessing any analytics data. We need immediate assistance to restore service.

title: Intermittent HTTP 429 Errors on EU-Central Production Analytics Dashboard
description: We are seeing intermittent HTTP 429 errors on our production Analytics Dashboard in the EU-Central region. This is affecting approximately 34 users who are unable to load their dashboards sporadically. The error seems to happen during peak usage hours. Could you please check if there are any rate limit adjustments needed for our account?

title: Status Page Config Changes Not Reflecting (US-West)
description: I made some updates to our Status Page configuration in US-West production, but the changes are not taking effect and there is a data mismatch visible on the public page. It looks like the system didn't pick up my new settings. I believe this is happening because we are using an unsupported configuration option that isn't being recognized by the parser. Please advise on the correct config format.

title: Feature Flag and Configuration Issues on Payment Gateway v2 (EU-Central)
description: We have configured a new feature flag for the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-Central production environment, but it is not applying as expected. Additionally, other configuration changes we made seem to be ignored by the system. There is no user-facing impact yet (0 users affected), but we need to ensure the config is valid before we go live with the new feature. Please check if the configuration has been propagated.

title: TLS Handshake Failures and HTTP 502 on Load Balancer (Staging LATAM)
description: Our staging environment in LATAM is experiencing TLS handshake errors and HTTP 502 Bad Gateway responses when trying to connect to the Load Balancer. DNS lookup failures are also being reported in the application logs. This is currently affecting 2 internal testers. We suspect the certificate or DNS records for the LB might be misconfigured. Please assist.

title: Queue Manager Health Check Failing in ANZ Production
description: We are observing health check failures on the Queue Manager service in our ANZ production environment. The service appears unresponsive to requests, causing delays in our backend processing pipeline. This is impacting around 39 users who rely on the queue for task submission. Please check the health of the Queue Manager instances and restart if necessary.

title: Critical: TLS Handshake Error Blocking Refund Manager (Staging US-West)
description: We are encountering a critical TLS handshake error on the Refund Manager in our US-West staging environment. This is blocking all refund processing workflows, and although it's staging, we have 20,209 users (test accounts/simulated traffic) impacted which is affecting our load testing. The error prevents secure connections to the payment processor. Please investigate the SSL certificate or handshake protocol immediately.

title: SSO Integration: Users Seeing Wrong Data and Elevated Privileges in US-East
description: There is a severe issue with our SSO Integration Module in US-East production. Users are seeing data that does not belong to them, and some are gaining elevated privileges incorrectly. This is affecting 438 users and poses a significant security risk. We need to know why the SSO token mapping or permissions are resolving incorrectly. Please treat this as high priority.

title: Incorrect Proration and Undercharging in Fee Analyzer (Staging US-East)
description: In our US-East staging environment, the Fee Analyzer is calculating proration incorrectly, leading to undercharging scenarios. Additionally, some subscriptions are not renewing as expected. This is affecting 30 test users. We need to understand if the billing logic has been altered or if there is a bug in the proration calculation module. Please review the logs for these transactions.

title: Analytics Dashboard Webhook Retries Exhausted and API Errors (Staging ANZ)
description: We are seeing webhook retries exhausted, API schema errors, and empty API responses on the Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ staging environment. This is impacting 223 users. We have investigated the backend and believe this is caused by database contention slowing down the response times and causing the webhooks to time out. Please look into optimizing the database queries or scaling the DB resources.

title: Admin Console Features Not Working
description: Hey, the Admin Console is acting up. Some features aren't showing up and things are missing. We have a bunch of users trying to use it and it's not working right. Can you help? It's in production ME.

title: Refund Not Reflecting in Sandbox (ME)
description: We initiated a refund in the ME sandbox environment using the Payment Gateway v2, but the refund status is not reflecting correctly. It's unclear if the issue lies with the payment gateway itself or if the API gateway is failing to propagate the status update. This is affecting 43 users in the sandbox. Please check why the refund state isn't syncing.

title: Missing Entries in Audit Log for Data Pipeline (US-East Production)
description: We have noticed that our Data Pipeline in US-East production is not writing all expected entries to the audit log. Several critical data transformation events from the past 24 hours are missing, affecting compliance reporting for 56 users. We need to identify why the logging is incomplete and ensure all audit trails are captured.

title: Intermittent HTTP 429 errors in Payment Gateway v2 (LATAM)
description: We are seeing a high volume of HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) responses from the Payment Gateway v2 API in our production environment within the LATAM region. This started around 10:00 AM UTC today. Our monitoring shows that approximately 25% of our transaction attempts are failing due to these rate limits, which seems unusual given our traffic volume hasn't spiked. Can you check if there are stricter rate limits applied to our account or the region?

title: Feature flag not applying for new checkout flow (US-East)
description: The 'new_checkout_flow_v3' feature flag is not being applied correctly in our production environment (US-East region). We enabled this flag for 100% of our users yesterday, but only about 5% are seeing the new UI, while the rest are stuck on the legacy version. This is impacting roughly 400 users who are unable to complete purchases using the new method. Please investigate why the flag propagation is failing.

title: Consent records missing and retention policy not applied in ANZ
description: We have identified an issue with our data compliance settings in the Payment Gateway v2 for the ANZ region. Specifically, consent records for recent user sign-ups are missing from the audit logs, and the configured data retention policies are not being enforced. This affects a subset of 31 users. We need to ensure GDPR/local compliance, so please clarify why these records are not appearing and why deletion triggers aren't firing.

title: MFA Manager: Prompt not appearing and sessions expiring early
description: Users in our LATAM production environment are reporting that the MFA prompt is not appearing during login. Furthermore, those who do manage to log in are finding their sessions expire unexpectedly fast (within 15 minutes). We suspect the MFA Manager component is not triggering the authentication step correctly. This is affecting about 4 specific accounts so far, but it is blocking their workflow.

title: Incorrect tax, invoice, and proration calculations in Staging (APAC)
description: In our APAC staging environment, we are seeing significant discrepancies in billing calculations using Payment Gateway v2. The tax amounts are being calculated incorrectly, resulting in inaccurate invoices. Additionally, proration for mid-cycle upgrades is not working as expected, leading to wrong credit amounts. This is impacting our entire QA team (approx. 630 test users) and blocking our release validation.

title: Mobile App backend unresponsive in ME Staging
description: Our mobile application is currently unable to communicate with the backend services in the Middle East staging environment. The service appears to be completely unresponsive; API calls are timing out without returning any error codes. This is preventing our 38 internal testers from proceeding with feature verification. Please check the status of the mobile service endpoints in the ME region.

title: SSO Integration: MFA codes rejected and HTTP 401 errors
description: We are experiencing login failures with the SSO Integration Module in our US-West production environment. Users are receiving valid MFA codes via their authenticator apps, but the system rejects them and returns an HTTP 401 error. This is resulting in a complete login failure for approximately 52 users. The issue seems to be specific to the MFA validation step within the SSO flow.

title: Session Controller returning empty/malformed JSON in Sandbox (ANZ)
description: When interacting with the Session Controller in our ANZ sandbox environment, we are receiving API responses that are either completely empty or contain malformed JSON structures. This makes it impossible for our integration to parse the session data correctly. We are not seeing any specific HTTP error codes, just the invalid payload format. This is affecting our development tests, though no end-users are impacted yet.

title: Refunds not reflected and subscriptions not renewing (US-West)
description: We have a few isolated cases in our US-West production environment using Payment Gateway v2. Specifically, refunds issued via the dashboard are not appearing in the customer's account balance or transaction history. Additionally, some subscriptions that reached their expiration date have not renewed automatically. This is currently affecting 3 specific customer accounts.

title: Memory spikes without autoscaling trigger in ANZ Production
description: Our Payment Gateway v2 deployment in the ANZ region is experiencing severe memory usage spikes. However, the autoscaling policies configured for this environment are not triggering, causing the instances to hit memory limits and degrade performance. This is impacting service stability for roughly 204 users. We need urgent assistance to determine why the autoscaler is ignoring the high memory threshold.

title: Analytics Dashboard timeouts and missing webhook data (ANZ)
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ production environment is suffering from multiple issues. Mainly, the dashboard pages are timing out when loading reports. Simultaneously, our configured webhooks are not firing, meaning downstream systems are not receiving data updates. API calls related to analytics are also returning empty responses instead of the expected data arrays. This is blocking data visibility for 923 users.

title: SSO Integration: No MFA prompt and short session lifetimes
description: In our LATAM production setup, the SSO Integration Module is failing to present the MFA prompt during the authentication process. Users are bypassing the second factor entirely, and once logged in, their sessions are expiring unexpectedly after a very short duration. We believe the SSO module configuration for MFA enforcement is not taking effect. This has affected about 5 users so far.

title: Subscription not renewing in ANZ Production
description: We noticed that a subscription using Payment Gateway v2 in our ANZ production environment did not renew upon its expiration date. The status was marked as 'inactive' instead of transitioning to the next billing cycle. No payments were attempted. This is currently affecting only 1 account, so the overall business impact is low, but we need to understand the cause for our records.

title: CRITICAL: SSO Sync and Provisioning stuck for all users (ANZ)
description: We are facing a critical outage with the SSO Integration Module in our ANZ production region. The user synchronization process is stuck and not completing, and provisioning of new users is halted. This is preventing access for approximately 18,819 users. We need immediate assistance to unstick the sync jobs and restore provisioning capabilities.

title: Data loss and corrupted exports in Metrics Engine
description: Hi, we're having trouble with the Metrics Engine in our EU-West staging env. Some users are reporting missing data, and when we try to export the metrics, the files seem corrupted and don't open properly. We're not sure exactly when this started or which specific metrics are affected, but it's blocking our reporting tasks for about 20 people. Please help.

title: Critical Login Failures in US-West Production: MFA Codes Rejected for All Users
description: We are experiencing a critical outage affecting the Payment Gateway v2 login portal in the US-West region. Starting at 09:15 PST, approximately 6,540 users have been unable to log in. The system accepts the correct username and password, but when the 6-digit MFA code is entered, it is immediately rejected with an 'Invalid Code' error. Users have confirmed the codes are generated correctly and within the time window. This is blocking all customer access to the dashboard. Please investigate urgently as this is a P1 incident.

title: Cache Service health check failing in US-East Dev environment
description: Our development team in US-East is reporting that the Cache Service is failing its health checks. We are seeing consistent timeouts on the /health endpoint. This is preventing us from deploying new changes to the dev environment. While this doesn't affect production, it is blocking our sprint progress for about 15 developers.

title: SSO Integration Module: Bulk Import Failed and Provisioning Stuck in ME Sandbox
description: We are encountering significant issues with the SSO Integration Module in the ME sandbox environment. First, a bulk user import attempted last night failed completely with no specific error logs provided. Subsequently, we noticed that user provisioning tasks are stuck in a 'pending' state and not completing. There is also a noticeable synchronization delay when trying to manually sync groups. This is affecting 327 test accounts and blocking our UAT phase. Please advise on steps to reset the sync state or identify the import failure cause.

title: HTTP 429 Errors on SSO Module in EU-West - Identity Provider Outage?
description: Users in the EU-West production environment are receiving HTTP 429 'Too Many Requests' errors when trying to access applications via the SSO Integration Module. We have traced the issue to our Identity Provider (IdP) being unavailable for short intervals. We think this is definitely an identity provider outage causing the gateway to throttle requests. Since the IdP is the root cause, please coordinate with them or adjust our timeout settings to handle these transient outages better. This is affecting 36 users moderately.

title: Double Charges on Subscriptions in Payment Gateway v2 Dev - Monitoring Gap?
description: We are seeing duplicate charges on subscriptions in the Payment Gateway v2 development environment (US-West). About 19 test users were charged twice for their monthly plan. We suspect this is happening because there are insufficient monitoring/alerting mechanisms in place to catch these double-billing events before they complete. This seems like a definitely a Y problem (lack of visibility) rather than a code bug. Can we get a review of the alerting thresholds to ensure this doesn't happen in prod?

title: Notification Hub UI Misalignment in US-East Production
description: A critical UI issue has been identified in the Notification Hub for the US-East production region. The main notification panel and the 'Mark All Read' button are significantly misaligned with the rest of the interface, overlapping with the navigation bar. This visual defect is impacting 563 users and is considered high priority as it hinders the ability to dismiss notifications properly. The issue appears to have started after the latest frontend deployment. Please provide a fix or CSS override.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Incorrect Currency Conversion and Refund Issues in EU-West
description: In the EU-West production environment, we are observing discrepancies with Payment Gateway v2 transactions. Specifically, currency conversion rates appear incorrect, leading to overcharges on 3 transactions. Furthermore, when refunds are initiated, they are not reflecting in the user's account balance. It is unclear whether the issue stems from the payment processing logic itself or the downstream refund service handling these transactions. The impact is currently low as only 3 users are affected, but the financial discrepancy requires immediate investigation to determine the root cause.

title: CPU Spike affecting Data Export and Real-Time Metrics in ANZ Prod
description: We are detecting high CPU usage spikes on the servers hosting the Data Export Service in the ANZ production region. However, the Real-Time Metrics Stream also appears to be lagging or dropping data packets during these spikes. It is difficult to determine if the Data Export jobs are causing the resource exhaustion, or if the Metrics Stream is failing and causing backpressure on the exporters. This is affecting 40 users moderately. Please investigate which service is driving the load.

title: Billing Disputes Handler showing duplicate subscription charges in EU-Central Sandbox
description: Our QA team is testing the Billing Disputes Handler in the EU-Central sandbox environment. We are seeing that subscriptions are being charged twice when a dispute is initiated and then resolved. This affects 120 test records. We believe the issue is within the Billing Disputes Handler logic, as it seems to trigger a new billing cycle instead of updating the existing one upon resolution. Please check the handler's event processing.

title: Incorrect Invoices and Tax Calculations in Payment Gateway v2 US-West Prod
description: Critical billing errors are occurring in the Payment Gateway v2 (US-West, Production). Invoices generated for 829 users are displaying incorrect total amounts, and specifically, the tax calculation lines are wrong. We think this is caused by a capacity limitation in the tax calculation engine, which is timing out and defaulting to zero or previous values. This seems like a definitely a capacity problem given the high volume of users affected. Please scale up the tax service resources immediately.

title: Session Controller: Expired Certificate Warning in APAC Production
description: We are receiving alerts regarding an expired SSL/TLS certificate on the Session Controller service in the APAC production region. Currently, only 2 users have reported minor connection issues, and the business impact is low. However, this warning indicates that the certificate management process may have failed for this specific endpoint. Please renew the certificate for the Session Controller to prevent potential widespread login failures.

title: Onboarding Wizard missing features and form submission failure in US-East Staging
description: After the recent release in the US-East staging environment, the Onboarding Wizard is not functioning correctly. A specific feature expected in this release is missing from the UI. Additionally, when users reach the final step, a form element fails to render completely, causing the submission to fail. This is blocking our sole tester (1 user) from validating the new flow. We believe the issue is within the Onboarding Wizard component configuration.

title: Rate Limiter hitting capacity limits in US-East Production
description: We are observing that the Rate Limiter service in the US-East production environment is reaching its capacity limit. This is causing some requests to be throttled unexpectedly. Only 2 users have been affected so far, resulting in low business impact, but we want to ensure the Rate Limiter configuration is optimal for current traffic patterns. Please review the limit settings for the Rate Limiter.

title: SSO Integration Module Full Outage (503) in APAC Prod - DNS Config Error?
description: The SSO Integration Module in the APAC production region is currently experiencing a full outage. Users are receiving 503 Service Unavailable errors. 309 users are impacted, making this a high-priority incident. We have checked our upstream dependencies and everything looks fine. We think this is definitely caused by an incorrect DNS configuration pointing to a dead backend pool. Please verify the DNS records for the SSO endpoint immediately.

title: Payment Gateway v2: SSO Error Page Displayed in EU-West Production
description: Users accessing the Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West production environment are being redirected to an unexpected SSO error page instead of the payment dashboard. This affects 534 users and is considered a high-impact issue as it prevents payment processing. The error page does not provide specific details other than a generic 'Authentication Failed' message. Please investigate the integration between the Payment Gateway and the SSO provider.

title: Intermittent HTTP 429 errors and timeouts in Payment Gateway v2 (Dev)
description: We are experiencing significant instability in our development environment using the Payment Gateway v2 API. Specifically, we are seeing a high volume of HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) responses accompanied by client-side timeouts. This is currently blocking our integration testing for approximately 40 users. We haven't changed our request volume significantly, so this seems like a rate limit or capacity issue on the gateway side rather than our end.

title: SSO Integration Module returning API schema errors and 429s in Production
description: Our production environment is failing authentication for about 31 users. The SSO Integration Module is throwing inconsistent errors: sometimes we get an API schema validation failure when sending the payload, and other times we hit HTTP 429 rate limits. Since we are in production, this is impacting our live user base. Can you check if there have been recent changes to the accepted schema or if the rate limits for our tenant were modified?

title: Critical login failures across staging environment (Payment Gateway v2)
description: We are unable to log in to the staging environment for Payment Gateway v2. This appears to be a complete blockage rather than intermittent issues. Currently, 458 users in our staging setup are affected, which has halted our release validation process. Please investigate why authentication is failing across the board.

title: Billing charges appearing twice
description: Hi, we noticed that some of our customers are being charged twice for their subscriptions. The Tax Calculator seems to be involved in the process. This is causing a lot of support tickets. Please look into it.

title: SSO provisioning is stuck
description: User provisioning in the SSO Integration Module is stuck. It's not completing for some new employees. We need this resolved as it's affecting our onboarding flow.

title: SSO Login Loop and MFA rejection - likely dependency failure
description: Users are getting stuck in a redirect loop when trying to log in via SSO, and the MFA codes are being rejected even when correct. We've checked our configuration and it looks fine. This is definitely a dependency failure on your side or an upstream service issue. The application itself hasn't changed, so we are confident the root cause is a failed dependency within the SSO stack.

title: High rate of HTTP 429 errors impacting LATAM production traffic
description: We are seeing a spike in HTTP 429 errors on the Payment Gateway v2 API in the LATAM region. This is affecting roughly 276 users and causing transaction failures. We need to know if this is a temporary capacity issue or if there is a misconfiguration on our account's rate limits.

title: Notifications not delivering for Cohort Builder segments
description: Cohort Builder is successfully identifying the right user segments, but the associated notifications are not being delivered. This is impacting about 399 users who should have received alerts recently. Please check the notification dispatch service.

title: Analytics Dashboard intermittent failures and lack of failover
description: The Analytics Dashboard is experiencing intermittent outages where data fails to load or display correctly. What is more concerning is that when these failures occur, the system does not appear to failover to a backup instance or cached state; it simply errors out. This is affecting around 36 users and is disrupting our daily reporting.

title: SSO Sync stuck/delayed - suspected bad deployment
description: We are noticing significant delays and stuck states in the SSO Integration Module synchronization process. Since this started recently, we think it's because of a bad deployment that went out without proper QA. We need you to rollback or fix the deployment immediately as it is affecting 20 users.

title: Incorrect currency conversion and subscription renewal failures (APAC)
description: We have reported issues with Payment Gateway v2 in the APAC production region. Two specific symptoms are occurring: first, currency conversions are calculating incorrect totals for certain transactions; second, subscriptions that should auto-renew are failing to process. This is affecting 19 distinct user accounts.

title: Status Page form errors and text issues

We need to understand why this data is not being retained or displayed correctly. Please investigate the data storage and retrieval mechanisms for this region.

title: Stale data in Subscription Manager (EU-Central)
description: Our Subscription Manager in the EU-Central production environment is showing stale data. About 115 users are seeing outdated subscription statuses and billing information. We've done some internal checks and we are pretty sure this is caused by an infrastructure hardware failure on your end that is slowing down the write operations. Please address the underlying hardware issue to refresh the data.

title: API returns empty response in Analytics Dashboard (DEV)
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our development environment (LATAM) is returning empty API responses for key metrics. This is affecting over 1000 users and is considered a critical blocker. We believe this is definitely due to an incomplete migration of the data schema. The previous migration steps were not fully applied to this region's dev instance, causing the API to fail silently. Please complete the migration to fix the empty responses.

title: HTTP 429 and rate limit exceeded in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are seeing HTTP 429 errors and 'rate limit exceeded' messages in the Payment Gateway v2 (EU-Central, production). While no users are currently impacted, we are concerned about the stability. The errors seem to be occurring when the system tries to log high volumes of transaction details. It is unclear if the gateway is rejecting the requests because of the volume, or if the audit logging mechanism is causing a bottleneck that triggers the rate limiter. Please investigate the interaction between the gateway and the logging processes.

title: Feature flags not applying and config drift in Payment Gateway v2 (ANZ)
description: In the ANZ production environment, the Payment Gateway v2 is exhibiting two related issues: specific feature flags are not applying as expected for a subset of 9 users, and we are seeing 'config drift detected' alerts. We need help ensuring that the correct configurations are propagated and that the feature flags function as intended. The drift alerts suggest that the local config might be out of sync with the central server. Please assist in reconciling these configurations.

title: MFA prompt missing or code rejected in Token Service (ANZ)
description: Users in the ANZ region are reporting issues with the Token Service in production. Some users do not receive the MFA prompt when they expect it, while others receive the prompt but their MFA codes are consistently rejected. Although no specific user count was provided, this affects the authentication flow for all users relying on this service. Please investigate why the MFA challenge is not being triggered correctly or why the validation is failing for valid codes.

title: Overcharging issue in Payment Gateway v2 (Staging)
description: We are seeing a critical overcharge bug in the Payment Gateway v2 in our staging environment (LATAM). Approximately 12,000 test transactions are being processed with incorrect amounts, resulting in overcharges. This is blocking our UAT. We need you to fix the calculation logic within the gateway module itself, as it appears to be adding extra fees or misapplying discounts. Please prioritize this as it is halting our release validation.

title: Overcharge and chargeback notices in Billing Disputes Handler (APAC)
description: In the APAC production environment, the Billing Disputes Handler is showing records of overcharges, and several accounts have received chargeback notices. While the impact is currently marked as none for our internal metrics, we need to understand why these disputes are being flagged and why the system accepted charges that resulted in overbilling. Please review the logic for dispute handling and chargeback prevention to ensure this does not escalate.

title: Retention policy not applied in Payment Gateway v2 (Staging)
description: We are observing that the data retention policy is not being applied correctly in the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment (EU-West). Records that should have been archived or deleted according to our compliance settings are still present. This affects approximately 112 user profiles in the test dataset. We need to ensure that the retention rules are functioning as configured to pass our compliance audits. Please investigate why the scheduled cleanup tasks are not executing.

title: MFA code rejected and SSO error page in Payment Gateway v2
description: Users in the EU-Central production environment are encountering 'MFA code rejected' errors followed by an SSO error page when trying to access the Payment Gateway v2. This is affecting about 25 users and has a moderate business impact. We suspect the issue lies within the gateway's authentication module failing to validate the tokens properly. Please fix the validation logic within the gateway so users can log in successfully.

title: HTTP 429 and webhooks not firing in Analytics Dashboard (US-East)
description: The Analytics Dashboard in US-East production is returning HTTP 429 errors, and consequently, webhooks configured for data export are not firing. This is impacting 32 users who rely on these automated exports for their daily reports. We need to determine why the dashboard is hitting rate limits and causing the webhook failures. Please investigate the API call frequency and the webhook trigger mechanism.

title: Pagination broken and wrong totals in Admin Console (APAC)
description: We are experiencing issues with the Admin Console in the APAC production environment. The pagination is broken (clicking next page does not change the data), and the 'total count' calculation is showing an incorrect number. This affects 16 users with admin privileges. It is difficult to pinpoint if this is a UI rendering issue in the console or if the underlying data aggregation service is returning malformed JSON. Please investigate the data fetching and pagination logic.

title: Subscriptions not renewing and refunds missing in Payment Gateway v2
description: A large number of users (907) in the EU-Central production environment are reporting that their subscriptions are not renewing and that issued refunds are not reflected in their accounts. We are convinced that this is a product defect in the core renewal and refund processing engine of the Payment Gateway v2. Please treat this as a high-priority bug fix for the product code.

title: Export failing

title: Currency Converter slow

title: Onboarding Wizard: Backup failures and replication lag

title: Subscription issues

description: We have observed the Webhook Engine in APAC production experiencing intermittent failures. title: MFA codes failing with LDAP Connector in APAC production

title: SSO Module causing duplicate accounts and import failures in APAC Dev

title: Webhooks failing with HTTP 429 via Rate Limiter (US-West)
description: Our webhooks are not firing correctly in the US-West production environment. We are receiving HTTP 429 errors, indicating that requests are being blocked. We need to adjust the rate limiting or identify why legitimate traffic is being throttled.

title: Duplicate records in Data Pipeline sandbox (EU-West)
description: In our sandbox environment (EU-West region), the Data Pipeline is generating duplicate records. This issue is affecting 23 users and has a moderate business impact. The duplication is occurring during the data processing phase, leading to inaccurate datasets for testing. We need to identify why the pipeline is not deduplicating or is creating extra instances of the same record.

title: Expired password reset links in SSO Integration Module (EU-Central)
description: Users in our EU-Central production environment are reporting that password reset links generated by the SSO Integration Module are expiring before they can be used. description: In our EU-Central production environment, the SSO Integration Module is not displaying the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompt during login for certain users. title: Invoice Service double charge and refund issues (US-East)

Additionally, the refund processed for this double charge is not being reflected correctly. The business impact is low as it affects only one user, but the billing discrepancy needs to be resolved.

title: Account lockouts and certificate warnings in Payment Gateway v2 Sandbox (APAC)

Please investigate why the dashboard component is behaving this way.

No business impact as this is staging, but we need clarification on the scope.

This is affecting about 78 users who are unable to log in via SSO. We need immediate assistance to resume the sync.

title: Event Tracker intermittent failures and high latency in dev

We need this resolved to maintain our development velocity.

Despite being in sandbox, this is blocking our high-priority integration testing for 486 internal test users.

title: Analytics Dashboard issues: webhooks, timeouts, and rate limits
description: We are facing multiple issues with the Analytics Dashboard in our LATAM staging environment. Webhooks are not firing, we are seeing request timeouts, and we are hitting rate limit exceeded errors. This combination of issues is impacting our ability to test analytics features for 50 users. Please investigate the stability and quota limits.

title: Permission Engine showing wrong tenant data and 401 errors
description: The Permission Engine in our development environment (LATAM) is displaying data from the wrong tenant for some users. Additionally, we are receiving HTTP 401 errors when attempting to access certain resources. This is a high-impact security and functionality issue affecting 328 developers and testers. We need to ensure proper tenant isolation and authentication.

title: Analytics Dashboard webhooks stopped firing in ANZ production
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in the ANZ production region has stopped sending webhook notifications. The dashboard UI appears to be loading correctly, but the integrations relying on these webhooks are failing. This is impacting 145 users and disrupting downstream data flows. We believe the issue is with the dashboard's webhook generation logic.

title: Retention policy not applied in Analytics Dashboard (ANZ)
description: We have noticed that the retention policy is not being applied correctly within the Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ production environment. Old data that should have been purged is still visible. This is a minor issue affecting a small subset of users (4), but it does pose a potential data governance concern. Please investigate why the retention logic is not executing.

title: Emails not received from SSO Integration Module
description: Users in our EU-West production environment are not receiving emails triggered by the SSO Integration Module (e.g., welcome emails, password resets). This is impacting 235 users and is causing support tickets for login issues. We need to determine why the SSO module is failing to send these critical notifications.

title: Webhook Engine unresponsive and health checks failing
description: The Webhook Engine in our ME production environment is currently unresponsive. Our internal monitoring shows that health checks are failing consistently. This outage is impacting 778 users who rely on these webhooks for real-time updates. We need immediate intervention to restore service.

title: Payment Gateway v2 issues: data residency, retention, and audit logs
description: We are seeing multiple inconsistencies with the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-Central development environment. The data residency flag appears to be mismatched, the retention policy is not being applied, and audit log entries are missing for recent transactions. This is affecting 19 developers and raises compliance concerns. We believe the gateway component itself is misconfiguring these behaviors.

title: SSO sessions expiring unexpectedly in sandbox
description: Sessions managed by the SSO Integration Module are expiring much faster than expected in our US-West sandbox environment. Users are being forced to re-authenticate frequently, which is disrupting the user experience for 171 test users. We need to investigate why the session lifetime settings in the SSO module are not being honored.

This is a critical issue affecting 18,959 users who rely on these reports for daily operations. The output files are incomplete, and the numbers do not add up. We need to fix the Report Builder's data processing logic.

title: Password reset links from SSO Integration Module expiring too quickly
description: Password reset links generated by the SSO Integration Module in our EU-Central production environment are expiring almost immediately, before users can click them. This is causing login failures for 90 users and generating support tickets. We believe the token expiration logic within the SSO module is set incorrectly.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Audit logs incomplete and retention policy failing in EU-West Prod
description: We are seeing inconsistencies in our Payment Gateway v2 logs in the EU-West production environment. Specifically, audit logs are missing entries for several transactions, and we have noticed that consent records are not being created as expected. Additionally, our data retention policies do not seem to be applied correctly to these records. This is affecting 3 users in our admin team who rely on these logs for compliance. Business impact is currently low, but needs attention.

description: We are experiencing intermittent deployment failures using the Deploy Manager in our ANZ sandbox environment.
