title: UI rendering and alignment issues on Customer Portal in EU-West Sandbox
description: We noticed some cosmetic issues in the Customer Portal within the EU-West sandbox environment. Certain UI elements are not rendering correctly, and others appear misaligned on the page. There is no business impact as this is a sandbox environment and no active users are affected, but we would like these visual defects addressed.

title: HTTP 429 Errors from Config Manager in EU-Central Staging
description: Our team is encountering HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors when interacting with the Config Manager in the EU-Central staging environment. This is affecting around 27 users who are unable to update or retrieve configuration settings reliably. The rate limiting seems aggressive for our normal usage patterns in staging.

title: Critical Security Incident: Elevated Privileges Observed in Payment Gateway v2
description: We have detected elevated privileges being assigned or observed unexpectedly in the Payment Gateway v2 production environment in LATAM. This is a high-severity issue potentially affecting 645 users. Immediate investigation is required to determine the scope of the privilege escalation and ensure no unauthorized access has occurred.

title: OAuth Service rate limit exceeded in EU-West Production
description: A single user in the EU-West production environment is reporting that the OAuth Service has exceeded its rate limit, preventing them from obtaining tokens. This is a low-impact issue as only one user is affected, but it is blocking their specific workflow.

title: Blank Screen on Report Builder in ME Development Environment
description: The Report Builder application in the ME development environment is displaying a completely blank screen upon load. This affects 48 users who are unable to view or create reports. The issue seems to be widespread within the dev environment and is halting development work.

title: Full Outage of Analytics Dashboard in US-West Production with Pod Restarts
description: We are currently experiencing a full outage of the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West production environment. The service is down, and we observe that the underlying pods are restarting repeatedly. This is a high-impact incident affecting 376 users. We strongly believe this is a database contention issue causing the restarts. Please check the database performance metrics immediately.

title: Bulk Import Failure and Duplicate Accounts in SSO Integration Module (APAC Staging)
description: In the APAC staging environment, the bulk import feature of the SSO Integration Module has failed completely. Worse, this failure has resulted in the creation of duplicate user accounts. Approximately 44 users are affected by these duplicates and the inability to sync properly. This is disrupting our staging data integrity.

title: Missing Audit Logs and Data Residency Flag Mismatch in Identity Vault (ANZ Staging)
description: We have identified two issues in the Identity Vault within the ANZ staging environment. First, several entries are missing from the audit logs. Second, there is a mismatch in the data residency flags, which may indicate incorrect configuration or data placement. This affects 15 users and poses a compliance risk if not addressed.

title: LDAP Connector issues in LATAM Prod
description: The LDAP connector seems to be timing out for a couple of users. We also saw something on the vendor status page about an incident. Not sure if that's related. Impact is low for now.

title: SSO Synchronization Delay in APAC Production
description: We are seeing synchronization delays in the SSO Integration Module in the APAC production environment. While there is no direct business impact on end-users at the moment, the lag is concerning. We are pretty sure this is caused by a breaking API contract change from the upstream provider. Please verify if any recent API updates have altered the expected payload structure.

title: Duplicate Subscription Charges in Payment Gateway v2 (US-West Prod)
description: Customers in the US-West production environment are reporting being charged twice for their subscriptions via Payment Gateway v2. This issue affects approximately 39 users and has a moderate business impact. We need to identify why the billing process is triggering multiple charges and refund the affected customers.

title: Critical Issue: Webhook Failures, Malformed Responses, and 429s in Payment Gateway v2 (ME Prod)
description: We are facing a critical outage affecting 6,919 users in the ME production environment for Payment Gateway v2. The service is returning HTTP 429 errors, and when responses are received, they contain malformed JSON. Additionally, webhooks are not firing at all. This combination of errors is blocking all payment processing. Immediate assistance is required.

title: LDAP Connector failing with HTTP 500 in Staging
description: We are seeing a critical issue with the LDAP Connector in our staging environment (LATAM region). Since the last deployment, attempts to sync users are resulting in HTTP 500 errors. This is blocking our testing as approximately 1781 users are affected and cannot log in. Please investigate urgently.

title: Payment Gateway v2 issues in Dev: double charges and failed renewals
description: In our development environment (US-East), the Payment Gateway v2 is behaving incorrectly. We have observed subscriptions that were charged twice, while others failed to renew completely. Additionally, refunds are not being reflected in the dashboard. Only about 5 test users are impacted so far, so the business impact is currently low, but it is causing confusion in our dev workflow.

title: Critical: Payment Gateway v2 timeouts, 429s, and missing webhooks in Production (LATAM)
description: We are experiencing high-impact issues with Payment Gateway v2 in our production environment in the LATAM region. Users are reporting timeouts during checkout, and our backend is receiving HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors from the gateway. Furthermore, webhooks are not firing, which means our local state is out of sync. Approximately 814 users are affected. Please check for rate limit configurations or service degradation.

title: Config Manager sandbox TLS handshake failures due to expired certificate warnings
description: In our LATAM sandbox environment, the Config Manager is throwing TLS handshake errors. The logs indicate that a certificate has expired or is nearing expiration, causing connection failures. This is impacting about 174 users and is considered a high business impact issue because it blocks configuration updates. We need assistance renewing the certs or adjusting the validation rules.

title: Payment Gateway v2 overcharges and currency issues in Production (US-East)
description: We are seeing significant billing errors in production with Payment Gateway v2. Subscriptions are not renewing correctly, and some users are being overcharged with incorrect currency conversions applied. This is affecting around 326 users. We are confident this is due to an incomplete rollback on your side that didn't fully revert the billing logic. Please verify the rollback status and correct the charges.

title: Load Balancer dev environment out of disk space
description: Our development environment Load Balancer (US-West) has run out of disk space. No users are currently affected as this is a non-production environment, and there is no immediate business impact, but we are unable to push new updates to the LB configuration. Please clear logs or expand storage when possible.

title: Fee Analyzer high latency and slow response times in Production (EU-Central)
description: The Fee Analyzer service in our EU-Central production environment is experiencing severe performance degradation. We are observing high latency and consistently slow response times for all API calls. This is impacting approximately 868 users and is considered a high business impact issue as it delays fee calculations for end customers. We need this investigated immediately.

title: Secret Store returning HTTP 429 and webhooks not firing in Dev
description: In our US-East development environment, the Secret Store is intermittently returning HTTP 429 errors. As a result, webhooks that rely on retrieving secrets are not firing. This affects 2 developers/testers and has a low business impact, but it is hindering our ability to test integration flows. Please check if rate limits are being applied incorrectly in the dev tier.

title: SSO Integration Module returning empty responses in Sandbox (APAC)
description: We are encountering an issue with the SSO Integration Module in our APAC sandbox environment. When attempting to authenticate, the API returns an empty response body instead of the expected token or user profile. This is affecting about 32 users during testing and is a moderate business impact issue. It appears the module itself is failing to generate data.

title: Payment Gateway v2 currency conversion errors and missing refunds in Production (ME)
description: Our production Payment Gateway v2 in the ME region is calculating currency conversions incorrectly. Users are also reporting that refunds are not being reflected in their accounts, and some subscriptions have failed to renew. Approximately 154 users are affected, causing a high business impact. Please review the currency exchange rates and refund processing logic.

title: Invoice Service creating duplicate accounts in Development (EU-Central)
description: In our EU-Central development environment, the Invoice Service is creating duplicate accounts when processing invoices. This has affected about 47 test accounts and is causing a moderate business impact by cluttering our data and breaking reporting scripts. Please investigate why the uniqueness constraint is failing during invoice generation.

title: CRITICAL: Analytics Dashboard rate limiting (429s) and webhook failures affecting 20k+ users
description: We are experiencing a critical outage with the Analytics Dashboard in production (EU-West). The API is returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors, causing webhooks to stop firing entirely. This has resulted in stale data for approximately 20,742 users. We need immediate intervention to lift rate limits or restore service stability.

title: Wallet Service double charging users in Production (US-West)
description: The Wallet Service in our US-West production environment is incorrectly charging users twice for single transactions. This has also led to some subscriptions being renewed without proper balance checks (overcharges). About 29 users are affected, resulting in a moderate business impact due to refund requests. Please investigate the transaction idempotency in the Wallet Service.

title: Currency Converter invoices wrong
description: Hi, the Currency Converter is messing up our invoices. People are being undercharged. It's happening in production. Can you help?

title: Tax Calculator issues
description: Our Tax Calculator seems broken. Invoices are incorrect, some subscriptions didn't renew, and we are undercharging. Affecting 10 users in ANZ. Please look into it.

title: Double charges and wrong invoices on Production Gateway
description: We are seeing multiple issues with billing in our ANZ production environment. About 20 users have reported being charged twice for their subscriptions, and the invoice amounts are also incorrect. We know this is definitely a bad deployment issue on your end. Please roll back immediately.

title: High impact: Sessions expiring early and MFA bypass in EU-West
description:
We are experiencing widespread authentication issues in our EU-West production environment affecting approximately 693 users. Two specific symptoms are occurring:
1. User sessions are expiring unexpectedly shortly after login.
2. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompts are failing to appear, allowing users to bypass the second step.
This is causing a high business impact as security compliance is at risk and user productivity is halted. Please investigate the authentication flow immediately.

title: Event Tracker: White screen and missing features after update (ANZ)
description: Following the recent release of Event Tracker in our ANZ production environment, we are encountering critical UI issues. Approximately 64 users are reporting a 'white screen of death' when accessing the main dashboard. Additionally, several key tracking features that were present in the previous version are now completely missing from the interface. This is moderately impacting our data collection efforts. Please check if the release deployment was successful or if feature flags are misconfigured.

title: Critical: HTTP 401 Errors and Access Denied for SSO Integration (ANZ)
description: We are seeing a high-impact outage in our ANZ production environment related to the SSO Integration Module. Approximately 790 users are unable to log in, receiving 'HTTP 401 Unauthorized' errors followed by 'Access Denied' messages on the application frontend. This issue started suddenly and appears to be affecting all users attempting to authenticate via SSO. We require immediate assistance to restore access.

title: Webhooks failing and empty API responses in ME Dashboard
description: We are noticing that webhook retries are being exhausted and the API is returning empty responses for certain endpoints in our Middle East Analytics Dashboard production environment. Currently, this affects 1 user (likely an admin or automated process), so the business impact is low. We think it's because of a customer configuration error on our side regarding the webhook endpoints, but please verify if there is any system-side issue preventing these calls from succeeding.

title: Funnel Analyzer unresponsive in dev environment
description: Our Funnel Analyzer service in the development environment (ME) is unresponsive. We are also seeing config drift detected warnings. This affects 6 internal developers. We are pretty sure this is a capacity limitation issue because the dev server is under-resourced for the load we are testing. Please increase the capacity limits for our dev tenant.

title: Password Reset Emails Not Arriving / Links Expired (APAC)
description: We are receiving reports from users in the APAC production environment that password reset emails are either not arriving at all or arriving too late for the link to be valid (expired). No users are currently blocked from working, but this creates friction for account recovery. Please check the email delivery status and link expiration settings for the OAuth service.

title: High Latency and Intermittent Failures in ME Dev Dashboard
description: Our development team in the ME region is experiencing severe performance issues with the Analytics Dashboard. We are seeing high latency, intermittent failures, and notably slow performance when accessing the dashboard via mobile apps. This is impacting the workflow of approximately 433 users during their development and testing cycles. Please investigate the performance bottlenecks in the dev environment.

title: APAC Production Dashboard: Out of Disk Space Alert
description: We have received alerts indicating that the Analytics Dashboard in our APAC production environment is running out of disk space. This is currently affecting 331 users who are unable to load new data or save changes. This is a high-impact issue as it threatens data integrity and availability. Please expand storage capacity or investigate what is consuming the space urgently.

title: Data Pipeline Issues: Disk Critical, Backup Failed, DB Pool Exhausted (APAC)
description: We are observing multiple related symptoms in our APAC production Data Pipeline environment affecting 92 users. Disk usage has reached a critical level, the nightly backup job failed to complete, and we are seeing database connection pool exhaustion errors. This combination is causing moderate disruption to data processing tasks. Please investigate the storage and database resource allocation.

title: EU-West Config Manager: Intermittent Failures and Crashes
description: Our Config Manager application in the EU-West production environment is behaving erratically. We are seeing intermittent failures, occasional application crashes, and at least one report of a full outage event. While no users are currently blocked (impact is none), the instability is concerning and could lead to future outages. Please check the stability of the service.

title: SSO MFA Prompt Not Appearing for Single User (EU-West)
description: A specific user in our EU-West production environment is reporting that the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompt is not appearing during login via the SSO Integration Module. This affects only 1 user, so the business impact is low. Please check if there are any user-specific configuration issues or if the MFA trigger logic is failing for this account.

title: Stale Data Displayed in Staging Analytics (LATAM)
description: We are seeing stale data in the Analytics Dashboard in our LATAM staging environment. Approximately 24 users are viewing outdated metrics. It is unclear whether this is due to a synchronization issue with the underlying data sources or a problem with how the dashboard is pulling from the catalog. The data seems to stop updating at a specific point, but we cannot determine if the fault lies with the dashboard rendering or the data availability layer.

title: Billing errors in dev
description: Hey, something is wrong with the payment gateway in dev (US-East). Some subscriptions aren't renewing and others are getting charged twice. It's a bit confusing and only affects like 5 people right now so it's not urgent but please look into it.

title: Critical Billing Issues in APAC Production: Refunds, Renewals, and Currency
description:
We are experiencing multiple high-impact billing issues in our APAC production environment affecting 109 users. The specific problems are:
1. Refunds are not being reflected in customer accounts.
2. Subscriptions that should have renewed are not doing so.
3. Currency conversions are incorrect for multi-currency transactions.
Please investigate these payment processing failures immediately as they are causing significant customer dissatisfaction and revenue discrepancies.

title: MFA codes being rejected for SSO login in Production (ME)
description: We are experiencing a significant issue with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment. Since this morning, approximately 38 users are unable to complete their login process because their MFA codes are being consistently rejected as invalid. This is blocking our staff from accessing internal tools. The error happens specifically at the second step of authentication. Can you please investigate why valid TOTP codes are being failed by the system?

title: Analytics Dashboard exports returning truncated files in Sandbox
description: Our team in the APAC region is reporting that data exports from the Analytics Dashboard are arriving incomplete. When we attempt to download large datasets in our sandbox environment, the resulting files are truncated and cannot be opened properly. This issue is affecting our ability to prepare reports for 219 users who rely on this data flow. Please check if there is a limit or a bug causing the file generation to stop prematurely.

title: User accounts locking out unexpectedly in Production (EU-Central)
description: We have noticed that around 53 users in our EU-Central production environment are getting locked out of their accounts. They did not enter incorrect passwords multiple times. The lockout seems to happen randomly, sometimes right after they log in successfully. We aren't sure if this is a permissions rule triggering incorrectly or if the user provisioning process is updating their status wrongly. This is impacting moderate business operations.

title: Billing Disputes Handler showing certificate expired warning and access denied
description: I'm trying to access the Billing Disputes Handler in our US-West production instance, but I keep getting an 'Access Denied' error. Additionally, the browser flags a 'certificate expired warning' right before the access failure. Only two of us are trying to do this, so the impact is low, but I need to process a dispute. It looks like the SSL setup for this module might have lapsed.

title: Missing conversion records in Currency Converter (EU-West)
description: We have observed that some historical exchange rate records are missing from the Currency Converter tool in the EU-West production region. When querying specific date ranges, the results return empty or incomplete sets, even though we know transactions occurred. Currently, this is not affecting active users, but we need to ensure the historical data integrity for auditing purposes.

title: Currency Converter issue in staging
description: Hey, the currency converter is acting up in staging. We think someone got charged too much. Can you check it out?

title: SSO module down or unstable
description: SSO is not working for about 30 of us. We get errors when trying to log in. Sometimes it works, sometimes it just hangs or fails completely. Please fix.

title: Overcharge detected in Payment Gateway v2 sandbox transactions
description: During testing in our APAC sandbox environment, we noticed that certain transactions processed via Payment Gateway v2 are resulting in overcharges. The total amount collected exceeds the invoice sum. This needs to be resolved before we move to production. No real customers are affected yet, but the logic seems flawed for multi-item carts.

title: Analytics logs weird in staging
description: Audit logs aren't looking right. Seems like retention policy isn't working. Missing entries.

title: Payment Gateway issues
description: Got a chargeback and double charge. Also payment declined. EU Central prod. Help.

title: Database timeouts and deadlocks affecting Secret Store in US-West Prod
description: We are encountering intermittent errors when retrieving secrets from the Secret Store. Our backend services are reporting database query timeouts and deadlock detected errors. This has affected two specific applications that rely heavily on frequent secret fetches. The impact is currently moderate, but stability is compromised. We need to optimize the underlying database performance or check for locking issues.

title: Webhooks not firing and retries exhausted in Analytics Dashboard (Dev)
description: In our development environment, the Analytics Dashboard is failing to trigger webhooks for new data events. After the initial failure, the system exhausts its retry attempts without successfully delivering the payload. This is blocking integration testing for 21 developers who rely on these automated notifications. Please investigate why the event bridge is not emitting signals.

title: Slow payments in dev
description: Payment gateway is slow. Taking too long to respond. 60+ people waiting.

title: Staging SSO sync stuck - definitely our config error
description: The SSO integration module in our APAC staging environment is stuck in a syncing state and hasn't progressed in hours. This is blocking 141 users. We know this is definitely a configuration error on our end where we missed setting up a specific mapping rule. Please guide us on how to fix the config so the sync resumes.

title: Config Manager missing env vars - likely token bug
description: We are seeing missing environment variables in the Config Manager for our ME production cluster. About 37 services are failing to start. This is almost certainly due to a token expiration handling bug in the manager, causing it to drop variables it can't decrypt. Please patch the token logic.

title: Customer Portal blanking out in Dev - definitely operator error
description: We are seeing blank screens on the Customer Portal when accessing the development environment. Honestly, this is definitely operator error on our side. We think it's because someone in the QA team forgot to clear their cache or typed the URL wrong. We have 3 users affected but it's low priority since we know it's just human mistake. Please confirm we are right about the cause.

title: Corrupted Export Files from Analytics Dashboard in Development
description: When attempting to export report data from the Analytics Dashboard in our development environment, the resulting CSV and Excel files are corrupted and cannot be opened. This issue is affecting a batch job that processes approximately 853 records per run. The export completes without error messages, but the file contents are garbled or the file size is 0 bytes. We need this resolved as it is blocking our data validation workflow.

title: SSO Integration Module: HTTP 403 and Incorrect Data Display in Production
description: In our production EU-Central region, we are experiencing issues with the SSO Integration Module. Users are encountering HTTP 403 Forbidden errors when trying to access certain internal tools after logging in via SSO. Additionally, some users who do manage to log in are seeing wrong data on their profile pages, suggesting access rights are being granted incorrectly or mapped to the wrong user profiles. Currently, there are no reported business impacts for this specific ticket as it seems to be an isolated configuration issue, but it needs to be fixed.

title: Intermittent Deployment Failures in Deploy Manager (EU-Central Prod)
description: We are observing intermittent failures when using Deploy Manager in the EU-Central production environment. Approximately 2 deployments failed in the last 48 hours, while others succeeded without issue. The failures occur randomly during the build or release stage. There is no consistent error code, but the status shows 'Failed' after a timeout. Impact is currently low as we can retry, but the unpredictability is concerning.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Refunds not reflecting and duplicate charges in ANZ
description: We are experiencing issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in the ANZ production region. Specifically, refunds issued through the system are not being reflected in the customer's bank account or our ledger. Simultaneously, some subscriptions are being charged twice for the same billing period. We cannot determine if this is a data synchronization issue between the gateway and our records or a problem with the API processing logic itself. 6 users are currently affected.

title: CRITICAL: Double Billing and Undercharging Issues with Payment Gateway v2
description: We are facing a critical issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in the ANZ production environment. A large number of customers (approx. 11,281 affected users) are reporting that they were charged twice for their subscriptions. Conversely, some other accounts show an undercharge where the correct amount was not deducted. This discrepancy in billing amounts is causing significant customer support volume and financial reconciliation issues. Immediate investigation is required.

title: Bulk User Import Failure in SSO Integration Module
description: We attempted a bulk import of user accounts into the SSO Integration Module in the Middle East production region, and the entire job failed. No users were created, and no partial successes were reported. The system returned a generic failure status after running for several minutes. This is impacting 57 users who are currently unable to access the platform. We need to know why the bulk operation aborted.

title: Data Pipeline Service Unresponsive and Feature Flags Not Working
description: We believe the Data Pipeline is broken in our US-East production environment. The service has become unresponsive for about 37 users, causing delays in data processing. Furthermore, feature flags we configured specifically for this pipeline are not applying correctly to the data streams. We are seeing stale data being processed regardless of the flag settings. We need support to check the pipeline connectivity and flag propagation.

title: Analytics Dashboard API Returning Empty Responses and 429 Errors
description: In the Middle East production region, our Analytics Dashboard is encountering severe issues. The API endpoints are frequently returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors, leading to empty responses on the frontend. Additionally, webhooks that should trigger on specific dashboard events are not firing at all. This is affecting 17 users and has a moderate business impact as real-time data visualization is unavailable.

title: KPI Tracker Export Corruption and Duplicate Records
description: We think the KPI Tracker is malfunctioning in the ANZ production region. When we export KPI data, the files appear corrupted or unreadable. Additionally, we are seeing duplicate records appearing within the tracker interface itself. This affects 32 users and has a moderate impact on our reporting accuracy. We need to know why the tracker is generating bad data.

title: Secret Store Connection Refused and HTTP 502 Errors in Production
description: Applications relying on the Secret Store in the ANZ production region are failing to retrieve credentials. We are seeing 'Connection Refused' errors followed by HTTP 502 Bad Gateway responses from our load balancers. This is impacting 57 users who cannot access services dependent on these secrets. The issue started abruptly and is causing moderate disruption to our services.

title: Invoice Service Generating Overcharges for ANZ Customers
description: We have identified an issue with the Invoice Service in the Middle East production region where customers are being overcharged. The invoice totals do not match the agreed-upon pricing tiers. This has a high business impact and affects approximately 781 users. We need immediate assistance to stop these incorrect invoices from being sent and to identify the root cause of the calculation error.

title: Critical SSO Integration Failure: Federation Mismatch and Expired Password Resets
description: We are experiencing a critical outage with the SSO Integration Module in the APAC production region. Users are hitting SSO error pages upon login attempts. Logs indicate a mismatch in federation metadata between our IdP and the service provider. Additionally, password reset links sent via the SSO module are expiring immediately or showing as invalid. This is blocking 1,517 users from accessing the platform.

title: Autoscaling Not Triggering Due to Quota Exceeded Errors
description: In our EU-West staging environment, we are observing that autoscaling policies are not triggering as expected. The Rate Limiter seems to be involved, as we are seeing 'Quota Exceeded' errors. It is unclear if this is a configuration issue with the Rate Limiter or if the Service Registry is not correctly reporting instance counts for the autoscaler. 24 users are experiencing delayed or failed scaling events, resulting in moderate performance impact.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Webhook Failures and Empty API Responses in Dev
description: We are testing the Payment Gateway v2 in the Middle East development environment and encountering issues. Webhooks are not firing upon successful transaction events. When they do attempt to fire, the retries are being exhausted without success. Furthermore, API calls to retrieve transaction status are returning empty responses instead of the expected JSON data. This is affecting 23 developers and slowing down our integration testing.

title: Subscriptions not renewing and incorrect billing amounts (APAC)
description: Hi team, we are seeing multiple issues with our Payment Gateway v2 in production for the APAC region. Several customers who were supposed to auto-renew their subscriptions this week did not get charged, and their accounts are now flagged as lapsed. Additionally, for the transactions that did go through, the final amounts charged seem lower than the agreed plan price. We aren't sure if the system is failing to pick up the correct currency rate or if the renewal logic itself is broken, but both symptoms are happening simultaneously and affecting about 36 users. Please investigate urgently.

title: Mobile App crashes to white screen and displays wrong totals
description: Our Mobile App is completely unusable for a large portion of our user base. When users open the checkout screen, the app frequently freezes and shows a white screen of death. In cases where it doesn't crash, the total amount displayed in the cart is calculated incorrectly, often showing a value that doesn't match the sum of the items. This is causing massive support tickets and refunds. We need this fixed immediately as it is blocking revenue for hundreds of customers.

title: Incorrect currency conversion and missing refunds in Subscription Manager (EU-West)
description:
Hello, we are experiencing two distinct issues with the Subscription Manager in the EU-West production environment:

1. Currency Conversion: Recent transactions for customers billed in EUR are showing incorrect totals. The conversion rates applied seem to be outdated or miscalculated, resulting in discrepancies between the invoice and the actual charge.
2. Refund Status: We processed refunds for approximately 15 customers last week, but the Subscription Manager dashboard still shows these transactions as 'Completed' or 'Pending'. The refunds are not being reflected in the user's billing history or the system status.

This impacts our financial reconciliation and customer trust. Please advise on the cause for both issues.

title: Admin Console UI elements are misaligned and broken
description: The Admin Console is displaying UI elements incorrectly. Buttons, text fields, and navigation bars are overlapping or shifted out of place, making the console difficult to navigate. This started happening suddenly and is affecting our ability to manage settings. We believe this is a front-end rendering issue within the console itself, as the layout looks broken across all browsers we have tested.

title: Unexpected session expiration in SSO Integration Module (Sandbox)
description: We are testing the SSO Integration Module in our sandbox environment (EU-Central) and noticing that user sessions are expiring much sooner than configured. Typically, the session timeout is set to 60 minutes, but users are being logged out after approximately 10-15 minutes of activity. This happens regardless of user role or specific application. The logs show the token validation passing initially, but the session state is lost shortly after. This is disrupting our testing workflow for about 69 users.

title: Analytics Dashboard: Query timeouts and index corruption warnings
description:
Hello, we are encountering performance issues with the Analytics Dashboard in the EU-Central production environment. Specifically:

1. Several complex queries are timing out after 30 seconds, returning a generic error message to the user.
2. The system logs are showing repeated warnings about 'index corruption detected' on the underlying database tables used by the dashboard.

We haven't noticed any end-user complaints yet, but these errors appear in our internal monitoring tools. We would like to know if this requires manual intervention or if it resolves automatically.

title: Password reset links expiring immediately in Payment Gateway v2 (Dev)
description: Critical issue in our development environment (EU-West) with Payment Gateway v2. When users request a password reset, the link generated in the email is invalid the moment it is clicked. The error message states 'Link Expired'. We have verified that the email is being delivered instantly and the user is clicking the link within seconds of receipt. This is blocking all QA testing for user authentication flows and affects our entire dev team's workflow. Please check the token generation and validation logic.

title: Missing consent records in Analytics Dashboard
description: Hi, we noticed that some consent records seem to be missing from the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West region. A few customers who should have active consents are not showing up in our reports. We aren't sure when this started or if it's affecting everyone or just specific segments. Can you please look into why these records might be missing?

title: SSO Error page displayed during login (Staging)
description: Users in our US-East staging environment are encountering a generic SSO error page when attempting to log in via the SSO Integration Module. The error message is vague and does not specify whether the authentication failed or if there was an issue retrieving user permissions. Some users report that they can log in successfully if they wait and retry, while others are blocked entirely. This makes it difficult to determine if the core authentication service is down or if there is a synchronization issue with the group/role assignments required for post-login access. This is a critical blocker for our 14,000+ staging users.

title: Payment Gateway v2 timing out for LATAM production
description: Our Payment Gateway v2 is experiencing severe timeouts in the LATAM production region. Transactions are hanging for a long time before eventually failing with a timeout error. This is happening for all payment methods and is blocking sales for thousands of customers. We believe there is an issue with the gateway's processing speed or responsiveness. Please investigate why the payments are not completing and are instead timing out.

title: Subscription Manager overcharging customers
description: We have reports of customers being overcharged when using our Subscription Manager. Several users in the US-West region have contacted support stating that the amount deducted from their account was higher than their subscription plan. We checked our internal logs and see that the Subscription Manager is calculating the final bill incorrectly. Please fix the billing logic in the Subscription Manager as this is causing financial discrepancies for our customers.

title: Certificate warning in Payment Gateway v2
description: Hello, we are seeing a certificate expired warning in the Payment Gateway v2 logs for our LATAM production environment. A few of our integrations are failing, and we suspect this is related to the SSL/TLS certificate. We aren't sure exactly when it started or which specific endpoints are affected, but it's causing issues for about 10 users. Could you please check the status of the certificates?

title: Unexpected chargeback notices received via Payment Gateway v2
description: Hi team, we have received several chargeback notices through the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-West production environment. These chargebacks appear to be for transactions that were completed successfully and for which customers have not reported any issues. We have verified the transaction details on our end and they seem correct. We are concerned that these might be erroneous or fraudulent chargebacks being pushed through the gateway. Please investigate why these notices are appearing and provide any relevant dispute documentation if possible.

title: KPI Tracker: Data residency flag mismatch and audit log gaps
description:
We have identified two anomalies in the KPI Tracker tool (EU-Central production):

1. Data Residency Flags: Some records are displaying a data residency flag that does not match the configured region for the user. For example, EU users are showing flags associated with other regions.
2. Audit Logs: There are noticeable gaps in the audit logs for certain administrative actions. We cannot trace who performed specific configuration changes during the last 48 hours.

These issues do not currently impact end-users, but they pose compliance risks. Please advise.

title: Access denied errors for authorized users in SSO Integration Module
description: Hello, we are experiencing 'Access Denied' and 'Permission Denied' errors for users who should have valid access rights in the US-West production environment. These users are logging in successfully via the SSO Integration Module but are then blocked from accessing specific applications they are licensed for. The error occurs randomly for about 31 users and persists until they clear their cache and re-authenticate. We believe the SSO token is not carrying the correct permissions or the module is failing to validate them against our internal ACLs. Please investigate.

title: Bulk user import failing and provisioning stuck in Dev environment
description: We are experiencing issues with the SSO Integration Module in our development environment. When attempting to perform a bulk import of users, the process fails partially. Additionally, user provisioning appears to be stuck for new accounts. This is currently affecting 3 developers trying to test the integration.

title: Permission Engine UI glitches and submission errors in Dev
description: I'm noticing several issues with the Permission Engine in the development environment. There is a UI element that is misaligned on the permissions configuration page. More critically, the form fails to submit when trying to save changes, and when calculations are run, the totals displayed are incorrect. This is impacting 2 users in the ANZ region.

title: Payments issues
description: Hey, we have some problems with the Payment Gateway v2. People are getting charged twice and some payments are just declining without reason. It's happening to a lot of users in APAC. Please check.

title: Security Alert: Elevated privileges and certificate warnings in Prod SSO
description: We have detected two concerning issues with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment (EU-Central). First, we are seeing elevated privileges being observed where they shouldn't exist. Second, users are receiving certificate warning messages upon login. This is a high-impact issue affecting 358 users and requires immediate investigation.

title: Issues with Invoice Service in Sandbox
description: We are seeing strange behavior in the Invoice Service within our sandbox environment. Payments are being declined, and conversely, some subscriptions are being charged twice. We have also received chargeback notices related to these transactions. This is affecting about 62 users in the ME region.

title: Critical: Analytics Dashboard API returning 500 errors and rate limit hits
description: The Analytics Dashboard is currently unstable in production. We are encountering HTTP 500 errors when making API calls, accompanied by schema errors. Additionally, we are hitting rate limits unexpectedly. This is a critical impact affecting nearly 3,000 users in the EU-West region.

title: Queue Manager: Missing audit logs and privilege issues
description: We are seeing missing entries in the audit logs for the Queue Manager, along with elevated privileges being observed on certain accounts. We think this is definitely a schema mismatch problem that occurred during the last update. Please verify this ASAP as it is affecting over 4,700 users in production.

title: TLS Handshake Failures and Certificate Expiry in Customer Portal
description: Users are unable to access the Customer Portal due to TLS handshake errors. Simultaneously, we are receiving warnings that the SSL certificate has expired or is invalid. This is a critical outage affecting approximately 12,000 users in the US-East region.

title: Analytics Dashboard timeouts and webhook delivery failures
description: The Analytics Dashboard is experiencing frequent timeouts during data retrieval. Furthermore, webhooks configured to trigger on specific events are not firing. This is disrupting our operations significantly and affecting 4,200 users in the APAC production environment.

title: Payment Gateway v2 unresponsive in Staging
description: The Payment Gateway v2 in our staging environment is unresponsive. No users are currently being impacted in production, but this is blocking our QA team from proceeding with tests.

title: SSO Errors and Duplicate Accounts in Payment Gateway Integration
description: We are encountering an SSO error page when users attempt to access the Payment Gateway v2. Consequently, duplicate accounts are being created for existing users. We also suspect a federation metadata mismatch might be the root cause. This is affecting 158 users in the US-East production environment.

title: Unexpected Session Expiry in Payment Gateway Sandbox
description: In our sandbox environment, users of the Payment Gateway v2 are experiencing unexpected session expirations. They are being logged out frequently without completing their transactions. This is moderately impacting 58 users in the LATAM region.

title: Cache Service: Logout issues, cert warnings, and missing audit logs in Staging
description: We are observing multiple symptoms with the Cache Service in staging. Users are being unexpectedly logged out. We also see certificate warnings and notice that entries are missing from the audit logs. This is affecting 48 users in the ANZ region.

title: Data Pipeline timeouts in Production
description: Our Data Pipeline is experiencing frequent timeouts in the production environment. This is slowing down data processing and affecting approximately 39 users in the US-East region.

title: Missing feature and form submission failure in Invoice Service
description: After the recent release, we noticed a feature is missing in the Invoice Service. Additionally, when trying to submit certain forms, the request fails. We aren't sure if this is an issue with the invoice generation itself or the merchant onboarding flow that triggers it. This is affecting 15 users in EU-West production.

title: Webhook Engine failing with DNS lookup errors in Staging (ME)
description: We are experiencing consistent DNS lookup failures when the Webhook Engine attempts to process events in our staging environment. The webhooks are not being delivered at all because the service cannot resolve the target hostnames. This is impacting approximately 540 internal users who rely on this for integration testing. Please investigate the DNS configuration for the ME region as soon as possible.

title: Payment Gateway v2 returning malformed JSON or empty responses in Prod
description: Our production Payment Gateway v2 integration is breaking. When we send transaction requests, we are intermittently receiving malformed JSON responses or completely empty bodies. This is causing our checkout process to fail for 1,773 users. We suspect an issue with how the gateway is serializing data or handling the request payload. Need urgent assistance as this is a critical revenue blocker.

title: Onboarding Wizard stuck in provisioning/sync state for new users
description: New users attempting to use the Onboarding Wizard in the US-West production environment are getting stuck. The process hangs at the 'provisioning' or 'sync' stage and never completes, resulting in significant synchronization delays. This is currently affecting 8,691 users and is a critical blocker for our customer acquisition flow. Please check the backend provisioning jobs.

title: Self-Service Hub UI elements misaligned in APAC Staging
description: We noticed that several UI elements in the Self-Service Hub are misaligned in the APAC staging environment. This is definitely an unsupported configuration problem on our end that we need to fix, but we are unsure which specific setting is causing the layout shift. It's affecting about 33 users during UAT. Please advise on the correct configuration to resolve the display issue.

title: Payment Gateway v2 webhooks failing with exhausted retries in ANZ Staging
description: In our ANZ staging environment, webhook deliveries from Payment Gateway v2 are failing and quickly exhausting their retry attempts. We are seeing 'retries exhausted' errors in the delivery logs for about 37 test accounts. This prevents us from validating the integration properly. Please help us understand why the webhooks are not succeeding on the first few attempts.

title: Payment Gateway v2 data residency flags mismatch and audit log gaps
description: We are seeing discrepancies in the Payment Gateway v2 production environment in EU-West. Specifically, the data residency flags are mismatching with our configured location, and we have detected gaps in the audit logs. This affects 77 users and is a moderate compliance concern. We believe the gateway itself is mislabeling the data origin. Please review the audit trail configuration.

title: Role Manager MFA prompt not appearing and unexpected session expirations
description: Users in the LATAM staging environment for Role Manager are reporting that the MFA prompt is not appearing during login attempts. Additionally, existing sessions are expiring unexpectedly shortly after authentication. This is affecting 22 users and blocking our security testing. Please check if the MFA enforcement policies are correctly applied in this region.

title: Analytics Dashboard webhooks not firing in EU-Central Production
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our EU-Central production environment is not triggering webhooks for certain events. We expect real-time notifications to flow to our downstream systems, but nothing is coming through. This is impacting 263 users and delaying our data processing pipelines. Please investigate the webhook trigger configuration for this region.

title: Feature flags not applying correctly in Analytics Dashboard (EU-Central)
description: We are unable to enable new features for specific cohorts using the Analytics Dashboard in EU-Central production. The feature flags are being set but are not applying to the 464 affected users. This is blocking a planned rollout. Please check the flag propagation logic and ensure it matches the user segments defined.

title: Self-Service Hub showing white screen of death in ANZ Production
description: When accessing the Self-Service Hub from the ANZ production environment, users are encountering a white screen of death. The page fails to render completely. Although there are currently no reported affected users, this is a critical display failure that needs investigation to prevent future outages. Please check the frontend build or rendering service.

title: Cache Service high replication lag and index corruption warnings
description: Monitoring alerts have triggered for the Cache Service in LATAM production, indicating high replication lag and potential index corruption. While no users are currently reporting issues, we are concerned about data consistency. Please investigate the replication status and verify the integrity of the cache indexes to prevent performance degradation.

title: Config drift detected on Analytics Dashboard in APAC
description: Our automated checks have flagged configuration drift on the Analytics Dashboard in the APAC production environment. The current state does not match the expected configuration template. This is a low-impact issue affecting 9 users, but we want to resolve it to ensure stability. Please help identify which specific parameters have drifted.

title: Missing entries and gaps in Analytics Dashboard audit logs
description: We are noticing that the audit logs for the Analytics Dashboard in US-West production are incomplete. There are missing entries and gaps in the timeline where actions were taken by 18 users. This is a moderate concern for our compliance auditing. Please investigate why certain events are not being recorded in the audit trail.

title: SSO Integration Module audit log gaps and certificate expiration warnings
description: The SSO Integration Module in US-East production is generating warnings about an expired certificate, and we are also seeing missing entries in the associated audit logs. This affects 48 users and is causing intermittent login issues. Please check the certificate rotation schedule and the logging agent to ensure all SSO events are captured.

title: Payment Gateway v2 causing duplicate charges and invoice errors
description: We are receiving multiple reports of duplicate charges and incorrect invoices via Payment Gateway v2 in ANZ production. This is impacting 388 users. We think this is happening because of a known product limitation in the gateway's retry logic that we haven't addressed yet. Please confirm if this is the expected behavior and how we can mitigate these billing errors.

title: SSO MFA bypass and duplicate user creation in EU-West production
description: We are experiencing two critical issues with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-West production environment. First, the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompt is completely missing for users attempting to log in via SSO; they are being granted access immediately after credential verification without being challenged for a second factor. Second, instead of mapping to existing user profiles, the system is creating duplicate accounts for these users, leading to identity confusion and permission errors. This is affecting approximately 226 users and poses a significant security risk. Please investigate why MFA is not triggering and why user deduplication/mapping is failing.

title: Critical latency and timeouts in OAuth Service (EU-West Sandbox)
description: Our OAuth Service in the EU-West sandbox environment is suffering from severe performance degradation. Response times have spiked to the point where most requests are timing out or failing completely. This is causing a bottleneck for over 1,355 users currently testing in this environment, effectively blocking our validation processes. We need this resolved urgently as the service is unusable for our integration testing.

title: Webhooks not firing for Analytics Dashboard in ANZ Staging
description: We are noticing that webhooks configured for the Analytics Dashboard are not firing in our ANZ staging environment. When events occur that should trigger a notification, the webhook listener receives nothing. It is unclear if the dashboard is failing to dispatch the event or if the API gateway layer is intercepting or dropping the request before it reaches our endpoint. This impacts about 29 users who rely on these automated alerts for their workflows.

title: Subscription Manager UI rendering errors and blank screens in ME Staging
description: Users accessing the Subscription Manager in our Middle East staging environment are encountering broken UI elements. Specifically, certain panels are failing to render entirely, resulting in blank white spaces where content should be visible. Additionally, when elements do appear, they are often misaligned, overlapping with other controls and making the interface unusable. This issue is affecting high-impact workflows for approximately 156 users and needs to be fixed to allow for proper configuration testing.

title: MFA not prompting and account lockouts in SSO (ME Production)
description: In our EU-West production environment, the SSO Integration Module is failing to present the MFA prompt during login. Consequently, many users are being locked out of their accounts because the system is likely timing out or rejecting the authentication flow when the second factor is absent. This has impacted 561 users, severely hindering our ability to access critical production systems. We need immediate assistance to restore MFA functionality and unlock the affected accounts.

title: SSO Federation Metadata Mismatch - US-West Production
description: We are seeing errors related to federation metadata mismatches in our US-West production SSO environment. About 29 users are unable to authenticate. We are confident this is because one of the backing services that the SSO module depends on is currently down or unreachable. The SSO integration can't fetch the necessary metadata from that dependency, causing the mismatch error on our side. Please check the status of the dependencies supporting the metadata exchange.

title: Mobile App form submission failure and layout issues in US-East Staging
description: During testing in the US-East staging environment, we found that forms in the Mobile App fail to submit. When we inspect the UI, we also see misaligned elements. We think this is definitely a problem caused by the incomplete migration of our app components to the new staging infrastructure. The backend services haven't fully synced with the new frontend definitions, which is why the submissions are failing. Please verify the migration status.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Subscriptions not renewing in EU-Central Production
description: We have observed that subscriptions are not being renewed in our EU-Central production environment using Payment Gateway v2. The expected renewal transactions are not appearing, and customers are remaining in a past-due state despite having valid payment methods. While this has not yet caused a broad outage, we need to ensure the renewal logic is functioning correctly to prevent revenue leakage. No specific user count is impacted yet, but the behavior is consistent across test accounts.

title: SSO Error Page displaying for users in US-West Production
description: Users in our US-West production environment are being redirected to a generic SSO error page instead of logging in successfully. This is affecting approximately 55 users. The error occurs intermittently. We suspect the issue lies within the SSO Integration Module's handling of the redirect or session validation, as the error originates from our own login flow. Please investigate the module's behavior during these failed attempts.

title: Metrics Engine displaying blank/white screens in APAC Production
description: The Metrics Engine dashboard in our APAC production environment is loading as a white screen or a blank state for users. The navigation bar might be visible, but the main content area where metrics should be displayed is empty. This prevents any data visualization or analysis. While we don't have a specific count of affected users yet, the rendering failure is complete for the metrics view.

title: SSO Webhooks not firing in ME Production
description: We are noticing that webhooks from the SSO Integration Module are not firing in our Middle East production environment. Events that should trigger downstream actions are not reaching our endpoints. We think this is because of insufficient capacity planning on our side, likely resulting in the webhook queue being full or dropped due to resource limits. We need to verify if the system is rejecting these calls due to capacity constraints.

title: Critical SSO synchronization delay and provisioning stuck in ME Production
description: Our SSO Integration Module in the Middle East production environment is experiencing severe synchronization delays. User provisioning is stuck, meaning new users are not being created or updated in downstream systems. This is impacting 1,875 users and is critical to our operations. We are confident this is due to insufficient monitoring/alerting in the SSO module, which allowed this backlog to grow without detection. The system clearly lacks the visibility to handle this scale of provisioning requests.

title: Audit log gaps detected in Payment Gateway v2 (APAC Sandbox)
description: In our APAC sandbox environment for Payment Gateway v2, we have detected gaps in the audit logs. Several transactions that occurred during testing do not appear in the audit trail. This discrepancy affects the integrity of our compliance testing for 838 simulated users. We need to understand why these events are being omitted from the logs.

title: Accounts locked out via SSO in EU-West Production
description: We are seeing account lockouts for users in our EU-West production environment when they attempt to access the system via SSO. The lockout happens unexpectedly, preventing access for approximately 15 users. We need assistance in understanding why the SSO module is triggering these lockouts and how to safely restore access to the affected accounts.

title: Secret Store: Feature flags not applying and rollback errors in ME Production
description: In our Middle East production environment, the Secret Store is exhibiting multiple issues. First, feature flags are not applying correctly to the services that depend on them. Second, when we attempted a rollback to fix this, a rollback was triggered automatically but failed to complete, leaving the system in an unstable state. Additionally, the migration scripts associated with the flag updates are throwing errors. This is impacting 119 users and requires immediate attention to stabilize the configuration management.

title: High impact MFA failures in SSO staging - definitely caused by outdated docs
description: We have 160 users in the US-West staging environment unable to log in because their MFA codes are being rejected. We've already ruled out user error. This is definitely a problem caused by stale internal documentation followed, which means our team is using outdated instructions that break the integration. Please fix the underlying doc-driven logic issue immediately.

title: Payment Gateway v2 in ANZ dev hitting rate limits (HTTP 429)
description: Our development environment for Payment Gateway v2 in the ANZ region is consistently returning HTTP 429 errors. We are hitting the rate limit thresholds on the API endpoints. This affects our test accounts (2 users). The requests are failing entirely due to the limit. Please review the rate limit configuration for our dev tenant.

title: SSO redirect loop and invalid token errors in Payment Gateway v2 (EU-West)
description: We are encountering an 'invalid token' error when users attempt to authenticate via SSO into Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West production environment. The issue manifests as a redirect loop where the user is sent back to the login page repeatedly. Although currently affecting 0 active users, this is a blocker for our upcoming deployment. Please investigate the token validation process.

title: Critical Billing Issue: Duplicate charges and incorrect invoices in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are experiencing a critical issue with Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West development environment. Approximately 339 users are reporting duplicate charges on their accounts. Additionally, the generated invoices are incorrect and do not reflect the actual transactions. This has a high business impact and needs urgent attention to reconcile the billing data and stop further incorrect invoicing.

title: Report Builder exports are corrupted and truncated (ME Region)
description: We are seeing critical failures with Report Builder in our staging environment (ME region). When users attempt to export data, the files are coming out corrupted and frequently truncated before completion. This affects over 2800 users and is blocking our reporting capabilities. Please investigate the export mechanism in Report Builder.

title: Rate Limiter feature flags not applying - definitely database contention
description: In our EU-Central production environment, the Rate Limiter is failing to apply new feature flags correctly. 564 users are affected, resulting in high business impact. We have analyzed the system and this is definitely caused by database contention. The database is locking up and preventing the flag updates from propagating. Please resolve the database locking issue so the flags can apply.

title: MFA prompts missing and codes rejected in Refund Manager (LATAM)
description: Our sandbox environment for Refund Manager in the LATAM region is experiencing critical authentication failures. Users report that the MFA prompt does not appear when it should, and when they do attempt to enter a code, it is rejected. This is affecting 2,137 users and preventing any refund processing activities. Please look into the MFA configuration within Refund Manager.

title: Critical Security Incident: Elevated privileges detected in Currency Converter (APAC)
description: We have detected elevated privileges being granted unexpectedly within the Currency Converter service in our APAC production environment. This is a critical security concern affecting 12,092 users. We are seeing access levels that exceed the configured roles. Immediate investigation and containment are required to prevent potential data exposure.

title: SSO Integration Module issues in staging
description: Hi, we are having some trouble with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-Central staging environment. It seems like there are some privilege issues and maybe a certificate warning? We are seeing this across the board for our test group. Please check it out.

title: Refund Manager performance degradation and backup failures (US-East)
description: We are observing significant issues with Refund Manager in our US-East production environment. Specifically, we are seeing high replication lag which is causing slow response times for users. Additionally, our automated backup verification process is failing. This impacts approximately 12 internal administrative users and is causing moderate business disruption. Please advise on steps to stabilize replication and resolve the backup verification errors.

title: OAuth Service hitting rate limits in ANZ production
description: Our OAuth Service in the ANZ production region is frequently exceeding rate limits, resulting in failed authentication attempts. This is impacting 76 users and causing moderate business impact. We are seeing 429 responses on the token endpoint. Please review our quota allocation or rate limiting rules.

title: Currency conversion errors and duplicate subscription charges in Payment Gateway v2
description: We have identified two issues with Payment Gateway v2 in our ANZ production environment. First, the currency conversion rates being applied are incorrect for a subset of transactions. Second, a small number of users (2) have been charged twice for their subscriptions. The business impact is currently low, but we need to verify the conversion logic and refund the duplicate charges.

title: SSO Integration Module sync issues
description: Hi, the SSO Integration Module is acting up in APAC production. The bulk import is failing completely and synchronization seems delayed. Provisioning is stuck. Please help.

title: Refund Manager sandbox privilege issue - likely incomplete migration
description: In our ANZ sandbox, Refund Manager is showing elevated privileges. We think it's because of incomplete migration of the user roles. Please complete the migration to fix the access levels.

title: MFA code rejection in SSO Integration Module (ME Production)
description: We are seeing MFA codes being rejected in the SSO Integration Module for users in our ME production environment. This affects 2 users and has a low business impact, but it is preventing them from logging in. Please investigate the MFA verification process.

title: Duplicate subscription charges for multiple users in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are seeing an issue in our production environment (ME region) where users are being charged twice for their subscriptions. This is happening across the Payment Gateway v2 integration. We have identified 9 affected accounts so far. Please investigate why the overcharge is occurring.

title: KPI Tracker UI broken and forms failing to submit
description: There are significant issues with the KPI Tracker in the US-East production environment. Several UI elements are not rendering correctly, specifically missing localization text strings. Additionally, users are unable to submit forms, which is blocking our workflow. This affects approximately 332 users. It's unclear if this is a frontend display issue or if the underlying data service is failing to respond to our requests, as both the display errors and submission failures are happening simultaneously.

title: Rate Limiter upstream timeouts in ANZ staging
description: We are experiencing issues with the Rate Limiter in our staging environment (ANZ region). We are receiving upstream dependency timeouts and errors. We noticed that the vendor status page currently shows an active incident, which likely correlates with these failures. This is impacting about 52 users in the staging workflow. Please confirm if this is solely due to the vendor outage or if there are internal configuration issues on our side.

title: Audit log gaps and missing consent records in Analytics Dashboard
description: We have detected gaps in our audit logs within the Analytics Dashboard (APAC production). Specifically, consent records are missing, and it appears retention policies are not being applied correctly. This affects 53 users. We are confident this is due to a rate limit misconfiguration on our end that is throttling the logging service, causing data to be dropped during high-traffic periods. Please review the rate limiting settings.

title: Critical payment errors: Overcharges and incorrect tax in EU-Central
description: We are facing a critical issue with Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-Central production environment. A large number of users (4,449) are receiving incorrect tax amounts and overcharges, leading to numerous chargeback notices. We believe this is definitely caused by an expired SSL certificate on the payment processor's side, which is causing handshake failures that result in duplicate or malformed transaction data. Please verify the certificate status immediately.

title: Incorrect tax and invoice details in Chargeback Handler
description: One of our accounts in the ANZ production environment is reporting issues with the Chargeback Handler. The invoices generated contain incorrect tax amounts. We have only one affected user for this specific issue, but it needs to be resolved to ensure accurate billing. Please check the tax calculation logic for this account.

title: SSO MFA prompts missing and sessions expiring early in EU-West
description: Users in the EU-West production environment are reporting that MFA prompts are not appearing during login via the SSO Integration Module. Additionally, some sessions are expiring unexpectedly. This affects 98 users. We think this is a capacity limitation issue on our identity provider's end, where the server is dropping the authentication steps due to high load. Please investigate if we need to scale our resources.

title: Overcharges occurring in LATAM Payment Gateway v2
description: We are seeing overcharges for 39 users in the LATAM region on the Payment Gateway v2 production environment. We are pretty sure this is due to a version incompatibility between our current integration and the latest update pushed by the payment provider. The old logic might be conflicting with new endpoints, causing double processing. Please check for any API version mismatches.

title: API schema errors and 429 responses from SSO Integration
description: We are observing HTTP 429 errors and API schema validation failures when interacting with the SSO Integration Module in the US-West production environment. Although no user impact has been reported yet (0 affected users), we want to log this to ensure our integrations remain stable. Please help us understand if these errors are transient or indicative of a deeper issue with the API contract.

title: Wallet Service outage in EU-West development
description: The Wallet Service in our development environment (EU-West) is currently down, resulting in a full outage for 12 users. We are unable to determine if the issue lies within the Wallet Service itself or if it is being blocked by the Central Rate Limiter. We are seeing timeouts that could suggest either service is failing to communicate. Please investigate the root cause.

title: Chargeback Handler unresponsive with 504 errors in US-East
description: One user in the US-East production environment is experiencing issues with the Chargeback Handler. The service is unresponsive, returning HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors. It is unclear if the Chargeback Handler is stuck processing a request or if the underlying Secret & Config Store is failing to provide necessary credentials, causing the hang. Please check both components to identify the source of the timeout.

title: Data discrepancies and corrupted exports in Analytics Dashboard
description: We have noticed data mismatches and corrupted export files in the Analytics Dashboard (US-East production). There are also duplicate records appearing in the output. This affects 4 users. The issues seem isolated to specific reports. Please review the data processing pipeline for any anomalies that might cause duplication or corruption during export.

title: Slow response times in Analytics Dashboard (LATAM)
description: Users in the LATAM production environment are reporting slow response times when using the Analytics Dashboard. This is affecting 4 users so far. The slowness seems consistent across different views. Please investigate potential performance bottlenecks in the region.

title: Payment Gateway v2 returning 429s and empty responses in ME dev
description: In our development environment (ME region), the Payment Gateway v2 is frequently returning HTTP 429 errors and empty API responses. This is impacting 10 developers. We are convinced this is due to a policy misconfiguration in the gateway that is incorrectly blocking valid requests as if they were abuse. Please review the throttling policies applied to our dev keys.

title: Missing data and duplicates in Cohort Builder (EU-West)
description: We are seeing missing data entries and duplicate records in the Cohort Builder tool in the EU-West production environment. This affects 8 users. The cohorts are not building correctly, likely due to data integrity issues. Please check the synchronization process for any errors that might lead to partial data loads or duplicated entries.

title: Payment Gateway v2 webhooks not firing in US-West Production
description: We are experiencing an issue with Payment Gateway v2 where webhook notifications are not being sent to our endpoint. This is affecting approximately 5 users in the US-West production environment. The webhooks simply do not trigger when transactions are completed, which is causing delays in our order fulfillment process. Please investigate why the webhook delivery mechanism is failing.

title: Critical: Form submission and UI rendering failures in Event Tracker (ANZ Dev)
description: We have a high-impact issue in the ANZ development environment with the Event Tracker. Users are reporting that forms fail to submit entirely. Additionally, several UI elements are either not rendering or are misaligned on the page. We aren't sure if this is a frontend rendering issue or if the backend event processing (possibly related to the message queue) is hanging, causing the UI to freeze or fail to update. This is blocking 472 users.

title: Invoice Service producing incorrect prorations and overcharges
description: Our team is noticing discrepancies in invoices generated by the Invoice Service. Specifically, proration calculations appear to be incorrect, leading to overcharges for 29 customers in the EU-Central production region. The final invoice amounts do not match the expected cost based on the service usage. Please review the proration logic within the Invoice Service.

title: Staging login issues
description: We can't log into Payment Gateway v2 in staging. It keeps looping or just fails. A lot of people are seeing this. Can you check it?

title: Refunds not reflected and subscriptions not renewing in LATAM Staging
description: In the LATAM staging environment, we are observing two distinct issues with Payment Gateway v2. First, refunds issued are not being reflected in the user account balances. Second, subscription renewals are failing to trigger for affected accounts. This is impacting about 10 users and causing moderate disruption to our testing workflows. Please check the refund processing and renewal scheduling modules.

title: Missing audit logs and consent records in ANZ Production
description: We have detected gaps in the audit logs for Payment Gateway v2 in the ANZ production region. Furthermore, consent records for approximately 36 users are missing from the system. This is a moderate compliance concern as we cannot verify user consent status for these accounts. Please investigate the logging and data retention processes.

title: Missing localization text in Self-Service Hub (US-East)
description: We are seeing missing text strings in the localization files for the Self-Service Hub in the US-East production environment. This is affecting 46 users. We think this is happening because of a duplicate processing failure or an idempotency key collision in the background sync job that updates these translations. It seems like the system is rejecting the new text updates as duplicates. Please investigate the update mechanism.

title: Slow response times in Admin Console Sandbox (ANZ)
description: We are experiencing slow response times with the Admin Console in the ANZ sandbox environment. This slowness is particularly noticeable when accessing the console via the mobile app, which is also performing poorly. The issue affects about 8 users and is currently low impact, but it is hindering our ability to configure settings efficiently. Please look into performance optimization for both the web and mobile interfaces.

title: Help Center timeout and latency issues
description: The Help Center in APAC production is timing out and running very slowly. Some users can't load pages. We don't have specific times or error codes, but it's happening for about 25 people. Please check.

title: SSO Webhooks not firing and timeouts in ME Production
description: We are observing issues with the SSO Integration Module in the ME production region. Specifically, webhooks related to SSO events are not firing as expected, and we are also seeing timeout errors during authentication attempts. While there is no reported business impact or affected user count at the moment, these anomalies need to be investigated to prevent future service disruptions. Please check the webhook delivery and authentication timeout configurations.

title: Payment Gateway v2 staging billing errors
description: Refunds aren't showing up, proration is wrong, and some people got charged twice in EU-Central staging. 769 users affected. Big issue. Please fix.

title: Account lockouts and privilege escalation in Session Controller (LATAM)
description: We are seeing accounts getting locked out unexpectedly in the Session Controller for the LATAM production environment. More concerning, we have observed instances of elevated privileges being granted to these locked-out or specific user accounts. This affects 2 users currently. Please investigate the session management and role assignment logic immediately.

title: Audit log gaps and data residency flags in EU-West Production
description: We have identified gaps in the audit logs for Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West production region.
