This is a moderate business impact due to compliance risks. Please investigate the background jobs for retention and the log shipping pipeline.

title: KPI Tracker UI element missing
description:
Hi team, 

In the KPI Tracker application, we are seeing an issue where a specific UI element (the 'Quarterly Target' gauge) is not rendering. The container div is present but empty. 

This is currently only visible to a few users in the ANZ production environment, so the impact is low, but it looks broken. No errors in the console. Just a blank space where the chart should be.

title: Refunds not showing up in Payment Gateway v2 - definitely a certificate issue
description:
We have a critical issue in the APAC production environment where refunds processed yesterday are not reflecting in the customer balances. This is affecting 761 users and is a high-impact blocker for our finance team.

We have investigated on our side and we are certain this is caused by an expired SSL certificate on your payment processing servers. The handshake is failing, which is why the refund callbacks aren't coming through. Please renew the certs immediately as this is a security configuration problem on your end.

title: SSO Integration Module rejecting valid MFA codes in US-West
description:
Hello, 

We are receiving reports from 5 users in the US-West production environment that the SSO Integration Module is rejecting valid MFA codes. The users are entering the correct 6-digit code from their authenticator app within the time window, but the system returns an 'Invalid Code' error.

This happens consistently for these specific accounts but not for others. We have verified that the time on the user devices is synchronized. Please check if there is a clock skew issue on the server side or if these accounts are locked out of the MFA provider.

title: Active Directory Sync: Audit logs missing and unexpected privilege escalation
description:
Hi, 

We are seeing concerning behavior with the Active Directory Sync tool in the ME production environment. 

1. Missing Audit Logs: Entries for recent user creation and group modifications are not appearing in the audit log.
2. Elevated Privileges: Several users have been observed with higher privilege levels than assigned in AD. 

This is affecting about 58 users and is a moderate risk. We suspect the sync is failing to write logs and possibly misinterpreting group mappings, leading to the privilege issues. Please investigate the sync engine logs.

title: High latency and slow mobile performance in Analytics Dashboard (Staging)
description:
We are testing the new release in the EU-Central staging environment for the Analytics Dashboard. We are observing high API latency (avg >2s) and the mobile app is performing very poorly, often timing out or freezing when loading reports.

Currently, this affects our 5 internal testers. While this is staging, we need to understand if this is a performance regression before we move to production. Please check the backend response times and any recent code changes affecting mobile optimization.

title: CRITICAL: Session Controller login failures and SSO redirect loops (EU-West)
description:
URGENT: We are experiencing a total outage of the login functionality via the Session Controller in the EU-West production environment. 

Symptoms:
1. Login Failures: Users receive a generic 'Authentication Failed' error.
2. SSO Redirect Loop: When attempting to log in via SSO, the browser enters an infinite redirect loop between the identity provider and our application.

This is a critical issue blocking 2,692 users from accessing the system. We have verified that our IdP is up and running. Please investigate the session handling and token validation logic immediately.

title: Active Directory Sync causing MFA failures and expired password reset links (ANZ)
description:
Hi, 

We have a critical issue affecting 1,044 users in the ANZ production environment related to the Active Directory Sync. 

Users are reporting two main problems:
1. MFA codes are consistently rejected during login.
2. Password reset links sent via email are arriving already expired (or marked as such immediately upon click).

We suspect the sync is not properly updating the password change timestamps or MFA registration status in the directory, causing the authentication service to reject valid requests. Please check the sync job health and data consistency.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Dev: Overcharging and refunds not processing
description:
In the US-East development environment for Payment Gateway v2, we are seeing billing discrepancies. 

1. Overcharge: Test transactions are being charged double the amount specified in the API request.
2. Refund Failure: When we initiate a refund via the API, the response says 'Success', but the amount is never credited back to the test card account.

This is currently affecting our 5 developers working on integration testing. Low business impact, but we cannot proceed with UAT until these core payment actions work correctly.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Staging: Feature flags not applying and config drift
description:
Hello, 

We are seeing inconsistencies in the US-West staging environment for Payment Gateway v2. 

1. Feature Flags: We enabled the 'New Fraud Check' feature flag for the 'Beta' tenant group, but transactions are still bypassing the new check.
2. Config Drift: The system is reporting configuration drift between the desired state in our GitOps repo and the actual state in the cluster. 

This is affecting 27 users testing the new features and is a moderate impact on our release schedule. Please check if the flag propagation service is healthy and why the config sync is failing.

title: Config Manager errors in EU-Central
description: We are getting bad gateway and timeout errors when trying to use the Config Manager in production (EU region). About 30 users are affected. It's happening randomly. Please check.

title: Role Manager extremely slow and timing out in US-West Dev
description:
The Role Manager application in the US-West development environment is becoming unusable. 

Symptoms:
1. Database Query Timeouts: Most requests to fetch user roles are hanging for 30+ seconds and then failing with a timeout error.
2. Slow Response: Even simple API calls to list permissions are taking minutes to complete.

This is a critical blocker for our team of 1,181 developers in the dev environment. We cannot test any role-based access control features. We believe the database indexing on the roles table is broken or the table is locked. Please investigate the database performance for the Role Manager service.

title: Partial outage and failing health checks on SSO Integration Module
description: We are experiencing a partial outage with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment (LATAM region). Specifically, the health checks are failing intermittently. This is currently impacting about 34 users who are unable to authenticate properly. Please investigate as soon as possible.

title: Refund not reflected in development environment
description: We've noticed that refunds initiated through the Payment Gateway v2 are not being reflected correctly in our development environment. This issue is affecting approximately 46 users who are testing refund workflows. The impact is moderate as it blocks further testing of the refund process.

title: UI elements misaligned in Funnel Analyzer
description: There is a visual issue with the Funnel Analyzer in the production APAC region where certain UI elements are misaligned. This is affecting the usability for around 18 users. While not a critical failure, it is impacting our ability to read the data clearly.

title: Database connection issues causing timeouts
description: Our Funnel Analyzer is failing. We are getting database query timeouts and connection pool errors. It's impacting many users in EU-West. Please fix urgently.

title: Critical data missing from Analytics Dashboard
description: We are seeing significant data gaps in our Analytics Dashboard. This issue is occurring in the US-East sandbox environment and is currently impacting a large user base of over 7000 individuals. Due to the volume of affected users and the lack of essential data, this is being treated as a critical issue. Please investigate the cause of the missing data points.

title: Errors with SSO module
description: We are seeing timeouts and errors with the SSO Integration Module in production. The vendor status page also shows an incident. It's happening for a few users in EU-Central. Please check.

title: Billing Engine overcharging and chargebacks
description: We have a critical issue with the Billing Engine. Users are being overcharged and we are receiving chargeback notices. This is affecting thousands of users in US-West. Needs immediate attention.

title: Queue Manager unresponsive due to third-party outage
description: Our Queue Manager in the ME sandbox is down. Health checks are failing and the service is completely unresponsive. We are seeing a partial outage. This is definitely a third-party service failure that is breaking our queue processing. We need you to confirm this is on their end.

title: Cohort Builder dependency errors
description: We are encountering upstream dependency errors with the Cohort Builder in production (ME). It is impacting about 23 users. Please investigate.

title: Password reset links expiring too quickly
description: Users in our production environment are reporting that password reset links from the Identity Vault are expiring before they can use them. This is happening frequently and affects a large number of users across different regions. We aren't sure if this is an issue with how the links are generated or if the data isn't syncing correctly to the email service.

title: API timeouts and empty responses on Payment Gateway v2
description: We are observing timeouts and empty API responses when interacting with the Payment Gateway v2 in our production EU-West environment. This issue is currently affecting approximately 332 users. The impact is significant as it disrupts our payment processing flows.

title: Incorrect invoices and missing renewals
description: We have a few users reporting issues with the Billing Disputes Handler. Invoices are coming out with incorrect amounts, some seem to be undercharged, and a couple of subscriptions did not renew when they should have. We aren't sure if this is a display issue in the disputes module or if the underlying revenue calculations are off.

title: Access denied errors on Payment Gateway v2
description: Two users in our ANZ production environment are receiving 'Access Denied' errors when trying to use the Payment Gateway v2. The impact is currently low, but we need assistance in determining why these specific accounts are being blocked.

title: Mass login failures suspected to be third-party outage
description: We are seeing a high volume of login failures across our SSO Integration Module in US-West production. Over 700 users are currently unable to log in. We are confident this is a third-party service failure causing the disruption. Please prioritize this.

title: Single user stuck in SSO login loop
description: One user is experiencing a login failure with the Payment Gateway v2 in production EU-Central. They are stuck in a redirect loop when trying to authenticate via SSO. The impact is limited to this single user, but we need assistance in resolving their access issue.

title: Notification Hub producing duplicate records and encoding errors in EU-West Production
description: We are experiencing issues with Notification Hub in our production environment (EU-West region). Approximately 631 users are affected by two main symptoms: 1) Duplicate notification records are being generated for single events. 2) We are seeing encoding errors in the payload data, resulting in garbled text. This is impacting high-volume communications and requires urgent attention.

title: Permission Engine failing to trigger MFA prompts, causing lockouts in APAC Dev
description: Our development team in the APAC region is reporting that the Permission Engine is not correctly displaying Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prompts during login attempts. As a result, approximately 455 accounts are getting locked out because the authentication flow stalls or fails silently. We need this resolved quickly as it is blocking our dev pipeline.

title: SSO Integration Module password reset links expiring immediately in US-East Prod
description: Users in our US-East production environment are unable to reset their passwords via the SSO Integration Module. The reset links sent via email appear to be expired immediately upon clicking, or shortly thereafter, preventing access recovery. This is affecting 853 users and has a high business impact. Please investigate the token generation or expiration logic in the SSO module.

title: Issues with subscriptions in Payment Gateway v2 sandbox
description: Hi, we're having problems with the Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West sandbox. Some subscriptions didn't renew, others got charged twice, and the refunds aren't showing up correctly. It's confusing and we need help fixing it. Thanks.

title: API schema errors and HTTP 429 responses in Payment Gateway v2 Dev (US-West)
description: We are encountering consistent issues when interacting with the Payment Gateway v2 API in our US-West development environment. Specifically, we receive HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors alongside API schema validation errors. While this is currently limited to the dev environment and no external users are impacted, it is blocking our integration testing. Please advise on rate limit configurations and schema updates.

title: Incorrect privilege elevation and HTTP 403 errors in SSO Integration Module
description: In our US-East production environment, we observed an anomaly with the SSO Integration Module affecting a single user. The user received an HTTP 403 error but was subsequently granted incorrect access levels, including elevated privileges that they should not possess. This suggests a mismatch between the authorization response and the applied permissions. Please review the access control logic for this specific incident.

title: Certificate expiration warnings in SSO Integration Module (ANZ Prod)
description: We are receiving certificate expiration warnings in the SSO Integration Module within our ANZ production region. Although currently only affecting one user session, the warning indicates potential upcoming connectivity issues if the certificate is not renewed. Please confirm the status of the SSL certificates associated with the SSO endpoint to prevent service disruption.

title: LDAP Connector rejecting MFA codes and locking accounts in EU-Central Dev
description: Our development team using the LDAP Connector in the EU-Central region is facing significant authentication issues. Users are reporting that valid MFA codes are being rejected, leading to unexpected account lockouts. Additionally, sessions are expiring unexpectedly during active usage. This is impacting 116 users and halting our development work. We suspect an issue with the connector's synchronization with the identity provider.

title: Critical SSO error page blocking access for 9000+ users in ME Staging
description: We are currently unable to access the staging environment in the Middle East region via the SSO Integration Module. Users are being presented with a generic SSO error page instead of being redirected to the application. This is affecting approximately 9139 users and is considered a critical blocker for our upcoming release validation. Immediate investigation into the SSO handshake and redirect logic is required.

title: Active Directory Sync causing logouts, cert warnings, and missing audit logs in APAC Prod
description: We are observing multiple related symptoms with Active Directory Sync in our APAC production environment affecting 577 users. These include unexpected logout events during active sessions, certificate expiration warnings, and gaps in the audit logs where sync activities are not being recorded. This combination of symptoms is causing compliance concerns and operational disruption. Please investigate the sync agent status and certificate configuration.

title: Report Builder hitting HTTP 429 errors in EU-West Staging
description: Our team is experiencing frequent HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors when attempting to generate reports using the Report Builder in the EU-West staging environment. This is impacting 466 users who are trying to access reporting data for testing purposes. We believe the rate limiting thresholds for the Report Builder API may be too aggressive or misconfigured for our staging workload. Please review.

title: Payment Gateway v2 unresponsive in ME Production due to monitoring gaps
description: We are seeing intermittent unresponsiveness from the Payment Gateway v2 in our ME production region. Additionally, feature flags are not applying as expected. We think it's definitely because of insufficient monitoring/alerting on your end; if you had proper alerts configured, we would have caught this sooner. This is affecting 6 users with low business impact, but the lack of visibility is the root cause here.

title: Feedback Collector account provisioning stuck and users not found in ANZ Prod
description: In our ANZ production environment, the Feedback Collector service is failing to provision new user accounts properly. Approximately 35 users are encountering 'account not found' errors after attempting to sign up, while their provisioning status remains 'stuck' in the admin portal. This is delaying user onboarding and has a moderate business impact. Please check the provisioning workflow and database synchronization.

title: Incorrect invoice generation in Payment Gateway v2 Dev (ANZ)
description: We are reporting an issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in our ANZ development environment where invoices are being generated with incorrect amounts or line items. This affects approximately 47 test users and is causing discrepancies in our billing integration tests. The impact is moderate as it is contained within the dev environment, but accurate invoice generation is critical for our release. Please investigate the billing calculation logic.

title: Double subscription charges and overbilling in Payment Gateway v2 Sandbox (ME)
description: In the ME sandbox environment for Payment Gateway v2, we are observing scenarios where subscriptions are being charged twice and total amounts are reflecting overcharges. While this currently affects no live users (impact: none), it is a critical bug for our testing phase. We need to ensure the sandbox accurately reflects billing logic before moving to production. Please review the transaction processing flow for duplicate charge prevention.

title: Analytics Dashboard issues in LATAM Sandbox
description: We are seeing critical failures in our sandbox environment. The replication lag is extremely high, and several backup jobs have failed to complete. It's unclear if the dashboard is failing to load data because of the lag or if the backup process is hanging on something else. We have nearly 6000 users affected by this instability.

title: SSO Module showing wrong tenant data in Staging
description: During testing in the ME Staging environment, our SSO Integration Module is displaying data from the incorrect tenant. Additionally, users are receiving unexpected 'permission denied' errors when trying to access resources they should have rights to. We need to determine if the identity mapping is broken or if the permission logic is failing.

title: Queue Manager errors in EU-Central Sandbox
description: We are encountering file upload failures when using the Queue Manager. It seems related to upstream dependency timeouts and third-party API unavailability. However, we are also seeing potential quota restrictions. It is difficult to isolate whether the Queue Manager is misconfiguring the retry logic or if the Resource Quota Manager is rejecting the requests due to capacity limits.

title: SSO Integration Module data visibility issues in LATAM Staging
description: In the LATAM staging environment, 37 users are reporting that they see incorrect data via the SSO Integration Module. Specifically, users are viewing information belonging to other accounts. This is accompanied by sudden permission denials for authorized actions. Please investigate the authentication token mapping and access control lists.

title: Currency Converter wrong rates
description: The currency converter is giving wrong values in production EU-Central. Impacts about 163 users. High severity.

title: Identity Vault account lockouts and MFA issues in LATAM Sandbox
description: We believe the Identity Vault is broken in our sandbox. A massive number of accounts (over 8000) are getting locked out unexpectedly. Furthermore, the MFA prompts are not appearing for users who are trying to log in. We need urgent assistance to restore access and fix the factor authentication flow.

title: Event Tracker retention and consent failures in LATAM Staging
description: Our Event Tracker appears to be malfunctioning. Retention policies are not being applied to stored data, and we are finding missing consent records for over 1000 users. This is a critical compliance risk. Please check if the tracker is correctly honoring the deletion requests and storing user preferences.

title: SSO Integration Module provisioning delays in US-West Production
description: We are experiencing a single instance of user provisioning being stuck in the US-West production environment via the SSO Integration Module. There is a noticeable synchronization delay, and the sync process appears to hang indefinitely for this specific user. Low impact currently, but needs review to prevent widespread sync issues.

title: Load Balancer timeouts and cert warnings in LATAM Production
description: Critical issues in the LATAM production environment. The Load Balancer is generating timeout errors for approximately 5,500 users. We also see warnings regarding an expired certificate. Please investigate if the timeout is a result of the cert issue or a separate backend health check failure.

title: API Gateway slow responses in EU-West Production
description: We are noticing degraded performance with the API Gateway in the EU-West production region. Responses are significantly slower than usual, affecting about 27 users. This has a moderate business impact on our transaction times. Please check the gateway health and backend latency.

title: Analytics Dashboard config drift detected in EU-West Production
description: A configuration drift has been detected on the Analytics Dashboard in the EU-West production environment. Only 1 user is currently affected, and the business impact is low, but we need to understand why the live config differs from the source of truth. Please advise on steps to reconcile the drift.

title: Session Controller login failures in EU-West Production
description: About 20 users in the EU-West production environment are unable to log in due to issues with the Session Controller. Additionally, password reset emails are not being delivered. We suspect the session controller is blocking authentication attempts or the reset trigger is failing. Please investigate.

title: SSO Integration Module provisioning issues in ANZ Staging
description: In the ANZ staging environment, we have a bulk import that partially failed via the SSO Integration Module. User provisioning is stuck for 2 accounts, and the synchronization process is not completing. This has a low business impact but blocks our testing workflow. Please check the import logs and sync status.

title: Mobile App 503 errors in US-West Staging
description: Our Mobile App in the US-West staging environment is returning 503 Service Unavailable errors. It appears that failover did not occur as expected when the primary service went down. 3 users are affected. We need to understand why the failover mechanism failed and why the app isn't recovering.

title: Session Controller provisioning stuck in ANZ Staging
description: We have 30 users in the ANZ staging environment experiencing moderate impact due to issues with the Session Controller. User provisioning is stuck, and duplicate accounts are being created for some users. This suggests a race condition or logic error in the session management during the creation process. Please review the provisioning logs.

title: Intermittent SSO login failures in EU-West sandbox affecting ~67 users
description: We are seeing intermittent failures with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-West sandbox environment. The issue isn't constant; roughly 10-15% of login attempts fail with a generic authentication error. This is impacting about 67 users who are currently testing new features. The failures seem random and not tied to specific user roles. Please investigate as this is slowing down our QA process significantly.

title: High impact: Overcharges and incorrect tax calculation in Payment Gateway v2 (EU-Central Staging)
description: We have identified a critical billing issue in the staging environment for Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-Central region. Customers are being overcharged, and the tax amount applied is consistently incorrect (appearing higher than expected). This affects approximately 560 test accounts. We need this resolved immediately before we promote this version to production, as it will result in significant financial discrepancies for live customers.

title: Certificate expired warning appearing on Payment Gateway v2 in ME production
description: Our Payment Gateway v2 implementation in the Middle East production environment is throwing certificate warning errors. Specifically, we are seeing 'certificate expired' messages during the handshake process. This is affecting about 21 users who are unable to complete transactions securely. We suspect an issue with how the gateway handles SSL certificates or their renewal status. Please check the gateway's certificate configuration.

title: Critical: Chargeback notices and overcharges affecting 5900+ users in ME production
description: We are experiencing a severe issue with Payment Gateway v2 in the ME production region. We have received numerous chargeback notices and are seeing cases where customers were overcharged. Approximately 5,910 users are affected. This could be a logic error within the gateway's calculation engine, but it also looks like there might be a timeout or connectivity issue causing duplicate submissions or incorrect amounts. The impact is critical and requires immediate attention to prevent further financial loss and reputational damage.

title: SSO Provisioning stuck, partial bulk import failure, and duplicate accounts created
description: In our US-East production environment using the SSO Integration Module, we have encountered three related issues: 1) A specific user provisioning job is stuck in 'pending' state. 2) The last bulk import partially failed (some users created, some did not). 3) We have identified a duplicate account creation for one user due to the sync error. The business impact is currently low as it affects only one specific test user and their duplicate, but we need to understand why the bulk import logic failed to prevent this in future larger imports.

title: Refunds not showing up in Payment Gateway v2 (EU-West Prod)
description: Hey, we're having issues with refunds not reflecting in the system. It's happening in production EU-West. A lot of users (around 100+) are complaining that they didn't get their money back. We initiated the refunds but nothing changed on the customer side. Please look into this ASAP as it's causing anger.

title: Invoice discrepancies, undercharging, and failed subscription renewals in LATAM staging
description: We have observed inconsistencies in Payment Gateway v2 in our LATAM staging environment. Specifically, invoices are displaying incorrect totals, leading to undercharges for certain subscription tiers. Additionally, subscriptions that should have renewed automatically are not doing so, remaining in a 'lapsed' state despite valid payment methods. This affects 12 test users. We need this fixed to validate our billing logic before launch.

title: SSO provisioning stuck with synchronization delays in LATAM production
description: The SSO Integration Module in our LATAM production environment is showing signs of a synchronization delay. Consequently, new user provisioning is getting stuck in the 'processing' queue and not completing. While there is currently no reported business impact and 0 affected users (as it appears to be an early detection issue or affecting non-critical background processes), we want to investigate the root cause of the sync lag to prevent future service degradation.

title: SSO redirect loop issue in ME production
description: Users are getting stuck in a redirect loop when trying to log in via SSO in the ME region. It keeps bouncing between the login page and the dashboard. We have about 60 people affected. It's really annoying and they can't work. Need help fixing this soon.

title: OAuth Service API issues: Malformed JSON, 429 errors, and empty responses in US-West
description: We are experiencing multiple intermittent issues with the OAuth Service in the US-West production environment. Our logs show three distinct problems: 1) Malformed JSON responses are being returned by the token endpoint. 2) We are receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors even when our call volume is within expected limits. 3) Some API calls return a completely empty response body. This is affecting 31 users and causing moderate disruption to our authentication flows. Please investigate the stability of the OAuth endpoints.

title: CRITICAL: Wrong tenant data displayed, Access Denied errors, and 401s in APAC SSO
description: We are facing a critical security and functionality issue with the SSO Integration Module in APAC production. Users are seeing data from the wrong tenant (cross-tenant leakage suspected), encountering 'Access Denied' errors when they should have permissions, and receiving HTTP 401 unauthorized responses. This is affecting 9,173 users. Immediate investigation is required as this poses a significant data privacy risk and blocks access for a large portion of our user base.

title: Payment declined errors and overcharges in Billing Disputes Handler (US-East Staging)
description: In our US-East staging environment for the Billing Disputes Handler, we are seeing two problematic behaviors: 1) Legitimate payments are being declined unexpectedly. 2) When payments do go through, customers are being overcharged. This is affecting 106 test cases. We need to understand why the handler is misclassifying valid transactions and applying incorrect amounts to the final bill.

title: Refunds not reflected and double subscriptions in APAC Payment Gateway v2
description: We are having issues with Payment Gateway v2 in APAC production where refunds are not showing up in customer balances, and some users are being charged twice for their subscriptions. About 29 users are affected. We are pretty sure this is caused by credential rotation not propagating correctly on our end, which is likely messing up the transaction reconciliation. Please check if the old credentials are still being used for these specific transaction types.

title: CRITICAL OUTAGE: Data Export Service completely down in US-West
description: The Data Export Service in US-West production is currently experiencing a full outage. No exports are completing, and all requests are failing. This is impacting 21,821 users who rely on this service for their reporting and data migration needs. This is a critical blocker for our operations and customer SLAs. We need immediate status updates and a resolution timeline.

title: MFA codes rejected and password reset links expiring in ME Payment Gateway v2
description: Users in the ME production environment are reporting that MFA codes are being rejected as invalid even when entered correctly. Additionally, password reset links are expiring almost immediately upon generation, before the user can even click them. This is affecting 110 users and has a high business impact as it locks people out of their accounts. It seems like the timing or validation logic within the Payment Gateway v2's security module is incorrect.

title: Cache service audit logs missing - definitely a known limitation?
description: We are seeing gaps in our audit logs for the Cache service in the LATAM production environment. Only one user is affected so far, so impact is low, but we are confused. We think this is just a known product limitation that we missed in the docs. Can you confirm if this is expected behavior or if something else is going on?

title: Wallet undercharging users
description: Something wrong with the Wallet service in dev. It's undercharging people. A few of us noticed it. Please check.

title: Payment Gateway v2 slow in ANZ prod
description: The system is lagging really badly in Australia/NZ production. Critical impact. Please fix ASAP.

title: Analytics Dashboard API errors: Schema mismatch, JSON issues, and 429s
description: We are experiencing critical issues with the Analytics Dashboard API in EU-Central production affecting approximately 5,390 users. We are seeing three distinct symptoms: 1) HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors, 2) malformed JSON responses that fail parsing, and 3) explicit API schema validation errors. The malformed JSON often accompanies the schema errors. This is blocking our reporting pipelines. We need immediate investigation into the API gateway and backend response handling.

title: SSO Integration Module issues: Redirect loops and email failures
description: We are encountering multiple issues with the SSO Integration Module in EU-Central production. For about 15 users, we are seeing an infinite redirect loop when attempting to log in. Additionally, password reset emails are either not arriving at all or arriving with expired links. This is preventing users from accessing the platform. We suspect a configuration or service state issue on the SSO side.

title: Payment Gateway v2 billing errors - likely hardware failure?
description: We have reported subscription renewals failing, overcharges, and incorrect currency conversions in the Payment Gateway v2 (EU-West, Prod). This affects about 15 users. We think this is definitely an infrastructure hardware failure on your end causing these calculation and processing errors. Please check your servers.

title: SSO showing wrong tenant data - token bug?
description: In the US-West Staging environment, the SSO Integration Module is displaying data from the wrong tenant for a large group of users (4,243 affected). This is a critical data leakage concern. We think it's because of a token expiration handling bug where old tokens aren't being invalidated properly, causing cross-tenant access. Please investigate the token lifecycle management.

title: HTTP 403 errors on SSO Integration Module in Dev
description: We are consistently receiving HTTP 403 Forbidden errors when trying to access resources via the SSO Integration Module in the US-West development environment. This affects about 38 developers. The authentication step seems to pass, but the subsequent authorization call fails. We have verified our client credentials and scopes are correct. This is blocking our development workflow.

title: Cohort Builder outage due to third-party API status
description: The Cohort Builder in EU-Central production is currently failing to generate new cohorts. We checked the vendor status page and they are reporting an incident regarding their API being unavailable. This correlates with the 'third-party API unavailable' errors we are seeing. About 16 users are impacted. We understand this may be external, but we need confirmation and an ETA from your side if there is a fallback mechanism we should trigger.

title: Admin Console issues: Blank screen, missing text, and feature absence
description: After the recent release, we are experiencing multiple UI issues in the Admin Console (US-East, Prod). Specifically: 1) Users in the French locale are seeing a blank screen instead of the dashboard. 2) Localization strings are missing for several menu items. 3) The 'Bulk Action' feature, which was present in the previous version, is completely missing from the navigation. This affects about 31 users and is hindering administrative tasks.

title: Critical latency in Payment Gateway v2 affecting mobile app
description: We are observing severe performance degradation in the Payment Gateway v2 sandbox environment in ANZ. Our mobile app, which relies on this gateway for testing, is experiencing high latency and slow performance. This is impacting 11,796 internal testers and blocking our release readiness. The response times for payment initiation calls are significantly above acceptable thresholds. We need an urgent investigation into the sandbox infrastructure performance.

title: Help Center 403 errors - incomplete migration?
description: We are seeing HTTP 403 errors on the Help Center in EU-Central production. No users are currently reporting this, and impact is low. We think this is because of an incomplete migration where some old permissions weren't mapped correctly to the new system. Can you check the migration logs?

title: Payment Gateway v2 Staging: Double charges and tax errors
description: In the US-East staging environment for Payment Gateway v2, we are seeing critical billing discrepancies. Specifically, subscriptions are being charged twice for a single cycle, and the calculated tax amounts are incorrect for certain jurisdictions. This affects a large volume of test data (12,334 users simulated). This is blocking our final pre-production validation. We need to know if this is a configuration issue or a bug in the billing engine.

title: SSO Integration Module: MFA prompt not appearing in EU-West Prod
description: Users in the EU-West production environment are bypassing Multi-Factor Authentication. The SSO Integration Module is not presenting the MFA prompt after the initial password entry. This affects 126 users and is a high-impact security concern as users are being authenticated without the second factor. We have verified that MFA policies are enabled for these users. We are seeing a significant number of users (approx. 397 in the last hour) in our Middle East production environment unable to log in via the SSO Integration Module. Two distinct issues are occurring:

1. When users request a password reset, the link provided in the email is already expired by the time they click it (within minutes).
2. For users who do get past the login screen, the MFA codes generated by the system are being rejected as invalid, even when entered immediately.

This is severely impacting our user base. Please investigate the configuration for token TTLs and MFA validation logic urgently.

title: Dev Environment: Payment Gateway v2 Schema Errors and Webhook Issues
description:
Working in our US-West development environment, we are encountering problems with the Payment Gateway v2 integration.

First, when we attempt to initialize a transaction using the standard payload, we are receiving an API schema validation error, suggesting the request format is not matching the expected definition. Second, once a transaction is successfully processed (when we bypass the schema check), the configured webhook is not firing. We have verified our endpoint is up and accepting requests from other services, but the gateway sends nothing. Please advise.

title: Cohort Builder Export Corruption and Data Mismatch
description: We are trying to export cohorts from the Cohort Builder in our APAC sandbox, but the resulting files are corrupted and the data doesn't match what is displayed on the screen. This is affecting about 461 users who rely on these exports for reporting. We think this is definitely a problem caused by a bug in the recent data migration scripts that ran last week. The migration didn't map the old cohort IDs correctly to the new structure, leading to these mismatches. Please fix the migration logic.

title: Payment Gateway charging too much
description: Hi, we are seeing some overcharges on the Payment Gateway v2 in production (ANZ). Some transactions are billing the customer more than the invoice amount. It's not happening to everyone, but we see it a few times. Please check.

title: Chargeback Handler Issues: Audit Logs, Data Residency, and Consent
description:
We have noticed several inconsistencies in the Chargeback Handler module in our ANZ production environment. Specifically:

1. We are detecting gaps in the audit logs where actions were performed but no record exists.
2. There is a mismatch in the data residency flags for certain regions.
3. Consent records appear to be missing for a small subset of users (approx. 6 affected).

We need these resolved to ensure compliance. The Chargeback Handler seems to be dropping or mislabeling this critical metadata.

title: LDAP Connector Warning: Certificate Expiring Soon
description: Our LDAP Connector in the LATAM production environment is currently throwing warnings about the SSL/TLS certificate expiring. The connection is still functioning, but we are concerned about a future outage if the rotation isn't handled. We would like to know the exact expiration date and if we need to manually update the certificate on our side or if it will auto-rotate. This is affecting 2 specific integration points we monitor closely.

title: Feedback Collector broken in dev
description: Hey, the Feedback Collector is acting up in our ANZ development setup. Pagination isn't working right (doesn't go to next pages) and sometimes the form just fails to submit without an error message. Around 77 users in our internal test group are seeing this. Can you help?

title: Payment Gateway v2 Certificate Expiry Warning - EU-Central Production
description: We are receiving certificate expiry warnings from the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-Central production environment. Approximately 47 users have reported connectivity issues or warnings when attempting to process transactions. We need to confirm if the root certificate on the gateway side needs updating or if this is an issue with our client-side trust store. Please advise on the next steps to prevent downtime.

title: Feedback Collector UI Not Rendering
description: In our ANZ production environment, the Feedback Collector widget is not rendering on several pages. About 3 users have reported seeing a blank space where the feedback form should be. We think it is a third-party service failure on the backend that is preventing the UI assets from loading. Please check your external providers.

title: Critical: Fee Analyzer Missing Records in US-West Production
description: We have identified a significant issue with the Fee Analyzer in our US-West production environment. Transactions that should be processed and reported by the analyzer are missing from the output. This affects a high volume of data—approximately 655 records are unaccounted for in our reconciliation reports. This is a high-impact issue for our finance team as we cannot close the books accurately. Please investigate why these records are not appearing in the analysis.

title: SSO Login Issues: Account Lockouts, Session Timeouts, and MFA Failures
description: We are experiencing authentication issues in our ME production environment. Users report their accounts are getting locked out unexpectedly, sessions are expiring much faster than configured, and MFA codes are being rejected. We use the SSO Integration Module, but we are also connected to a Central Identity Vault. We aren't sure if the SSO module is mishandling the tokens or if the Identity Vault is rejecting the requests, but the result is that users can't log in. Please help determine where the failure is occurring.

title: Incorrect Invoice Generated via Payment Gateway v2
description: We have received a complaint from a customer in our ANZ production environment regarding an incorrect invoice generated by the Payment Gateway v2. The invoice details (specifically the tax calculation and subtotal) do not match the agreed-upon contract terms for this user. The payment was processed successfully, but the resulting document sent to the customer is wrong. We need this specific transaction investigated to understand why the gateway pulled incorrect pricing data.

title: Staging Environment: Overcharges and Chargeback Notices in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are seeing concerning behavior in our LATAM staging environment with the Payment Gateway v2. During our recent load testing, we observed multiple instances of overcharging test accounts beyond the expected amount. Furthermore, several of these transactions triggered chargeback notices, which is unexpected in a staging context. This is affecting our test data integrity and impacting 201 test users. We need to ensure the gateway sandbox is behaving correctly before we push our latest update to production.

title: Analytics Dashboard Webhooks Not Firing
description: We are having trouble with the Analytics Dashboard in our APAC production environment. We have configured several webhooks to send data to our internal reporting system when certain thresholds are met. However, these webhooks are not firing. We have verified that the trigger events are occurring, but no HTTP requests are being sent to our endpoints. This is affecting 31 users who rely on these real-time alerts. Please investigate the webhook delivery mechanism.

title: Login issues
description: Users are getting locked out or kicked out of sessions randomly. It's happening for a lot of people in the dev environment. Can you check?

title: Cohort Builder is timing out
description: The Cohort Builder is taking forever to load queries and eventually times out. We are seeing high latency on all our cohort calculations in staging. This is affecting about 46 users.

title: Account not found error in SSO Integration Module
description: We are encountering an 'account not found' error when trying to authenticate via the SSO Integration Module in the US-East production environment. Only one user is currently impacted, but it prevents them from logging in entirely. The IDP returns a success, but the application denies the session.

title: Blank screen when accessing Feedback Collector
description: The Feedback Collector widget renders as a completely blank white screen in our development environment. This affects all 13 users on the dev team. The console does not show any obvious JavaScript errors, but no UI elements are visible.

title: Billing Engine causing overcharges and chargebacks
description: We have noticed that the Billing Engine is applying incorrect amounts to invoices, resulting in overcharges. Several clients have already issued chargeback notices. This is occurring in the US-East development environment and currently affects approximately 12 user accounts. Please investigate the calculation logic.

title: Refunds not reflecting in Payment Gateway v2
description: Refunds processed through Payment Gateway v2 in the US-East production environment are not appearing on customer statements, despite showing as successful in the admin portal. This is affecting 4 specific transactions. The initial charges were also higher than expected.

title: Provisioning and sync hanging in SSO Integration
description: User provisioning from our directory to the SSO Integration Module has stalled. We are seeing sync jobs stuck in a 'processing' state for over 45 users in the EU-West production environment. It looks like the updates aren't propagating to the broker side either, so we aren't sure if the issue is the module itself or the connection to the broker.

title: Admin Console returning 503 errors intermittently
description: The Admin Console in the ME production region is intermittently returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors. We are seeing failures for about 40 users. The failover mechanism does not appear to be kicking in, as traffic continues to hit the unhealthy nodes.

title: Bulk import failure and duplicate accounts in SSO Integration
description: We attempted a bulk import of users into the SSO Integration Module in the US-West production environment, but the process failed completely. Additionally, we have noticed that some users now have duplicate account entries. This impacts roughly 54 users who are unable to log in due to the duplicates.

title: Missing records and truncated files in Analytics Dashboard
description: When exporting data from the Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM staging environment, the resulting CSV files are truncated, and several expected records are missing from the report. This affects the data integrity for our 4 analysts on the team.

title: SSO Login fails with MFA error
description: Users in US-West production are hitting an SSO error page after entering their credentials. The system rejects valid MFA codes, preventing login for about 94 users. We've checked the settings on our end, and this is definitely a network configuration error blocking the authentication handshake.

title: Chat Widget slow response times
description: The Chat Widget in the US-East production environment is experiencing significant delays. Messages take a long time to send and receive, and overall performance feels sluggish, especially when accessed via the mobile app. This is impacting the workflow for 15 active support agents.

title: Critical: Incorrect currency conversion leading to overcharges
description: Payment Gateway v2 in the APAC production environment is applying incorrect exchange rates to transactions. This has resulted in widespread overcharging for customers. The impact is critical, affecting approximately 1,719 users. Immediate investigation into the currency conversion logic is required.

title: SSO Synchronization delay and stuck provisioning
description: We are observing a noticeable delay in user synchronization within the SSO Integration Module in the US-West production environment. Specifically, provisioning jobs for 3 new hires appear to be stuck and are not completing. This is preventing those users from accessing necessary applications.

title: Certificate warnings blocking Wallet Service
description: The Wallet Service in the EU-Central production environment is throwing certificate expired warnings, which is disrupting transactions for 930 users. We are seeing SSL handshake issues. We think it's because of an incomplete rollback from the last deployment, so please check the cert chain against the previous version.

title: Analytics Dashboard is serving garbage JSON - definitely a hardware failure
description: Our production Analytics Dashboard in ANZ is completely broken for over 1000 users right now. The API responses are coming back as malformed JSON, so the UI just crashes or shows empty states. This is critical. We are certain this is a hardware failure on your end. We see no code changes on our side and this looks like a disk read error or RAM issue causing data corruption. Please investigate the physical infrastructure immediately.

title: Payment declined in sandbox environment
description: We are testing Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West sandbox environment. We are attempting to process a standard credit card transaction, but it is consistently being declined. We have verified the test card numbers and configuration are correct according to documentation. This affects our ability to finalize testing for the upcoming release, though impact is currently low.

title: HTTP 500 errors on Analytics Dashboard API in Sandbox
description: When accessing the Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM sandbox environment, we are receiving HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses. This occurs when calling the primary reporting endpoints. No end-users are currently impacted as this is a development environment, but it is blocking our integration testing.

title: Critical Compliance Issues: Audit Log Gaps and Data Residency Mismatch
description: We have identified multiple severe issues with Report Builder in production (ME region) that constitute a critical compliance risk affecting approximately 9,300 users. 1. We detected gaps in the audit logs where actions are not being recorded. 2. Our configured retention policies are not being applied; data older than the limit still exists. 3. There is a mismatch in data residency flags, indicating data may not be stored in the required regional boundaries. Immediate escalation required due to regulatory implications.

title: KPI Tracker showing missing records and data mismatches
description: We are experiencing data integrity issues with our KPI Tracker in the EU-West production environment. Several users (approx 500) are reporting that records are missing entirely from their views, while others see data mismatches where totals do not align with source systems. We need to understand if this is a synchronization issue or a reporting calculation error.

title: SSO Integration Sync Stuck
description: The sync process for our SSO Integration Module in the EU-West sandbox has hung and is not progressing. We are unable to determine if the SSO connector itself is failing or if there is an underlying issue with how group memberships are being synchronized. The status shows 'in progress' indefinitely.

title: Dashboard API issues
description: Hey, the Analytics Dashboard in LATAM sandbox isn't working right. We're getting empty responses, some errors, and weird JSON stuff. Lots of users are seeing this. Please check ASAP.

title: Data Residency Flag Mismatch and Missing Consent Records
description: In our production Analytics Dashboard (LATAM region), we have detected two specific compliance issues affecting about 55 users. First, the data residency flags on certain records do not match the configured regional policy. Second, we are seeing missing consent records associated with these same data points. We need clarification on why these discrepancies are appearing.

title: Metrics Engine data issues
description: We are seeing duplicate records and some missing records in the Metrics Engine. Not sure which data sets exactly, but the numbers don't look right.

title: Webhook Engine timeouts and slow performance affecting mobile app
description: Our Webhook Engine in production (ANZ) is extremely slow, with frequent timeouts. This is causing noticeable performance degradation in our mobile application, which relies on these webhooks for real-time updates. We believe the issue lies within the Webhook Engine's processing capabilities as the latency spikes correlate directly with our app's lag.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Overcharging and Declines - Likely Schema Issue
description: We are seeing a mix of issues with Payment Gateway v2 in production (EU-West). Some subscriptions are being charged twice, while other payments are declined unexpectedly. We are confident this is caused by a schema mismatch between our integration and your latest API version. Please advise on which schema fields need to be corrected to resolve the double-charging.

title: Total Outage of SSO Integration Module in APAC
description: We are experiencing a full outage of the SSO Integration Module in the APAC production environment. Users cannot authenticate, and all SSO-dependent services are inaccessible. This affects approximately 169 users and is currently blocking business operations. We need an immediate status update.

title: Corrupted Exports and Data Mismatch in Metrics Engine
description: Users in the US-West production environment are reporting that data exports from the Metrics Engine are corrupted (unopenable files or garbled content). Additionally, when data is successfully exported, there are mismatches compared to the values shown in the dashboard UI. This affects a small group of about 4 users.

title: Overcharge detected on two accounts
description: We have identified two instances of overcharges in our Payment Gateway v2 production environment (EU-Central). The amounts charged exceed the expected subscription fees. We have confirmed the pricing configuration on our side is correct. Please investigate the billing logic for these specific transactions.

title: Billing Engine weirdness
description: Our Billing Engine is acting up. Some people aren't renewing, some are getting charged twice, and the currency conversion looks wrong. Need help.

title: Config Manager staging environment unresponsive with HTTP 504 errors
description: We are experiencing significant issues with the Config Manager in our staging environment (LATAM region). The service has become completely unresponsive for approximately 138 users. We are seeing frequent HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors and sudden connection resets when trying to interact with the configuration interfaces. This is blocking our deployment testing and has a high business impact. Please investigate immediately.

title: Analytics Dashboard staging in EU-West causing mobile app slowdowns and timeouts
description: Our mobile application is performing poorly when connected to the Analytics Dashboard in the EU-West staging environment. We have about 10 users reporting significantly slow response times, which eventually lead to timeouts. The issue seems isolated to the integration between the mobile client and the dashboard data feeds. This is impacting our ability to validate mobile features in staging.

title: Analytics Dashboard LATAM staging: Audit log gaps and data residency mismatches
description: We noticed a discrepancy in the Analytics Dashboard within the LATAM staging environment. Specifically, there is a gap in the audit logs for recent activities, and we are also seeing a mismatch in the data residency flags. This affects about 7 users who rely on these logs for compliance checks. The impact is currently low, but we need clarity on whether this is a logging failure or a configuration error.

title: SSO Integration Module issue
description: Hi, we are getting 'permission denied' errors unexpectedly when trying to use the SSO integration in staging. Only one user is affected right now. It started happening recently but we aren't sure exactly when or why. Please help.

title: Payment Gateway v2 staging US-East: Missing audit logs and consent records
description: We have identified a high-priority issue with Payment Gateway v2 in our US-East staging environment affecting 138 users. We are seeing gaps in the audit logs, missing consent records, and mismatches in data residency flags. We think this is definitely a data migration defect from the previous system upgrade. Please verify if the migration script failed to carry over these specific records.

title: Analytics Dashboard APAC staging: Missing records and truncated files
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in the APAC staging environment is failing to display complete data. We are observing missing records in the main views and several exported files are truncated. This is critically impacting our data validation process for 346 users. The issue appears to be with the data retrieval or rendering layer, as the raw data seems to be stored but not presented correctly.

title: SSO Integration Module production LATAM: MFA rejections and unexpected session expirations
description: In our production environment (LATAM region), users of the SSO Integration Module are facing authentication issues. Approximately 22 users are reporting that their MFA codes are being rejected despite being valid, and they are also experiencing unexpected session expirations. This is disrupting workflow for our sales and support teams. We need to know if this is an identity provider configuration issue or a module bug.

title: Analytics Dashboard EU-West production: Slow responses and failed backup jobs
description: We are observing slow response times on the Analytics Dashboard in the EU-West production environment. Additionally, our scheduled backup jobs for the dashboard data are failing. This affects about 4 users primarily from the finance team. While the user impact is currently low, the backup failure is concerning. We suspect performance degradation might be linked to the backup timeout issues.

title: Deploy Manager staging US-West: Service unresponsive
description: The Deploy Manager in our US-West staging environment has become unresponsive. Two users are unable to trigger deployments or view deployment history. We have restarted the interface and cleared caches, but the issue persists. This is blocking our release candidates for testing. Please check the service health.

title: Mobile App ANZ Sandbox: UI and feature issues
description: Hi team, we are seeing some issues in the Mobile App sandbox for ANZ. A feature that should be there after the last release is missing, and some UI elements are misaligned. It looks bad for our demo. Please check. Thanks.

title: SSO Integration Module EU-Central: API errors
description: We are getting HTTP 429 errors and empty responses from the API when using the SSO Integration Module in production (EU-Central). About 9 users are affected. It happens intermittently. No other details right now.

title: Active Directory Sync US-West Sandbox: Elevated privileges observed
description: We have detected a security anomaly in the Active Directory Sync tool within our US-West sandbox environment. Several test accounts are showing elevated privileges that they should not have. This affects a group of 262 users in the sandbox and poses a high business risk if this behavior bleeds into production or indicates a logic flaw in the sync mapping. We need an immediate audit of the privilege assignment logic.

title: Analytics Dashboard US-East Dev: Malformed JSON responses
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our US-East development environment is returning malformed JSON responses. This is breaking the frontend visualization for 59 users on the dev team. We have checked the data sources and they look fine, so we believe the issue is within the Dashboard's API layer or serialization logic. Please investigate why the JSON structure is invalid.

title: Metrics Engine US-West Staging: Data mismatches and stale data
description: We are seeing significant data inconsistencies in the Metrics Engine in our US-West staging environment. Users report data mismatches between the dashboard and the raw metrics, as well as stale data not updating in real-time. This impacts 589 users and is hindering our ability to test new metric definitions. The business impact is high as we cannot trust the output of the engine.

title: Onboarding Wizard LATAM Production: Provisioning stuck and duplicate accounts
description: In our production environment (LATAM region), the Onboarding Wizard is experiencing issues with user provisioning. The process gets stuck at a certain stage for some users, and in other cases, it creates duplicate accounts. This affects approximately 23 new hires or clients and is causing confusion in our user directory. We need to resolve the provisioning logic and clean up the duplicates.

title: SSO MFA issues in LATAM Production
description: We are experiencing intermittent failures with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment (LATAM region). Approximately 20 users are affected. The issues are twofold: some users are receiving errors stating their MFA code is rejected even when entered correctly within the time limit, while other users are not seeing the MFA prompt at all after successful initial authentication, causing the login process to hang or fail. This is impacting daily access for a portion of our workforce.

title: Help Center index corruption detected
description: During routine maintenance checks on our production Help Center instance in the ME region, we detected signs of index corruption. There are currently no reported user-facing errors or downtime, and impact is minimal at this stage. We are logging this to ensure the integrity of the search functionality and article retrieval before it potentially affects user experience.

title: MFA prompt missing in Sandbox Onboarding
description: Our team is reporting that the Onboarding Wizard in the US-West sandbox environment is failing to trigger the MFA prompt for approximately 35 users. We are confident this is due to an identity provider outage on your end, as the login flow proceeds past the standard verification step without requiring the second factor. Please investigate the provider status.

title: Empty API responses from Payment Gateway
description: We are seeing API calls to the Payment Gateway v2 in the APAC sandbox return empty responses. This is definitely a bad deployment issue on your side, likely related to the recent push. One internal tester is affected, causing minor friction in our testing workflow, but we need the API to return proper payloads to continue validation.

title: High traffic errors: 502/504 and TLS failures
description: In our EU-Central development environment, we are observing a spike in HTTP 504 Gateway Timeouts, HTTP 502 Bad Gateway errors, and TLS handshake failures affecting over 300 users. The connection resets and timeouts are happening frequently. We are unsure if the Load Balancer is routing incorrectly or if the backend services (possibly related to data retention or backup processes) are failing to respond, causing the LB to drop connections.

title: Permission Engine SSO error page
description: A single user in our ANZ production environment encountered an SSO error page when trying to access resources governed by the Permission Engine. The specific error message indicates an authentication failure during the redirect. No other users are currently reporting this, so the impact is isolated, but we want to flag it to ensure there are no underlying configuration issues with the permission mappings.

title: Billing discrepancies in Payment Gateway
description: We have identified multiple billing-related issues with Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-Central production region. About 12 users are affected. Symptoms include invoices reflecting incorrect amounts, users being overcharged for services, and subscriptions that have not renewed automatically as expected. We need assistance reconciling these charges and ensuring future renewals process correctly.

title: Critical billing errors in US-East Staging
description: We are seeing widespread invoice inaccuracies and duplicate charges for subscriptions in the US-East staging environment, affecting over 12,000 users. This is a critical blocker for our release. We cannot determine if the Payment Gateway is processing the transactions twice or if the Usage Metering Service is sending duplicate events that are being billed incorrectly. The root cause needs to be identified to distinguish between a gateway logic failure and a metering ingestion error.

title: Rate Limiting and Capacity Alerts
description: Our production Rate Limiter in the ME region is consistently triggering 'quota exceeded' and 'capacity limit reached' errors. This is impacting approximately 1,386 users, causing significant disruption to our service availability. We need urgent assistance to review the current limits or investigate if the limiter is malfunctioning, as legitimate traffic is being blocked.

title: SSO Access Denied and Data Visibility Issues
description: In the APAC production environment, users utilizing the SSO Integration Module are facing two major issues. First, a significant number of users (approx. 493) are receiving 'Access Denied' errors despite having valid credentials. Second, some users who do gain access are seeing incorrect or restricted data views, suggesting a mismatch between their actual permissions and what the SSO token is conveying. This is severely impacting business operations.

title: MFA Failures and Account Lockouts
description: We are experiencing a critical issue with the SSO Integration Module in the ANZ production region where MFA prompts are not appearing for over 1,000 users. Consequently, these users are being locked out of their accounts. We are unsure if the SSO module is failing to trigger the challenge or if the Identity Lifecycle Manager is prematurely locking accounts due to a perceived lack of response. The result is a complete halt in access for a large portion of our user base.

title: Duplicate charge in APAC Sandbox
description: One of our testers reported a duplicate charge occurring in the Payment Gateway v2 sandbox environment (APAC). We think this is caused by a schema mismatch in the recent API updates. While there is no business impact currently, we need this resolved to ensure the data structures are correctly interpreted during testing.

title: Missing data in Analytics Dashboard
description: Users of the Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM development environment are reporting missing data points and, in some cases, full data loss for specific timeframes. Approximately 45 users are affected. The reports are inconsistent, with some segments showing no data where activity logs confirm events occurred. We need to investigate the data ingestion pipeline to restore visibility.

title: Unexpected Permission Denied in Session Controller
description: We observed an instance in the EU-West production environment where the Session Controller returned a 'permission denied unexpectedly' error. This appears to be an isolated event with no current user impact or widespread issues, but we are flagging it to monitor for potential instability in session management logic.

title: Payment Overcharge and Declines
description: In the LATAM production region, two users have reported issues with the Payment Gateway v2. One user was overcharged for a recent transaction, while another experienced an unexpected payment decline for a valid transaction. The impact is currently low but requires verification to ensure billing accuracy and transaction reliability.

title: Payment Gateway v2 charging incorrect amounts and declining valid payments in dev
description: We are seeing issues with Payment Gateway v2 in our development environment. Specifically, customers are being overcharged for certain transactions, while other valid payments are being unexpectedly declined. This affects about 29 users currently. Can you please investigate why the gateway is processing charges incorrectly?

title: Chargeback notices received despite undercharging
description: We received several chargeback notices in the US-West production environment. Upon reviewing the transactions, we noticed that the amounts were actually undercharged rather than overcharged. There are no known affected users or business impact at the moment, but we want to ensure this isn't a systemic billing error. Please check the reconciliation logs.

title: Session Controller login loop
description: Users in the APAC production region are stuck in a login loop. They enter credentials and get bounced back to the login screen. It's happening to a lot of people. Please fix.

title: Analytics Dashboard showing missing records and garbled text
description: In our EU-West production environment, the Analytics Dashboard is displaying garbled characters instead of readable text for some fields. Additionally, several expected records appear to be missing entirely from the view. This impacts about 29 users with moderate business consequences. Can you check the data rendering and retrieval logic?

title: Permission Engine slow and running out of space
description: Our dev environment for the Permission Engine is super slow. We are also getting disk space warnings and it seems like an index rebuild might be needed? Not sure what's causing the lag for the 24 affected users. Please advise.

title: Subscriptions not renewing and refunds missing in Chargeback Handler sandbox
description: In the ME region sandbox for Chargeback Handler, we have an issue where subscriptions are failing to renew automatically. Furthermore, refunds that were processed are not being reflected in the customer accounts. This is impacting 148 users with high business impact. Please investigate the renewal and refund posting mechanisms.

title: KPI Tracker returning 503 errors
description: The KPI Tracker service in the ME production environment is intermittently returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors. This is affecting about 10 users and has a moderate impact on our reporting. The errors seem to occur during peak usage times. Please check service health and capacity.

title: Chargeback Handler double charging and wrong currency rates
description: We are seeing critical issues in the Chargeback Handler in production. Some users are being charged twice for the same subscription, and the currency conversion rates applied are incorrect. This affects thousands of users (7717+) and is causing significant financial discrepancies. Please prioritize.

title: Active Directory Sync token errors and expired reset links
description: One user in our staging environment (US-East) is unable to reset their password. They report that the reset link expires immediately. We also see invalid token errors when trying to sync via Active Directory. Low impact, but please check the sync service configuration.

title: Payment Gateway v2 hitting rate limits and autoscaling failing
description: In the EU-Central staging environment, Payment Gateway v2 is frequently exceeding rate limits. It appears that autoscaling is not triggering as expected, leading to throttled requests. This affects 25 users and has a moderate impact. Can you verify the scaling policies and rate limit configurations?

title: Metrics Engine audit logs missing and account lockouts
description: Something weird is happening with the Metrics Engine in EU-Central prod. We have missing entries in the audit log, some accounts are getting locked out, and we're seeing elevated privileges where they shouldn't be. 11 users affected. Please look into it.

title: Status Page UI element not rendering for thousands of users
description: A critical issue with the Status Page in US-West production. A key UI element is failing to render, making the page unusable for a significant portion of our users. We have identified 15,286 affected users. This is severely impacting our ability to communicate service status. Please fix the rendering bug immediately.

title: Payment Gateway v2 data residency and consent record errors
description: We are encountering high-impact issues in the ANZ production environment with Payment Gateway v2. There is a mismatch in the data residency flags, and several consent records are missing from the transaction data. This affects 570 users and poses compliance risks. Please investigate the data handling and consent storage.

title: Notification Hub failing to send alerts
description: Our Notification Hub in the ME production environment is not sending out any alerts. It seems like the service is down or timing out, but we aren't seeing any error messages on our end. No users are currently affected, but this needs to be resolved urgently.

title: Unexpected chargeback notices in Payment Gateway v2 staging
description: We are receiving a high volume of chargeback notices in the APAC staging environment for Payment Gateway v2. These notices are appearing for transactions that should not be disputed. This is affecting 937 users and causing significant confusion and potential financial modeling errors. Please check why these disputes are being generated.

title: SSO Integration Module showing certificate expired warning in EU-West Production
description:
Hello,

We are receiving a 'certificate expired' warning within our SSO Integration Module dashboard. This is occurring in the EU-West production environment. description:
Hi Support,

title: Payment Gateway v2 Sandbox: Double charges, declines, and chargebacks
description:
Hello,

We are testing the Payment Gateway v2 in the LATAM sandbox environment and have encountered several issues. Please clarify if this is expected behavior or a bug.

title: Health check failures impacting Config Manager in APAC Production
description:
Hi,
