title: Billing issue with Payment Gateway v2
description: We think there is a bug in the Payment Gateway v2. Some customers are getting charged twice for their subscriptions. It started happening recently in US-West production. Please check.

title: Billing Disputes Handler ANZ: Wrong currency conversion
description: In the ANZ sandbox, the Billing Disputes Handler is applying incorrect currency conversion rates. We are pretty sure this is caused by the rate cache not clearing out after our last manual override, so the system is still using old exchange rates for new calculations.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Audit logs and consent records missing in US-East production
description: We are seeing issues with data retention and logging in our Payment Gateway v2 deployment in the US-East region. Specifically, our audit logs show gaps for transactions processed between last Tuesday and Thursday. Additionally, several users' consent records are completely missing from the database, and it appears the configured retention policies are not being applied to these records (some are purging too early or not at all). This has impacted about 56 users so far. Can you please investigate why the retention jobs are failing and why consent data isn't being persisted correctly?

title: Billing errors in APAC
description: Our APAC customers are getting overcharged. Refunds aren't showing up and subscriptions aren't renewing properly. This is affecting hundreds of users. Please fix ASAP.

title: Critical: Password reset links expiring immediately for EU-West SSO users
description: We are experiencing a critical issue with the SSO Integration Module in the EU-West region. Users requesting password resets are receiving emails, but the links expire almost instantly or fail upon click with an 'expired token' error. This is blocking approximately 19,831 users from accessing their accounts. We have verified that the time-to-live settings on our end haven't been changed recently. This seems to have started around 09:00 UTC today. Please prioritize this as it is causing a massive support backlog.

title: Help Center intermittent failures and potential failover issues in LATAM
description: We are observing intermittent failures in our Help Center in the LATAM region. Some users report being able to search articles fine, while others get 500 errors or timeouts. It looks like failover to the secondary data center isn't happening automatically when the primary node has issues, leading to partial outages. We're also seeing that file uploads within the help articles are failing sporadically, which might be related to the same underlying connectivity or widget issue. This is impacting around 1,290 users.

title: Staging login loop and billing sync issues for Payment Gateway v2
description: In our US-East staging environment for Payment Gateway v2, users are getting stuck in a login loop. They authenticate successfully but are redirected back to the login page. Alongside this, we are seeing discrepancies in usage metering; the billing dashboard shows zero usage for accounts that clearly made API calls during the session attempts. It's unclear if the login issue is preventing metering data from being sent, or if there are two separate problems here. This is affecting our internal test team of about 152 people.

title: Status Page and Consent Banner issues in ANZ after recent release
description: Following the latest release in the ANZ region, we are seeing several UI and functional issues. On our Status Page, forms fail to submit when users try to report incidents. Some UI elements are misaligned, and specific status categories seem to be missing. Separately, the Consent/Cookie Banner is not appearing on certain pages, or if it does, the 'Accept All' button doesn't register. We aren't sure if the banner issue is causing the form submission failures on the Status Page or if these are unrelated regressions from the update. Impacting roughly 555 users.

title: Currency and refund issues in Sandbox
description: Refunds aren't reflecting correctly in our ANZ sandbox environment. The currency conversion rates look wrong too. Not sure what the specific error is, but the amounts don't match. Please check.

title: Funnel Analyzer: Data loss and missing records in EU-Central Dev
description: We are noticing significant data inconsistencies in the Funnel Analyzer within our EU-Central development environment. Users are reporting that funnel steps they previously recorded are now missing from the analytics dashboard. We've compared raw event logs with the processed data and confirmed that records from the last 48 hours are absent in the final output. This has affected about 477 test accounts and is hindering our ability to validate the new tracking implementation.

title: Queue Manager access issues in LATAM - likely rollback problem
description: We are having trouble logging into the Queue Manager in production (LATAM). Users get an MFA code rejected error, and some are seeing federation metadata mismatches. We think this is definitely caused by the incomplete rollback from last night's deployment. Our team is pretty sure the config changes weren't fully reverted, which is breaking the SSO integration. Please check the rollback status immediately.

title: SSO MFA and session issues
description: MFA prompts aren't showing up for some users in ANZ. Also, sessions are expiring way too fast. Affects about 39 users. Please investigate.

title: Payment Gateway v2: Autoscaling not triggering in US-East Production
description: We've observed that autoscaling is not functioning as expected for our Payment Gateway v2 instance in US-East production. Despite hitting high CPU and memory utilization thresholds during peak transaction hours, no additional instances are being provisioned. We checked the autoscaling group configuration and it appears correct, but the scaling actions are not being executed. This has caused minor latency issues for a small subset of our high-volume clients (approx. 3 affected users). Could you check if there's an issue with the scaling policies or the metric ingestion?

title: Permission Engine: Password reset link expiration and invalid token errors in LATAM
description: Our Permission Engine in the LATAM region is failing to process password resets correctly. Users are receiving emails with reset links, but clicking them results in an 'Invalid Token' error. Some users also report that the link expires immediately upon generation. This is blocking access for approximately 130 users. We haven't changed any security token settings recently, so this seems to be a system-side issue. Please advise on troubleshooting steps or a fix.

title: Deploy Manager unresponsive - probably an expired certificate
description: Deploy Manager in US-East production is completely unresponsive. We can't trigger any new deployments or view logs. This is affecting about 359 users on our dev team. We think this is because of an expired certificate on the load balancer or the API endpoint. Please check the cert expiry dates, that's almost certainly the cause.

title: Payment Gateway v2 overcharges and declines in US-West
description: We are seeing customers being overcharged and payments declined unexpectedly in our US-West production environment. About 33 users are affected. We are pretty sure this is due to insufficient capacity planning on your end causing timeouts that result in double charges. It's not a code bug, it's a resource issue. Please add more capacity.

title: Secret Store outage in ANZ production
description: Our Secret Store in the ANZ region is currently unresponsive, causing a full outage for any services relying on it for credential retrieval. We cannot read or write secrets. This is impacting about 53 users/services. The service seems completely down rather than just degraded. Can you please investigate the root cause and provide an ETA for restoration?

title: Subscription Manager search results incorrect and UI glitches
description: We are experiencing issues with the Subscription Manager in the US-East production environment. When we use the search function, it returns the wrong customers or doesn't find profiles that definitely exist. Additionally, some UI elements in the results table fail to render properly, showing as blank spaces or broken links. This is affecting our support team's ability to quickly locate subscription details.

title: Payment Gateway v2 slow response times in EU-West
description: We are noticing significant delays in API responses from the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-West production environment. It takes up to 15 seconds to process a standard transaction, whereas it used to be under 2 seconds. We think this is happening because the documentation for the v2 integration is stale and we are following an outdated protocol. This is definitely a documentation problem that needs to be fixed urgently.

title: Help Center API timeouts and empty responses (EU-Central)
description: Our Help Center service in the EU-Central production environment is intermittently failing. Approximately 39 users have reported that the knowledge base search results fail to load. Upon investigation, we found that the API endpoint `/api/v1/help/search` is returning HTTP 200 OK but with an empty JSON body, or sometimes timing out completely after 30 seconds. We need assistance determining why the data is not being returned.

title: OAuth Service certificate warnings and missing audit logs (ANZ)
description: We are seeing critical errors in our OAuth Service in the ANZ region. Our security team has flagged expired certificate warnings during handshake processes, and we have also noticed that audit logs are missing entries for successful token refreshes. This affects over 15,000 users. We believe this is caused by a schema mismatch in our token payload structure which is confusing the logging service. Please investigate the schema validation logic.

title: Webhook Engine outage and restart loop (US-West)
description: The Webhook Engine in US-West production has gone down completely. We attempted a failover, but it did not trigger, and the primary pods are restarting repeatedly in a crash loop. About 19 users are impacted, but it is causing moderate disruption to our notification systems. This is definitely a third-party service failure on the downstream consumer side that is causing our engine to crash when it can't deliver.

title: SSO Integration Module bulk import stuck
description: I'm trying to perform a bulk user import via the SSO Integration Module in US-East production, but it is getting stuck at the provisioning stage. Only a few users were processed before it halted. This is an incorrect DNS configuration issue on my end, I think the A record for the callback URL isn't propagating correctly. Can you verify if you are seeing any DNS resolution errors from your side?

title: Queue Manager: Account lockout and privilege issues
description: We are observing several anomalies in the Queue Manager in the LATAM production environment. First, we see elevated privileges granted to service accounts unexpectedly. Second, a specific administrative account was locked out without any failed login attempts recorded. Finally, we are receiving certificate warnings when connecting to the manager endpoint. No users are currently impacted (reported impact is none), but these security signals require investigation.

title: Payment Gateway v2 sandbox timeouts and empty responses
description: In our sandbox environment for Payment Gateway v2 (ANZ region), we are encountering frequent timeouts when calling the charge API. When the request does not timeout, it occasionally returns an empty response body instead of the expected transaction ID. This is severely blocking our testing process for about 793 internal test cases/users. We need to know why the sandbox is behaving this way.

title: Payment Gateway v2 audit log gaps and missing consent
description: We have detected a gap in our audit logs for Payment Gateway v2 in US-East production. Furthermore, consent records for approximately 425 users are missing from the compliance dashboard. We are certain this is due to a schema mismatch between our data ingestion pipeline and the logging database, causing those specific fields to be dropped. Please review the mapping logic.

title: Analytics Dashboard: Malformed JSON in Dev Environment
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our development environment (ANZ) is failing to render charts. The browser console shows a 'SyntaxError: Unexpected token' error. Upon inspecting the network traffic, the API response body contains malformed JSON, specifically unclosed brackets and invalid escape characters. This is a critical blocker for our 5,620 development team members as they cannot view any analytics data.

title: Payment Gateway v2 incorrect currency conversion and double charges
description: We are receiving reports from our APAC production customers of incorrect currency conversions on invoices. Some users are also being charged twice for a single subscription renewal. We think this is because of a stale cache on our checkout page serving old exchange rates and previous transaction IDs. This is affecting 718 users and needs immediate resolution to prevent further billing errors.

title: Wallet Service: Audit gaps and data residency mismatch
description: In the ANZ production environment, our Wallet Service is showing gaps in audit logs for transaction history. Additionally, we have a mismatch in the data residency flags, where some data appears to be stored outside the approved region despite the configuration. We suspect this is due to database contention causing write timeouts and log failures. Please investigate the database lock states.

title: Payment Gateway v2 staging overcharge issue
description: We have noticed that test transactions in the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment (ME region) are resulting in overcharges. The final amount deducted from the test account is higher than the initial quote. While this does not impact production users or revenue, it is blocking our integration testing. We need to understand why the staging calculation logic is deviating from the expected values.

title: SSO Integration Module: Redirect loops in sandbox
description: Our SSO Integration Module in the ME sandbox environment is causing infinite redirect loops during login attempts. Users are unable to access the application and are stuck bouncing between our portal and the identity provider. We are convinced this is an incorrect DNS configuration issue where the callback URL is pointing to the wrong sandbox instance. Please check the DNS records we provided.

title: Analytics Dashboard intermittent failures in EU-West staging
description: We are experiencing intermittent failures in the Analytics Dashboard in our EU-West staging environment. Sometimes the charts load correctly, but other times they fail to display any data or return a generic error. We cannot determine if the issue lies within the Dashboard UI itself or if the underlying Analytics API Gateway is failing to route requests consistently. The instability affects 434 users testing the new features.

title: Critical latency affecting 5k+ users on mobile app via Analytics
description: We are seeing a significant slowdown in our mobile application starting this morning. The issue appears to be originating from the Analytics Dashboard backend, as API calls from the app are timing out or taking upwards of 15 seconds to complete. This is impacting approximately 5,500 active users in the US-West region. The dashboard itself is loading slowly, but the main concern is that the high latency is causing our mobile clients to fail requests and show error screens to end-users. This is a critical blocker for our launch event today.

title: MFA prompts missing for SSO login in Middle East region
description: Hello, we have noticed that Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is not triggering for a subset of our users attempting to log in via the SSO Integration Module. This is specific to users in the ME region. Normally, after entering credentials, an MFA prompt should appear, but currently, users are being logged in directly without the second factor. This affects about 63 employees and is a moderate security concern. We have verified that the MFA configuration for these user groups is correct. Please investigate why the prompt is being suppressed.

title: API returning empty responses causing login failures for 8k users
description: Our production environment is experiencing a critical issue with the SSO Integration Module. The authentication API is returning empty responses to client requests, which is causing login failures for a large portion of our user base. We have roughly 8,009 users in US-West unable to authenticate. Logs indicate that the request is reaching the endpoint but no body is returned, suggesting a timeout or drop upstream, but from our perspective, the API is simply silent. This is breaking all single sign-on access.

title: Missing localization strings in Event Tracker (Dev)
description: We are seeing missing text labels in the Event Tracker for non-English languages in our development environment. It looks like the localization files aren't being served correctly. This is definitely an expired certificate problem on the CDN side preventing the JSON language files from downloading. We need you to renew the cert ASAP because it's blocking our APAC team from testing the localized interface for over 1,000 users.

title: Analytics Dashboard freezing with database deadlock errors
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our APAC production environment is frequently becoming unresponsive. When we try to generate reports or view real-time metrics, the system hangs and eventually throws a 'database deadlock detected' error. This is happening for about 388 users. The dashboard seems to be the primary issue here; it's likely locking tables or not releasing connections properly. We need a fix for the deadlock handling within the dashboard's query engine.

title: Webhook retries exhausted for Payment Gateway in ANZ
description: We have observed that some transaction webhooks from Payment Gateway v2 are failing delivery. Specifically, the system has exhausted all retry attempts for these events. This affects a small number of users (3) in the ANZ production region. The impact is low, but we want to understand why the webhooks are dropping so we can prevent data sync issues. Can you provide logs or insights into why these specific webhooks failed to deliver after retries?

title: SSO Certificate warnings in Staging environment
description: Our SSO Integration Module in the ANZ staging environment is throwing certificate expired warnings and general certificate validation errors. This is preventing us from testing SSO flows effectively for our team of 51 users. The warnings indicate that the SSL/TLS certificate used for the integration is either expired or nearing expiration. Please advise on the renewal process or if there is a specific configuration update needed to resolve these trust issues in staging.

title: MFA code rejection and metadata mismatch in Payment Gateway SSO
description: We are encountering two related issues with authentication in the Payment Gateway v2 production environment (ANZ). First, valid MFA codes are being rejected. Second, we are seeing federation metadata mismatch errors during the handshake. This is affecting 19 users and is causing login failures. It seems like the identity provider metadata might be out of sync with what the payment gateway expects, which could be causing the MFA validation to fail. Please check the metadata configuration.

title: Index corruption and query timeouts in Secret Store
description: We are receiving alerts about index corruption and database query timeouts within the Secret Store service. We aren't sure if the corruption is causing the timeouts or if a separate database performance issue is leading to the corruption warnings. Currently, there are no reported user impacts or affected users (0), but the health status is yellow. We need help diagnosing whether the underlying database indices need rebuilding or if there is a configuration issue causing slow queries that trigger the timeout errors.

title: Unauthorized elevated privileges in Permission Engine (Staging)
description: We have detected elevated privileges being granted to specific roles in the Permission Engine in our LATAM staging environment. This is affecting around 906 users and is a high-impact issue for us. We believe the Permission Engine itself is incorrectly applying role inheritance or defaulting to admin scopes for certain groups. There is no indication of external dependency issues; it appears to be a logic flaw or configuration error within the engine's policy evaluation. Please review the permission assignment logic.

title: Corrupted export files from Metrics Engine
description: When exporting data from the Metrics Engine in our development environment (US-West), the generated CSV and JSON files are corrupted. They are either empty or contain binary garbage at the start. This affects a small team of 8 developers. We have tried multiple times with different metrics ranges, and the issue persists. The export function seems to be failing to properly serialize the data. Please investigate the export module.

title: Metrics Engine hitting rate limits unexpectedly
description: We are seeing 'rate limit exceeded' errors from the Metrics Engine in our EU-West production environment. This is happening even though our usage appears to be within the contracted limits for our account. Currently, there are no impacted users (0) and no business impact, but we want to clarify why the rate limiter is triggering. Is there a configuration change or a specific endpoint that is counting towards the limit incorrectly? We believe the Metrics Engine is throttling us unfairly.

title: Canary rollout stalled for API Gateway in ANZ
description: We initiated a canary deployment for our API Gateway in the ANZ production region, but the rollout process has stalled. The traffic split is stuck at the initial percentage, and the health checks are not passing to allow the deployment to proceed. This is affecting 57 users who are part of the canary group. We need assistance in determining why the canary traffic is not being routed or why the deployment status is hung.

title: Payment declines and chargeback notices in Fee Analyzer
description: We are observing a pattern of payment declines in the Fee Analyzer tool, followed shortly by chargeback notices for the same transactions. This is occurring in our development environment (US-West) and affects a test user base of 31. We suspect the Fee Analyzer is miscalculating transaction limits or flags, leading to declines that shouldn't be happening. Please review the logic that triggers declines and how it interacts with the chargeback notification system.

title: Timeouts in Analytics Dashboard sandbox
description: The dashboard keeps timing out. We are trying to view some reports in the sandbox EU-Central region but the page just spins and fails. It's happening for a few of us. Not sure when it started exactly. Please fix.

title: SSO Login Failures and MFA Rejection in Production (EU-West)
description: We are experiencing significant issues with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment (EU-West region). Approximately 36 users are currently unable to log in. The process starts normally but fails at the second step: the Multi-Factor Authentication code is consistently rejected as invalid, even when entered within the timeout window. This results in a generic SSO error page being displayed to the end-user. We have verified that user credentials and MFA setups are correct on our side. This is impacting daily operations for the affected staff.

title: Incorrect Tax Calculation and Undercharging in Invoice Service (Staging)
description: During testing in the staging environment (ME region), we have identified discrepancies in the Invoice Service output. Specifically, the tax amounts applied to generated invoices are incorrect, resulting in overall undercharging for certain line items. This affects approximately 22 test accounts we are monitoring. The issue appears to be isolated to the tax calculation logic within the invoice generation step. We need this clarified before promoting these changes to production.

title: Third-Party API Unavailable Affecting Notification Hub (Staging)
description: We are observing failures in the Notification Hub within our staging environment (US-East). It appears that a third-party API dependency required for sending notifications is currently unavailable. While this does not impact production, it is blocking our ability to test notification workflows. Could you confirm if this is a known issue with the provider or if there is a status page we should be monitoring?

title: Analytics Dashboard Webhooks Not Firing in Development
description: I'm working in the ANZ development environment with the Analytics Dashboard. I have configured several webhooks to trigger when specific data thresholds are met, but they are not firing at all. The dashboard UI shows the data updating correctly, but no HTTP requests are being sent to our endpoints. I've double-checked the webhook URL configuration and payload settings in the dashboard interface, and everything looks correct. Can you help investigate why the webhook triggers aren't working?

title: Proration Calculations Incorrect in Payment Gateway v2 (Staging)
description: We are seeing errors in proration calculations within the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment (ANZ region). When users upgrade or downgrade their subscription tiers mid-cycle, the prorated amounts charged are incorrect. This issue has affected 3 recent test transactions. The base charge seems correct, but the adjustment for the unused time period is miscalculated. This is a low-priority bug for us but needs to be fixed before go-live.

title: Database Deadlocks and Index Corruption Detected via Rate Limiter (Production)
description: Our monitoring tools, specifically the Rate Limiter module in the US-East production environment, have detected critical database errors. We are seeing reports of index corruption and frequent database deadlocks. These issues are causing moderate disruption, affecting approximately 20 users with intermittent failures. The errors appear to be originating from the backend data layer. We need urgent assistance to resolve the underlying data integrity issues.

title: Users cannot login or verify MFA
description: Hi, many users in the EU-West region are reporting they can't log in. The MFA codes aren't working and they get login failure errors. It's happening for a lot of people. Please check.

title: Payment Declines and Overcharging Issues in Payment Gateway v2 (Staging)
description: We are encountering intermittent issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in the ANZ staging environment. Some transactions are being declined without a clear error reason from the gateway. Additionally, in cases where payments do go through, we have observed overcharging on 3 specific test accounts. There are no business impacts on production users at this time, but these behaviors need to be investigated to ensure billing accuracy during our upcoming release cycle.

title: SSO Module Issues in Dev
description: We are seeing problems with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-West development environment. Some accounts are getting locked out, and we noticed entries missing from the audit logs. About 49 users are affected. Not sure exactly when it started or what the specific error codes are, but the logging is definitely incomplete and logins are failing.

title: Critical Billing Engine Performance and Data Issues in APAC Production
description: We are experiencing severe degradation in the Billing Engine within our APAC production environment. Backup jobs have failed to complete, and we are observing high replication lag, leading to significantly slow response times for our users. This is impacting approximately 229 active users and is considered a critical incident for our business operations. We need immediate support to restore backup functionality and reduce latency.

title: Webhook and API Errors in Payment Gateway v2 (Staging)
description: In the EU-West staging environment, the Payment Gateway v2 is exhibiting several API-related errors. Webhook retries are being exhausted without successful delivery. Furthermore, when querying specific endpoints, the API returns empty responses instead of the expected JSON objects, and we are also encountering schema validation errors. This affects 2 internal test users but is blocking our integration testing efforts. Priority is low for production but medium for our development timeline.

title: Chargeback Handler Errors and Log Gaps
description: Hi team, in the sandbox EU-Central environment, our Chargeback Handler seems buggy. We have some accounts locked out and we can't find entries in the audit log for certain actions. Also seeing some elevated privileges being reported. Affects around 31 users. We don't have exact timestamps for when this started but it's disrupting our testing.

title: Critical Security Alert: Missing Audit Logs and Elevated Privileges in Permission Engine (US-West)
description: We have identified a critical security anomaly in our production Permission Engine (US-West region). The audit logs are missing entries for specific high-level actions, which is preventing us from tracking changes accurately. Concurrently, we have observed unauthorized elevated privileges being granted to certain user roles. This issue potentially affects over 21,000 users. Given the security implications and the scale of impact, this requires immediate investigation and remediation to ensure compliance and data integrity.

title: Certificate Expired Warning Causing Critical Outages in Payment Gateway v2 (US-West)
description: Our production Payment Gateway v2 in the US-West region is generating 'certificate expired' warnings, which is causing widespread connectivity issues. This has resulted in a critical failure of transaction processing for approximately 26,325 users. The warning messages are appearing in our system logs, and the affected endpoints are timing out or rejecting connections. Immediate intervention is required to update or renew the relevant certificates to restore service stability.

title: Data Mismatch Observed in Notification Hub (EU-West)
description: We are seeing a data mismatch in the Notification Hub within our EU-West production environment. The data reflected in the notifications sent to users does not align with the source records. This issue has been observed by 2 specific users and is considered low impact. We have verified the source data is correct, suggesting the discrepancy arises during the notification generation or delivery process. Requesting an investigation into the data mapping logic.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Audit Logs Missing Entries and Privilege Escalation Alerts
description: We are observing gaps in our Payment Gateway v2 audit logs in the EU-West production environment. Specifically, several transaction entries appear to be missing entirely. Additionally, our security monitoring has flagged instances of elevated privileges that do not correspond to authorized admin actions. This is concerning for compliance reasons, though no direct user impact has been noticed yet.

title: Billing Engine Double Charging Users - Race Condition Suspected
description: We are seeing payment declines followed by successful overcharges in the Billing Engine staging environment (US-West). About 57 users have been charged twice for the same subscription. This is definitely a race condition problem. We think the system isn't locking the transaction properly when multiple requests hit at once, causing the duplicate charges.

title: SSO Integration Module Login Failures and Metadata Mismatch
description: Users in the EU-West production environment are unable to log in via the SSO Integration Module. The symptoms include SSO error pages, password reset links that show as expired immediately, and a federation metadata mismatch error. Only about 6 users are currently affected, so the impact is low, but it prevents them from accessing the platform.

title: Analytics Dashboard Slow Performance and High CPU Usage
description: The Analytics Dashboard in the EU-West production environment is responding very slowly to user queries. We have also observed significant spikes in CPU usage on the underlying infrastructure. While this is affecting usability, we have not received specific reports of failed requests or data loss, and the number of affected users is currently reported as zero, suggesting it might be intermittent or widespread but not yet breaking core functionality.

title: Analytics Dashboard Unresponsive in ANZ Region
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in the ANZ production environment has become completely unresponsive. We expected the service to failover to a secondary node, but that did not occur. This is a high-impact issue affecting approximately 183 users who cannot access their reports. Please investigate why the dashboard itself is not recovering or switching over.

title: Permission Engine Provisioning Stuck in EU-Central
description: We are experiencing issues with the Permission Engine in the EU-Central production environment. User provisioning processes are getting stuck and not completing. We haven't seen any user complaints yet, but the jobs are clearly hanging in the queue.

title: SSO Bulk Import Failure
description: The SSO Integration Module bulk import failed partially. We have a lot of users who didn't get imported. Need help fixing this ASAP as it's impacting many people.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Webhooks Not Firing Due to Rate Limits
description: In the US-West production environment, we are noticing that webhooks from the Payment Gateway v2 are not firing. Our logs indicate that we are hitting rate limits ('rate limit exceeded'). This is causing a backlog of transaction confirmations and is impacting about 254 users with delayed updates.

title: Session Controller Login Failures in Sandbox
description: We are seeing widespread login failures in the Session Controller within our EU-West sandbox environment. Approximately 547 users are unable to log in. The error occurs right at the authentication step. Please check why logins are failing in this non-production environment.

title: Feedback Collector Forms Failing to Submit
description: The Feedback Collector in the EU-West sandbox is failing to submit forms. We have about 155 users trying to send feedback. We think it's because of a policy misconfiguration. We recently changed some security policies and it looks like the form submission is getting blocked.

title: OAuth Service Account Lockouts and MFA Issues
description: Users in the LATAM production environment are being locked out of their accounts via the OAuth Service. Furthermore, the MFA prompt is not appearing when it should. This is affecting 36 users with moderate impact. This is definitely an incorrect DNS configuration problem. Our DNS settings for the auth server seem to be pointing to the wrong place.

title: Identity Vault API Errors and Throttling
description: We are receiving API schema errors and HTTP 429 responses when interacting with the Identity Vault in the LATAM staging environment. This is causing high impact for our 279 test users who cannot complete identity workflows.

title: SSO Integration Module Showing Wrong Tenant Data
description: In the US-West production environment, users logging in through the SSO Integration Module are occasionally seeing data from a different tenant. We also have reports of 'access denied' errors following these incidents. This is affecting about 38 users and is a moderate security and usability concern.

title: Self-Service Hub UI Elements Not Rendering
description: Critical issue in the ME production environment with the Self-Service Hub. Key UI elements are not rendering for 2,532 users. We think it's because of version incompatibility. It seems like the new frontend update doesn't play well with our current browser versions.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Audit Log Gaps and Retention Issues
description: We have detected gaps in our Payment Gateway v2 audit logs in the US-East production environment. Specific entries are missing, and our automated checks have flagged these as 'audit log gap detected'. Additionally, it appears that the configured retention policy is not being applied correctly. This is a critical compliance issue affecting 1,285 users' transaction records.

title: Rate Limiter service unresponsive in production (EU-West)
description: We are experiencing issues with the Rate Limiter service in our production environment within the EU-West region. The service has become completely unresponsive, leading to a moderate business impact. Approximately 57 users are currently affected and cannot proceed with requests that rely on this component. Please investigate immediately.

title: Analytics Dashboard: Missing audit logs and incomplete compliance reports in ANZ production
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in the ANZ production region is displaying incomplete data. Specifically, we have noticed that certain entries are missing from the audit logs, which has consequently caused our compliance reports to generate with gaps. This is affecting one user who is responsible for these reports. While the impact is currently low, we need this resolved to ensure accurate reporting.

title: SSO Integration Module showing certificate expiration warnings (ME Production)
description: We are seeing warnings related to certificate expiration on the SSO Integration Module in our Middle East production environment. The system is flagging potential issues with the current certificates. There are no critical failures yet, but 7 users are affected by these warnings, and the overall business impact is considered low. We would like to check if these certificates need renewal or if this is a false positive.

title: Analytics Dashboard returning HTTP 429 errors
description: The Analytics Dashboard in the US-West production environment is intermittently returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors. This has resulted in no significant business impact and does not appear to be affecting any specific users at this moment. We are logging this for visibility and potential rate limit adjustments.

title: CRITICAL: Report Builder form submission failure in ANZ Production

title: Security Anomalies in SSO Module (ME Production)
description: We have detected elevated privileges being assigned to unexpected users in the ME production environment, along with missing entries in the audit log for these events. We are confident that this is a data quality issue within our directory source that is causing the SSO module to misinterpret user roles. We need you to look at how the data ingestion handles malformed records, as we believe bad data is slipping through and causing these permission errors.

title: Truncated CSV exports from Data Export Service in EU-West
description: Our scheduled daily exports via the Data Export Service in the EU-West production region are returning truncated files. The CSV files stop writing mid-stream, resulting in incomplete datasets for our BI team. This affects reports for approximately 40 users. We have verified that the source data is intact and that the query runs successfully in the database. The issue appears to be on the file generation or transmission side. Please investigate the export pipeline.

title: HTTP 429 Errors and Malformed JSON Responses in US-West Production
description: We are receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) responses from the Payment Gateway API in our US-West production environment, which is impacting 59 users. Concurrently, when successful responses are returned, the JSON body is malformed and cannot be parsed by our SDK. This combination suggests either a rate limiting configuration issue or a serialization bug on the gateway side. We need these resolved to restore stable transaction processing.

title: High volume of payment declines and chargebacks in EU-Central Development
description: Our development environment in EU-Central is simulating a high volume of payment declines, which is unexpectedly triggering chargeback notices in the system. This is confusing our testing team as chargebacks should not be generated for declined transactions during development. This issue is blocking validation for 285 test cases. We need to understand why the state machine is transitioning to 'chargeback' instead of 'failed'.

title: Compliance Report Gaps due to Missing Audit Logs
description: We have identified gaps in our audit logs for US-East production, which has resulted in incomplete compliance reports for 38 users. We believe this is definitely an idempotency failure in the gateway processing logic, causing duplicate requests to overwrite previous log entries instead of being handled separately. We need the engineering team to investigate the deduplication mechanism, as we are certain this is where the data loss is occurring.

title: Webhook Delivery Failures in APAC Production SSO
description: We are observing that webhook retries have been exhausted for the SSO Integration Module in the APAC production region. Notifications for user lifecycle events are not being delivered to our endpoint. This has affected 670 users, causing a desynchronization between our identity provider and our internal systems. The receiving endpoint is up and healthy; we suspect the issue is on the sender side or network path. Please escalate as this is a high-impact stability issue.

title: Duplicate charges on subs
description: Users are saying they got charged twice for their subscription. We have about 30 people complaining. Please fix ASAP.

title: Critical: Incorrect tax calculation and duplicate billing in Production (ME)
description: We are observing two distinct issues affecting Payment Gateway v2 in our Middle East production environment. First, the tax amount applied to invoices is incorrect for several customers. Second, some of these same customers are being charged twice for their subscriptions. This is impacting approximately 1,935 users and is considered a critical business blocker. Please investigate the billing logic and tax engine immediately.

title: Users locked out after login attempts
description: Two of our users are getting locked out of their accounts. They enter their credentials, but instead of logging in, the account gets locked. We aren't sure if this is an issue with the OAuth token generation or if their SAML assertions are being rejected incorrectly. Can you check the authentication logs to see where the failure is happening?

title: Payment declines followed by double charges
description: We are seeing a weird sequence in our Payment Gateway v2 production logs. Many transactions are showing as 'declined' on the front end, but the customer's bank account is actually being debited, sometimes twice. It looks like either the gateway is failing to communicate the decline correctly, or the settlement service is retrying failed transactions that shouldn't be retried. This is critical and affecting ~1360 users.

title: Overcharges and bad FX rates in Staging
description: During testing of Chargeback Handler v2 in the ME staging environment, we noticed that when a chargeback is processed, the final amount charged to the merchant is too high. Additionally, the currency conversion applied seems wrong. We can't tell if the issue is with how the chargeback handler calculates the delta or if the underlying Subscription Billing Engine is applying the incorrect exchange rate before the chargeback logic even runs.

title: Sandbox payment gateway sending wrong invoices
description: In the EU-West sandbox, we are receiving chargeback notices for invoices that look incorrect. We are definitely seeing stale cache data on our end causing the invoice details to mismatch what was originally charged. Please clear the cache and reprocess.

title: Missing consent records in APAC
description: We have 26 users in the APAC production environment with missing consent records in Payment Gateway v2. We think this is because of a customer configuration error on our side where we didn't enable the right feature flag, but we need you to confirm.

title: Certificate expiration warnings in Development Role Manager
description: Our development team in the ME region is reporting 'certificate expired' warnings when using the Role Manager module. The errors started appearing this morning. There are 42 developers affected, which is blocking our role assignment testing. Please check the certificate status and renew if necessary.

title: Webhook retries exhausted in LATAM Production
description: We are noticing that webhooks from the Analytics Dashboard are failing and exhausting their retry attempts. This is happening in our LATAM production environment. About 18 users are affected by missing analytics data as a result. We need to understand why the webhooks are failing and why they aren't recovering after the initial retries.

title: Rate limit exceeded and timeouts in EU-Central Sandbox
description: While testing the SSO Integration Module in the EU-Central sandbox, we are hitting 'rate limit exceeded' errors followed by timeouts. This is affecting about 37 test accounts. The issue seems consistent during high-load simulation. Please review the sandbox rate limits and timeout configurations.

title: Refund not reflected in account balance

title: Invoice export issues
description: We are seeing duplicate records and some missing records in the invoice exports. The file is also truncated. Not sure which environment this is affecting but it looks broken. Please check.

title: Elevated privileges and cert warnings in US-East Prod

This affects approximately 682 active test users and is blocking our compliance sign-off for the release. Please investigate why these log entries were not captured.

This is impacting about 213 users who are currently locked out of the Payment Gateway v2 staging instance. We have confirmed the system time is synced correctly. Please check the token expiration configuration.

Please investigate the root cause urgently.

This is affecting 21266 users in the sandbox and is critical as it prevents us from testing authentication flows. Please check the MFA service integration in this environment.

Please investigate if the permission checks are failing to return a valid token, causing the loop.

This affects 9,309 users and is critically blocking our release schedule. Please investigate the gateway response times.
