This is leading to dropped sessions and users needing to re-authenticate. Currently, we haven't identified a broad business impact or a large number of affected users, but the timeouts are occurring. Please check the Session Controller for any latency or timeout configurations that might be causing this behavior.

title: Analytics Dashboard High Latency and Query Timeouts (APAC)
description: Users in our APAC production environment are reporting that the Analytics Dashboard is extremely slow. Some queries are timing out before returning results. This is affecting about 3 users who are trying to access specific heavy reports. The business impact is currently low, but we would like the dashboard to load data faster and prevent query timeouts for complex analytics.

title: Duplicate subscription charges and missed renewals in Production APAC
description: We are seeing significant billing errors for our customers in the APAC region using Payment Gateway v2. Specifically, some users are being charged twice for their monthly subscriptions, while others are not being renewed at all despite having valid payment methods. This is affecting approximately 349 users and causing a high volume of support tickets. We need this investigated urgently as it impacts our revenue and customer trust.

title: CRITICAL: Analytics Dashboard failover did not trigger in ANZ
description: During a recent outage event, the Analytics Dashboard in the ANZ production environment failed to execute its automatic failover. The service remained unavailable, impacting over 9,500 users. Since the failover did not occur, we are experiencing a complete loss of data visibility for this region. This is a critical issue requiring immediate attention.

title: Duplicate records appearing in Analytics Dashboard (US-West)
description: We have noticed duplicate entries in our production Analytics Dashboard for the US-West region. These duplicates are appearing in several data tables, resulting in inflated metrics for about 55 affected users. While the impact is moderate, it is affecting the accuracy of our reporting. Please investigate the source of these duplicates.

title: Customer Portal issues
description: Hey, we're having some problems with the Customer Portal. A few users are complaining that they can't log in or access their accounts properly. It seems like the site is being slow or blocking them for some reason. Not sure exactly when it started or who else is affected, but we need help fixing this soon.

title: High impact timeouts in Development Analytics Dashboard (ANZ)
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in the ANZ development environment is experiencing persistent timeouts. This is severely hindering our development workflow, affecting approximately 988 internal users who rely on this environment for testing. The timeouts are frequent and make it nearly impossible to view reports or validate data changes. We need a resolution to restore stability to the dev environment.

title: Billing Engine double charging customers in ME
description: We are observing that the Billing Engine in the Middle East (ME) production region is incorrectly charging some customers twice for the same subscription period. This overcharging is causing distress among our subscriber base. Approximately 22 users have reported this issue. We believe the Billing Engine is malfunctioning and need to identify why these duplicate transactions are being processed.

title: Subscription Manager retention and residency issues in LATAM Dev
description: The Subscription Manager in the LATAM development environment is not correctly applying retention policies. Additionally, we are seeing data residency flags that do not match the expected configuration for this region. This discrepancy is causing issues for about 214 users and could potentially lead to compliance problems if it reaches production. We need the Subscription Manager to correctly reflect the retention and residency rules.

title: Data residency flag mismatch and audit log gaps in Analytics Dashboard (LATAM)
description: In the LATAM production environment, we have identified a mismatch between the expected and actual data residency flags on the Analytics Dashboard. Furthermore, our audit logs show gaps where critical access events are not being recorded. This affects 33 users and raises concerns about data integrity and compliance visibility. We need these discrepancies investigated to ensure proper data handling and complete audit trails.

title: Missing feature in Billing Disputes Handler after latest release
description: Following the recent release in the ME production region, a specific feature in the Billing Disputes Handler is missing. The dispute resolution workflow is incomplete, affecting approximately 89 users who rely on this functionality to manage chargebacks and billing errors. We expected this feature to be available post-release. Please restore the missing component to the Billing Disputes Handler.

title: SSO Integration Module: Metadata mismatch and expired reset links
description: We are encountering two issues with the SSO Integration Module in the LATAM production environment. First, there is a mismatch in the federation metadata, which is causing authentication failures for some users. Second, password reset links sent through the SSO flow are expiring prematurely, preventing users from recovering their accounts. This affects about 56 users and is creating a bottleneck in account access. Please resolve the metadata configuration and reset link validity.

title: UI element not rendering in Attribution Engine (APAC)
description: In the APAC production environment, a specific UI element within the Attribution Engine is failing to render. This issue is currently affecting 2 users who are unable to view or interact with that part of the interface. While the impact is low, it prevents these users from completing their analysis tasks. Please investigate why the UI component is not displaying correctly.

title: Admin Console Full Outage in EU-West Staging
description: The Admin Console in the EU-West staging environment is completely down. We cannot access any administrative features, which is blocking our testing and deployment processes. We think this is definitely an incomplete rollback issue from the last update that failed to clean up properly. This is impacting 5,717 users and is a critical blocker for our team. Please prioritize this.

title: Invoice Service errors: Non-renewals, incorrect invoices, and chargebacks
description: Our customers in the US-West production region are facing multiple issues traced to the Invoice Service. Subscriptions are not renewing, invoices are displaying incorrect amounts, and we are receiving chargeback notices. This affects 212 users and has a high business impact. We need to investigate the Invoice Service immediately to stop these billing errors and resolve the underlying causes.

title: SSO Integration Module stuck in Sandbox (ANZ)
description: We are seeing issues in the ANZ sandbox environment with the SSO Integration Module. User provisioning is getting stuck, sync processes are not completing, and bulk imports are partially failing. We are pretty sure this is a clock/time synchronization issue between our servers and the SSO provider causing these timeouts and hangs. Please check the time settings on your end.

title: Provisioning stuck and bulk import failures in SSO Integration Module (ANZ Prod)
description: In the ANZ production environment, the SSO Integration Module is experiencing stalled user provisioning and partial failures in bulk import operations. Approximately 23 users are affected by these delays and errors. The process hangs without completing, requiring manual intervention. We need to identify why the SSO Integration Module is failing to process these requests correctly.

title: Issue in sandbox with self-service hub
description: Something is wrong with the environment variables and flags not working. It's affecting about 30 users. Please check.

title: Duplicate records and missing data in Analytics Dashboard (US-East Prod)
description: We are observing inconsistencies in the production Analytics Dashboard. Specifically, we are seeing duplicate entries in the transaction logs alongside some records that appear to be missing entirely. This started recently for the US-East region. No users are currently reporting impact, but we need these discrepancies investigated.

title: High volume of payment declines in Production (ME Region)
description: Our production environment in the Middle East region is experiencing a high failure rate for payment processing. Approximately 458 users have reported that their payments are being declined unexpectedly. This is causing significant business impact and needs immediate attention.

title: Index corruption detected in Analytics Dashboard
description: We have detected what appears to be index corruption in the production Analytics Dashboard for the US-East region. This is impacting data retrieval for about 31 users. Please investigate the integrity of the underlying data structures.

title: Refunds not processing and duplicate subscription charges
description: We are facing critical billing issues in our production Payment Gateway v2 setup (ME region). Users are reporting that refunds are not being reflected in their accounts, and furthermore, some active subscriptions are being charged twice. This has affected 378 users and is causing high business impact.

title: Timeout errors in Analytics Dashboard Sandbox (EU-West)
description: When attempting to access the Analytics Dashboard in our EU-West sandbox environment, we are consistently encountering timeout errors. This issue is affecting 67 users and is hindering our testing capabilities.

title: Total outage of Analytics Dashboard in Production (ANZ)
description: We are currently experiencing a full outage of the production Analytics Dashboard for the Australia/New Zealand region. 203 users are completely unable to access the service. This is a critical issue with high business impact.

title: SSO Login failures due to upstream errors
description: We are seeing errors related to upstream dependencies and third-party API availability when using the SSO Integration Module in production (ANZ). Currently, there are no reported user impacts. We think this is definitely a race condition in our code causing these API conflicts.

title: API Schema errors and 429s in Payment Gateway Sandbox
description: In the US-West sandbox environment for Payment Gateway v2, we are encountering API schema validation errors. Additionally, webhook retries are exhausting, and we are receiving HTTP 429 status codes. This is affecting 4 users and has low business impact, but blocks integration testing.

title: Status page showing blank screen
description: The status page is just showing a blank screen. It is affecting about 57 users. Not sure why it is not loading the components.

title: Billing errors in Subscription Manager
description: One of our users in the EU-West production environment is reporting that their invoice is incorrect, including wrong tax amounts, and they have also received a chargeback notice. We believe the Subscription Manager is not calculating these fees correctly.

title: UI elements failing to render on Status Page
description: In the APAC production region, certain UI elements on the Status Page are not rendering correctly. This visual glitch is affecting 17 users and preventing them from reading specific status updates.

title: Application crashes and failover issues in Dev
description: During our development testing in EU-West, the Onboarding Wizard application is crashing. We also noticed that the expected failover did not occur. This is impacting 107 users. We are unsure if this is a failure in the wizard logic itself or if the Client Error Reporting SDK is failing to handle the exception properly.

title: Duplicate charges and incorrect invoices in Production
description: We are receiving widespread reports of billing inaccuracies in the ME production environment via Subscription Manager. Specifically, users are seeing duplicate charges on their subscriptions and invoices that do not match the correct amounts. This has affected 534 users and is causing high business impact.

title: Critical performance degradation in Analytics Dashboard
description: The production Analytics Dashboard in US-West is experiencing severe latency issues, resulting in slow performance for the mobile app. This is impacting approximately 7,999 users and is considered a critical issue with high business impact.

title: Fee Analyzer performance degradation and database errors
description: We are experiencing significant issues with the Fee Analyzer tool in our EU-Central production environment. The replication lag has become unacceptably high, causing delays in data availability. Additionally, we have detected database deadlocks occurring intermittently. This is affecting our ability to process fees efficiently, though currently only a couple of users are heavily impacted. Please investigate the internal state of the Fee Analyzer as it seems to be struggling under the current load.

title: Intermittent 503 errors and full outages on Attribution Engine in LATAM
description: Hello, we are reporting intermittent failures on the Attribution Engine service in the LATAM region. Specifically, we are seeing 503 Service Unavailable responses from the endpoint. While some requests succeed, others fail completely, leading to periods of full outage for the affected users. This has been occurring sporadically and impacts about 4 users directly. We have logs showing the 503 errors starting at [Time] and continuing in bursts. Please check the service health for the LATAM cluster.

title: Missing audit log entries in LDAP Connector
description: We have noticed that the LDAP Connector is not recording all activities in the audit logs. Several entries are missing from the logs for the past 24 hours in our US-West production environment. We have verified that the actions were performed, but they do not appear in the connector's audit trail. This affects approximately 9 users who rely on these logs for compliance tracking. Please investigate why the LDAP Connector is failing to log these events.

title: CRITICAL: Refund Manager API returning empty responses
description: URGENT: The Refund Manager API in our LATAM production environment is consistently returning empty responses. This is a critical issue impacting 4,414 users. We are unable to retrieve refund status or initiate new refunds because the API call succeeds but contains no data. This started approximately 2 hours ago. Please prioritize this investigation as it is halting our refund processing workflows entirely.

title: Status Page rate limits, webhook failures, and malformed JSON in Dev
description: In our development environment (US-West), we are encountering multiple issues with the Status Page component. First, we are hitting rate limits more frequently than expected, which causes webhook retries to exhaust and fail. Second, when responses do come back, we are occasionally receiving malformed JSON that cannot be parsed by our integration. This affects 294 users testing the workflow. Please check the rate limiting configuration and the JSON serialization logic for the Status Page API.

title: Chat Widget timeouts and slow performance on mobile
description: We have observed that the Chat Widget is experiencing timeouts, particularly on mobile devices. The mobile app performance also seems degraded when the widget is active, leading to slower load times and occasional hangs. This is happening in the EU-West production environment. While no users are currently blocked from using the service, the experience is poor. We see timeout errors in the network logs after 30 seconds of inactivity. Please investigate the latency sources for the widget on mobile clients.

title: CRITICAL: Incorrect currency conversion and missing refunds in Payment Gateway v2 (Dev/APAC)
description: We are seeing critical data integrity issues in the Payment Gateway v2 within our APAC development environment. Currency conversions are being calculated incorrectly, leading to significant discrepancies in transaction amounts. Furthermore, refunds are not being reflected in the balance updates. This affects 12,854 test users and blocks our release validation. Please investigate the conversion logic and refund processing flow in the gateway.

title: Help Center timeouts and rate limit hits in Sandbox
description: Our sandbox environment in APAC is experiencing frequent timeouts when accessing the Help Center. We are also hitting rate limits quickly, which prevents us from testing bulk operations. This is impacting 31 users on our internal team who are trying to validate content. The timeouts occur consistently on complex query pages. Please look into the resource allocation and rate limiting thresholds for the sandbox Help Center instance.

title: Overcharges and incorrect currency conversion in Payment Gateway v2 (ME/Prod)
description: We are reporting a high-impact issue with the Payment Gateway v2 in our Middle East production region. Customers are being overcharged due to incorrect currency conversion calculations. Approximately 693 users have been affected by these billing errors. We have identified that the conversion rate applied at the time of charge differs from the expected rate, resulting in higher amounts being deducted. Please investigate the currency conversion service within the gateway.

title: Out of disk space error on Attribution Engine
description: We are receiving alerts that the Attribution Engine is running out of disk space. The disk usage has hit a critical level, which is causing some processes to fail or slow down. This is happening in our US-East production environment. Currently, 2 users are experiencing delays in report generation due to this resource constraint. Please check the storage allocation for the Attribution Engine and recommend a solution to free up space or expand the volume.

title: Analytics Dashboard audit log gap detected
description: We have noticed a gap in the audit logs for the Analytics Dashboard. Certain actions taken by users are not being recorded in the dashboard's internal audit trail. This is occurring in our US-East production environment and affects 3 users who require these logs for security reviews. We are confident the actions were performed, but the Analytics Dashboard failed to log them. Please investigate the logging mechanism of the dashboard.

title: Incorrect invoices and chargeback notices on Payment Gateway v2
description: We have received multiple chargeback notices from financial institutions, and upon review, the associated invoices generated by the Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-Central production environment are incorrect. The discrepancies involve billing amounts and dates. This has resulted in unnecessary disputes. Please review the invoice generation logic and the synchronization with chargeback events to identify why the invoices are mismatched.

title: CRITICAL: Feedback Collector slow response and connection pool exhaustion
description: The Feedback Collector service in our APAC development environment is experiencing severe performance degradation. We are seeing extremely slow responses, often leading to timeouts. Logs indicate that the database connection pool is exhausted, preventing new queries from executing. This is blocking 13,937 users from submitting feedback and is a critical blocker for our team. Please investigate the database connection handling and optimize the query performance for the collector.

title: Billing discrepancies: Incorrect invoices, tax, and double charges in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are observing multiple billing-related errors in the Payment Gateway v2 for our ANZ production customers. Specifically, we have complaints about incorrect invoice totals, wrong tax amounts applied, and subscriptions being charged twice. These issues seem related but affect different parts of the billing flow. Approximately 175 users are impacted. We are unsure if the error originates in the gateway's calculation engine or the record-keeping system. Please investigate the root cause of these billing inaccuracies.

title: High impact: Incorrect invoices in Payment Gateway v2 (Staging/ME)
description: In our Middle East staging environment, we are consistently seeing incorrect invoices generated by the Payment Gateway v2. The amounts listed do not match the subscription tiers selected by the test users. This is affecting 152 internal testers and is preventing us from certifying the new billing features for production. Please investigate the invoice generation logic in the staging gateway to identify why the amounts are being miscalculated.

title: Login issues in LATAM dev
description: We are having trouble logging into the Permission Engine in our development environment. Some users say the MFA code doesn't work and others just see an error page when trying to use SSO. It's affecting about 46 people but not sure exactly when it started. Please help.

title: Production SSO loop and missing MFA in US-East
description: We are experiencing critical authentication failures in our production US-East region using Payment Gateway v2. Approximately 641 users are affected. When attempting to log in via SSO, the browser gets stuck in a redirect loop. Additionally, for those who do bypass the loop or attempt direct login, the MFA prompt fails to appear, preventing successful authentication. We need urgent resolution as this is blocking transactions.

title: Staging API returning 500 and empty responses in ANZ
description: In our staging environment (ANZ region), the Analytics Dashboard is encountering backend issues. When calling the API, we are receiving HTTP 500 errors or empty response bodies. Consequently, our webhook retries have exhausted because the system isn't acknowledging receipt or providing valid data. This is currently affecting only one user but blocks our testing pipeline. Logs indicate the failures started after the latest deployment.

title: Password reset links expiring immediately in Staging ANZ
description: We are seeing an issue in our staging environment (ANZ) where password reset links for the SSO Integration Module appear to expire instantly upon generation. Users report that by the time they click the link, it is already invalid. This is affecting around 37 users and is disrupting our onboarding tests. We are unsure if this is an SSO configuration issue or related to the Group Sync service, as user groups are also not updating correctly during these attempts.

title: Gateway timeouts and errors in US-West staging
description: Our staging environment for Payment Gateway v2 in US-West is throwing a lot of errors. We are seeing HTTP 429s and timeouts when trying to process payments. It is impacting our ability to test and is urgent. Please check.

title: UI rendering and form submission failures in EU-West Status Page
description: We are reporting moderate impact on our production Status Page in the EU-West region. Approximately 52 users are affected. The issues include a specific UI element not rendering on the dashboard, a form that fails to submit when trying to update status entries, and general misalignment of UI components on the main view. These issues appear to be client-side rendering problems that prevent proper interaction with the status update interface.

title: Chat Widget capacity and quota errors in ME
description: In our production Middle East environment, the Chat Widget is failing to autoscale when traffic spikes. Users are hitting capacity limits and we are seeing 'quota exceeded' messages. We are not sure if the scaling mechanism in the widget itself is broken or if the underlying billing ledger is incorrectly reporting our usage limits. 30 users are currently unable to start new chats. Please investigate both the widget scaling logic and our account quota status.

title: Billing data lag and index issues in US-East
description: We are noticing discrepancies in our production Billing Engine in US-East. Reports suggest an index rebuild is required, and we are seeing high replication lag between our primary and secondary databases. This is affecting about 15 users who are seeing outdated balance information. We are unsure if the issue is isolated to the billing engine's data layer or if it is stemming from the Revenue Recognition Engine's data sync processes. Please advise on where to look.

title: Webhook failures and rate limiting in ME Payment Gateway
description: Our production Payment Gateway v2 in the ME region is experiencing issues with outbound webhooks not firing. Simultaneously, we are encountering 'rate limit exceeded' errors when attempting to retry these webhooks manually or via API calls. This is affecting approximately 84 users' transaction confirmations. We need to know if the rate limiting is correctly configured for our account tier and why the webhooks are failing to trigger initially.

title: Audit log gaps in ANZ Analytics
description: We have detected gaps in the audit logs for our production Analytics Dashboard in the ANZ region. About 31 users are affected by this missing data. This is definitely an identity provider outage on your end causing the logs to fail capture. We need you to fix the IDP connection so our audit trail is complete again.

title: Intermittent SSO failures in ME Dev
description: In our development environment for the SSO Integration Module (ME region), we are experiencing intermittent login failures. Some sessions work fine, while others result in what appears to be a full outage for the authentication service. Since this is development only, there is no business impact, but we need to understand why the service is flapping between working and down states to proceed with integration testing.

title: Provisioning and sync stuck in APAC Dev
description: We have a high-priority issue in our development environment (APAC) regarding the SSO Integration Module. User provisioning processes are stuck and not completing, and we are observing that the group sync process is also halted. This is affecting 666 users in our test data set. We need assistance identifying why these background jobs are not progressing.

title: Service unresponsive in EU-West Analytics
description: The Analytics Dashboard service in our production EU-West environment is currently unresponsive. We are seeing timeouts when attempting to load dashboards or query data. This is affecting 8 users but is blocking their current work. Please investigate the service health.

title: Security warnings and privilege issues in EU-West Sandbox
description: We are seeing elevated privileges being observed in the logs for our sandbox environment (EU-West) Analytics Dashboard. Additionally, users are encountering certificate warnings when accessing the tool. This is affecting 10 users. We believe the Analytics product itself is compromised or misconfigured regarding security certificates and user roles. Please check the application's security settings immediately.

title: Webhook delivery issues in ME Payment Gateway
description: In our production ME environment for Payment Gateway v2, we are noticing that webhooks are not firing for certain transactions. When we check the API, we are also seeing 'rate limit exceeded' responses. This is currently affecting 3 users and has low business impact, but we need to understand if the rate limits are too strict for our current volume or if there is a bug preventing webhook triggers.

title: Critical performance degradation on Role Manager (US-East)
description: Our Role Manager instance in US-East has become extremely slow, affecting roughly 1100 users. We are seeing high latency across the board. We can't pinpoint the root cause but this is blocking our admin teams. Please investigate urgently as it's a critical business impact.

title: Data Pipeline issues in ANZ
description: We are experiencing an outage on the Data Pipeline in the ANZ region. Some data is not coming through. High impact. Please check.

title: Identity Vault Login/MFA Failures
description: Users are reporting that Identity Vault is rejecting their MFA codes and preventing logins. The system seems broken on the authentication side. No specific error messages, just failure to enter. Please fix the Identity Vault login functionality.

title: OAuth Service provisioning and sync stuck for 93 users
description: We have observed that user provisioning and synchronization processes within the OAuth Service (LATAM) have stalled. Approximately 93 users are currently unable to complete onboarding due to these stuck jobs. This is causing moderate delays in our deployment schedule. Please investigate the sync status.

title: Payment Gateway v2 metadata error
description: Getting federation metadata mismatch errors on Payment Gateway v2 in EU-West. Affects a small group of users. Please assist.

title: Payment Gateway v2 (ANZ) - Declined transactions and billing errors
description: We are reporting three distinct issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in the ANZ region affecting 17 users: 1) Payments are being declined incorrectly. 2) Some successful transactions are resulting in overcharges. 3) Currency conversion rates appear incorrect. Please investigate these billing and transaction handling errors.

title: Cannot login to Identity Vault in Sandbox (EU-Central)
description: I am unable to log into the Identity Vault sandbox environment in EU-Central. The system rejects my MFA code and fails the login attempt. This appears to be a defect in the Identity Vault service itself. Please restore access.

title: Payment Gateway v2 Throttling and Scaling Issues
description: We are seeing throttling errors and the autoscaling group for Payment Gateway v2 (US-East) is not triggering despite increased load. This is impacting 41 users. We think it's definitely a network configuration error on your end preventing the scaling events. Please correct the network config.

title: Invoice Service double charging customers (APAC Dev)
description: We have identified that the Invoice Service in the APAC development region is charging subscriptions twice, resulting in overcharges for 48 users. This billing logic issue in the Invoice Service needs to be fixed.

title: Garbled characters in Attribution Engine output
description: The Attribution Engine in EU-West is displaying garbled characters. This is a display issue within the product. Please investigate the text rendering.

title: HTTP 429 Errors on SSO Integration Module (Dev)
description: We are encountering frequent HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) responses when interacting with the SSO Integration Module in the US-East development environment. No users are impacted yet, but we need to resolve this rate-limiting issue to proceed with testing.

title: Missing records and data mismatches in Help Center (Staging)
description: Our Help Center staging environment in EU-West is showing significant data inconsistencies. Records are missing from search results, and there are clear mismatches between the displayed data and the source database. This affects 175 users and is a high-impact blocker for our launch.

title: Deploy Manager timeout issues
description: Deploy Manager in EU-West is timing out. Please check upstream dependencies. No user impact reported.

title: SSO Integration Module MFA rejection in LATAM
description: Users in the LATAM production region are reporting that the SSO Integration Module is rejecting valid MFA codes. This prevents successful authentication. Please investigate why the module is failing to validate these tokens.

title: LDAP Connector SSO and Metadata errors
description: We are seeing SSO error pages, federation metadata mismatches, and expired password reset links via the LDAP Connector in EU-West. This affects 3 users. We believe this is a known product limitation of the LDAP Connector. Please confirm if this is expected behavior.

title: SSO Integration Module bulk import failure causing sync stuck in APAC production
description: We are experiencing a critical issue with the SSO Integration Module in our APAC production environment. A bulk import of user identities was initiated this morning, but it appears to have partially failed. Consequently, the synchronization process has become stuck and is no longer progressing. This has resulted in approximately 1,753 users being unable to access services that rely on these identities. We need immediate assistance to unblock the sync and complete the import.

title: Chargeback Handler processing undercharges and failing subscription renewals
description: In our ANZ production environment, the Chargeback Handler seems to be miscalculating amounts, resulting in undercharges for several accounts. We have received formal chargeback notices for these transactions. Additionally, because of the billing discrepancies, approximately 70 subscription renewals have failed to process correctly. This is causing moderate business impact as we are losing revenue and dealing with disputes. Please investigate why the handler is not applying the correct renewal logic.

title: Missing records in Customer Portal sandbox
description: Users in the ME sandbox environment are reporting that some records are missing from the Customer Portal. They think their data was lost. We aren't sure exactly which records or when this started happening, but it is affecting a small group of about 18 users. Please help.

title: Federation metadata mismatch in Payment Gateway v2
description: We are observing a federation metadata mismatch error in the Payment Gateway v2 within our LATAM production environment. This issue is currently affecting only one specific transaction flow or user account. The business impact is low, but we need to resolve this configuration discrepancy to ensure proper validation. Please check the metadata exchange logs.

title: KPI Tracker not applying feature flags correctly
description: There is an issue with the KPI Tracker in our ME production environment. We noticed that the feature flags we configured are not being applied to the dashboard views. It looks like there is some config drift, as the settings seem to revert or aren't taking effect. This is impacting high-priority reporting for 643 users. Please look into why the KPI Tracker is ignoring these flags.

title: Onboarding Wizard slow response
description: The Onboarding Wizard in US-West production is responding very slowly. It takes forever to load steps. Only one user has reported it so far, but it's annoying. Please check.

title: Billing Engine overcharging users in sandbox
description: We are seeing overcharge issues in the Billing Engine within our EU-West sandbox environment. The calculations seem to be adding extra amounts to the invoices. This is affecting a large number of test accounts (873), which is a high impact for our testing cycles. Please investigate why the Billing Engine is producing incorrect totals.

title: Critical data issues in Analytics Dashboard: duplicates, missing data, encoding errors
description: Our APAC production Analytics Dashboard is showing severe data integrity issues. We are seeing a mix of duplicate records, missing data points, and encoding errors in the visualizations. This is affecting over 10,000 users and is a critical business impact. We aren't sure if the issue is with the dashboard rendering or the underlying segment data it's pulling. The data looks corrupted across multiple widgets. Please investigate immediately.

title: Currency conversion wrong in Payment Gateway v2 dev
description: Payment Gateway v2 in APAC dev env is converting currencies incorrectly and charging too much. A few people are complaining. Impact is high for our testing. Please fix.

title: Cohort Builder experiencing high latency
description: The Cohort Builder in our APAC development environment is running extremely slowly. Users are reporting high latency when trying to generate or view cohorts. This is blocking our workflow for 168 users, creating a high-impact bottleneck. We believe the Cohort Builder itself is the source of the delay. Please investigate performance.

title: Payment Gateway v2 receiving unexpected chargeback notices
description: In our LATAM development environment, the Payment Gateway v2 is generating a high volume of chargeback notices. This is occurring for approximately 637 test transactions. The impact is high as it disrupts our settlement simulation testing. We need to understand why the gateway is flagging these as chargebacks when they should be successful or refunded. Please review the gateway logs for these specific test cases.

title: Analytics Dashboard exports corrupted and truncated
description: Users in the US-West production environment are reporting that data exports from the Analytics Dashboard are corrupted. The files appear truncated before completion, leading to perceived data loss. This is affecting 441 users and has a high business impact as reporting deadlines are approaching. We are seeing incomplete CSVs and unopenable XLSX files. Please investigate the export functionality.

title: Account lockouts and certificate warnings in Cache Service
description: We are seeing a critical issue in our US-West production environment with the Cache Service. Numerous users (over 5,000) are getting locked out of their accounts. Along with the lockouts, we are receiving warnings about expired certificates within the Cache Service interface. This is preventing users from accessing cached data and blocking their workflows. We need immediate help to resolve the lockouts and update the certificates.

title: HTTP 429 errors on Analytics Dashboard in sandbox
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our US-West sandbox environment is throwing HTTP 429 errors (Too Many Requests). This is affecting over 1,000 users during our load testing phase. The business impact is critical as we cannot validate performance metrics under load. The dashboard seems to hit rate limits prematurely. Please investigate the API quotas for the sandbox.

title: Role not applied via SSO Integration Module
description: We have noticed that roles are not being applied correctly when users log in via the SSO Integration Module in our US-East production environment. While there is no immediate business impact reported, a specific test user or group is showing the wrong permissions. This seems to be a configuration issue with how the SSO module maps roles. We want to ensure this doesn't affect other users.

title: Chat Widget failing to load in Staging due to upstream timeouts
description: We are experiencing issues with the Chat Widget in the Staging environment (LATAM region). Since this morning, the widget fails to initialize for our test users. When we inspect the network requests, we see that the calls to the third-party API are returning '503 Service Unavailable' errors or timing out after 30 seconds. This prevents the chat from starting, though the rest of the application seems stable. Currently, this is affecting about 26 internal testers. We suspect the dependency is unreachable, but wanted to report it in case it's related to our widget configuration.

title: Webhook Engine hitting rate limits and timing out in Sandbox
description: Our Webhook Engine in the Sandbox environment (ME region) is consistently failing to deliver events. The Load Balancer appears to be completely stuck, causing high replication lag and what looks like database deadlocks on our end. This is blocking over 1000 users and halting all our testing activities. Please investigate the LB health checks immediately as this is impacting our release schedule severely.

We suspect this might be related to our Data Catalog Service as well, as metadata queries are failing, but we can't isolate which component is the root cause. 36 internal users are blocked from reporting tasks.

This is also impacting the mobile app performance for our test users, who are reporting very slow load times. 1156 users are affected, and this is blocking our critical feature validation.

title: Analytics Dashboard returning HTTP 429 and timeouts

Additionally, we are seeing upstream dependency timeouts when trying to load complex reports. This is impacting 450 users and severely slowing down our data analysis workflow. We have increased our rate limits but the issue persists.

title: Payment issues with subscriptions
description: We are having problems with the Payment Gateway v2 in our ANZ production setup. Some payments are getting declined when they shouldn't be, and we've also had reports of customers being charged twice for their subscriptions. It's causing some confusion for our users. Please look into this.

This is a high-impact incident affecting 382 users. Please investigate the Webhook Engine service immediately as nothing is coming through.

title: Data Export Service intermittent failures and slow performance
description: The Data Export Service in our EU-Central production environment is experiencing intermittent failures. When exports do succeed, they are taking significantly longer than usual. This is impacting about 28 users who are waiting on data for weekly reports. The issue seems to happen randomly, making it difficult to reproduce consistently.

title: Incorrect tax and overcharging on Payment Gateway v2

No specific error messages are shown, but the final charge amounts are wrong. We need to correct this to avoid customer disputes.

title: Elevated privileges observed in MFA Manager logs

This involves approximately 41 users. We need to understand why this is happening and ensure that no unauthorized access has occurred. Please investigate the privilege escalation events.

description: A major UI element in the Metrics Engine production dashboard (US-East) is severely misaligned, making the charts unreadable. This is impacting over 20,000 users globally. The alignment issue appears across all modern browsers. This is a critical visual bug that needs immediate attention as it renders the main KPI dashboards unusable.

title: Login issues in Payment Gateway v2 sandbox
description: We are unable to log in to the Payment Gateway v2 in our ME sandbox environment. The MFA codes are being rejected. A few users are affected but we can't get past the login screen. Please help.

Second, when a user tries to submit the form, it fails to go through. We need this fixed ASAP as it's blocking users from reaching out.

Additionally, refunds initiated recently are not reflecting in the account balances. We are also seeing incorrect currency conversion rates applied to these transactions, resulting in unexpected totals. Please investigate these billing engine issues urgently.

title: SSO Login failures: MFA codes rejected and metadata mismatch

When attempting to log in, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) codes are consistently rejected even when entered correctly. We are also seeing federation metadata mismatch errors that prevent the connection from establishing. This is critical as it blocks access for our entire regional team.

title: Analytics Dashboard extremely slow and high latency
description: The Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ production environment is suffering from severe performance degradation. Users report extremely slow response times when loading reports or interacting with the UI. We are observing high latency across the board, making the dashboard practically unusable for our 149 affected users. Please look into why the dashboard is lagging so badly.

title: Chargeback notices received for Subscription Manager accounts
description: We have received chargeback notices for several accounts managed via the Subscription Manager in the EU-Central region. We think this is definitely a dependency failure on your end causing the payments to drop or get flagged incorrectly. Please check the underlying services connected to the subscription module, as we believe that is where the fault lies.

title: SSO Errors and MFA rejections in Development environment
description: In our ME development environment, the SSO Integration Module is throwing errors. It is unclear if the issue is with the SSO module itself or the authorization step preceding it, as the failure happens during the authentication flow. This is blocking development for 56 users.

The downloads often stop midway or produce unreadable formats. This is affecting nearly 500 users who rely on these exports for reporting. We need to ensure the export function generates complete, valid files.

Furthermore, active sessions are expiring unexpectedly, and many users are being locked out of their accounts after multiple login attempts. This is impacting over 2,200 users and halting operations.

title: Bulk import failures and synchronization delays in SSO Module
description: In our ME staging environment, we are noticing significant synchronization delays when updating user groups via the SSO Integration Module. Additionally, a recent bulk import operation failed completely. title: Audit log gap detected in Metrics Engine sandbox
description: We have noticed a gap in the audit logs within the Metrics Engine sandbox environment in the ME region. Specific user actions that should have been recorded are missing from the log stream. We need to investigate why these entries are not appearing in the audit trail to ensure compliance and data integrity.

title: Admin Console intermittent failures and high latency in Dev
description: The Admin Console in our ME development environment is experiencing intermittent failures. Users report high latency when navigating the interface, and actions sometimes fail to complete or hang indefinitely. This instability is affecting over 1,000 users and is critical for our testing efforts. Please investigate the performance and reliability issues.

title: SSO Session expirations, expired reset links, and error pages
description: Our SSO Integration Module in the EU-West sandbox is showing signs of instability. Users are experiencing unexpected session expirations. Additionally, password reset links are reported as expired before they are even clicked. We are also seeing frequent SSO error pages during login attempts. It is unclear if these are lifecycle management issues with identity provisioning or authentication failures within the SSO module itself.

title: Payments declined in Production via Payment Gateway v2
description: We are seeing a moderate number of payment declines in our ME production environment using Payment Gateway v2. 14 users have reported failed transactions. The error messages are generic. We are unsure if the issue is with the gateway processing the payment or if the currency conversion step involved in the transaction is causing the decline. Please help us diagnose the cause of these failures.

description: Webhooks are not firing correctly in the Role Manager staging environment in ANZ. We are not receiving the expected notifications when roles are changed. Please check why the webhooks are failing.

title: Analytics Dashboard data flags and log gaps

title: Analytics exports from production (APAC) are arriving truncated and corrupted

When we download the reports, the resulting files appear to be corrupted or cut off before the end. Specifically, the CSV files are truncated, meaning they stop mid-row or fail to open in Excel properly. We haven't noticed any other impact on the dashboard usage itself, just these export issues. Please investigate why the downloads are incomplete.

description: We have identified several concerning behaviors in our US-West staging environment for the Analytics Dashboard that are impacting our security review. We are seeing certificate warnings when accessing the service, which suggests a configuration issue. More importantly, our audit logs are missing entries for recent activities, which is a major compliance concern. Additionally, some internal tools are reporting elevated privileges for certain service accounts that shouldn't have them. This is affecting approximately 1,700 users in our test group and is blocking our release pipeline. We need urgent assistance to secure the environment and restore audit visibility.

title: Subscription renewal failures and double charges in Payment Gateway v2 staging
description: We are encountering inconsistent billing behavior in our US-East staging environment for Payment Gateway v2. Some subscriptions that should have renewed are showing as 'not renewed' despite valid payment methods, while others are being charged twice for the same period. This is confusing our testing team and has affected around 398 test user accounts. We need to understand why the renewal logic is failing in some cases and duplicating transactions in others.

When a new user goes through the flow, it sometimes creates a duplicate account instead of updating the existing one. Furthermore, the provisioning process often gets stuck in a 'pending' state and never completes. This doesn't impact live business operations, but it makes testing new user flows very difficult as we have to manually clean up duplicates and retry provisioning.

description: We are experiencing intermittent API errors with the Analytics Dashboard in our Middle East staging environment. When making requests, we occasionally receive HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors, even though our traffic volume is low. Other times, the API returns HTTP 500 errors or sends back a 200 OK status with an empty response body. This is happening sporadically and affects our integration testing, though it currently only impacts one primary developer account.

title: Production login failures for APAC users via OAuth Service
description: We are reporting login failures in our APAC production environment. Users are unable to authenticate through our OAuth Service. We need this investigated to restore access for these users.

We haven't observed a direct business impact on user-facing dashboards yet, but the data sync failures are concerning. Please check the API stability and webhook configuration.

description: Testing Payment Gateway v2 in our EU-West staging environment has revealed issues with transaction processing. We are seeing incorrect tax amounts calculated for certain products, leading to overcharges in some test cases. Consequently, some payments are being declined unexpectedly, likely due to validation failures on the incorrect totals. This affects our billing logic tests, though no real users are involved. We need to correct the tax configuration and transaction handling.

title: Data mismatches and corrupted exports in APAC production Analytics Dashboard

The figures shown in the dashboard do not match our source of truth, indicating a data mismatch. When we attempt to export this data for reconciliation, the files come through corrupted or with inconsistent formatting. This is affecting about 32 users who rely on these reports for decision-making. We are unsure if the issue originates from the visualization layer or the underlying data catalog feeding the dashboard.

This is not consistent, making it hard to reproduce, but it is affecting approximately 45 users who encounter access denial errors randomly. We need to determine why the service is occasionally becoming unavailable.

title: Widespread login failures via SSO Integration Module in EU-Central production
description: We are experiencing a high volume of login failures in our EU-Central production environment using the SSO Integration Module. Approximately 489 users are currently unable to access their accounts due to authentication errors during the SSO handoff. This is a significant issue impacting user productivity. Please investigate the SSO connector and authentication flow immediately.

title: Payment Gateway API returning 429s and empty responses in US-West production
description: We are seeing rate limiting issues (HTTP 429) and empty API responses when calling the Payment Gateway v2 in our US-West production environment. Please check with your upstream providers.

description: Our SSO Integration Module in the ANZ production region is failing to send webhooks. The system logs show that webhook retries have been exhausted for several events, and for some users, the webhook isn't firing at all. This is critically impacting 3,671 users who rely on these notifications. We think it's because of database contention in our own cluster causing the locks, so please check if your side is contributing to that load.

This affects approximately 4 users currently and is causing frustration with account access.

title: SSO Integration Module issues: Federation metadata mismatch and expired password reset links
description: We are experiencing problems with the SSO Integration Module in our production APAC environment. Specifically, users are encountering a 'federation metadata mismatch' error when attempting to log in. Additionally, several users have reported that password reset links are expiring before they can be used. This is affecting approximately 88 users and has a moderate business impact. Please investigate the metadata configuration and the password reset link expiration settings.

title: Analytics Dashboard API returning empty responses in production LATAM

This issue is impacting a high number of users (880) and has a significant business impact as we cannot retrieve necessary data. The API calls appear to complete but return no data. Please check the API service status and data retrieval mechanisms urgently.

title: Permission denied errors in Funnel Analyzer
description: We are seeing unexpected 'permission denied' errors in the Funnel Analyzer. Several users are unable to access certain views or reports. This is happening in the US-West production environment. We are not sure why this is occurring as their roles haven't changed recently. It's affecting about 46 users. Please check why they are being denied access.

title: Wallet Service slow performance and timeouts
description: The Wallet Service in the US-West production environment is performing very slowly. Please investigate the performance issues and the timeouts.

title: Analytics Dashboard partial outage and pod restarts
description: We are observing a partial outage with the Analytics Dashboard in the LATAM production environment. The pods seem to be restarting repeatedly. While there are no affected users reported at this time (0 users) and the business impact is currently marked as none, the instability is concerning. Please investigate the cause of the repeated pod restarts and the partial outage status.

title: Chargeback notice received from Billing Engine
description: We have received a chargeback notice related to transactions processed through the Billing Engine in the APAC production environment. Please investigate the transaction history and the source of the chargeback.

description: We are testing the Tax Calculator in the EU-Central sandbox environment. We received a chargeback notice during our test transactions. This is impacting 195 test users. We are unsure if the fault lies with the core Payment Gateway v2 processing logic or the API response handling during the refund flow. This is a high-priority issue for our release validation.

title: Unexpected session expirations on Tax Calculator (EU-Central Prod)
description: Users of the Tax Calculator in the EU-Central Production environment are reporting that their sessions are expiring unexpectedly and frequently. This forces them to re-authenticate repeatedly, disrupting their workflow. This issue is currently affecting 485 users and has a high business impact on our customer support teams who rely on this tool.

title: Critical: Subscription renewal failure affecting all users in EU-West
description: We are experiencing a critical issue where our subscriptions are not renewing automatically. This is affecting our entire user base in the EU-West region, totaling approximately 4,277 users. The system should have processed renewals, but they have failed to execute. Please investigate immediately as this is blocking our service continuity.

title: Webhooks failing and API schema errors in US-East Production
description: We are seeing webhook deliveries not firing for transaction events in our US-East production environment. Additionally, when we attempt to call the API, we are receiving schema validation errors. This is impacting about 585 users. We need these webhooks to trigger reliably to keep our order states synchronized.

title: HTTP 429 Errors and Malformed JSON in Analytics Dashboard (ME Region)
description: Our Analytics Dashboard in the Middle East region is returning HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors. When the requests do go through, the JSON response payload is malformed and cannot be parsed by our client. This is a critical blocker for 2,939 users who rely on these analytics for real-time reporting.

title: User Sync and Provisioning Stuck in LATAM Production
description: The SSO Integration Module in our LATAM production environment appears to have stalled. User synchronization is stuck and no new accounts are being provisioned despite valid triggers from our IdP. This is affecting 107 users and causing a backlog of pending access requests. We need this sync process resumed urgently.

title: Billing Discrepancies: Currency Conversion, Refund Status, and Renewal
description: We are observing several billing irregularities in our US-East setup. First, currency conversion rates appear incorrect on recent invoices. Second, a processed refund is not reflecting in the customer's balance. Finally, the subsequent subscription renewal failed to process. These issues are currently isolated to 1 user account but need resolution to prevent broader impact.

title: Identity Vault SSO Redirect Loop
description: Users are getting caught in an infinite redirect loop when trying to log in via Identity Vault. The authentication flow starts, redirects to the identity provider, and then loops back to the application's login page without establishing a session. This is happening in our US-West production environment and is blocking 22 users from accessing the platform.

title: Incorrect Invoice and Overcharge in Staging Environment
description: While testing payment flows in our LATAM staging environment, we noticed that the generated invoice amounts are incorrect and result in an overcharge compared to the agreed pricing plan. This does not affect production, but we need to understand the calculation logic error before we go live with this configuration.

title: Critical Access Denied Errors for All Users in LATAM
description: We are receiving 'Access Denied' errors for all login attempts through the SSO Integration Module in the LATAM region. This is a complete blockage preventing 6,220 users from accessing the service. The issue started recently and is critical for our operations. Please escalate immediately.

title: Staging SSO Import Failures and Duplicate Accounts
description: In our US-East staging environment, bulk user imports are failing completely. Additionally, we are seeing duplicate account creations and 'account not found' errors during sync attempts. We think this is definitely a version incompatibility problem between our current API connector and the updated SSO module, causing the data mapping to break.

title: Undercharging Detected in EU-Central Production
description: We have identified that transactions are being processed at a lower amount than configured, resulting in undercharges. This is affecting approximately 10 users in our EU-Central production region. We need to verify the billing configuration and understand why the correct tariff is not being applied.

title: Notification Hub Sandbox: Quota Exhaustion and Scaling Issues
description: In our LATAM sandbox environment, we are hitting quota limits unexpectedly. Furthermore, autoscaling does not seem to be triggering to handle the load, and we suspect a memory leak is contributing to the performance degradation. This is impacting 17 internal testers.

title: Service Outage (503 Errors) in APAC Staging
description: The SSO Integration Module in our APAC staging environment is returning 503 Service Unavailable errors, indicating a full outage for that region. This is preventing 979 users from testing the integration. We need this service restored to continue our validation process.

title: Refund Not Showing, Double Charges, and Overcharges in EU-West
description: We are seeing multiple billing errors in production EU-West: refunds are not reflecting in user balances, some users are being charged twice for a single subscription, and there are instances of overcharging. We think this is because of database contention causing transaction locks and duplicate processing. Please investigate the billing pipeline integrity.

title: Account Lockouts and Missing Audit Logs in Analytics Dashboard
description: A few users (8 total) are experiencing account lockouts when accessing the Analytics Dashboard in EU-West. Upon checking the security logs, we found that entries for these events are missing, and there are observations of elevated privileges being granted without corresponding audit trails. This needs review for potential security or logging configuration issues.

title: Empty Responses and Malformed JSON from Queue Manager API in Staging
description: In our ME staging environment, calls to the Queue Manager API are returning empty responses or malformed JSON structures. This is affecting 9 developers trying to test message queue integrations. We need a fix or clarification on why the API is not returning valid data payloads.

title: API Schema Error causing Webhook Retries to Exhaust in Production Analytics Dashboard
description: We are experiencing issues with our production Analytics Dashboard in the APAC region. Since this morning, we are seeing API schema errors when trying to sync data via webhooks. The system attempts to retry the connection multiple times but eventually exhausts the retries and fails to update the dashboard metrics. This is affecting about 8 users who rely on these dashboards for daily reporting. The business impact is currently considered low as manual updates are possible, but we need this resolved to ensure data consistency.

title: Customer Portal down with 504 errors, likely due to admin configuration mistake
description: We are seeing HTTP 504 timeouts and certificate expired warnings on the Customer Portal in the US-West production environment. Honestly, this is definitely an operator error situation. One of our admins must have messed up the certificate settings or the proxy configuration during our last maintenance window. We think it's because of a typo in the config file. Please just revert whatever we changed or tell us where to fix the certificate path.

title: Autoscaling policy not responding to CPU spikes in production
description: We are running a Session Controller instance in our ANZ production environment. Recently we noticed that when the CPU usage on the nodes spikes significantly, the autoscaling group does not trigger any new instances. This has happened a few times now. We have checked the scaling policies and they seem to be configured correctly for CPU utilization. Currently, only about 3 users are experiencing slow session responsiveness when these spikes occur, so it is not a full outage, but we need to fix this before it impacts more people. Please investigate why the auto-scaling mechanism is failing to engage.

title: URGENT: Billing Disputes Handler rejecting payments and charging wrong amounts
description: We are seeing a critical issue with the Billing Disputes Handler in our sandbox environment. Since yesterday, about 126 users in the LATAM region have had their payments declined even though we have funds available. Worse, when the system does process, it's overcharging us significantly compared to the expected rates. This is blocking our launch testing and causing a high business impact. Please check why the Billing Disputes Handler is malfunctioning.

title: Development Environment SSO issues: Duplicate Accounts, Expired Reset Links, and MFA Rejections
description:
We are experiencing multiple issues with the SSO Integration Module in our US-East development environment. 

First, when users attempt to register via the portal, we are seeing duplicate accounts being created for the same email address. This is causing confusion during testing.

Second, password reset links are expiring almost immediately after being sent. Users are clicking the link and getting an 'expired' error within seconds, which suggests a clock skew or token duration issue on our end, but we haven't changed any config.

Finally, about 60 of our test users are reporting that valid MFA codes are being rejected by the system. They enter the 6-digit code correctly, but the auth fails.

The impact is moderate as it is blocking our QA team from completing the SSO workflow tests. Please advise.

title: Payment Gateway config issues
description: Hi, we think something is wrong with the configuration in the payment gateway. It seems like the settings aren't applying correctly or maybe the config is out of sync? We haven't noticed any major errors yet but wanted to check if everything looks ok on your end. Thanks.

title: Overcharges occurring in production on Payment Gateway v2
description: We started seeing overcharges from our customers this morning. Everything was working fine yesterday. We are using Payment Gateway v2 in our production environment (US-West region). I have attached a screenshot of a transaction where the customer was charged $25.00 instead of the expected $20.00. This is happening on all credit card transactions, not just one specific type. Please investigate as soon as possible, we are getting a lot of complaints.

title: Staging environment MFA failures and account locks
description: We're seeing multiple issues in our US-West staging environment with Payment Gateway v2. About 5 users are getting their MFA codes rejected immediately upon entry, which then triggers the account lockout mechanism. This is definitely an operator error on our side, likely because we're using the wrong user roles for testing. We just need someone to confirm if our configuration is the root cause so we can fix our internal processes.

title: SSO redirect loop in production for EU-Central users
description: We are experiencing an issue with our SSO Integration Module in the production environment within the EU-Central region. When users attempt to log in, they get caught in a redirect loop instead of completing the authentication process. The login page loads briefly, then redirects back to itself multiple times until the browser throws an error. This started happening around 10 minutes ago and is affecting all login attempts through our corporate identity provider.

title: Login issues with partner integration
description: We can't seem to get into the portal using the SSO option today. It just hangs for a while and then fails. Only happens to a couple of people on our team. Is this a known issue? Please check when you can.
